title: Performing in "Autonomy Theater": Balancing t he Needs of Social Media Researchers with Perspectives of High Profile Figures
affiliations: and George Washington University

detail.title: Performing in "Autonomy Theater": Balancing t he Needs of Social Media Researchers with Perspectives of High Profile Figures

declarations.ethicsApproval: The authors met with the high profile figures over Zoom and recorded each session with express permission from the participants in line with GWU IRB (#NCR234951).
declarations.funderStatement: The Institute for Data, Democracy & Politics (IDDP) launched in 2019 with the support of the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation. IDDP's mission is to help the public, journalists and policymakers understand digital media's influence on public dialogue and opinion, and to develop sound solutions to disinformation and other ills that arise in these spaces.

detail.abstract: Publicly available social media data has become increasingly important for understanding issues of public interest. As voluntary researcher access to such data becomes more restricted, policymakers have proposed mandates requiring large platforms to share high reach public data with researchers through mechanisms we call public content libraries. Although this data is often described as less sensitive, the collection and use still raises meaningful privacy and ethical questions. This study explores how individuals most represented in these datasets—high profile figures—perceive their own privacy, the privacy of others, and researchers’ use of public social media content. Drawing on 18 in-depth interviews, we find that high profile figures actively manage physical, emotional, and financial boundaries online, adjusting their posting practices based on their experiences. Participants understood their content was public and circulating through a suite of third party marketing tools. Despite this increased awareness of third parties, high profile figures still prefer "autonomy theater,” an understanding that data ethics practices may seem performative in a world of near ubiquitous surveillance but nonetheless acknowledge individual’s autonomy—which researchers and journalists working in the public interest to disseminate information that is trusted should not ignore. To perform in autonomy theater, researchers and policymakers may understand that a high profile figure’s expectations of privacy are low, even for deleted posts and bystanders in their content, but still take steps to protect individuals when possible and reasonable—aiming to balance the needs of social media researchers with the perspectives of high profile figures. We conclude with a series of recommendations for researchers working with social media data and policymakers who mandate that platforms offer some type of public content library.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨高知名度人物对社交媒体公共数据隐私和伦理问题的看法，发现他们偏好"自主权剧场"——在普遍监控环境下看似表演性的数据伦理实践，但仍承认个体自主权，为研究人员和政策制定者提供平衡数据使用与隐私保护的指导。
AI.research_question: 高知名度人物如何看待社交媒体公共内容的隐私问题以及研究人员对这些数据的使用？
AI.motivation: 随着研究人员自愿获取社交媒体数据的途径受限，政策制定者提议建立公共内容库，但这些数据的收集和使用仍存在隐私和伦理问题，需要了解数据主体的观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界管理理论、隐私期望理论、自主权剧场概念
AI.method: 18个深度访谈
AI.findings: 高知名度人物积极管理物理、情感和财务边界，调整发帖行为；虽然意识到内容公开且被第三方工具传播，但仍偏好"自主权剧场"——承认个体自主权的表演性数据伦理实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"自主权剧场"概念，扩展了在普遍监控环境下对数据伦理实践的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和政策制定者提供具体建议，帮助平衡社交媒体数据研究需求与高知名度人物的隐私期望。

title: Can a Skill be Measured or Assessed? 6-Level Skills Development Approach to Skill Assessment
affiliations: Hochschule Fresenius - University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Can a Skill be Measured or Assessed? 6-Level Skills Development Approach to Skill Assessment
detail.abstract: This paper reviews historic and current definitions of skill as a concept, as well as frameworks that have been applied to analyse levels of skills development across the academic and professional spectrum. The author proposes a 6-level chart of skill development based on the "can-do descriptors" approach by CEFR, also known as the ability assessment approach, for further discussion, development, and application. The proposed chart is based on six levels. These are organized into two Entry levels, two Operational Use levels and two Strategic Vision levels. Further debate on the typology of skills by Deloitte, LinkedIn Research and World Economic Forum is presented as of 2020 documentation. Its dynamic manner of paradigms changing the importance of a wide array of skills (alternatively denominated as employability skills, soft skills and/or 21st Century skills) are analysed, both for educators and employers.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了技能概念的历史和当前定义，提出了基于CEFR能力评估方法的6级技能发展图表，并分析了Deloitte、LinkedIn和世界经济论坛关于技能类型学的讨论。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个有效的技能发展评估框架？
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏统一的技能发展评估标准，需要建立一个基于能力评估方法的系统化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: CEFR（欧洲语言共同参考框架）的"能做描述"方法，Deloitte、LinkedIn和世界经济论坛的技能类型学。
AI.method: 文献回顾和理论分析，提出基于CEFR的6级技能发展图表。
AI.findings: 提出了包含两个入门级、两个操作使用级和两个战略愿景级的6级技能发展图表。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CEFR方法扩展到一般技能评估领域，建立了系统化的技能发展评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育者和雇主提供了实用的技能评估工具，有助于技能发展和人才培养。

title: How Aesthetics influences Aversion of Routing Operations Algorithms
affiliations: Leiden University - Leiden Institute of Advanced Computer Science (LIACS), Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and Erasmus Research Institute of Management (ERIM)

detail.title: How Aesthetics influences Aversion of Routing Operations Algorithms
detail.abstract: Calculating optimal routes is useless when route planners decide not to use them. This is not a hypothetical problem many people display algorithm aversion, resisting to follow algorithmic advice even when this advice is good. Indeed, accurately predicting the decisions of route planners enables more efficient traffic management, empowering route planning systems to provide effective executive route plans. In existing research on vehicle route problems, visual appeal is assumed as a factor that influences route planners' decisions, and its effectiveness is assumed to follow certain rules. However, these assumptions lack any support from empirical research and may not accurately capture route planners' behavior patterns at all. We develop empirical studies to explore the role of a route plan's visual appeal in planners' route choices. This contributes to bridging the gap between vehicle routing problems, which focus on optimizing routes in ideal situations, and route planners' behavior in real-world scenarios, since even mathematically optimal routes may not be the best routes in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了路线规划中算法厌恶现象，发现即使算法提供最优路线，规划师仍可能因视觉吸引力等因素拒绝采纳。研究通过实证方法验证了视觉吸引力对路线选择的影响，填补了理想优化与现实行为之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 视觉吸引力如何影响路线规划师的路线选择决策？
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设视觉吸引力影响路线规划决策，但缺乏实证支持。现实中规划师常拒绝算法推荐的最优路线，导致交通管理效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法厌恶理论、行为决策理论、车辆路径问题理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法
AI.findings: 视觉吸引力显著影响路线规划师的决策行为，即使面对数学上的最优路线，规划师仍可能基于视觉因素选择其他路线。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了车辆路径问题理论与现实规划行为之间的理论空白，为算法厌恶现象提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助路线规划系统设计更有效的执行路线计划，提升交通管理效率，使算法建议更符合实际使用场景。

title: Assessing the Relative Importance of the Drivers of CO2 Emissions in the Selected Emerging Economies Using Machine Learning Approach
affiliations: VIPS

detail.title: Assessing the Relative Importance of the Drivers of CO2 Emissions in the Selected Emerging Economies Using Machine Learning Approach
detail.abstract: The main objective of the present research is to answer a key research question: what is the relative importance of the drivers of CO2 emissions? Another important question the present study addresses is how the countries are related to each other regarding CO2 emissions. Taking a sample of 42 emerging economies from Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) and using hierarchical clustering and the neural network method the study tries to answer the key question. Firstly, the explanatory variables were identified through a review of the literature. Subsequently, the gathered data was classified into two clusters having similar characteristic variables utilizing the dendrogram by performing an exploratory clustering method known as hierarchical clustering. Later using the machine learning K-Means clustering technique, the clusters were verified. The use of another machine learning method of feed-forward multilayer perceptron commonly known as neural network helped us to identify the relative importance of explanatory variables viz. economic growth (EG), renewable energy consumption (REC), urbanization (URB), democracy index (DI) and foreign direct investment (FDI) for their relation to the response variable viz. CO2 emissions. The neural network results reveal that EG, REC, and URB are the most important variables (with Rank 1,2, and 3 respectively) followed by DI (Rank 4) and FDI (Rank 5). FDI seemingly is the least important among these identified variables.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用层次聚类和神经网络方法分析42个新兴经济体的CO2排放驱动因素，发现经济增长、可再生能源消费和城市化是最重要的变量，民主指数和外国直接投资相对次要。
AI.research_question: CO2排放驱动因素的相对重要性是什么？各国在CO2排放方面如何相互关联？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴经济体CO2排放的关键驱动因素及其相对重要性，为制定有效的减排政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和发展经济学理论，探讨经济增长、能源消费、城市化、政治制度和外资流入对碳排放的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用层次聚类和K-Means聚类对国家进行分类，使用前馈多层感知器神经网络识别解释变量的相对重要性。
AI.findings: 经济增长(EG)、可再生能源消费(REC)和城市化(URB)是CO2排放最重要的驱动因素(排名1-3)，民主指数(DI)和外国直接投资(FDI)相对次要(排名4-5)。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新兴经济体CO2排放驱动因素相对重要性的实证证据，丰富了环境库兹涅茨曲线和环境经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别关键减排领域提供指导，建议重点关注经济增长模式转型、可再生能源推广和可持续城市化发展。

title: When AI Meets Entrepreneurship: Evidence from the Commercialization of ChatGPT
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When AI Meets Entrepreneurship: Evidence from the Commercialization of ChatGPT
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the commercialization of generative artificial intelligence influences new firm creation, leveraging the release of ChatGPT as an exogenous shock to AI accessibility. We develop a novel industry-level measure of AI compatibility that captures the extent to which AI tools can support early-stage entrepreneurial tasks. Using a difference-indifferences design, we find that industries more compatible with AI experienced an increase of over 10% in firm formation following ChatGPT's release. To investigate why, we examine three mechanisms: reduced experimentation costs, capital reallocation, and human capital complementation. While we find no evidence supporting the latter two, we show that the increase in firm formation is concentrated in industries where AI can effectively assist and experimentation is critical—evidence consistent with a reduction in the cost of experimentation as the key driver. Moreover, new firms created after ChatGPT's release in AI-compatible industries are more likely to survive, grow faster, and attract more educated workers. Taken together, the mechanism and quality results suggest that AI lowers the cost of experimentation in a way that disproportionately benefits high-ability entrepreneurs, leading to both greater and higher-quality firm formation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现ChatGPT的发布通过降低实验成本促进了AI兼容行业的新企业创建，这些新企业生存率更高、增长更快，且吸引了更多高学历员工。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能商业化如何影响新企业创建？
AI.motivation: 利用ChatGPT发布作为AI可及性的外生冲击，研究AI对创业活动的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI兼容性理论框架，关注AI工具对早期创业任务的支持程度。
AI.method: 使用双重差分设计，构建行业级AI兼容性指标，分析ChatGPT发布前后的企业创建变化。
AI.findings: AI兼容行业在ChatGPT发布后企业创建增加10%以上；新企业生存率更高、增长更快、吸引更多高学历员工；实验成本降低是主要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI通过降低实验成本促进创业的机制，识别了AI对高能力创业者的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了AI促进创业的具体路径，帮助创业者理解AI在降低创业门槛方面的作用。

title: Impact of Inventory on Production Smoothening in FMCG Supply Chain
affiliations: VIPS

detail.title: Impact of Inventory on Production Smoothening in FMCG Supply Chain
detail.abstract: The FMCG sector is the cornerstone of any economy with significant contribution to GDP, employment and economic growth. The study aims to explore the relationship among production, demand, inventories and profit before interest and tax for FMCG sector in context of India. For analysis a panel data is employed with 64 firms of Indian FMGC sector, over 10-year time span from 2013-2023. To analyze cost structures and production, ordinary least square (OLS), fixed effect model and random effect model is utilized. It is found that demand, inventories and profit before interest and tax significantly impact Production. Furthermore, higher profitability helps firms to minimize their cost of production and operational costs. The study also highlights the unobserved heterogeneity across firms after employing Breusch-Pagan and Hausman test, illustrating variations in production techniques due to firm specific policies and strategies. Moreover, the inventories plays a significant role in production smoothening.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了印度快速消费品行业中生产、需求、库存和息税前利润之间的关系。基于2013-2023年64家印度FMCG企业的面板数据分析发现，需求、库存和息税前利润显著影响生产，高盈利能力有助于降低生产成本和运营成本，库存在生产平滑中发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 印度FMCG行业中生产、需求、库存和息税前利润之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: FMCG行业是任何经济的基石，对GDP、就业和经济增长有重要贡献。研究该行业的生产要素关系有助于理解行业运行机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于面板数据分析理论，运用OLS、固定效应模型和随机效应模型来分析成本结构和生产函数。
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年64家印度FMCG企业的面板数据，采用OLS、固定效应模型和随机效应模型进行实证分析，并通过Breusch-Pagan和Hausman检验识别企业异质性。
AI.findings: 需求、库存和息税前利润显著影响生产；高盈利能力有助于降低生产成本和运营成本；库存在生产平滑中发挥重要作用；存在企业间未观察到的异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FMCG行业生产函数的决定因素，验证了库存在生产平滑中的作用，识别了企业异质性对生产技术的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FMCG企业优化生产决策、库存管理和成本控制提供实证依据，有助于企业制定更有效的经营策略。

title: The Paradox of Delivery Failure: How Human vs. Machine Failure Shapes Customer Adoption of Autonomous Delivery Vehicles
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School, Southern University of Science and Technology - School of Business, University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School and University of North Carolina Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: The Paradox of Delivery Failure: How Human vs. Machine Failure Shapes Customer Adoption of Autonomous Delivery Vehicles
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of online retail has elevated last-mile delivery into one of the most costly and customer-critical segments of the supply chain. In response, autonomous delivery vehicles have emerged as a promising solution for efficient, on-demand service at scale. Yet autonomy fundamentally reshapes the service process: rather than a traditional courier-led interaction, delivery completion now operates through joint customer–machine co-production, requiring active customer participation. Moreover, this shared responsibility creates significant attributional ambiguity, complicating how blame and trust are assigned when things go wrong. In this study, we investigate how the attribution of responsibility, whether the customer or the autonomous delivery vehicle is at fault, impacts subsequent customer engagement. Leveraging a unique dataset of over 200,000 autonomous delivery orders from a leading global e-commerce platform, we uncover a paradox: overall, experiencing a delivery failure increases customers' future engagement with autonomous delivery. We reconcile this paradox by disaggregating failures based on their source, which reveals two opposing mechanisms: (1) internal (human-fault) failures trigger a powerful make-up effect potentially driven by regret, increasing re-engagement; (2) external (machine-fault) failures elicit a punitive effect potentially driven by eroded trust, decreasing re-engagement. The counterintuitive aggregate result arises because the make-up effect from human-fault failures outweighs the punitive effect from machine-fault failures. We validate these distinct pathways using a two-stage least squares (2SLS) approach. Finally, as the perceived costs of the failure impact the intensity of these opposing reactions, we examine the moderating effects of order- and customer-specific factors. For human-fault failures, the make-up effect is amplified by high collection costs (e.g., large packages) and failures during non-working hours, but attenuated by coupon usage and habituation to self-pickup. Conversely, for machine-fault failures, the punitive effect is mitigated by high collection costs and coupon usage, but amplified by failures during non-working hours and habituation to self-pickup. Our study contributes to the literature on operational failures and human-AI collaboration by demonstrating how the cause of failure in a co-production context shapes technology adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现自主配送失败对客户参与度存在矛盾影响：整体上配送失败会增加客户未来参与度，但分解后发现人类责任失败会通过补偿效应增加参与度，而机器责任失败会通过惩罚效应减少参与度。
AI.research_question: 责任归因（客户责任vs机器责任）如何影响自主配送失败后的客户参与度？
AI.motivation: 自主配送改变了传统配送服务流程，引入了客户-机器协同生产模式，这种共享责任导致归因模糊，影响客户信任和参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 归因理论、协同生产理论、人机协作理论
AI.method: 基于全球领先电商平台的20万+自主配送订单数据，采用两阶段最小二乘法(2SLS)验证机制
AI.findings: 1. 人类责任失败通过补偿效应（可能源于后悔）增加客户再参与；2. 机器责任失败通过惩罚效应（可能源于信任侵蚀）减少客户再参与；3. 总体效应为正，因为补偿效应强于惩罚效应
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了运营失败和人机协作文献，揭示了协同生产情境下失败原因如何影响技术采纳
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商平台优化自主配送服务提供策略建议，如针对不同失败原因采取差异化应对措施

title: Measuring the Impact of Inventory and Marketing on Production Smoothening in a Utility Sector: A Panel Data Approach
affiliations: VIPS

detail.title: Measuring the Impact of Inventory and Marketing on Production Smoothening in a Utility Sector: A Panel Data Approach
detail.abstract: Utility sector is the foundation of economic growth that ensures energy security and industrial productivity along with influencing the living standards especially for the developing countries. The present study critically examines the progressing landscape of India's utility sector, focusing on demand side drifts, executive challenges, financial performances and technological improvements. The study uses extensive panel data of 26 major firms of the utility sector listed in Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) sectoral indices over the period of 10 years (2013-2023). The panel data analysis includes multiple linear regression modelling, random effect analysis and fixed effect regression models capture the heterogeneity in the data. The regression model indicates that change in cost of goods sold (proxy variable of demand), marketing expenses, profit before interest and tax (PBIT) and inventories are significantly impacting the change in cost of production (proxy variable for production). Between ordinary least square (OLS) and random effect, Breusch pagan test concluded that random effect is better approach which shows time invariability. After that Hausman test confirms that there is temporal dynamism present in data and hence the fixed effect prevails. The study provides valuable insights for optimizing production smoothening and hence the operational efficiency based on financial performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用面板数据分析方法，考察了印度公用事业部门26家主要企业的财务表现对生产成本的影响。研究发现销售成本变化、营销费用、息税前利润和库存显著影响生产成本，并确定固定效应模型最适合分析该数据。
AI.research_question: 印度公用事业部门中哪些财务因素显著影响生产成本？
AI.motivation: 公用事业部门是经济增长的基础，对能源安全、工业生产和生活水平具有重要影响，特别是在发展中国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 面板数据分析理论，包括多元线性回归、随机效应和固定效应模型。
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年期间孟买证券交易所26家主要公用事业企业的面板数据，进行多元线性回归、随机效应和固定效应分析。
AI.findings: 销售成本变化（需求代理变量）、营销费用、息税前利润和库存显著影响生产成本变化（生产代理变量）。固定效应模型最适合分析数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了面板数据分析方法在公用事业部门研究中的适用性，确定了影响生产成本的关键财务因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化生产平滑化和运营效率提供了基于财务表现的宝贵见解，有助于提高公用事业部门的管理效率。

title: Dongguan Barreled Water: Multifamily Business Merger and Integration
affiliations: Université Paris Dauphine, Shenzhen Technology University and Shenzhen University of Technology

detail.title: Dongguan Barreled Water: Multifamily Business Merger and Integration

declarations.ethicsApproval: Writen consent has been obtained from the case firm

detail.abstract: Case Objectives and Usage This case is developed for financial management degree, especially courses on company merger and acquisition (M&A), post-merger integration (PMI), and multifamily business management. The target student groups are undergraduate students in management, accounting, finance, and business administration major. Through this case, students can understand complexity in multifamily business, merger and integration, and corporate governance. It serves as an excellent introductory case for business education. It helps students understand conflicting interests in multifamily business, and how to develop appropriate check-and-balance controls in finance, human resources, and business operations post merger.

AI.tldr: 本案例研究多家族企业并购后的整合复杂性，重点关注财务、人力资源和业务运营中的利益冲突与制衡机制开发。
AI.research_question: 多家族企业并购后如何有效管理利益冲突并建立适当的制衡控制机制？
AI.motivation: 为金融管理专业学生提供理解多家族企业并购整合复杂性的教学案例，特别是针对并购后治理和利益协调的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论、并购整合理论和多家族企业管理理论。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过具体企业并购实例分析多家族企业的整合过程。
AI.findings: 多家族企业并购后存在显著的利益冲突，需要在财务、人力资源和业务运营三个关键领域建立有效的制衡控制机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了多家族企业并购整合的理论框架，提供了针对家族企业特殊性的治理机制设计思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理、会计、金融和工商管理专业学生提供了实用的并购整合分析工具，帮助理解实际业务中的治理挑战。

title: Arbitration in England and Wales outside London
affiliations: University of Leicester Law School

detail.title: Arbitration in England and Wales outside London
detail.abstract: This article discusses the foundations of arbitration in England and Wales outside London, including topics such as the arbitration market, the arbitration community, arbitration practice, and arbitration institutions.  The interviews on which the article is based were performed as part of a research project funded by the United Kingdom’s Economic and Social Research Council.  Interviews were performed in 47 countries, including 127 cities and 1,086 interviewees.  Further information on the project is available on the project website (https://commercialarbitrationineurope.wordpress.com).  Seventeen interviews were performed in England and Wales outside London, involving 39 participants, with four interviews performed in Birmingham on 10 March 2019; one interview performed in Bristol on 16 November 2022; one interview performed in Cambridge on 24 October 2022; one interview performed in Cardiff on 14 November 2022; one interview performed in Cheltenham on 11 November 2022; one interview performed in Hull on 14 October 2022; three interviews performed in Ipswich on 20 October 2022; two interviews performed in Leeds on 12 October 2022; one interview performed in Liverpool on 5 September 2022; two interviews performed in Manchester on 7 September 2022; one interview performed in Newcastle on 10 October 2022; one interview performed in Northampton on 6 March 2019; two interviews performed in Nottingham on 9 March 2019; one interview performed in Oxford on 28 October 2022; one interview performed in Sheffield on 17 October 2022; and one interview performed in Southampton on 7 November 2022.  All interviews were performed by the author.  Interviews were recorded and then professionally transcribed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于英国经济与社会研究理事会资助的研究项目，通过对英格兰和威尔士伦敦以外地区17个访谈（涉及39名参与者）的分析，探讨了该地区仲裁的基础设施，包括仲裁市场、仲裁社群、仲裁实践和仲裁机构。
AI.research_question: 英格兰和威尔士伦敦以外地区的仲裁基础设施（包括仲裁市场、仲裁社群、仲裁实践和仲裁机构）的现状和特点是什么？

detail.abstract: In early 2025, I publicly announced my withdrawal from any direct debate with Mr. Frank R. Zindler-a decision made out of respect for his health, his age, and his lifelong contributions to free thought and rational discourse. However, after this announcement, Mr. Zindler continued to publish additional replies and rejoinders concerning my previous research (Faith, Not Trance, 2025) and broader questions of religion and science. As he remained intellectually active and continued to address the same subjects publicly, I found it necessary-out of scholarly responsibility and fairness-to present a further response. Thus, The End of an Excuse was written not as a revival of personal debate, but as a continuation of academic inquiry. It aims to clarify scientific, methodological, and philosophical issues raised in his later works, including In Defense of Science (2025), and to preserve the integrity of the discussion for future readers and researchers. This paper stands as a record of intellectual dialogue, not confrontation-written in the same spirit of critical respect that guided my earlier decision to withdraw.-This note is included for transparency regarding the historical context of publication and debate.

title: Do Better Local Governments Make Cleaner Environment? Evidence from Fiscal Monitoring Policies
affiliations: , University of Alberta - School of Business, City University of Hong Kong and

detail.title: Do Better Local Governments Make Cleaner Environment? Evidence from Fiscal Monitoring Policies
detail.abstract: This study examines whether municipal governance shapes local industrial firms’ pollution levels. We argue that well-governed municipalities have strong environmental oversight and enforcement and, in turn, effective controls on corporate pollution. Using the staggered adoption of fiscal monitoring policies across U.S. states as a plausibly exogenous improvement in municipal governance, we find that toxic emissions from industrial facilities decline significantly following the implementation of such policies. This effect is more likely driven by investment in abatement measures than shrinkage in production activity. Our cross-sectional analyses show that the effect of fiscal monitoring policies on reducing toxic emissions is more pronounced for facilities located in areas with lower levels of ex-ante local government stewardship and those subject to weaker regulatory oversight from the Environmental Protection Agency. Overall, our findings underscore municipal governance and, more generally, local government quality as a significant factor disciplining local industrial firms’ environmental practices.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现市政治理质量显著影响地方工业企业的污染水平，通过美国各州财政监控政策的交错实施作为准自然实验，发现此类政策实施后工业设施的有毒排放显著减少，且这种效应在事前地方政府监管较弱和EPA监管较弱的地区更为明显。
AI.research_question: 市政治理是否影响地方工业企业的污染水平？
AI.motivation: 探讨地方政府治理质量对企业环境行为的影响机制，填补市政治理与环境监管关系的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市政治理理论，认为治理良好的市政当局具有更强的环境监督和执法能力，从而有效控制企业污染。
AI.method: 使用美国各州财政监控政策的交错实施作为准外生冲击，采用因果推断方法分析政策实施前后工业设施有毒排放的变化。
AI.findings: 财政监控政策实施后，工业设施的有毒排放显著下降；这种效应更可能是通过减排投资而非生产收缩驱动的；在事前地方政府监管较弱和EPA监管较弱的地区，政策效应更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证市政治理作为约束企业环境行为的重要机制，拓展了地方政府质量与环境治理关系的理论框架。

title: Rewriting the Future: How Metamodern Education Can Redefine Society and Leadership

detail.title: Rewriting the Future: How Metamodern Education Can Redefine Society and Leadership
detail.abstract: This food-for-thought paper challenges traditional paradigms and proposes a metamodern framework for redefining the optics on the role of education in society, advocating for a new social contract rooted in shared values, inclusivity, and interdisciplinary collaboration. How can we democratize higher education and empower individuals to navigate the uncertainties of the 21st century? Is moving beyond fragmented knowledge and fostering skills-based education truly beneficial? Moving beyond postmodern fragmentation, metamodernism emphasizes cooperation and holistic development, presenting a blueprint for transforming society by bridging individual agency and collective progress. The Inner Development Goals (IDG) promotes skills-based and humanity-focused leadership that addresses the inner and outer dimensions of sustainable development. This transformative skills-based approach to leadership encourages educators and institutions to embrace complexity and ambiguity, preparing future leaders to leverage inherited chaos for meaningful change. This approach challenges traditional paradigms and calls for a dynamic interplay that aligns with the metamodern ethos.

title: Enhancing Examination Integrity Through Vision-Based Smart Proctoring Powered by YOLOv8 and Dlib Frontal Face Detector
affiliations: and

publicationDetails.detailsText: Chinese Space Science and Technology Journal,  Volume 21 Issue 11, November 2025. Available Online at: https://www.xbna-pku-edu-cn.ddns-ip.net

detail.abstract: The ubiquity of online exam systems, driven by the swift surge in digitization and globalization, especially in times of global health crises like pandemics, necessitates a robust cheating detection mechanism. While current platforms employ conventional machine learning techniques based on vision, their efficacy is limited by the reliance on manually crafted features and the inability to extract hierarchical representations from raw data. This paper aims to address challenges related to complex system integration and low-resolution video by introducing a practical and efficient deep learning-based method for real-time cheating detection in online exam systems. Leveraging recorded videos from a custom real-world video dataset, YOLOv8 is used for object detection, while Dlib serves as a frontal face detector using a Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG)-based approach. The proposed method fuses the outputs of YOLOv8 and HOG to accurately detect faces, enhancing detection reliability and performance. The proposed method, which combines YOLOv8 and Dlib's HOG-based detector, achieved exceptionally high performance in the fused system, reaching 99.9% accuracy, 99.8% precision, 99.7% recall, and a 99.6% F1-score, surpassing existing methods. This fused approach accurately detected faces in online exam hall scenarios, demonstrating its reliability and suitability for maintaining exam integrity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合YOLOv8和Dlib HOG检测器的深度学习作弊检测方法，在在线考试场景中实现了99.9%的准确率，显著优于现有方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高效可靠的实时作弊检测方法来解决在线考试系统中的复杂系统集成和低分辨率视频问题？
AI.motivation: 在线考试系统的普及需要强大的作弊检测机制，但现有基于视觉的机器学习方法依赖手动特征提取且无法从原始数据中提取层次表示，效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的对象检测理论，结合YOLOv8实时目标检测和Dlib的HOG特征提取技术。
AI.method: 使用自定义真实世界视频数据集，融合YOLOv8对象检测和Dlib的HOG正面人脸检测输出，提高检测可靠性和性能。
AI.findings: 融合方法在在线考试场景中达到99.9%准确率、99.8%精确率、99.7%召回率和99.6% F1分数，超越现有方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了融合深度学习和传统特征提取方法的混合检测框架，为实时作弊检测提供了新的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的在线考试作弊检测系统，能够准确检测考试场景中的人脸，有效维护考试完整性。

detail.abstract: This white paper presents a systems-informed approach to qualitative inquiry that integrates reflexive interviewing, qualitative coding, and memo-based modelling within a unified epistemological framework. Drawing from second-order cybernetics and systems theory, the paper emphasises the researcher’s role as an observer within the observed system, advancing qualitative research as a process of co-constructing meaning through dialogue. It positions qualitative inquiry not merely as data collection but as systemic observation, interpretation, and theory building. The proposed methodology introduces a reflexive conversation framework inspired by von Foerster’s second-order observation, Luhmann’s social systems theory, and Pask’s conversation theory, articulating a novel mode of qualitative practice suited to organisational and social systems research.

title: Monotheism and the Limits of Multiculturalism: A Civic Rethink for NDMCs A Position Paper by

detail.title: Monotheism and the Limits of Multiculturalism: A Civic Rethink for NDMCs A Position Paper by

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Monotheism, by its nature, promotes theological singularity and civic discomfort in plural societies. NDMCs must avoid adopting monotheistic frameworks as state philosophy or civil religion, and instead cultivate pluralistic models like Anekantavad that affirm multiplicity, coexistence, and epistemic humility. 

This essay critically examines the civic implications of monotheism in the context of Newly Developing Multicultural Countries (NDMCs). Drawing on theological, philosophical, and sociopolitical sources, it argues that monotheism—while historically influential—carries metaphysical and civic risks when adopted as a framework for public life in plural societies. The essay challenges the adequacy of conventional multiculturalism, which often fails to interrogate the theological singularity embedded in civil religion. Through analysis of historical patterns, insider movements, contextual theology, and grassroots syncretism, the essay demonstrates that monotheism’s exclusivist tendencies can produce discomfort, symbolic dominance, and epistemic closure in NDMCs. It proposes a shift toward metaphysical pluralism, grounded in traditions like Anekantavad, which affirm manifold truths and relational coexistence. The essay concludes by advocating for a pluralistic civil theology—one that decouples civic unity from theological singularity and embraces diversity not merely as demographic fact but as metaphysical principle. This framework offers NDMCs a path toward inclusive civic identity, legal equilibrium, and interfaith harmony without replicating the exclusionary legacies of monotheistic statecraft.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性分析了一神论在新兴多元文化国家中的公民影响，认为一神论在多元社会中作为公共生活框架会带来形而上学和公民风险，主张转向基于Anekantavad等传统的形而上学多元主义。

AI.theoretical_framework: 神学、哲学和社会政治理论，特别关注一神论的形而上学特征及其公民影响，以及Anekantavad等多元主义传统。
AI.method: 通过分析历史模式、内部运动、情境神学和基层融合主义，批判性考察一神论在多元社会中的影响。
AI.findings: 一神论在多元社会中会产生不适、象征性支配和认知封闭，需要转向形而上学多元主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将公民团结与神学单一性解耦的多元主义公民神学框架，将多样性视为形而上学原则而非仅仅人口事实。

detail.abstract: This study examined the impact of political leadership on organizational culture and civil service in Ukraine. The study employed a qualitative review to evaluate this impact. Using a purposive sampling technique, the researchers analyzed relevant documents obtained from academic sources, and from international institutions in order to get a more holistic picture of the impact of various aspects of political leadership on Ukraine's public and civil service. The findings from this research showed that although the effects of political responsibility were felt in the local levels of government, the enshrinement of ethical standards was not uniformly applied. There appeared to be some disparity between the enforcement of ethical standards among the lower cadres of staff and what obtained at the higher rung of the ladder. Furthermore, because of the crisis presented by the 2022 Russian invasion, the leadership structure in Ukraine's public service evolved from its previously rule based system, to a more adaptive form of leadership that was agile, innovative and able to take up multiple responsibility in a time of crisis. The study concludes that the decentralization efforts of the government were yet to be completed because many aspects of its implementation require urgent attention. The paper further recommends that for this process to be effective and efficient, the government would have to institutionalize adaptive leadership principles in order to ensure that the local authorities are better equipped to carry out their functions and to avoid political interference from the government hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了乌克兰政治领导力对组织文化和公务员制度的影响，发现虽然政治责任在地方政府层面有所体现，但道德标准的执行存在层级差异。由于2022年俄罗斯入侵危机，乌克兰公共服务领导结构从基于规则的系统转变为更具适应性、敏捷和创新的领导形式。政府的分权努力尚未完成，需要制度化适应性领导原则。

title: The Necessity of Error: Why Mistakes Are the Essential Nutrients for Scientific Progress
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Necessity of Error: Why Mistakes Are the Essential Nutrients for Scientific Progress
detail.abstract: Modern academic publishing operates under the illusion that the elimination of error guarantees scientific excellence. The peer review system, designed to prevent the publication of incorrect papers, has paradoxically become the primary obstacle to genuine innovation. This paper argues that error is not a threat but a prerequisite for progress. Through historical and modern examples, including systematic errors in microwave absorption theory and the entrenched resistance of peer-reviewed journals to correction, this study reveals that attempts to create a "perfect" error-free publishing ecosystem sterilize intellectual evolution. Just as life could not arise in pure water, science cannot thrive in an environment purged of mistakes. The suppression of "incorrect" ideas not only prevents their correction but also delays the birth of new paradigms. The paper concludes that the most dangerous aspect of the current publishing system is not the presence of error-but the institutional denial of its necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文认为现代学术出版系统过度追求消除错误，反而阻碍了真正的科学创新。错误不是威胁而是进步的前提，当前出版系统最大的危险在于制度性地否认错误的必要性。
AI.research_question: 现代学术出版系统如何通过过度追求消除错误而阻碍科学创新？
AI.motivation: 观察到同行评审系统从防止错误发表的机制演变为阻碍创新的主要障碍，需要重新审视错误在科学发展中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学哲学和科学社会学理论，特别是关于科学革命和范式转换的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用历史和现代案例分析，包括微波吸收理论的系统性错误和同行评审期刊对修正的顽固抵抗。
AI.findings: 试图创建"完美"无错误的出版生态系统会扼杀智力进化；压制"错误"思想不仅阻止其修正，还延迟新范式的诞生。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了错误在科学进步中的必要作用，挑战了当前学术出版的基本假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改革学术出版系统提供了理论基础，建议接受错误作为科学发展的必要组成部分。

title: The Johari Window Revisited: An Analysis of 48,000 LeaderView360 Reviews
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Johari Window Revisited: An Analysis of 48,000 LeaderView360 Reviews
detail.abstract: Analyzing 47,891 multisource leadership assessments from 2005–2025, this study revisits the Johari Window framework to quantify self-awareness and “blind spots” in 35 leadership competencies. Results reveal that leaders consistently overestimate interpersonal and adaptive behaviors—such as understanding others, recognizing trends, and building teams—while showing stronger alignment on task-based competencies. Cluster analysis identifies fourteen “blind-spot” competencies centered on emotional intelligence, adaptability, and people development. Although overestimation rates have declined modestly over time, relational misalignments persist. The findings highlight that sustainable leadership growth depends less on technical skill than on feedback-driven self-awareness and emotionally attuned interaction with others.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析47,891份多源领导力评估数据，重新审视Johari Window框架，量化领导者在35项领导力能力中的自我认知和盲点。结果显示领导者普遍高估人际交往和适应性行为，而在任务型能力上认知更准确。研究发现14项以情商、适应性和人员发展为核心的盲点能力。
AI.research_question: 领导者在哪些领导力能力上存在自我认知盲点？这些盲点如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 重新审视Johari Window框架，量化领导者的自我认知偏差，为领导力发展提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: Johari Window框架，自我认知理论，领导力能力模型
AI.method: 分析47,891份多源领导力评估数据（2005-2025年），采用聚类分析识别盲点能力
AI.findings: 领导者普遍高估人际交往和适应性行为（如理解他人、识别趋势、团队建设），在任务型能力上认知更准确；识别出14项以情商、适应性和人员发展为核心的盲点能力；高估率随时间略有下降但关系性偏差持续存在
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展Johari Window框架的实证应用，为领导力自我认知研究提供量化证据
AI.practical_contributions: 强调可持续领导力发展依赖于反馈驱动的自我认知和情感协调的人际互动，而非技术技能

title: Is the only Purpose of Companies making Profits: Analysis of the CSR Role of Companies in Promoting Social Welfare?
affiliations: University of East Anglia

detail.title: Is the only Purpose of Companies making Profits: Analysis of the CSR Role of Companies in Promoting Social Welfare?
detail.abstract: The earliest forms of Modern Companies were instinctively and inherently social entities that were first invented to support societal welfare. In the past many years, however, dictated by the principles of capitalism and the Agency Theory of the Firm, companies are recognized by law as institutions primarily organized for the sake of operating economic activities targeted to maximize profit, and they have no legal duty to engage in activities of corporate social responsibility ('CSR'). Recently, however, as per the Stakeholders Theory of the Firm, the societal purpose of companies is regaining ground. Due to the proliferation of globalization, the lack of strong global governance mechanisms, and the presence of weakened national governments, the impact and business's place in society is, once again, being transformed, which has augmented the companies' ability to play essential roles in public policy and social welfare and thereby tackle global problems of welfare in a coordinated way. It has become an international norm for companies to engage in CSR activities aimed at advancing societal welfare. Having considered the amount of capital mobilized or profit earned, many countries also require companies, by law, to allocate a certain percentage of their yearly profits to engage in CSR activities that give back to the society in which they operate their business. Accordingly, this article analyzes the CSR duties of companies (including transnational companies) and argues that companies can and should engage in activities that promote social welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了公司的企业社会责任（CSR）义务，认为公司能够且应该从事促进社会福利的活动，并探讨了从资本主义和代理理论向利益相关者理论的转变。
AI.research_question: 公司的企业社会责任义务是什么？公司是否应该从事促进社会福利的活动？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化的发展、全球治理机制的缺乏以及国家政府的弱化，公司在公共政策和社会福利中的作用正在转变，公司有能力在解决全球福利问题中发挥重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本主义原则、公司代理理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 理论分析和法律分析
AI.findings: 公司最初是社会实体，旨在支持社会福利；现代公司被法律认可为以利润最大化为主要目标的经济机构；利益相关者理论使公司的社会目的重新获得重视；许多国家法律要求公司将部分年利润用于CSR活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 从代理理论向利益相关者理论的转变，重新定义了公司的社会目的和责任。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公司在公共政策和社会福利中的角色提供了理论支持，强调了法律强制CSR活动的必要性，特别是在跨国公司的背景下。

title: Anchoring Debt Management on National Financial Net Worth -A Nigerian Perspective
affiliations: Nigerian Economic Summit Group

detail.title: Anchoring Debt Management on National Financial Net Worth -A Nigerian Perspective
detail.abstract: Nigeria stands at a critical fiscal crossroads, grappling with a complex debt structure, structurally weak revenue mobilisation, and rising development financing needs. This article advances a novel policy perspective centred on Nigeria's sovereign net worth as an anchor for sustainable public finance management and development-oriented borrowing. Drawing on global best practices, fiscal transparency frameworks, and balance sheet-based approaches, the article critiques Nigeria's evolving debt portfolio, particularly the shift from concessional to commercial financing, and assesses the macro-fiscal vulnerabilities it creates. It proposes a paradigm shift toward the National Financial Net Worth (NFNW) framework, which prioritises asset-backed borrowing, comprehensive balance sheet accounting, and capital budget ringfencing. Through this lens, innovative instruments such as GDP-linked bonds, climate-contingent debt, and infrastructure special purpose vehicles (SPVs) are explored as mechanisms to align fiscal expansion with long-term value creation. The article concludes by advocating for institutional reforms, particularly in fiscal transparency and asset valuation, and introduces a prototype Fiscal Sustainability Dashboard to track Nigeria's public sector net worth. Overall, the article provides a forward-looking, diagnostics-based approach to public finance in Nigeria, aimed at restoring fiscal credibility while unlocking transformational development outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以尼日利亚主权净资产为核心的新政策视角，通过国家金融净资产框架、资产支持借贷和资产负债表方法，解决尼日利亚复杂的债务结构、收入动员不足和发展融资需求问题，推动可持续公共财政管理和面向发展的借贷。
AI.research_question: 如何通过主权净资产框架解决尼日利亚的财政可持续性和发展融资挑战？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚面临复杂的债务结构、结构性薄弱的收入动员和日益增长的发展融资需求，需要新的政策视角来确保财政可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权净资产理论、资产负债表方法、财政透明度框架、全球最佳实践
AI.method: 基于全球最佳实践、财政透明度框架和资产负债表方法的政策分析，提出国家金融净资产框架
AI.findings: 尼日利亚从优惠融资向商业融资的转变加剧了宏观财政脆弱性，需要转向资产支持借贷和综合资产负债表核算
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国家金融净资产框架作为公共财政管理的新范式，强调资产价值创造和资本预算隔离
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了GDP挂钩债券、气候或有债务、基础设施特殊目的工具等创新融资工具，以及财政可持续性仪表板原型

title: Internet Ozone Layer: A Vision for Reclaiming Human Freedom in Information Civilization

detail.title: Internet Ozone Layer: A Vision for Reclaiming Human Freedom in Information Civilization
detail.abstract: In the 1990s, the United States and the European Union created the "ozone hole" in the global information environment by allowing the governance of the World Wide Web (Web)-the global public information infrastructure-to fall under corporate control. In pursuit of profit, these corporations adopted surveillance as their business model, transforming the Web into a system of mass behavioural extraction and modification. This led to an "Information Armageddon"-a state of eroding trust in the shared reality that threatens democracy, markets, and the global rule of law. As the US backs its technology corporations against regulations worldwide, the EU stands as the last line of defence capable of restoring balance. Europe faces an existential dilemma: calls for "competitiveness" and "simplification" risk weakening the digital rulebook, even as the movement for enforcement and technological sovereignty-known as EuroStack-is gaining momentum. This paper advances a vision for Europe's path forward: the creation of an Internet Ozone Layer-a public information infrastructure built upon user agents (browsers and operating systems) regulated as public utilities. These agents would serve as the backbone of a fair and sustainable online advertising ecosystem that monetises the Web. Achieving this requires urgent coordinated action tied into a coherent industrial policy: (1) enforcing the EU digital rulebook, (2) regulating user agents and online advertising, (3) establishing robust governance (4) funding the development of a European user agent infrastructure, such as browser engines. Addressed to policymakers, civil society, academia, and industry, this discussion paper calls for Europe to reclaim its information infrastructure and rebuild the online environment on democratic foundations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出欧盟应通过监管用户代理（浏览器和操作系统）作为公共事业，建立"互联网臭氧层"公共信息基础设施，以对抗企业控制的网络监控商业模式，重建民主的在线环境。
AI.research_question: 欧盟如何通过监管用户代理和建立公共信息基础设施来对抗企业控制的网络监控商业模式，重建民主的在线环境？
AI.motivation: 1990年代美国和欧盟允许企业控制万维网治理，导致监控成为商业模式，造成"信息末日"，威胁民主、市场和全球法治。欧盟是恢复平衡的最后防线。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共事业监管理论、信息基础设施治理理论、数字主权理论
AI.method: 政策分析框架，提出"互联网臭氧层"概念和具体政策建议
AI.findings: 企业控制的网络治理导致监控商业模式，威胁民主基础；欧盟需要通过监管用户代理作为公共事业来重建公平可持续的在线广告生态系统
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"互联网臭氧层"概念，将用户代理视为公共事业的理论框架，为数字主权和民主信息基础设施提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供具体行动路线：执行数字规则手册、监管用户代理和在线广告、建立治理机制、资助欧洲用户代理基础设施开发

title: Centralize or Decentralize? Co-Location with Accounting Precision and Incentive Power
affiliations: Keio University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Centralize or Decentralize? Co-Location with Accounting Precision and Incentive Power
detail.abstract: We analyze a principal-agent environment with two levers: a measurement designer chooses accounting precision and a decision maker sets incentive intensity. In a CARA-normal setting with heterogeneous priors, we prove strict complementarity between precision and incentives and establish a Co-Location Theorem: when a single residual claimant controls both levers, expected residual value weakly exceeds any split allocation, and strictly exceeds it under disagreement. Robustness analyses (interval-mean ambiguity and multiplier preferences) preserve these results, while institutional frictions (limited liability and pay caps) leave the comparative statics intact. When "hard" measurement and "soft" discretion are technological substitutes, we characterize a switching frontier: separation can be locally optimal under small disagreement but gives way to co-location beyond a threshold. The model yields testable predictions for KPI redesign, pay-performance sensitivity, and the centralization of governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文在CARA-normal设定下分析测量精度与激励强度的互补关系，证明了当单一剩余索取者控制两个杠杆时，预期剩余价值优于分离分配，特别是在存在分歧时。模型对KPI重新设计、薪酬绩效敏感性和治理集中化提供了可检验的预测。
AI.research_question: 在异质先验的委托代理环境中，测量精度与激励强度之间是否存在互补关系？单一剩余索取者控制两个杠杆是否优于分离分配？
AI.motivation: 理解在测量设计和激励设置中的协调问题，特别是在存在分歧的情况下，如何优化组织治理结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CARA-normal设定的委托代理理论，结合异质先验、区间均值模糊性和乘数偏好等概念。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，包括严格互补性证明、共位定理推导，以及稳健性检验（区间均值模糊性、乘数偏好）和制度摩擦分析（有限责任、薪酬上限）。
AI.findings: 证明了测量精度与激励强度之间的严格互补性；建立了共位定理：单一剩余索取者控制两个杠杆时预期剩余价值优于分离分配，特别是在存在分歧时；当"硬"测量与"软"裁量权是技术替代品时，存在一个切换边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了测量精度与激励强度互补性的理论框架；提出了共位定理；分析了在技术替代情况下的最优治理结构选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为KPI重新设计、薪酬绩效敏感性设置和治理集中化决策提供了理论指导和可检验的预测；帮助组织在测量系统设计和激励制度安排中做出更优决策。

title: Advance Selling under Dynamic Uncertainty and Time-Dependent Penalty
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and UCL School of Management, University College London

detail.title: Advance Selling under Dynamic Uncertainty and Time-Dependent Penalty
detail.abstract: We study a setting where a firm offers products or services, such as hotel rooms or rental units, under time-dependent cancellation policies. Customers choose between two types of options: a pay-in-advance (PA) policy with limited refund flexibility and higher penalties for cancellation, and a pay-later (PL) policy offering greater cancellation flexibility at a higher price. Customers are forward-looking, their utilities from PA and PL options are correlated, have heterogeneous willingness-to-pay and dynamic cancellation risks modeled using a Mixed Nested MNL choice model. We characterize the firm's optimal assortment of PA/PL options and prices. We uncover previously ignored interactions between service usage valuation and cancellation penalties and how they drive optimal pricing and assortment decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了企业在提供有时间依赖性取消政策的产品或服务时，如何优化预付(PA)和延付(PL)两种选项的组合和定价。PA选项退款灵活性有限且取消罚款较高，PL选项取消灵活性更高但价格更高。
AI.research_question: 企业在提供有时间依赖性取消政策的产品或服务时，如何优化预付(PA)和延付(PL)两种选项的组合和定价？
AI.motivation: 研究企业如何通过设计不同的取消政策选项来优化收益管理，考虑客户的前瞻性行为和异质性偏好。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于混合嵌套MNL选择模型，考虑客户的前瞻性行为、效用相关性、异质性支付意愿和动态取消风险。
AI.method: 使用混合嵌套MNL选择模型分析客户选择行为，并构建优化模型来求解最优产品组合和定价策略。
AI.findings: 揭示了服务使用价值与取消罚款之间先前被忽视的相互作用，以及这些相互作用如何驱动最优定价和产品组合决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑时间依赖性取消政策的收益管理理论框架，扩展了传统收益管理模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计取消政策和定价策略提供了实用指导，特别是在酒店客房和租赁单元等服务行业。

title: Property Rights and Financial Access
affiliations: London Business School

detail.title: Property Rights and Financial Access
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of property rights on financial inclusion and subsequent changes in labor market participation and human capital investment. Using hand-collected savings bank data linked to the English census, I exploit the 1870 Married Women's Property Act, which granted married women ownership of their financial assets. A 10% increase in the population of married women is associated with a 1% rise in accounts and a 1.2% rise in deposit receipts after the reform, indicating greater financial inclusion. In districts with a savings bank, following the reform, female employment increases by ∼3 pp for married women and ∼6 pp for single women, with no change for men. The occupational structure shifts, with married women moving toward low-entry-cost work and single women moving into higher-skill roles that require greater human capital. Girls' school attendance rises by 9-12%, with no change for boys. These patterns align with an appropriability and agency channel in which greater control over earnings raises the private return to work and skill investment, with savings banks making property rights operative by providing secure, interest-bearing deposits. I develop a theoretical framework emphasizing this complementarity between reduced expropriation risk and enforceable, remunerated savings. These results demonstrate an important role of property rights in encouraging financial participation, and the complementarity of property rights and financial access in employment and education outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1870年《已婚妇女财产法》对金融包容性的影响，发现该法律通过赋予已婚妇女财产权，显著提高了女性储蓄账户持有率、就业参与度和女孩教育投资，体现了财产权与金融准入在促进就业和教育成果方面的互补性。
AI.research_question: 财产权如何影响金融包容性，进而改变劳动力市场参与和人力资本投资？
AI.motivation: 探讨财产权改革对女性经济赋权的影响，特别关注金融包容性在其中的中介作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可占用性和代理渠道理论框架，强调减少征用风险与可执行、有报酬储蓄之间的互补性。
AI.method: 利用1870年《已婚妇女财产法》作为准自然实验，结合手工收集的储蓄银行数据与英国人口普查数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 改革后，已婚女性人口每增加10%，账户数量和存款收入分别增长1%和1.2%；在有储蓄银行的地区，已婚女性就业率上升约3个百分点，单身女性上升约6个百分点；女孩入学率提高9-12%。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了强调减少征用风险与可执行、有报酬储蓄互补性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了财产权在鼓励金融参与中的重要作用，以及财产权与金融准入在就业和教育成果方面的互补性。

title: Alcohol Prohibition and Attitudes towards Spousal Violence against Women
affiliations: Le Moyne College and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Alcohol Prohibition and Attitudes towards Spousal Violence against Women

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: We study the effects of a comprehensive, statewide alcohol ban on attitudes towards spousal violence in the Indian state of Bihar. Using a triple-difference framework, we document significant improvements in attitudes towards spousal violence involving scenarios reflecting an increase in women's personal freedom, such as going out without telling the husband and arguing with the husband. We observe no change in attitudes involving a wife's supposedly traditional responsibilities, such as looking after kids, cooking, and having sex with the husband. We argue and provide evidence that alcohol consumption exerts a significant income effect, souring spousal relations that causes men's attitudes towards wife-beating to worsen. Our findings suggest that the alcohol ban benefited women of weaker sections (SC/ST communities) of society the most. We conclude that while such policies can empower women in certain walks of life, they are insufficient to alter long-rooted patriarchal beliefs.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用三重差分法分析印度比哈尔邦全面禁酒令对家庭暴力态度的影响，发现禁酒令显著改善了涉及女性个人自由场景（如外出不告知丈夫、与丈夫争吵）的家庭暴力态度，但对涉及传统妻子责任场景的态度无影响。禁酒通过收入效应改善夫妻关系，对弱势群体女性帮助最大，但不足以改变根深蒂固的父权观念。
AI.research_question: 全面禁酒令如何影响印度比哈尔邦居民对配偶暴力的态度？
AI.motivation: 研究酒精消费对家庭暴力的影响，特别是禁酒政策能否改善女性地位和减少家庭暴力接受度
AI.theoretical_framework: 酒精消费的收入效应理论、性别权力关系理论、父权制社会结构理论
AI.method: 三重差分框架（triple-difference framework）的实证分析方法
AI.findings: 禁酒令显著改善了涉及女性个人自由场景的配偶暴力态度，但对传统妻子责任相关场景的态度无影响；酒精消费通过收入效应恶化夫妻关系；弱势群体（SC/ST社区）女性受益最大
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了酒精政策通过收入效应对性别态度的作用机制，补充了禁酒政策对女性赋权影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定针对家庭暴力的酒精管制政策提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解禁酒政策在改善女性地位方面的局限性和有效性

title: Policy instruments for circular economy: Evidence-Based assessment of sustainable waste management in the UK and Finland
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Policy instruments for circular economy: Evidence-Based assessment of sustainable waste management in the UK and Finland
detail.abstract: Municipal solid waste (MSW) management has become a critical issue globally, driven by its growing environmental and societal impacts. This study addresses these concerns by identifying key factors across policy, economic, social, and technological dimensions through a systematic review of relevant literature. To assess the effectiveness of these factors, linear regression analysis is applied to examine the role of landfill taxes (policy), oil prices and Gross Domestic Product (economic indicators), education (social factor), and patents (technological innovation) in MSW management. The model is tested using data from the United Kingdom and Finland. The results show that landfill taxes are an effective policy tool in both countries, reducing waste sent to landfills. Based on econometric modeling, we recommend that nations introduce a complementary incineration tax to shift focus from incineration to recycling, invest in research and development of recycling technologies, enhance education and public awareness, monitor the impact of fluctuating oil prices on energy markets and waste management, encourage extended producer responsibility, and design integrated policy frameworks to foster circularity. These findings offer valuable insights for improving waste management practices and advancing circular economy initiatives globally.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述识别了影响城市固体废物管理的关键政策、经济、社会和技术因素，并利用英国和芬兰数据通过线性回归分析验证了填埋税、油价、GDP、教育和专利等因素的有效性。研究发现填埋税是有效的政策工具，建议引入焚烧税、投资回收技术研发、提高公众意识等措施来推进循环经济。
AI.research_question: 哪些政策、经济、社会和技术因素对城市固体废物管理最有效？
AI.motivation: 城市固体废物管理已成为全球关键问题，其环境和社会影响日益增长
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策、经济、社会和技术四个维度的分析框架
AI.method: 系统文献综述结合线性回归分析，使用英国和芬兰数据
AI.findings: 填埋税在两国都是有效的政策工具，能减少送往填埋场的废物
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了涵盖多维度因素的城市固体废物管理分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了引入焚烧税、投资回收技术研发、提高公众意识、监控油价影响、鼓励生产者责任延伸和设计综合政策框架等具体建议

title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Educational Strategy Challenges and Opportunities for International Schools in Egypt A Case Study of Repton School Cairo
affiliations: Ain Shams University, Misr American College, Elsewedy Electric, Zadna KSA and ALMehwar hospital

detail.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Educational Strategy Challenges and Opportunities for International Schools in Egypt A Case Study of Repton School Cairo
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is poised to become a cornerstone of educational transformation, offering pathways to personalized learning and operational efficiency. This study investigates the integration of AI into the strategic management of international K-12 schools in Egypt, a highly competitive market. It focuses on how strategic AI adoption can enhance pedagogical outcomes, administrative efficiency, and the overall quality of education. Despite Egypt’s National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2025–2030), adoption at the school level is often fragmented. This paper uses a qualitative case study of Repton School Cairo to analyze a mature, first-mover strategy. Through a document analysis of the school's official AI policies, governance frameworks, and public case materials, this study finds that Repton has moved beyond fragmented tools. The school has developed a holistic, "human-centred" (UNESCO, 2019) strategy centered on (1) proactive data governance that mitigates key ethical risks, (2) the development of a secure, in-house AI assistant named "Nour," and (3) a school-wide AI literacy program. This paper proposes the Strategic AI Integration Framework for Education (SAI-F-Edu), validated by the Repton case, to offer other international schools in Egypt a phased roadmap toward AI-driven educational excellence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析埃及Repton开罗学校的案例，提出了战略AI整合教育框架(SAI-F-Edu)，展示了国际K-12学校如何通过整体性、以人为本的AI策略实现教育转型。
AI.research_question: 国际K-12学校如何战略性地整合人工智能来提升教育质量和运营效率？
AI.motivation: 尽管埃及制定了国家人工智能战略(2025-2030)，但学校层面的AI采用往往零散化，需要探索成熟的整体性AI整合策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国教科文组织(2019)的"以人为本"AI教育理念，构建战略AI整合框架。
AI.method: 采用定性案例研究方法，对Repton开罗学校的官方AI政策、治理框架和公开案例材料进行文档分析。
AI.findings: Repton学校超越了零散工具使用，建立了整体性AI策略：主动数据治理、内部AI助手"Nour"开发和全校AI素养计划。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了经过验证的战略AI整合教育框架(SAI-F-Edu)，为教育AI整合理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及其他国际学校提供了分阶段实施AI驱动教育卓越的路线图。

title: Do Banks Build Societies? Evidence from Brazilian and U.S. Mutual Intermediaries
affiliations: Texas Tech University,  and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: Do Banks Build Societies? Evidence from Brazilian and U.S. Mutual Intermediaries
detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural framework to quantify how banks shape real lending capacity and financial resilience across advanced and emerging economies. We model equilibrium loan demand and supply under balance-sheet constraints, identifying two channels through which banks affect mutual and cooperative intermediaries: a cost-offunds channel and a constraint-relaxation channel. Using a new crosscountry dataset covering all major U.S. banks and credit unions alongside Brazilian commercial banks and cooperatives from 2002-2025, we structurally recover the time-varying loan-capacity multiplier that governs intermediation under stress. The results reveal that in the United States, banks stabilize mutual lending by absorbing liquidity shocks, whereas in Brazil, funding constraints bind and amplify credit contractions. The findings demonstrate that banks "build societies'' when they act as stabilizers, transmitting liquidity rather than retrenching it, and highlight how financial development hinges on institutional capacity to sustain intermediation when liquidity vanishes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个结构框架来量化银行如何影响发达和新兴经济体的实际贷款能力和金融韧性。研究发现，在美国，银行通过吸收流动性冲击来稳定互助贷款；而在巴西，资金约束会放大信贷收缩。
AI.research_question: 银行如何通过不同渠道影响互助和合作中介机构的贷款能力和金融韧性？
AI.motivation: 理解银行在不同经济体中如何塑造实际贷款能力和金融韧性，特别是在流动性压力时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产负债表约束下的均衡贷款需求与供给模型，识别银行影响中介机构的两个渠道：资金成本渠道和约束放松渠道。
AI.method: 使用涵盖2002-2025年美国主要银行和信用合作社以及巴西商业银行和合作社的新跨国数据集，结构性地恢复随时间变化的贷款能力乘数。
AI.findings: 在美国，银行通过吸收流动性冲击来稳定互助贷款；在巴西，资金约束会放大信贷收缩。银行作为稳定器时能够'建设社会'，传递流动性而非收缩流动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个量化银行对贷款能力和金融韧性影响的结构框架，识别了银行影响中介机构的具体渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了金融发展取决于在流动性消失时维持中介能力的制度能力，为政策制定者提供了关于银行稳定作用的实证证据。

title: Slaying the Dragon: The Quest for Democracy in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca, and Complexity Science Hub Vienna

detail.title: Slaying the Dragon: The Quest for Democracy in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs)
detail.abstract: This chapter explores how Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs), a novel institutional form based on blockchain technology, challenge traditional centralized governance structures. DAOs govern projects ranging from finance to science and digital communities. They aim to redistribute decision-making power through programmable, transparent, and participatory mechanisms. This chapter outlines both the opportunities DAOs present, such as incentive alignment, rapid coordination, and censorship resistance, and the challenges they face, including token concentration, low participation, and the risk of de facto centralization. It further discusses the emerging intersection of DAOs and artificial intelligence, highlighting the potential for increased automation alongside the dangers of diminished human oversight and algorithmic opacity. Ultimately, we discuss under what circumstances DAOs can fulfill their democratic promise or risk replicating the very power asymmetries they seek to overcome.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨了基于区块链技术的去中心化自治组织(DAOs)如何挑战传统中心化治理结构，分析了DAOs在金融、科学和数字社区等领域的应用潜力，以及其在激励协调、快速协调和抗审查方面的机会，同时也指出了代币集中、参与度低和实际中心化等挑战。
AI.research_question: 在什么情况下DAOs能够实现其民主承诺，或者反而会复制它们试图克服的权力不对称？
AI.motivation: DAOs作为一种基于区块链技术的新型制度形式，旨在通过可编程、透明和参与性机制重新分配决策权，挑战传统中心化治理结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化治理理论、区块链技术框架、制度经济学
AI.method: 理论分析和概念性探讨
AI.findings: DAOs在激励协调、快速协调和抗审查方面具有优势，但面临代币集中、参与度低和实际中心化等挑战；DAOs与人工智能的结合可能增加自动化，但也带来人类监督减少和算法不透明的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对去中心化治理模式的理解，提出了DAOs民主承诺实现条件的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计者和政策制定者提供了关于DAOs治理机制设计的重要见解，帮助识别和缓解潜在风险

title: Global Sourcing under Political and Technological Expropriation Risk: The Role of Financing Frictions
affiliations: King’s College London - King's Business School

detail.title: Global Sourcing under Political and Technological Expropriation Risk: The Role of Financing Frictions
detail.abstract: Growing concerns over intellectual property protection have renewed interest in how multinationals organize production. We examine how state political risk and technologytargeted expropriation threats shape the choice between outsourcing (lower capital commitment but weaker control) and internalization (higher capital but stronger control over technology), and whether financing frictions condition these decisions. Using data on 3,000 U.S. multinationals across 95 countries (2002-2017), we find that higher political risk is associated with a shift toward outsourcing, consistent with firms avoiding capital exposure in hazardous institutional environments. Yet this effect reverses when firms face technology-targeted expropriation threats and possess high-quality patents, suggesting internalization is used strategically to protect proprietary technologies. However, high leverage strengthens outsourcing even under high technology expropriation threats, indicating that financial risk limits firms' ability to commit capital to secure stronger control. Our findings show how political, technological, and financing frictions jointly shape the boundaries of the multinational firm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政治风险、技术征用威胁和融资摩擦如何共同影响跨国公司的外包与内部化决策。研究发现政治风险促使企业转向外包以降低资本风险，但在面临技术征用威胁且拥有高质量专利时，企业会转向内部化以保护技术。高杠杆率会强化外包倾向，限制企业为获取更强控制权而投入资本的能力。
AI.research_question: 国家政治风险和技术针对性征用威胁如何影响跨国公司在外包（资本承诺较低但控制较弱）与内部化（资本较高但对技术控制较强）之间的选择？融资摩擦如何调节这些决策？
AI.motivation: 知识产权保护日益受到关注，重新引发了人们对跨国公司如何组织生产的兴趣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交易成本经济学和资源基础观，探讨政治风险、技术征用威胁和融资约束对企业边界决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用2002-2017年间95个国家3,000家美国跨国公司的数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 政治风险较高时企业倾向于外包以规避资本风险；2) 面临技术征用威胁且拥有高质量专利时，企业转向内部化以保护专有技术；3) 高杠杆率会强化外包倾向，即使在面临技术征用威胁时也是如此。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治、技术和融资摩擦如何共同塑造跨国公司的边界决策，扩展了企业边界理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司在不同制度环境下制定生产组织策略提供了实践指导，特别是在知识产权保护和融资约束条件下的决策参考。

title: From suspected to prosecuted: Investigating insider trading
affiliations: Stockholm University

detail.title: From suspected to prosecuted: Investigating insider trading

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes identifiable Suspicious Transaction and Order Reports (STORs) provided by the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen, FI) under a data-use agreement. The material contains personal data and information relating to suspected offenses within the meaning of GDPR Article 10 and, therefore, requires ethical review under the Swedish Ethical Review Act (SFS 2003:460). The project sought and obtained approval from the Swedish Ethical Review Authority (Etikprövningsmyndigheten), Linköping division: Decision Dnr 2024-03527-01, approved 6 Aug 2024 (decision notice 14 Aug 2024). Data were processed only for research purposes, on secure systems, with confidentiality undertakings, and without any contact with the data subjects. Individual consent was not required because this data is a secondary use of administrative records.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the progression from suspicion to prosecution of illegal insider trading, using proprietary data of broker and exchange reports. Only 2% of the suspicion reports result in prosecution. Thus, public datasets limited to prosecutions capture only a narrow slice of enforcement. Reports are more likely when there are signs of information leakage, when the information is more valuable, and around scheduled announcements, but less likely at times of higher illiquidity and for firms listed on regulated markets. Regulators focus on trading profits, the suspect’s ties to the firm, the information value, budget constraints, and the volume of reports. Consistent with informed trading, suspected insider trading increases abnormal returns and correlates positively with asymmetric information.

AI.tldr: 本文使用券商和交易所的专有数据，研究了从可疑内幕交易到起诉的整个过程。只有2%的可疑报告最终被起诉，因此仅基于起诉数据的公开数据集只能捕捉到执法的狭窄范围。报告更可能在出现信息泄露迹象、信息价值更高以及预定公告期间发生，但在流动性较低时和在受监管市场上市的公司中较少发生。监管机构关注交易利润、嫌疑人与公司的关联、信息价值、预算限制和报告数量。与知情交易一致，可疑内幕交易增加了异常收益，并与信息不对称呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 从可疑内幕交易到起诉的整个过程是怎样的？哪些因素影响可疑报告的生成和监管机构的起诉决策？
AI.motivation: 公开数据集通常只包含已起诉的内幕交易案件，这只能反映执法的狭窄范围，无法全面了解从可疑到起诉的整个过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和监管执法理论，分析内幕交易的可疑特征和监管决策机制。
AI.method: 使用券商和交易所的专有数据，分析可疑内幕交易报告的生成和起诉过程。
AI.findings: 只有2%的可疑报告被起诉；报告更可能在信息泄露迹象、高价值信息和预定公告期间发生；监管机构关注交易利润、公司关联、信息价值等因素；可疑内幕交易与异常收益和信息不对称正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了从可疑到起诉的完整执法过程视角，揭示了监管决策的影响因素，丰富了内幕交易监管的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了改进执法效率的参考，帮助投资者更好地理解内幕交易监管的实际运作机制。

title: Values-Driven Investment Choices by Gen Z for Spirituality and Security
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, and NDIM - New Delhi Institute of Management

detail.title: Values-Driven Investment Choices by Gen Z for Spirituality and Security
detail.abstract: This research delves into the convergence of Gen Z's spiritual values and financial security in investment behavior. Being the first generation to be born digitally native, Gen Z is reshaping conventional norms not just in lifestyle and work but also the way they merge personal values and financial behavior. Ever more, spirituality, mindfulness, and seeking purpose are impacting this group's investment decisions, with an increased interest in ethical, sustainable, and impactoriented financial products. Meanwhile, fears of economic volatility, global warming, and job insecurity inform Gen Z's need for economic security and risk-averse management. This article examines how these twin priorities spiritual alignment and financial security exist together, sometimes intersect, and finally influence Gen Z's investment choices. Shows there is significant association, having prayed to God and making a purchase in different age group. Also significant difference is found in chose the investment which feels secure for money purchase in different age groups.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨Z世代精神价值观与财务安全在投资行为中的融合。作为第一代数字原住民，Z世代不仅在生活方式和工作方面重塑传统规范，还在整合个人价值观与财务行为方面表现出新特点。研究发现，灵性、正念和寻求目的等因素显著影响该群体的投资决策，同时经济波动、全球变暖和就业不安全感也塑造了他们对经济安全和风险规避的需求。
AI.research_question: Z世代的精神价值观与财务安全需求如何共同影响其投资选择？
AI.motivation: Z世代作为第一代数字原住民，正在重塑个人价值观与财务行为的整合方式，灵性、正念等精神因素与经济安全需求共同影响其投资决策，这一现象值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价值观导向投资理论、行为金融学理论，以及代际差异理论，探讨精神价值观与财务安全在投资决策中的交互作用。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，通过调查数据分析不同年龄组在投资选择上的差异，包括祈祷行为与购买决策的关联性，以及安全感对投资选择的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）祈祷行为与购买决策在不同年龄组中存在显著关联；2）不同年龄组在选择感觉安全的投资时存在显著差异；3）精神价值观与财务安全需求共同影响Z世代的投资选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了价值观导向投资理论，将精神价值观维度纳入分析框架；丰富了代际差异理论在投资行为中的应用；深化了对数字原住民投资决策机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构开发符合Z世代价值观的金融产品提供指导；帮助投资顾问更好地理解年轻投资者的决策模式；为企业制定针对Z世代的营销策略提供参考。

title: A Computational Method for Solving the Stochastic Joint Replenishment Problem in High Dimensions
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: A Computational Method for Solving the Stochastic Joint Replenishment Problem in High Dimensions
detail.abstract: We consider a discrete-time formulation for a class of high-dimensional stochastic joint replenishment problems. First, we approximate the problem by a continuous-time impulse control problem. Exploiting connections among the impulse control problem, backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) with jumps, and the stochastic target problem, we develop a novel, simulation-based computational method that relies on deep neural networks to solve the impulse control problem. Based on that solution, we propose an implementable inventory control policy for the original (discrete-time) stochastic joint replenishment problem, and test it against the best available benchmarks in a series of test problems. For the problems studied thus far, our method matches or beats the best benchmark we could find, and it is computationally feasible up to at least 50 dimensions-that is, 50 stock-keeping units (SKUs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络的计算方法，用于解决高维随机联合补货问题，该方法在50维问题中表现优于现有基准。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决高维随机联合补货问题？
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以处理高维随机联合补货问题，需要开发新的计算方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脉冲控制问题、带跳跃的后向随机微分方程(BSDEs)、随机目标问题
AI.method: 将离散时间问题近似为连续时间脉冲控制问题，利用深度神经网络开发基于模拟的计算方法
AI.findings: 在测试问题中，该方法匹配或优于现有最佳基准，计算可行至50维
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了脉冲控制问题、BSDEs和随机目标问题之间的联系，开发了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可实施的库存控制策略，解决了高维随机联合补货问题的计算挑战

title: Report of the Pittsburgh Task Force on Public Algorithms
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: Report of the Pittsburgh Task Force on Public Algorithms
detail.abstract:
This report summarizes the findings of the Pittsburgh Task Force on Public Algorithms, a group created to examine how the city of Pittsburgh and Allegheny County use automated systems to make major decisions. The Task Force found that local governments are already using algorithms in critical areas like child welfare, policing, and court risk assessments.

A key trend is a mixed track record: some agencies are transparent, but overall, there is low public awareness and a significant risk that these tools could reinforce existing racial and social biases. The report emphasizes that without strong oversight, transparency, and mandatory public participation, these algorithms may worsen inequity. The recommendations focus on giving the public a voice, ensuring clear accountability, and requiring outside review before high-risk systems are adopted.

AI.tldr: 该报告总结了匹兹堡公共算法工作组的调查结果，发现地方政府已在儿童福利、警务和法庭风险评估等关键领域使用算法系统。主要趋势是混合表现：部分机构透明，但整体公众意识低，存在强化种族和社会偏见的风险。报告强调需要加强监督、透明度和公众参与。
AI.research_question: 匹兹堡和阿勒格尼县政府如何使用自动化系统做出重大决策，以及这些算法系统对公平性的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着地方政府越来越多地使用算法系统做出重要决策，需要评估这些系统的透明度、公平性和公众参与度，以防止加剧社会不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法治理、公共政策透明度、算法公平性、社会偏见强化理论
AI.method: 通过匹兹堡公共算法工作组的调查和案例分析，评估地方政府在关键决策领域使用算法系统的现状和影响。
AI.findings: 地方政府已在儿童福利、警务和法庭风险评估等领域使用算法；机构透明度不一；公众意识普遍较低；算法系统存在强化现有种族和社会偏见的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了地方政府算法治理的实证研究，深化了对算法系统在公共决策中公平性影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了加强公众参与、明确问责机制和外部审查的具体建议，为地方政府制定算法治理政策提供实践指导。

title: Beyond military sales: the market premium on dual-use R&D in the defence sector
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond military sales: the market premium on dual-use R&D in the defence sector
detail.abstract: We examine how financial markets value defence firms’ R&D investments in the context of rising European military spending. Using data for listed European and US contractors, we relate equity valuation and expected earnings to R&D intensity and dual-use (civilian and military) activities. We find that higher R&D intensity is linked to stronger equity valuations, especially for firms with substantial dual-use exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在欧洲军费开支增加的背景下，国防企业的研发投资强度与股票估值呈正相关，特别是对于具有显著军民两用业务的企业。
AI.research_question: 金融市场如何评估国防企业在欧洲军费开支上升背景下的研发投资？
AI.motivation: 欧洲军事开支增加为研究金融市场对国防企业研发投资估值提供了独特背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业估值理论和研发投资价值评估理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲和美国上市国防承包商数据，分析股权估值和预期收益与研发强度和军民两用活动的关系。
AI.findings: 更高的研发强度与更强的股权估值相关，特别是对于具有大量军民两用业务的企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国防企业研发投资价值评估的理论理解，特别强调了军民两用业务的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国防企业投资决策和投资者评估国防企业价值提供实践指导。

title: Flexible Data Aggregation for Prediction and Decision Making with Contextual Information: Applications in Retailing
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Meituan, Meituan and Meituan

detail.title: Flexible Data Aggregation for Prediction and Decision Making with Contextual Information: Applications in Retailing
detail.abstract: Problem definition: How should online retailers make demand predictions or operational decisions with limited relevant data? Motivated by conventional data aggregation approaches, we develop a flexible data aggregation (FlexDA) framework to adapt to different degrees of heterogeneity across products, thereby striking a better balance between the bias and variance of data-driven predictions and decisions. Methodology/results: Under the FlexDA framework, we propose aggregating the individual datasets at different levels, potentially based on contextual information, and training submodels with each aggregated dataset. A meta-model is trained to integrate the outputs of these submodels with a set of weights. For demand prediction tasks with linear models, we propose a consistent estimate of the optimal weight, and theoretically demonstrate the advantage of the FlexDA approach over existing approaches under the small-data, large-scale regime. For decision making with nonlinear feature-demand relationships, with a fixed sample size, we show that the optimality gap of the FlexDA approach decays near-linearly in the number of products with high probability. We further validate the FlexDA approach with synthetic data and real data from the Rossmann store. Building on the theoretical development and empirical validation, we conducted an internal study with Meituan Youxuan, focusing on ordering problems in their community group buying business. Our proposed approach achieves an average reduction of more than 10% in both lost sale ratio (LSR) and inventory ratio (IR) for newly launched fresh products as well as standard products compared with the algorithm implemented by Meituan Youxuan. Managerial implications: Simply aggregating data from all products and training a shared model reduces the high variance caused by data scarcity but compromises the ability to capture heterogeneity across products. Our study highlights the value of flexible data aggregation for data-driven prediction and decision-making, especially for large-scale applications with limited data, with both theoretical and empirical support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了灵活数据聚合（FlexDA）框架，通过在不同层次聚合数据并训练子模型，再用元模型整合子模型输出，以在数据稀缺情况下平衡预测偏差和方差。该方法在需求预测和运营决策中优于现有方法，并在美团优选的实际应用中显著降低了缺货率和库存率。
AI.research_question: 在线零售商如何在相关数据有限的情况下进行需求预测或运营决策？
AI.motivation: 传统数据聚合方法在减少数据稀缺引起的高方差时，会牺牲捕捉产品间异质性的能力，需要在偏差和方差之间取得更好平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灵活数据聚合（FlexDA）框架，基于产品异质性程度在不同层次聚合数据，训练子模型并通过元模型整合输出。
AI.method: 在不同层次聚合个体数据集，训练子模型，训练元模型整合子模型输出；使用线性模型进行需求预测，非线性特征-需求关系进行决策；通过合成数据、Rossmann商店数据和美团优选内部研究进行验证。
AI.findings: 对于线性模型需求预测，FlexDA方法在小数据大规模情况下优于现有方法；对于非线性决策，最优性差距随产品数量近线性衰减；在美团优选应用中，新上市生鲜产品和标准产品的缺货率和库存率平均降低超过10%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了FlexDA框架，理论上证明了在小数据大规模情况下优于现有方法，为数据稀缺情况下的预测和决策提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 在美团优选社区团购业务中成功应用，显著改善了订单决策效果，为在线零售商在数据有限情况下的运营决策提供了实用解决方案。

title: Integrated Planning of Drone-Based Disaster Relief: Facility Location, Inventory Prepositioning, and Fleet Operations under Uncertainty
affiliations: ,  and Texas Tech University

detail.title: Integrated Planning of Drone-Based Disaster Relief: Facility Location, Inventory Prepositioning, and Fleet Operations under Uncertainty
detail.abstract: We introduce a two-stage robust optimization (RO) framework for the integrated planning of a drone-based disaster relief operations problem (DDROP). Given sets of demand points, candidate locations for establishing drone-supported relief facilities, facility types, drone types, and relief items types, our first-stage problem solves the following problems simultaneously: (i) a location problem that determines the number of facilities to establish and where to establish them, (ii) an inventory prepositioning problem that decides the quantity of relief items to store at each established facility, (iii) a fleet sizing problem that decides the number of drones to deploy, and (iv) an assignment problem that assigns drones to established facility and demand points. In the second stage, the model determines a relief distribution plan and enables the reassignment of drones to demand nodes. We equip the RO model with an uncertainty set that captures the relationship between facility disruptions, demand for relief items, drone operational status, and the remaining usable fraction of pre-positioned supplies after the disaster. Additionally, we explicitly model the dependency of postdisaster drone functionality on the pre-disaster assignment decisions. To address the challenges of integer recourse, we derive a K-adaptability approximation of the RO model and develop a column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm to solve it. Moreover, we introduce several strategies to enhance the computational performance of C&CG, including an efficient warm-starting mechanism, symmetry-breaking constraints, and valid inequalities. We present extensive numerical experiments that demonstrate the computational efficiency of our framework and provide valuable insights.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个两阶段鲁棒优化框架，用于无人机灾害救援操作的集成规划，包括设施选址、库存预置、无人机部署和分配决策，并考虑了设施中断、需求不确定性和无人机功能依赖等复杂因素。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑设施中断、需求不确定性和无人机功能依赖的情况下，制定有效的无人机灾害救援操作集成规划方案？
AI.motivation: 灾害救援操作面临多重不确定性，传统方法难以同时处理设施选址、库存预置、无人机部署和分配决策的复杂性，需要开发能够应对这些挑战的鲁棒优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两阶段鲁棒优化理论，结合K-适应性近似和列约束生成算法，构建考虑整数追索的灾害救援规划模型。
AI.method: 采用两阶段鲁棒优化方法，第一阶段解决设施选址、库存预置、无人机部署和分配问题，第二阶段制定救援分配计划；使用K-适应性近似处理整数追索，开发列约束生成算法求解。
AI.findings: 提出的框架在计算效率上表现良好，能够有效处理灾害救援规划中的多重不确定性，并提供有价值的决策见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了鲁棒优化在灾害救援领域的应用，提出了考虑整数追索和复杂依赖关系的两阶段优化框架，发展了K-适应性近似和高效求解算法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害救援组织提供了实用的规划工具，能够帮助决策者在不确定性环境下制定更可靠的救援方案，提高救援效率和资源利用率。

title:
From Busyness Management to Business Management:

Reclaiming Business Management from the Cult of Busyness
affiliations: University of Portsmouth

detail.title:
From Busyness Management to Business Management:

Reclaiming Business Management from the Cult of Busyness
