detail.abstract: This paper distinguishes between business management and busyness management as competing logics of organizing and knowing in contemporary organizations. Through conceptual analysis and theoretical synthesis, we argue that modern managerial practice has become dominated by a culture of busyness-the continuous performance of productivity through activity rather than achievement-a phenomenon we term and theorize as "Headless Chicken Syndrome." Drawing on classical management thought, theories of bounded rationality and sensemaking, critical management studies, and the sociology of time, this paper develops a conceptual framework contrasting the reflective, purposive logic of business management with the reactive, performative logic of busyness management. The paper advances the notion of managerial resonance as an alternative paradigm for reclaiming time, attention, and meaning in organizational life, while providing normative implications for leadership practice. In doing so, it contributes to the emerging discourse on post-productivist management and the ethics of attention by providing both a diagnostic lens and a restorative framework for organizational transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了商业管理和忙碌管理作为当代组织中两种竞争性的组织逻辑，提出了'无头鸡综合症'概念来描述现代管理实践中过度强调活动而非成就的忙碌文化，并提出了管理共鸣作为替代范式。
AI.research_question: 现代管理实践中忙碌文化与商业管理逻辑之间的区别是什么？如何通过管理共鸣范式来重构组织中的时间、注意力和意义？
AI.motivation: 现代管理实践被忙碌文化主导，管理者过度关注活动而非成就，导致'无头鸡综合症'，需要重新思考管理逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典管理思想、有限理性理论、意义建构理论、批判管理研究、时间社会学
AI.method: 概念分析和理论综合
AI.findings: 区分了反思性、目的导向的商业管理逻辑与反应性、表演性的忙碌管理逻辑，提出了管理共鸣作为替代范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后生产主义管理和注意力伦理的讨论提供了诊断视角和修复框架，推进了组织转型的理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导实践提供了规范性启示，帮助组织重新获得时间、注意力和意义。

title: A structured reflection for improving third party interventions and mediation practice: Reconsidering debrief
affiliations: Rutgers University

detail.title: A structured reflection for improving third party interventions and mediation practice: Reconsidering debrief
detail.abstract: We make a case for structured reflective practice for improving third-party interventions and mediation decision-making and outcomes. We propose that a lack of awareness of the automatic, intuitive nature of judgments that dominate the fast-paced and uncertain mediation circumstances risk a proper treatment of implicit social-psychological matters driving conflict and suitably addressing substantive issues. Implicit matters include parties' feelings about themselves and relational and process-related issues. The quality of intuitive unconscious decisions could improve by conscious structured reflective practice. This reflection presents a learning opportunity to gain an awareness of unconscious judgments and advance a beneficial interplay between conscious and unconscious processing. To support the significance of conscious, reflective practice for improving automated decisions in third-party interventions and mediation, we present the context of mediation and findings on cognitive processing, intuitive decision-making, expertise, and reflective practice. Empirical findings in negotiation, management, and medicine confirm the effectiveness of structured reflective practice. A research-based, four-dimensional Structured Reflective Instrument (SRI) developed by Tzofnat Peleg-Baker is offered. It was designed to systematically help mediators improve judgments, particularly the response to implicit mediation goals and outcomes. We provide an example of one dimension of the SRI in the Appendix.

AI.tldr: 本文主张通过结构化反思实践来改善第三方干预和调解决策及结果，强调在快速不确定的调解环境中，直觉判断的自动性可能导致对冲突中隐含的社会心理问题处理不当。作者提出了一个四维结构化反思工具来帮助调解员提高判断质量。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化反思实践来改善第三方干预和调解中的决策质量和结果？
AI.motivation: 调解环境快速且不确定，调解员往往依赖自动直觉判断，这可能忽视冲突中隐含的社会心理问题，如当事人的自我感受、关系问题和过程相关问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知处理理论、直觉决策理论、专业知识理论和反思实践理论
AI.method: 基于实证研究开发了一个四维结构化反思工具，并通过谈判、管理和医学领域的实证发现验证其有效性
AI.findings: 结构化反思实践能够提高直觉决策的质量，帮助调解员更好地处理隐含的调解目标和结果
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将结构化反思实践应用于调解决策的理论框架，强调意识与无意识处理的良性互动
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具体的结构化反思工具，为调解员提供了系统化的反思方法，有助于改善调解实践效果

title: AI-ENHANCED MULTI-OBJECTIVE OPTIMIZATION FRAMEWORK FOR LEAN MANUFACTURING EFFICIENCY AND ENERGY-CONSCIOUS PRODUCTION SYSTEMS
affiliations: Lamar University

detail.title: AI-ENHANCED MULTI-OBJECTIVE OPTIMIZATION FRAMEWORK FOR LEAN MANUFACTURING EFFICIENCY AND ENERGY-CONSCIOUS PRODUCTION SYSTEMS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There were no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals and therefore did not require ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Manufacturing enterprises increasingly operate under the dual imperative of enhancing operational efficiency while simultaneously reducing energy consumption. However, conventional improvement approaches often remain siloed-addressing either productivity or sustainability-thereby constraining opportunities for reproducible and system-wide optimization. This study aims to develop and empirically evaluate an AI-enhanced, multi-objective optimization framework that aligns lean manufacturing principles with energy-conscious operations. Using a quantitative, cross-sectional, case-based design, enterprise cloud data pipelines were established to integrate Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) historians with submetered energy logs across multiple discrete-part production lines in three industrial plants. The primary variables included Lean Practice Intensity (measured through a five-point Likert instrument), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and its components, and Energy Intensity (kWh per good unit). Additional operational moderators such as peak kW, demand variability, product mix, machine age, and shift patterns were also captured to account for contextual heterogeneity. The analysis pipeline consisted of scale reliability testing, descriptive and inferential statistics, correlation analysis, and hierarchical multiple regression incorporating plant-and shift-level controls. Furthermore, mediation analysis tested the role of efficiency as an intervening variable, while moderation analysis assessed the conditional effects of demand variability. To complement empirical inference, a surrogate-assisted evolutionary optimization algorithm was employed to generate Pareto-optimal fronts and knee solutions, benchmarked against baseline production schedules. Key results demonstrate that Lean Practice Intensity exhibits a positive association with OEE and a negative association with energy intensity, confirming efficiency as a significant mediator with a residual direct effect of lean practices on energy outcomes. The influence of lean practices was found to diminish under high demand variability, indicating a boundary condition for implementation. The optimization results further revealed that knee-point policies typically improved OEE by approximately 2-5 percentage points, reduced energy intensity by 6-15%, and curtailed peak demand by around 6%, all without compromising delivery performance or schedule adherence. From a managerial and systems integration perspective, the findings highlight the importance of viewing lean routines as actionable energy levers rather than ancillary practices. The study recommends institutionalizing variability-aware and tariff-aware production planning, and adopting a governed digital stack that links key performance indicators (KPIs), digital-twin telemetry, and AI-driven optimization engines.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个AI增强的多目标优化框架，将精益制造原则与节能运营相结合。通过实证研究发现，精益实践强度与设备综合效率正相关，与能源强度负相关，且效率是重要的中介变量。在高需求波动下，精益实践的影响减弱。优化结果显示，Pareto最优策略可提升OEE 2-5%，降低能源强度6-15%，削减峰值需求约6%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发并实证评估一个AI增强的多目标优化框架，使精益制造原则与节能运营相协调？
AI.motivation: 制造企业在提高运营效率的同时减少能源消耗的双重需求日益增长，但传统改进方法往往各自为政，限制了系统级优化的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精益制造原则、多目标优化理论、能源效率管理理论
AI.method: 采用定量、横断面、案例研究设计，建立企业云数据管道整合MES和SCADA系统数据，使用可靠性测试、描述性和推断性统计、相关分析、分层多元回归、中介和调节分析，以及代理辅助进化优化算法。
AI.findings: 精益实践强度与OEE正相关，与能源强度负相关；效率是显著的中介变量；高需求波动下精益实践影响减弱；优化策略可提升OEE 2-5%，降低能源强度6-15%，削减峰值需求约6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实精益实践通过效率中介影响能源结果，识别需求波动作为边界条件，发展了多目标优化理论在制造环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的优化策略，建议建立变异性感知和电价感知的生产规划，采用连接KPI、数字孪生遥测和AI优化引擎的治理数字堆栈。

title: No-good Pattern-based Solutions for the Operational Final Pit Problem
affiliations: University of Chile,  and University of Chile

detail.title: No-good Pattern-based Solutions for the Operational Final Pit Problem
detail.abstract: The operational final pit problem (OFPP) is the problem of determining the set of blocks that maximizes the undiscounted economic value of an open-pit mine while satisfying both slope-precedence and operational horizontal geometric constraints. Unlike the classical final pit problem, which considers only slope-precedence constraints, the OFPP explicitly enforces additional operational constraints on minimum widths that account for extraction, non-extraction, connectivity, and reclassification requirements. To overcome these challenging geometric constraints, we propose a simple yet effective heuristic based on an integer linear programming model that incorporates no-good patterns to eliminate infeasible block configurations. This pattern-based formulation ensures geometric consistency by maintaining a strictly positive Hamming distance between infeasible and feasible pit layouts. The methodology is evaluated on seven large-scale instances, showing that practical pit limits can be achieved with less than 1.1% loss in undiscounted value for most cases, while deviations above 5% in others highlight the model's ability to reveal potential value losses that conventional approaches may overlook until later planning stages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于整数线性规划和不良模式的启发式算法，用于解决考虑坡度优先和操作几何约束的露天矿最终坑问题。该方法在7个大规模实例上验证，显示大多数情况下可实现实际坑界，未贴现价值损失小于1.1%。
AI.research_question: 如何在满足坡度优先和操作几何约束的条件下，确定露天矿最大化未贴现经济价值的块集合？
AI.motivation: 经典最终坑问题仅考虑坡度优先约束，而实际运营需要额外考虑最小宽度等操作约束，包括开采、非开采、连通性和重新分类要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于整数线性规划理论，结合不良模式消除不可行块配置，通过保持不可行与可行坑布局之间的严格正汉明距离来确保几何一致性。
AI.method: 提出基于整数线性规划和不良模式的启发式算法，通过模式化公式确保几何约束的满足。
AI.findings: 在7个大规模实例评估中，大多数情况下可实现实际坑界，未贴现价值损失小于1.1%，部分案例偏差超过5%显示模型能揭示传统方法可能忽视的潜在价值损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了最终坑问题的理论框架，引入了操作几何约束的数学建模方法，发展了基于不良模式的启发式求解技术。
AI.practical_contributions: 为露天矿规划提供了考虑实际运营约束的决策工具，能够在早期规划阶段识别潜在价值损失，提高矿山运营的经济效益。

title: Random Tariff Wars and Business Uncertainty
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: Random Tariff Wars and Business Uncertainty

keywords: business uncertainty JEL Classification Numbers: F13

detail.abstract: The paper investigates the effects of frequent random tariff wars on business profit. One country randomly imposes an import tariff while the other country always retaliates tit-for-tat with the same import tariff rate. I characterize equilibria in which firms earn higher profits under a permanent reciprocal tariff war than under random reciprocal tariff wars. The profit loss due to uncertainty does not depend on risk aversion. The loss of profit occurs because firms are unable to plan and deliver their optimal production and sales levels when reciprocal import tariff rates fluctuate randomly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在随机关税战中，企业利润低于永久性互惠关税战。不确定性导致的利润损失与风险规避无关，而是源于企业无法在关税随机波动时规划最优生产和销售水平。
AI.research_question: 频繁随机关税战对企业利润的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究关税政策不确定性对企业经营决策和利润的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论框架下的关税战模型，包含随机关税设定和报复性关税机制
AI.method: 理论建模和均衡分析，比较随机关税战与永久关税战下的企业利润
AI.findings: 企业在永久互惠关税战下获得更高利润；不确定性导致的利润损失不依赖于风险规避；损失源于企业无法在关税波动时优化生产和销售
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了关税不确定性对企业利润的影响机制，证明损失主要源于规划困难而非风险规避
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于关税政策稳定性的重要启示，帮助企业理解关税波动对经营决策的影响

title: Suing the Bretton Woods Institutions: A Legal and Moral Imperative for the People of Developing Countries

detail.title: Suing the Bretton Woods Institutions: A Legal and Moral Imperative for the People of Developing Countries
detail.abstract: Developing countries frequently endure the adverse impacts of corruption, poor governance, and maladministration within public institutions, outcomes often enabled or aggravated by the conditionalities, lending practices, and oversight weaknesses of the Bretton Woods Institutions (BWIs), notably the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF). This paper argues that citizens of developing countries should pursue legal action in U.S. courts against these institutions to compel institutional reform and accountability. Building on the legal precedent set by Jam v. International Finance Corporation (2019), which curtailed the doctrine of absolute immunity historically enjoyed by International Financial Institutions (IFIs), this analysis demonstrates that victims of development-related harm now possess viable grounds to litigate under U.S. jurisdiction. Drawing on comparative reasoning from international law, sovereign immunity principles, and recent U.S. court decisions, the essay argues that citizens of developing countries can and should strategically utilize litigation to demand transparency, enforce restitution, and reform governance frameworks. The rationale emphasizes that legal challenges would not only promote justice for affected communities but also catalyze global accountability mechanisms, strengthening equitable and sustainable development governance.

AI.tldr: 本文主张发展中国家公民应在美国法院对布雷顿森林体系机构提起诉讼，以推动机构改革和问责制。基于Jam诉国际金融公司案确立的法律先例，分析表明发展相关损害的受害者现在有可行的理由在美国司法管辖区提起诉讼。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家公民能否通过在美国法院对布雷顿森林体系机构提起诉讼来推动机构改革和问责制？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家经常遭受腐败、治理不善和行政失当的不利影响，这些结果往往因布雷顿森林体系机构的附加条件、贷款实践和监督薄弱而加剧或促成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法、主权豁免原则、美国法院判例（特别是Jam诉国际金融公司案2019）
AI.method: 基于法律先例和比较推理的分析方法，结合国际法、主权豁免原则和近期美国法院判决
AI.findings: 受害者现在有可行的理由在美国司法管辖区提起诉讼，法律挑战不仅能促进受影响社区的正义，还能催化全球问责机制
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了国际金融机构法律责任的理论框架，挑战了传统绝对豁免原则
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家公民提供了具体的法律行动路径，推动布雷顿森林体系机构的透明度和治理改革

title: The Price of Liquidity: Implied Volatility of Automated Market Maker Fees
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - University at Buffalo and Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business

detail.title: The Price of Liquidity: Implied Volatility of Automated Market Maker Fees
detail.abstract: An automated market maker (AMM) provides a method for creating a decentralized exchange on the blockchain. For this purpose, individual investors lend liquidity to the AMM pool in exchange for a stream of fees earned from its operations as a market maker. Within this work, we reinterpret the loss-versus-rebalancing as the implied fee stream generated by an AMM so that a risk-neutral investor is indifferent in the decision of providing liquidity. With this implied fee structure, we propose a novel fixed-for-floating swap on the fees generated by an AMM in order to quote the implied volatilities and implied correlations of digital assets. We apply this theory to realized fees in different markets to empirically validate the relevance of the deduced fee-based volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解释AMM中的损失与再平衡关系作为隐含费用流，提出基于AMM费用的固定-浮动互换来推导数字资产的隐含波动率和相关性，并通过实证验证费用基础波动率的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AMM费用流来推导数字资产的隐含波动率和相关性？
AI.motivation: 传统金融市场中波动率是重要指标，但在去中心化金融中缺乏类似工具。AMM作为DeFi核心组件，其费用流包含资产波动信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将AMM的损失与再平衡重新解释为隐含费用流，风险中性投资者在提供流动性决策中保持无差异。
AI.method: 提出基于AMM费用的固定-浮动互换模型，应用该理论到不同市场的实际费用数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 推导出的费用基础波动率具有实际相关性，能够有效反映数字资产的波动特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AMM费用流与资产波动率之间的理论联系，为DeFi市场提供了新的波动率度量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为去中心化交易所提供了隐含波动率和相关性的定价工具，有助于风险管理和衍生品开发。

title: Killer Acquisitions: How Big Tech's Startup Buyouts Threaten Innovation and Market Competition
affiliations: National Law University Odisha and National Law University Odisha

detail.title: Killer Acquisitions: How Big Tech's Startup Buyouts Threaten Innovation and Market Competition
detail.abstract: This article examines the phenomenon of the "killer acquisitions" wherein the dominant technology firms acquire the nascent competitors to neutralize threats and consolidate market power. It highlights how such acquisitions can disrupt dynamic competition by eliminating innovative challengers before they mature; which ultimately shapes the market structure and consumer choice. This paper explores the global regulatory responses including the US Federal Trade Commission's reinvigorated merger guidelines, the EU's Ex-Ante Digital Markets Act and UK's proactive Competitions and Market Authority. Against this backdrop, this article addresses India's emerging legal framework, noting the introduction of Deal Value Threshold and the proposed Digital Competition Bill designating Systematically Significant Digital Enterprises (SSDEs). It argues for a balanced approach that combines the qualitative and quantitative tests which strengthens institutional capacity and ensures proportionality to avoid overregulation that could stifle innovation. This paper concludes by emphasizing the need for international cooperation and a tailored, adaptive framework to preserve innovation, consumer welfare and market contestability in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析科技巨头通过收购新兴竞争对手来消除威胁和巩固市场支配地位的"杀手收购"现象，探讨全球监管应对措施，并针对印度新兴法律框架提出平衡监管与创新的建议。
AI.research_question: 如何有效监管科技巨头的"杀手收购"行为，在保护创新和消费者福利的同时避免过度监管？
AI.motivation: 科技巨头通过收购新兴竞争对手来消除潜在威胁，这种"杀手收购"行为可能破坏动态竞争、扼杀创新并损害消费者选择，需要有效的监管框架来应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态竞争理论、市场支配地位理论和创新经济学理论，分析杀手收购对市场竞争结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用比较分析法，研究美国、欧盟、英国等主要司法管辖区的监管措施，并结合印度新兴法律框架进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 杀手收购确实会破坏动态竞争，消除创新挑战者；全球监管趋势包括加强并购审查、引入事前监管机制；印度正在建立包含交易价值门槛和数字竞争法案的监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对杀手收购现象的理论理解，提出了平衡监管的理论框架，强调比例原则和适应性监管的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的监管建议，包括加强机构能力建设、采用定性与定量相结合的测试方法，以及促进国际合作以应对跨境数字市场竞争问题。

title: Supply Chain Management and Operational Performance: A Critical Evaluation of Available Literatures
affiliations: Canadian University of Bangladesh and Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP)

detail.title: Supply Chain Management and Operational Performance: A Critical Evaluation of Available Literatures
detail.abstract: The Supply Chain Management (SCM) is a strategic tool that companies across the world are using for promoting performances. Operational performance is one of the performance measures for both manufacturing and service companies. Proper implementation of SCM is instrumental for achieving targeted performance and growth for companies. It contributes in improving competitiveness for the companies in the global market place. There is hardly any option left for companies in Bangladesh for not implementing extended SCM in order to survive in the industry. In this era of intense competition, implementation of SCM is the likely solutions for grabbing more market share. This study makes a critical evaluation of available literatures on influence of SCM on operational performance in the Bangladesh Readymade Garments Industry.

AI.tldr: 本文对孟加拉国成衣行业供应链管理对运营绩效影响的文献进行批判性评估，强调SCM对提升企业竞争力和市场份额的重要性。
AI.research_question: 供应链管理对孟加拉国成衣行业运营绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 在激烈竞争的时代，实施供应链管理是获取更多市场份额的可能解决方案，孟加拉国企业几乎没有选择不实施扩展供应链管理来在行业中生存。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理作为战略工具的理论框架，以及运营绩效作为制造和服务公司绩效衡量指标的理论基础。
AI.method: 对现有文献进行批判性评估的方法。
AI.findings: 适当的供应链管理实施对于实现目标绩效和公司增长至关重要，有助于提高公司在全球市场的竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为供应链管理在发展中国家特定行业（如孟加拉国成衣业）中的应用提供了理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国成衣企业实施供应链管理以提升运营绩效和竞争力提供了实践指导。

title: Judicial Corruption and Creative Destruction in Colombia
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Judicial Corruption and Creative Destruction in Colombia
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the Colombian “Cartel de la Toga” scandal (2017–2020) from the theoretical perspective of Joel Mokyr , Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt , Nobel laureates in Economics 2025. Their central postulate — that sustained development depends on investment in knowledge , innovation culture, and regulatory competition — is contrasted with the institutional deterioration caused through judicial corruption . paper explores how the scandal undermined social trust, reduced innovation incentives, and deepened territorial inequality by weakening the mechanisms that sustain creative destruction . The analysis adopts a multidisciplinary approach combining economic , financial , and cultural perspectives to evaluate the long-term impact of institutional failure on development and competitiveness in Colombia.

AI.tldr: 本文从2025年诺贝尔经济学奖得主Mokyr、Aghion和Howitt的理论视角分析哥伦比亚"长袍卡特尔"丑闻（2017-2020），探讨司法腐败如何破坏知识投资、创新文化和监管竞争，从而阻碍可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 司法腐败如何通过破坏知识投资、创新文化和监管竞争机制来影响哥伦比亚的可持续发展和竞争力？
AI.motivation: 分析"长袍卡特尔"丑闻这一重大司法腐败案件对哥伦比亚制度环境和发展前景的深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Mokyr、Aghion和Howitt（2025年诺贝尔经济学奖得主）的发展理论，强调知识投资、创新文化和监管竞争对可持续发展的关键作用。
AI.method: 多学科方法，结合经济、金融和文化视角，分析制度失败对发展的长期影响。
AI.findings: 丑闻破坏了社会信任，降低了创新激励，加深了地区不平等，削弱了维持创造性破坏的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将诺贝尔经济学奖得主的发展理论应用于司法腐败分析，深化了对制度质量与创新关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚和其他面临类似制度挑战的国家提供了政策启示，强调司法改革对促进创新和竞争力的重要性。

title: Conscious Distraction Learning Theory

detail.title: Conscious Distraction Learning Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: ODEFTO LABS (ODEFTO TECH Pvt Ltd.- ODEFTO.COM)

keywords: Conscious Distraction Learning Theory Conscious Distraction Learning Theory Conscious Distraction Learning Theory conscious distraction

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Conscious Distraction Learning Theory (CDLT), a novel educational framework that harnesses intrinsic curiosity through strategic conscious distractions to promote continuous learning across diverse environments. Unlike traditional structured learning approaches, CDLT transforms everyday experiences into rich learning opportunities, cultivating meta-cognitive skills and enhanced decision making capabilities. The proposed learning equation, L = (C × E) + (O × R), where Learning equals Curiosity multiplied by Environment and Observation multiplied by Reflection, provides practitioners with a simple framework to implement this methodology. This research explores how CDLT offers advantages over conventional approaches by aligning learning with intrinsic motivation, facilitating domain specific value creation, and promoting perpetual growth mindsets. Through case studies across multiple domains, we demonstrate how conscious distraction learning develops pattern recognition, predictive capabilities, and innovative problem finding & solving skills essential for success in the rapidly evolving 21st-century landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了意识分心学习理论（CDLT），这是一个利用内在好奇心通过战略性意识分心来促进跨环境持续学习的新型教育框架。CDLT将日常体验转化为学习机会，培养元认知技能和决策能力。
AI.research_question: 意识分心学习理论（CDLT）如何通过战略性意识分心来促进持续学习，相比传统学习方法有何优势？
AI.motivation: 传统结构化学习方法无法充分利用日常经验作为学习机会，需要一种能够利用内在好奇心、将日常体验转化为学习机会的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意识分心学习理论（CDLT），基于内在动机理论和元认知理论，强调通过战略性意识分心培养学习能力。
AI.method: 通过跨多个领域的案例研究，展示CDLT的实施效果和优势。
AI.findings: CDLT能够发展模式识别、预测能力以及创新问题发现与解决技能，这些能力对于21世纪快速变化的环境至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的学习方程L = (C × E) + (O × R)，为教育理论提供了新的框架和视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了简单易行的实施框架，能够促进持续学习、领域特定价值创造和成长型思维的发展。

title: Artificial Intelligence Adoption through the Lens of Strategy, Governance & Risk Management
affiliations: , Consultant and  Truist Financial Corporation

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Adoption through the Lens of Strategy, Governance & Risk Management
detail.abstract:
The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping industries and redefining how organizations achieve their strategic objectives. When effectively harnessed, AI enables smarter, faster decision-making, fuels product and service innovation, enhances customer personalization, and drives significant productivity and cost efficiencies. It is, without a doubt, a critical lever for sustaining a competitive advantage.

However, these same technologies, if implemented without appropriate governance, oversight, and ethical safeguards, can introduce material risks that undermine strategic intent. Poorly designed or misaligned AI initiatives can expose organizations to operational, ethical, and reputational vulnerabilities, ultimately eroding stakeholder trust and long-term value.

As AI becomes embedded in core business processes and decision-making frameworks, the imperative for a clear, coherent, and well-governed AI strategy has never been greater. Organizations that fail to establish such a strategy risk falling behind competitors, misallocating resources, or even incurring unintended financial and reputational debt due to ineffective implementation.

This paper is intended to:

  • Provide strategic guidance on how AI initiatives and use cases should be pursued with deliberate intent.

  • Offer direction to boards and executive leadership on developing and executing AI initiatives that deliver short and long-term value creation.

  • Stimulate discussion and reflection among directors and senior management as they review, approve, and oversee AI-related investments and governance structures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在组织战略中的双重作用：一方面AI能够提升决策效率、推动创新和降低成本，是维持竞争优势的关键杠杆；另一方面，缺乏适当治理的AI实施会带来运营、道德和声誉风险。论文为董事会和高管层提供了开发和管理AI战略的指导框架。
AI.research_question: 组织如何制定和执行有效的AI战略，以最大化价值创造同时最小化相关风险？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在各行业的快速渗透，组织面临在利用AI获取竞争优势与防范AI实施风险之间的平衡挑战。缺乏明确的AI战略可能导致资源错配、竞争优势丧失和声誉损害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略管理理论、风险管理理论和企业治理理论，构建AI战略与组织价值创造之间的理论联系。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，结合行业最佳实践和案例研究，提供战略指导原则。
AI.findings: 成功的AI战略需要明确的治理结构、道德保障措施和风险管控机制，同时要与组织的核心业务目标和长期价值创造保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了战略管理理论在AI时代的应用，提出了AI治理与战略整合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会和高管层提供了具体的AI战略制定指南、治理框架和风险管控措施，帮助组织有效实施AI项目并实现价值最大化。

title: Supplier Performance and CEO Compensation Contracts: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business,  and Fordham University - Gabelli School of Business

detail.title: Supplier Performance and CEO Compensation Contracts: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: This study examines how a firm's strategic interactions with its suppliers influence its executive compensation contracts. We develop a parsimonious model that demonstrates how a firm's board of directors can positively link CEO pay to supplier performance as a commitment mechanism to encourage supplier investment in production capacity. Our empirical analysis provides evidence consistent with this prediction, indicating that managerial incentives, on average, reflect not only the interests of the firm but also those of its supply base. Cross-sectional results reveal that positive incentive weights on supplier performance are larger for firms whose suppliers operate closer to full capacity, for firms with more financially constrained suppliers, and for firms with major suppliers or strategic alliances with their suppliers. Additionally, we find that suppliers increase their capital expenditures after their customers' CEO compensation is positively linked to supplier performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了企业与其供应商的战略互动如何影响高管薪酬合同。研究发现，董事会可以通过将CEO薪酬与供应商绩效正向挂钩，作为鼓励供应商投资生产能力的承诺机制。实证分析支持这一预测，表明管理激励不仅反映企业利益，也反映供应商利益。
AI.research_question: 企业的战略互动如何影响其高管薪酬合同？
AI.motivation: 理解企业如何通过薪酬设计来管理供应链关系，特别是如何激励供应商投资生产能力的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论和供应链管理理论，构建了董事会通过薪酬设计作为承诺机制的理论模型。
AI.method: 开发简约模型并进行实证分析，检验CEO薪酬与供应商绩效的正向关联及其影响因素。
AI.findings: 管理激励确实反映了供应商利益；供应商产能利用率高、财务约束强、存在主要供应商或战略联盟时，正向激励权重更大；供应商在客户CEO薪酬与自身绩效挂钩后会增加资本支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了高管薪酬理论，揭示了薪酬设计在供应链协调中的作用，提供了新的承诺机制理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计更有效的供应链管理工具提供了实践指导，帮助管理者通过薪酬合同优化供应商关系。

title: The Toga Cartel and Social Morality. Judicial Corruption and Social Morality
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: The Toga Cartel and Social Morality. Judicial Corruption and Social Morality
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the phenomenon of judicial corruption in Colombia known as the "Cartel of the Robe ," drawing on the theoretical postulates of Émile Durkheim's sociology and the positivist philosophy of law. It examines how the collective moral structure was weakened by institutional deviations that transformed justice-conceived as a guarantor of social cohesion-into a mechanism of privilege and impunity. Through a qualitative and hermeneutical approach, the case is interpreted as a manifestation of anomie and a loss of moral legitimacy in the State. The analysis relies on Durkheimian concepts of solidarity, the moral division of labor, and the sanctity of the legal norm to explain how the ethical decay of the judicial elite erodes the sense of community. It concludes that the reconstruction of justice requires a moral renewal of the State based on civic education, public ethics, and social responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文运用涂尔干社会学和实证主义法学理论分析哥伦比亚"法袍卡特尔"司法腐败现象，探讨制度偏差如何削弱集体道德结构，将司法从社会凝聚力的保障转变为特权和有罪不罚的机制。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚"法袍卡特尔"司法腐败现象如何体现涂尔干理论中的失范状态和国家道德合法性丧失？
AI.motivation: 分析司法腐败如何破坏社会团结和道德结构，探讨国家道德合法性的重建路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涂尔干社会学理论（团结、道德分工、法律规范的神圣性）、实证主义法学。
AI.method: 定性和解释学方法。
AI.findings: 司法精英的道德腐化侵蚀了社区意识，司法腐败是失范状态和道德合法性丧失的表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将涂尔干理论应用于司法腐败分析，深化了对国家道德合法性危机的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出通过公民教育、公共伦理和社会责任重建司法正义和国家道德基础。

title: The Challenge of Embracing Our Relational Nature in a Divided World
affiliations: Rutgers University

detail.title: The Challenge of Embracing Our Relational Nature in a Divided World
detail.abstract: This chapter examines the challenges of overcoming binary, divisive responses to crises-such as the 2023 Hamas-Israel war-through a relational lens. While polarized reactions often reduce complex realities to simplistic categories of oppressor and oppressed, such habits are rooted in Western individualist traditions that prioritize autonomous selves, monologic interaction, and hierarchical structures. These cultural patterns reinforce defensive reactions, diminish the value of the "other," and obscure the relational dynamics of power, thereby hindering genuine collaboration and dialogue. Drawing on social constructionist, dialogic, and relational theories, the chapter critiques the limits of individualist assumptions and highlights facilitative leadership as a transformative practice. Facilitative leadership can offer inclusive, reflective, and dialogic spaces that can surface hidden cultural and psychological dynamics, rebalance power, and foster co-created meaning. Through practices such as reflective inquiry, relational awareness, and dialogic engagement, it can support a shift from adversarial, top-down models toward collaborative, equality-based systems that can sustain constructive conflict engagement and collective problem solving. Ultimately, the chapter argues for embracing a relational paradigm that recognizes interdependence and fluid identities as central to human existence. By doing so, we can move beyond reactive binaries toward transformative collaboration grounded in dignity, mutual respect, and shared responsibility-conditions necessary for thriving in a divided and complex world.

AI.tldr: 本章通过关系视角探讨如何克服对危机（如2023年哈马斯-以色列战争）的二元对立反应，批判西方个人主义传统，提出促进型领导力作为转型实践，倡导基于尊严、相互尊重和共同责任的关系范式。
AI.research_question: 如何通过关系视角克服对危机的二元对立反应？
AI.motivation: 极化反应将复杂现实简化为压迫者与被压迫者的二元对立，这种习惯根植于西方个人主义传统，阻碍真正的合作与对话。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会建构主义、对话理论和关系理论
AI.method: 理论分析和批判性反思
AI.findings: 促进型领导力能够创造包容性、反思性和对话性空间，重新平衡权力，促进共同创造意义，支持从对抗性模式向协作性系统的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 批判个人主义假设的局限性，强调关系范式的必要性，认识到相互依存和流动身份对人类存在的核心意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供促进型领导力的具体实践方法（反思性探究、关系意识、对话参与），支持建设性冲突参与和集体问题解决，为分裂复杂世界中的繁荣发展创造必要条件。

title: The Sterile Ground: How an Environment of "Failure to Pass Review" Stifles the Birth of Thinkers
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Sterile Ground: How an Environment of "Failure to Pass Review" Stifles the Birth of Thinkers
detail.abstract: The genesis of transformative thought and profound intellectualism is not a spontaneous occurrence but the product of a conducive environment. This essay argues that a socio-intellectual climate dominated by the mechanism of "failure to pass review"-where ideas are preemptively filtered, censored, and judged against rigid, orthodox standards-is inherently antithetical to the cultivation of true thinkers. By examining the psychological, philosophical, and practical dimensions of such an environment, this paper will demonstrate how it systematically extinguishes the essential conditions for intellectual birth: cognitive liberty, the tolerance for failure, and the freedom to challenge the fundamental premises of established systems. Finally, it will posit a connection between the rise of bureaucratic academic review and the perceived stagnation in fundamental scientific progress since the 1970s Keywords

AI.tldr: 本文认为以"评审不通过"机制为主导的社会-知识环境会扼杀真正思想家的培养，因为它压制了认知自由、对失败的容忍以及挑战现有体系基本前提的自由。
AI.research_question: 以"评审不通过"机制为主导的社会-知识环境如何影响真正思想家的培养？
AI.motivation: 探讨当前学术环境中严格的评审机制如何抑制创新思想和深刻知识分子的产生，以及这种环境与基础科学进步停滞之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合心理学、哲学和实践维度，分析知识环境对思想发展的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和环境维度考察，论证严格评审机制对思想培养的负面影响。
AI.findings: 严格的评审机制会系统性地压制认知自由、对失败的容忍以及挑战现有体系的能力，从而阻碍真正思想家的产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"失败通过评审"机制对知识环境影响的系统理论框架，连接了官僚化学术评审与基础科学进步停滞之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术机构和知识环境改革提供了理论依据，强调了创造更宽容、更自由的知识环境的重要性。

title: The Garbage Majority: Why Most Academic Papers Are Useless-and Why This Harms Scientific Progress
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Garbage Majority: Why Most Academic Papers Are Useless-and Why This Harms Scientific Progress
detail.abstract: It is increasingly asserted that the overwhelming majority of academic publications-often estimated at 90-95%-provide little or no intellectual value. While the claim is controversial, bibliometric evidence and historical patterns strongly suggest that only a very small minority of scholarly work produces meaningful scientific or theoretical advancement. This article examines the intellectual, structural, and epistemic reasons for the proliferation of low-value research, critiques the argument that "useless" papers are harmless or necessary, and evaluates historian Li Bozhong's assertion that academic garbage constitutes a public hazard, not a neutral by-product. We argue that low-quality research is not merely unhelpful-it actively distorts knowledge, consumes resources, reinforces false paradigms, and suppresses innovation. The crisis is not individual but systemic: publication incentives reward quantity rather than originality, leading to an explosion of incremental, derivative, and conceptually hollow work. The conclusion emphasizes that scientific progress requires a reorientation toward problem-driven inquiry, theoretical advancement, and critical scrutiny rather than publication volume.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了学术界低价值研究的泛滥现象，认为90-95%的学术出版物缺乏知识价值，这些低质量研究不仅无益，反而会扭曲知识、消耗资源、强化错误范式并抑制创新。文章指出这是系统性危机，需要重新定位科研方向。
AI.research_question: 为什么学术界会产生大量低价值研究？这些研究对知识进步有何负面影响？
AI.motivation: 当前学术界普遍存在低价值研究泛滥的问题，据估计90-95%的学术出版物缺乏实质性知识贡献，这种现象需要系统性的批判分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学社会学、知识生产理论和学术激励机制理论，分析低价值研究的产生机制和影响。
AI.method: 文献分析、历史模式研究和理论论证相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 低价值研究不仅无益，反而会扭曲知识体系、消耗有限资源、强化错误研究范式并抑制真正的创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了低价值研究作为系统性危机的理论框架，挑战了"无用论文无害"的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术评价体系改革提供了理论基础，强调应从数量导向转向问题驱动和理论创新的导向。

title: Inclusive Economic Growth and Poverty Reduction Strategies in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Bibliometric Study
affiliations: 8 Mai 1945 – Guelma University

detail.title: Inclusive Economic Growth and Poverty Reduction Strategies in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Bibliometric Study
detail.abstract: This study offers a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of scholarly research on inclusive economic growth and poverty reduction in sub-Saharan Africa from 2015 to 2025, utilising data from the Scopus database and advanced network visualization tools like VOS viewer. The research maps patterns of author collaboration, thematic clustering, and research productivity in the field. The findings reveal the dominance of a small group of influential scholars such as Handa and Davis who serve as central nodes within dense collaborative clusters. Temporal and density visualisations highlight both long-established research communities and emerging themes, particularly in financial inclusion and governance reforms. Despite robust co-authorship networks, the analysis uncovers ongoing gaps, including limited interdisciplinary integration and underexplored policy mechanisms for poverty alleviation at micro and sectoral levels. The results emphasize the importance of high-quality, inclusive growth strategies and effective knowledge dissemination for sustainable development. Policy implications highlight the need for targeted capacity building, increased cross-sector collaboration, and the adoption of innovative development paradigms to accelerate poverty reduction in the region. This bibliometric approach provides an evidence-based model for ongoing assessment and strategic planning in African development research.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过文献计量方法分析了2015-2025年撒哈拉以南非洲包容性经济增长与减贫研究的合作网络、主题聚类和研究产出模式，揭示了核心学者集群、新兴主题和研究缺口。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲包容性经济增长与减贫研究的学术合作模式、主题发展和研究缺口是什么？
AI.motivation: 为非洲发展研究提供基于证据的评估模型和战略规划指导，促进该领域研究的系统性发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论、社会网络分析理论、知识扩散理论
AI.method: 基于Scopus数据库的文献计量分析，使用VOS viewer进行网络可视化分析
AI.findings: 1）少数核心学者（如Handa和Davis）主导研究网络；2）金融包容性和治理改革成为新兴主题；3）存在跨学科整合不足和政策机制研究薄弱等缺口
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了非洲发展研究的文献计量分析框架，揭示了该领域知识生产的结构和动态
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性能力建设、跨部门合作和创新发展战略的建议，促进可持续减贫

title: Strategic Management (SM)

detail.title: Strategic Management (SM)
detail.abstract: This paper, submitted by Nambili Samuel for the Master's in Global MBA at Abertay University, provides an in-depth strategic management evaluation of International Business Machines Corporation (IBM). The author draws upon professional experience as a data scientist within the organization to support the analysis. Using established strategic tools such as SWOT, PESTLE, and Porter's Five Forces, the study examines IBM's competitive position in the rapidly changing global technology landscape. The findings indicate that IBM possesses notable strengths, including a reputable global brand, extensive international presence, and leadership in hybrid cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI). However, the company faces persistent challenges related to bureaucratic structures, reliance on traditional business models, and strong competition from major cloud service providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Strategic initiatives, including the acquisition of Red Hat and progress in quantum computing, have strengthened IBM's market differentiation. The report concludes that IBM's long-term success will rely on its capacity to increase organizational flexibility, promote customer-focused innovation, and embed sustainability and ethical governance into its overall corporate strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文对IBM公司进行战略管理评估，发现其拥有全球品牌声誉、混合云和AI领导地位等优势，但面临官僚结构、传统业务模式依赖和激烈云服务竞争等挑战。
AI.research_question: IBM在快速变化的全球技术格局中的竞争地位如何？
AI.motivation: 作者作为IBM内部数据科学家的专业经验支持分析，旨在评估IBM的战略管理状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: SWOT分析、PESTLE分析、波特五力模型
AI.method: 使用SWOT、PESTLE和波特五力等战略工具进行分析
AI.findings: IBM拥有全球品牌声誉、国际存在、混合云和AI领导地位等优势，但面临官僚结构、传统业务模式依赖和来自AWS、Azure、Google Cloud的激烈竞争
AI.theory_contributions: 应用经典战略管理框架分析大型科技公司的竞争地位
AI.practical_contributions: 为IBM提供战略建议：增强组织灵活性、推动客户导向创新、将可持续性和伦理治理融入企业战略

reference: Osama A. Marzouk (2025). Verification of the reactingFoam Solver Through Simulating Hydrogen–Methane Turbulent Diffusion Flame, and an Overview of Flame Types and Flame Stabilization Techniques. Processes. 13(11):3610. https://www.mdpi.com/2227-9717/13/11/3610
title: Verification of the reactingFoam Solver Through Simulating Hydrogen-Methane Turbulent Diffusion Flame, and an Overview of Flame Types and Flame Stabilization Techniques
affiliations: University of Buraimi

detail.title: Verification of the reactingFoam Solver Through Simulating Hydrogen-Methane Turbulent Diffusion Flame, and an Overview of Flame Types and Flame Stabilization Techniques

publicationDetails.detailsText: Osama A. Marzouk (2025). Verification of the reactingFoam Solver Through Simulating Hydrogen–Methane Turbulent Diffusion Flame, and an Overview of Flame Types and Flame Stabilization Techniques. Processes. 13(11):3610. https://www.mdpi.com/2227-9717/13/11/3610

detail.abstract: This study aims to qualitatively and quantitatively assess the ability of the flow solver "reactingFoam" of the open-source OpenFOAM software v.2506 for a control-volumebased computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver in treating the reacting flow problem of a popular benchmarking bluff-body-stabilized turbulent diffusion (non-premixed) flame, that is, the HM1 flame. The HM1 flame has a fuel stream composed of 50% hydrogen (H2) and 50% methane (CH4) by mole. Thus, the acronym "HM1" stands for "hydrogen-methane, with level 1 of jet speed". This fuel stream is surrounded by a coflow of oxidizing air jet. This flame was studied experimentally at the University of Sydney. A measurement dataset of flow and chemical fields was compiled and made available freely for validating relevant computational models. We simulate the HM1 flame using the reactingFoam solver and report here various comparisons between the simulation results and the experimental results to aid in judging the feasibility of this open-source CFD solver. The computational modeling was conducted using the specialized wedge geometry, suitable for axisymmetric problems. The turbulence-chemistry interaction (TCI) was based on the Chalmers' partially stirred reactor (CPaSR) model. The two-equation k-epsilon framework is used in modeling the small eddy scales. The four-step Jones-Lindstedt (JL) reaction mechanism is used to describe the chemical kinetics. Two meshes (coarse and fine) were attempted, and a converged (mesh-independent) solution was nearly attained. Overall, we notice good agreement with the experimental data in terms of resolved profiles of the axial velocity, mass fractions, and temperature. For either mesh resolution, the overall deviation between the computational results and the experimental results is approximately 8% (mean absolute deviation) and 10% (root mean square deviation). These are favorably low. The current study, and the presented details about the reactingFoam solver and its implementation, can be viewed as a good case study in CFD modeling of reacting flows. In addition, the information we provide about the measurement dataset, the emphasized recirculation zone, the entrainment phenomena, and the irregularity in the radial velocity can help other researchers who may use the same HM1 data.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了OpenFOAM软件中reactingFoam求解器在处理HM1火焰（氢-甲烷非预混湍流扩散火焰）的能力，结果显示模拟结果与实验数据吻合良好，平均绝对偏差约8%，均方根偏差约10%。
AI.research_question: reactingFoam求解器在处理HM1非预混湍流扩散火焰问题中的能力如何？
AI.motivation: 验证开源CFD软件OpenFOAM在反应流问题中的可行性，为研究人员提供可靠的模拟工具选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于控制体积法的计算流体动力学框架，使用Chalmers部分搅拌反应器模型处理湍流-化学反应相互作用，k-epsilon模型模拟小涡尺度，Jones-Lindstedt四步反应机制描述化学动力学。
AI.method: 使用reactingFoam求解器对HM1火焰进行数值模拟，采用适合轴对称问题的楔形几何，尝试粗细两种网格，比较模拟结果与实验数据。
AI.findings: 模拟结果与实验数据在轴向速度、质量分数和温度分布方面吻合良好，平均绝对偏差约8%，均方根偏差约10%，收敛性接近网格无关解。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了开源CFD工具在复杂反应流问题中的适用性，为湍流-化学反应相互作用建模提供了案例支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了使用OpenFOAM进行反应流模拟的详细实施指南，强调了回流区、卷吸现象和径向速度不规则性等关键特征，可作为CFD建模的良好案例研究。

title: The Quantum Organizational Framework (QOF): The Grammar of Transformation

detail.title: The Quantum Organizational Framework (QOF): The Grammar of Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflicts of interest related to the subject matter of this paper or the frameworks described. All concepts and models referenced (Quantum Organizational Framework, Structural Maturity Continuum, Pragmatic Transformation Diagnostic, Quantum Contribution Model, and Atomic Organizational Evolution) are the author’s original intellectual property.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study is conceptual and theoretical and does not involve human participants, proprietary data, or experimental methods. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was independently conducted and self-funded by the author through Transformation Triage Ltd (United Kingdom).

detail.abstract:
Transformation failure is most often diagnosed as behavioural, yet its root cause is structural - organisations cannot deliver what their architecture cannot sustain. This paper introduces the Quantum Organizational Framework (QOF) as a diagnostic grammar that makes structure visible and measurable. QOF integrates the Pragmatic Transformation Diagnostic (PTD), Quantum Contribution Model (QCM), Atomic Organizational Evolution (AOE), and Structural Maturity Continuum to map how friction, flow, and feedback determine adaptive capacity. Drawing on organisational-design theory (Galbraith, Lawrence & Lorsch, Burns & Stalker, Mintzberg), systems and learning theory (Senge, Argyris & Schön, Beer, Wiener, Meadows), and information ethics (Floridi), it defines a five-level Leverage Hierarchy that links energy, visibility, and coherence across design layers. The paper positions constructive autonomy and dual-loop governance as design disciplines that turn ethics into engineered visibility. It serves as the theoretical and diagnostic foundation for the QOF ecosystem and related research on structural maturity and AI governance.

Transformation has become the most overused and least understood word in management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了量子组织框架(QOF)作为诊断工具，认为组织转型失败的根本原因是结构性问题而非行为问题。该框架通过整合多个诊断模型，使组织结构变得可见和可测量。
AI.research_question: 如何诊断和解决组织转型失败的结构性根源？
AI.motivation: 组织转型失败通常被归因于行为问题，但根本原因在于组织结构无法支撑转型目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合组织设计理论(Galbraith, Lawrence & Lorsch等)、系统与学习理论(Senge, Argyris & Schön等)、信息伦理(Floridi)，定义五级杠杆层次结构。
AI.method: 开发量子组织框架(QOF)，整合Pragmatic Transformation Diagnostic、Quantum Contribution Model、Atomic Organizational Evolution和Structural Maturity Continuum等诊断工具。
AI.findings: 摩擦、流动和反馈决定了组织的适应能力；建设性自主权和双环治理是将伦理转化为工程可见性的设计原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了连接组织设计层级的理论框架，为结构成熟度和AI治理研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供诊断工具使组织结构可见和可测量，帮助组织识别和解决转型障碍。

title: The MiCA Paradox: Regulatory Enablement and Network Effect Constraints in Euro-Denominated Stablecoin Development
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The MiCA Paradox: Regulatory Enablement and Network Effect Constraints in Euro-Denominated Stablecoin Development
detail.abstract: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation represents a landmark effort to create a harmonized framework for digital assets, with a key objective of fostering a eurodenominated stablecoin market. This paper identifies and empirically tests the "MiCA Paradox": the regulation successfully enabled market entry, yet its enactment is associated with a significant relative decline in the market share of euro stablecoins. Using a difference-indifferences eventstudy design with wild cluster bootstrap inference and data spanning 2020-2025, we find robust evidence that the post-enactment period led to a 33.5% relative decline in the euro stablecoin market share compared to USD stablecoins. We attribute this paradox to the interplay between regulatory enablement and the insurmountable network effects enjoyed by incumbent USD stablecoins. The findings highlight the limits of territorial regulation in global digital platform markets and offer critical lessons for the design of the digital euro and other jurisdictional policies.

AI.tldr: 欧盟MiCA法规旨在促进欧元稳定币市场，但实证研究发现存在'MiCA悖论'：法规成功促进市场进入，却导致欧元稳定币市场份额相对下降33.5%。

title: Sequential Decision Making in Dynamic Environment Bandits with Stochastic Structure

detail.title: Sequential Decision Making in Dynamic Environment Bandits with Stochastic Structure
detail.abstract: Motivated by the dynamic/non-stationary nature of many real-world market settings, we study sequential decision making problem under dynamic environment that satisfies two conditions: (i) the amount of changes is linear in time horizon T ; (ii) the expected reward of each possible decision (an arm) follows an ergodic stochastic process. Existing algorithms fail to perform well in the dynamic settings, where the expected reward of decision evolves over time. In this formulation, the expected reward of each arm follows a Reflected Brownian Motion (RBM that governs the temporal structure of the reward distributions. Our goal is to characterize the cost of adopting to the changing environment. Due to the dynamic nature of rewards, in this setting, decision maker has to continuously keep exploring in order to adapt to the changing environment. It implies that the confidence bounds do not shrink over time. Our formulation is a special case of the restless multi-armed bandit problem that is ”stateless reinforcement learning (RL)” problem.

detail.abstract: Governments worldwide are increasingly applying behavioral insights, particularly "nudges," to enhance policy implementation and public service outcomes. This paper reviews the theory and practice of nudges in public administration, drawing on cases from developed and developing contexts (UK, USA, India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Malaysia). This study examines the evidence for nudge effectiveness, compares meta-analyses and government trials, and discusses design and implementation factors. Behavioral economics and choice-architecture concepts build our theoretical framework, while policy implementation models (e.g., top-down vs. bottom-up) guide our analysis of administration. A mixed-methods approach is used: systematic literature review and comparative case-study synthesis. This investigation finds that nudges can yield modest but meaningful behavior changes (often a few percentage points). Success depends on context: well-targeted nudges (e.g., timely text reminders, default options) have improved tax compliance, health uptake, and environmental behaviors in multiple countries, but effects often diminish at scale. Ethical and capacity considerations are critical: high-level political support, institutional infrastructure, and safeguards against manipulation are needed for sustained impact. Based on this analysis, this research proposes a framework to integrate behavioral science into public policy cycles, emphasizing data-driven experimentation, cross-agency collaboration, and evaluation. Finally, this study discusses implications for administrative capacity and longterm governance.

detail.abstract:
In this second and final phase of our study, we validated and revised the Responsible AI Framework based on key insights gained from our interviews with leading AI experts and professional accountants. Our report also highlights the use cases of AI shared by some of our interviewees. These short case studies feature the challenges encountered, effective measures adopted to address these challenges and key benefits derived from their respective AI deployment.  We highlight below key points from our interview.

Successful deployment of trusted AI hinges on a shared responsibility framework involving collaborative efforts from AI developers, service providers, organisations and end-users. A “market beware” model is insufficient and would not work, as AI models are black boxes and too complex for users to decipher. As a result, they may not properly detect and appreciate AI limitations and biases. Interviewees were of the view that the primary responsibility for detecting and mitigating bias lies with developers and organisations deploying AI, supported by independent verification and robust frameworks. Tools, training and continuous monitoring can empower users to play a supporting role. 

The acceptable confidence or accuracy threshold for AI outputs depends on the use case, risk level and user context. AI systems capable of auto-correction and auto-upgrade present significant opportunities but also introduce complex risks, including bias, model drift, lack of transparency, operational disruptions and ethical concerns. Mitigating these risks requires a combination of governance, transparency, security and human oversight. 

While Privacy Enhancing Techniques (PETs) provide an important advancement in data anonymisation, client agreement to use anonymised corporate data for AI training depends on trust, clarity and robust governance. Best practice requires certified datasets and data provenance documentation. 

While research in Explainable AI (XAI) is advancing, interviewees opined that a fully feasible, reliable and stable XAI model is unlikely to emerge within the next two years. Incremental progress, driven by regulatory pressure and sector-specific needs, is expected, but significant challenges remain due to model complexity and the trade-offs between explainability and performance. In the meantime, practical approaches such as post-hoc explainability and robust governance can help bridge the gap and build trust in AI systems. 

AI applications in accountancy have the potential to significantly enhance the profession’s attractiveness by transforming roles, improving job satisfaction and broadening the talent pool. However, successful implementation requires responsible integration, robust training and a focus on empowering professionals. By addressing transitional challenges and fostering a culture of innovation, the accountancy profession can position itself as a dynamic, future-ready career choice for the next generation.

title: Inherited Inequality in Latin America
affiliations: World Bank - Development Research Group (DECRG), Università degli Studi di Bari “Aldo Moro” (UNIBA) - Faculty of Economics, ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research - Labour Markets, Human Resources and Social Policy Department, London School of Economics and London School of Economics and Political Science

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper argues that relative measures of intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity are closely related ways of quantifying the inheritability of inequality. We review both literatures for Latin America, looking both at income and educational persistence. We document very high levels of intergenerational persistence and inequality of opportunity for education, with inherited characteristics predicting 29% to 52% of the current-generation variance in years of schooling. Inherited circumstances are somewhat less predictive of educational achievement, measured through standardized test scores, accounting for 20% to 30% of their variance. Our estimates of inequality of opportunity for income acquisition suggest that between 46% to 66% of contemporary income Gini coefficients can be predicted by a relatively narrow set of inherited circumstances, making Latin America a region of high inequality inheritability by international standards. Our review also finds a very wide range of intergenerational income elasticity estimates, with substantial uncertainty driven by data challenges and methodological differences.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了代际流动性和机会不平等的相对衡量方法是量化不平等继承性的密切相关的途径。我们回顾了拉丁美洲在收入和代际教育持续性方面的文献，发现教育方面存在非常高的代际持续性和机会不平等，继承特征可以预测当前代教育年限方差的29%至52%。继承环境对教育成就（通过标准化测试成绩衡量）的预测力稍弱，占其方差的20%至30%。我们对收入获取机会不平等的估计表明，当代收入基尼系数的46%至66%可以通过相对较窄的继承环境集来预测，使拉丁美洲成为国际标准下高度不平等继承性的地区。

Drawing on historical analysis, political theory, and over thirty years of personal experience, the work advocates for a renaissance of humane capitalism—one grounded in transparency, fairness, and moral responsibility. It also proposes educational reforms to cultivate ethical leadership in business schools.

detail.abstract: Homelessness represents a persistent global challenge affecting millions, with approximately 750,000-771,000 individuals experiencing homelessness in the United States on any given night in 2024. Homeless populations require coordinated access to diverse services, including healthcare, food assistance, mental health support, and shelter, yet service fragmentation across geographic and organizational boundaries creates critical gaps in care delivery. This paper examines blockchain technology as an innovative solution to address coordination challenges in homeless services. Blockchain's distributed network architecture offers unique advantages: nationwide deployment unconstrained by political boundaries, universal accessibility via smartphones, enhanced data security through cryptographic protection, privacy preservation for vulnerable populations, real-time identification of service gaps, and reliable auditing capabilities. We further analyze the application of blockchain technology to homeless veteran populations-who constitute approximately 5% to 13% of the homeless adult population and are at a moderately higher risk of homelessness compared to the general population-as a potential model for broader implementation. Case studies, including the Blockchain for Social Impact initiative, Blockchain Charity Foundation, and emerging homeless registry systems, demonstrate practical applications. The integration of blockchain technology into social safety net infrastructure provides a scalable framework for ensuring equitable access to essential services while respecting individual privacy and dignity. This approach offers immediate implementation potential for governments and nonprofit organizations seeking to optimize resource distribution and close critical service gaps for vulnerable populations.

detail.abstract: This study investigates how Qawmi madrasahs in Bangladesh sustain themselves financially, focusing on primary revenue streams, management practices, and risks to long-term viability. Employing a mixed-methods design structured financial surveys, document analysis, and in-depth interviews with administrators, teachers, donors, and community stakeholders the research traces how zakat, sadaqah, local chanda, waqf, and diaspora contributions underpin daily operations. Findings show a heavy dependence on faith-based and episodic giving, weak mobilisation of waqf and internal revenue, and pronounced seasonal volatility that produces cash-flow gaps. These shortfalls regularly interrupt teacher salaries, routine maintenance, and investments in teaching and learning. Informal governance, inconsistent bookkeeping, and donor preferences for high-visibility capital projects further exacerbate fragility and widen divides between well-connected urban madrasahs and resource-poor rural ones. Based on these insights, the study proposes practical, context-sensitive measures to shore up financial resilience while safeguarding institutional autonomy: professionalizing waqf administration, creating pooled zakat mechanisms and community reserve funds, building basic accounting capacity, and piloting modest recurrent income-generating activities under transparent governance safeguards. Targeted at madrasah leaders, policymakers, and development partners, the recommendations aim to stabilize funding flows without undermining local values. By mapping financial flows and organizational practices, the thesis offers empirically grounded pathways toward fairer, more sustainable faith-based education.

detail.abstract: We examine EU and UK plans for achieving a fossil-free energy system by 2050, centered on massive electrification and large-scale deployment of wind and solar power. Using empirical trends, cost analyses, and systemfunction assessments, we argue that current strategies underestimate real economic, technical, and social challenges. Three scenarios for meeting 2050 electricity demand are compared: full reliance on renewables; a 50/50 split between wind-solar and nuclear; predominantly nuclear. Evidence shows that higher shares of weather-dependent generation correlate with higher electricity prices, greater volatility, and increased system integration costs. High renewable shares require extensive backup, storage, and grid reinforcement, raising complexity and environmental impacts. Overlooked costs are highlighted: reduced capacity value, transmission expansion, balancing services, and social externalities. Sustainability must encompass environmental, economic, and social dimensions. A technologically diverse, dispatchable-power-based strategy-especially with expanded nuclear power-offers a more robust, cost-effective, and socially acceptable pathway to climate neutrality than a predominant reliance on intermittent renewables.

AI.tldr: 欧盟和英国2050年化石能源系统转型计划过于依赖可再生能源，低估了经济、技术和社会挑战。研究表明，相比完全依赖风能太阳能的方案，包含核能的多样化技术组合能提供更稳健、经济和社会可接受的碳中和路径。
AI.research_question: 欧盟和英国实现2050年无化石能源系统的计划是否低估了实际挑战？不同能源组合（全可再生能源、风能太阳能与核能各半、主要核能）在实现气候中性目标中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 当前能源转型战略可能低估了大规模部署间歇性可再生能源带来的真实经济、技术和社会挑战，需要更全面地评估不同技术路径的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实证趋势分析、成本分析和系统功能评估，强调可持续性的多维度（环境、经济、社会）考量。
AI.method: 使用经验趋势、成本分析和系统功能评估方法，比较三种不同能源组合情景。
AI.findings: 高比例天气依赖型发电与更高的电价、更大的价格波动性和更高的系统整合成本相关；高可再生能源比例需要大量备用、存储和电网加固，增加了复杂性和环境影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了被忽视的成本因素：容量价值降低、输电扩展、平衡服务和社会外部性；提出了更全面的可持续性评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于实证的决策支持，建议采用技术多样化、以可调度电力为基础的战略，特别是扩大核能，作为更稳健、经济和社会可接受的碳中和路径。

title: Rating Government Procurement Markets

detail.title: Rating Government Procurement Markets

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a novel, scalable method for assessing the quality of public procurement systems using standard administrative data. Our approach compares the distribution of procurement opportunities to the distribution of contract awards across firms. We first derive a simple theoretical benchmark that relates the expected distribution of contract value winning firms, measured as a Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI), to the distribution of auction values, measured as a respective HHI, and the number of winning firms. Significant deviations of winning firms' HHI from this benchmark indicate potential governance failures such as corruption or unchecked collusion. Our method requires no subjective input, is transparent and reproducible, and allows for meaningful comparisons across countries, industry sectors, and over time. We use procurement data from Ukraine and EU member states in 2018-2021 to assess the performance of five large sectors. Ukraine's procurement performance in four of the five sectors is comparable to many other European countries, but Ukraine's construction sector consistently displays the largest excess concentration among all countries considered, consistent with anecdotal evidence of corruption in this sector.

AI.tldr: 开发了一种使用标准行政数据评估公共采购系统质量的新方法，通过比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布来识别潜在治理失败。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种可扩展的方法来评估公共采购系统的质量？
AI.motivation: 需要一种透明、可复制且无需主观输入的方法来评估公共采购系统的治理质量，以便进行跨国、跨行业和跨时间的比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI）的理论基准，将中标企业合同价值分布的期望HHI与拍卖价值分布的HHI及中标企业数量相关联。
AI.method: 使用乌克兰和欧盟成员国2018-2021年的采购数据，比较采购机会分布与合同授予分布，计算HHI偏差来识别治理失败。
AI.findings: 乌克兰在五个大型行业中有四个的表现与其他欧洲国家相当，但建筑行业在所有国家中显示出最大的过度集中，与腐败传闻一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于HHI的理论基准，用于识别采购系统中的治理失败，如腐败或串通。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种透明、可复制的方法，可用于评估和比较不同国家、行业和时间的公共采购系统质量。

title: From Vision to Nation: Sheikh Hasina's Political Philosophy and the Developmental Transformation of Bangladesh: Investigates How Hasina's Governance Ideology Aligns with Bangladesh's Socioeconomic Modernization
affiliations: Rajshahi University

detail.title: From Vision to Nation: Sheikh Hasina's Political Philosophy and the Developmental Transformation of Bangladesh: Investigates How Hasina's Governance Ideology Aligns with Bangladesh's Socioeconomic Modernization
detail.abstract:
The contemporary political trajectory of Bangladesh is inextricably linked to the leadership philosophy of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, whose governance framework has shaped the nation's transformation from a postcolonial crisis state into a model of resilience and developmental progress in South Asia. This study critically examines the philosophical foundations, strategic policies, and moral narratives embedded within Sheikh Hasina's political ideology and their influence on Bangladesh's socioeconomic evolution. Drawing upon political communication theory, developmental state theory, and leadership studies, the paper explores how Hasina's vision-rooted in the ideals of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and the ethos of Joy Bangla-has been translated into actionable statecraft.
The research investigates how Hasina’s governance integrates inclusive development, gender equity, digital modernization, and humanitarian diplomacy into a coherent national vision. It further analyzes her articulation of national identity and collective memory as instruments of political stability and democratic resilience. Through a qualitative synthesis of policy documents, speeches, and media discourses, the article argues that Sheikh Hasina’s leadership represents not merely administrative competence but an evolving philosophy of nationhood—a dynamic interplay between ideological conviction and pragmatic governance.
Ultimately, the paper contends that Sheikh Hasina’s leadership embodies a symbiotic relationship between vision and nation, wherein Bangladesh’s developmental achievements reinforce her political legitimacy, and her moral-political philosophy continues to define the nation’s identity and global positioning. The findings contribute to the broader discourse on political leadership and nation-building in postcolonial contexts, highlighting Bangladesh as a compelling case of visionary governance in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本研究批判性分析了孟加拉国总理谢赫·哈西娜的领导哲学如何塑造该国从后殖民危机国家转变为南亚发展典范的历程，探讨其政治意识形态中的哲学基础、战略政策和道德叙事对孟加拉国社会经济发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 谢赫·哈西娜的政治意识形态如何影响孟加拉国的社会经济转型和国家建设？
AI.motivation: 理解孟加拉国在谢赫·哈西娜领导下的政治轨迹和发展转型，以及其领导哲学如何将国家从后殖民危机状态转变为南亚的韧性和发展典范。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治传播理论、发展型国家理论、领导力研究
AI.method: 对政策文件、演讲和媒体话语进行定性综合分析的质性研究方法
AI.findings: 谢赫·哈西娜的领导不仅体现了行政能力，更代表了一种不断演变的民族哲学——意识形态信念与务实治理之间的动态互动。她的领导体现了愿景与国家之间的共生关系，孟加拉国的发展成就强化了她的政治合法性，而她的道德-政治哲学继续定义着国家的身份和全球定位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后殖民背景下政治领导力与国家建设的更广泛讨论做出贡献，强调孟加拉国作为全球南方愿景治理的引人注目案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了将包容性发展、性别平等、数字现代化和人道主义外交整合到连贯国家愿景中的治理模式，分析了民族认同和集体记忆作为政治稳定和民主韧性工具的作用。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The research was conducted independently and is not influenced by any financial or personal relationships with organizations that could be perceived as a conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human participants or identifiable private data and no experiments. Ethics approval was therefore not applicable.

detail.abstract: Argentina rose to prosperity in the early 20th century, then endured a century of volatility marked by debt crises, inflationary spirals, and policy reversals. This essay reviews the historical arc (“belle époque” to recurrent crises), parses data on inflation, growth, debt, and fiscal balances, and explains why the textbook link between deficits and debt sometimes breaks down. The conclusion looks forward to 2024–2025 stabilization efforts—surpluses, deregulation, and energy infrastructure—and the conditions under which disinflation can stick.

title: The Granular Origins of Inflation
affiliations: Harvard Business School, Bank for International Settlements (BIS), University of Basel and University of Michigan - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Granular Origins of Inflation

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper uses barcode-level price data for 16 advanced and emerging market countries over the period 2005–2022 to investigate the role of individual firms and product categories in aggregate inflation. We decompose inflation into the component due to macroeconomic shocks and the granular residuals capturing the impact of individual firms and product categories, respectively. In advanced economies, the firm granular residual accounts for 41% of the variance of overall inflation, while the product category granular residual accounts for another 15%. Most of the variation in the firm granular residual is due to idiosyncratic shocks rather than to higher sensitivity of larger firms to common shocks. In the cross-section of countries, granular residuals are less important in economies with less concentrated market shares and higher inflation, such as emerging markets. Granular forces also contributed to the post-COVID inflation surge, with the firm-level component explaining roughly one-third of the 2021–2022 inflation in advanced economies. Finally, granularities are associated with a more sluggish response of inflation to monetary policy shocks, suggesting that market concentration can influence monetary non-neutrality.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2005-2022年16个发达和新兴市场国家的条形码级价格数据，研究单个企业和产品类别在总体通胀中的作用。研究发现，在发达经济体中，企业层面的异质性冲击解释了41%的通胀方差，产品类别层面解释了另外15%。市场集中度高的经济体更容易受到异质性冲击的影响，这些冲击也解释了新冠后通胀飙升的三分之一。
AI.research_question: 单个企业和产品类别的异质性冲击在总体通胀中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解通胀的微观基础，特别是企业层面和产品类别层面的异质性冲击如何影响总体通胀动态。

AI.findings: 在发达经济体中，企业异质性冲击解释41%的通胀方差，产品类别异质性解释15%；市场集中度高的经济体更易受异质性冲击影响；异质性冲击解释了新冠后通胀飙升的三分之一；市场集中度影响货币政策传导效果。

title: Enhancing Access to Mental Health Services on University Campuses: The Impact of Tragic Events
affiliations: Santa Clara University, Leavey School of Business, Santa Clara University and Santa Clara University - Information Systems and Analytics

detail.title: Enhancing Access to Mental Health Services on University Campuses: The Impact of Tragic Events

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research has received IRB approval.

detail.abstract: Student mental health has emerged as a pressing concern in higher education. In contrast to the growing demand among students for mental health services, universities have lagged significantly in prioritizing these needs. Particularly, following tragic events such as student deaths, impacted individuals often experience substantial emotional or psychological suffering, requiring appropriate crisis-response operational strategies to sustain access to mental health care. In this paper, we examine how universities can enhance access to mental health counseling services on campus in light of the occurrence of tragic events. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset from the Counseling and Psychological Services center of a U.S. university, we address this issue by first estimating the impact of a tragic event on demand for mental health counseling services through a difference-in-differences analysis. We find that demand increases significantly, with individuals being 124% more likely to make an appointment in the immediate days following the tragic event. Among impacted individuals, those who belong to the proximate cohort of the victims are more likely to seek care. Second, we propose a multi-period optimization model that accounts for the anticipated demand surge and strategically balances the trade-off between meeting immediate and future demand, guiding budget allocation decisions for staffing mental health clinicians in a rolling-horizon approach. Our optimization model yields substantial gains compared to less sophisticated benchmarks used in practice, including a myopic approach that depletes the remaining budget immediately following a tragic event without accounting for future needs, and an empirically-informed approach that partially accounts for future needs.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨大学如何通过优化资源配置来应对悲剧事件后心理健康服务需求的激增。研究发现悲剧事件使心理咨询预约需求增加124%，并提出了一个多周期优化模型来平衡即时和未来需求，相比现有方法能显著提升服务效率。
AI.research_question: 大学如何能够在悲剧事件发生后增强校园心理健康咨询服务的可及性？
AI.motivation: 学生心理健康已成为高等教育中的紧迫问题，但大学在优先满足这些需求方面显著滞后，特别是在悲剧事件发生后，受影响个体需要适当的危机应对策略来维持心理健康服务的可及性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异分析方法和多周期优化理论，用于评估需求冲击和制定资源配置策略。
AI.method: 利用美国某大学心理咨询服务中心的全面数据集，首先通过差异分析估计悲剧事件对心理健康咨询服务需求的影响，然后提出一个考虑预期需求激增的多周期优化模型。
AI.findings: 悲剧事件后需求显著增加，个体在悲剧事件发生后立即预约的可能性增加了124%；在受影响个体中，与受害者关系更密切的群体更可能寻求帮助；优化模型相比实践中使用的较简单基准方法（如短视方法和经验方法）能产生显著收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个考虑需求冲击动态变化的多周期优化框架，为危机情境下的资源配置提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学管理者提供了实用的预算分配和人员配置策略，帮助他们在悲剧事件后更有效地满足学生心理健康服务需求，平衡即时和长期需求。

title: A Transparent, Data-Driven Framework for Warranty Premium Estimation
affiliations: KU Leuven - Faculty of Business and Economics (FEB), KU Leuven - Faculty of Business and Economics (FEB) and Ghent University

detail.title: A Transparent, Data-Driven Framework for Warranty Premium Estimation
detail.abstract: The European right-to-repair directive has raised costs for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) by imposing stricter repair requirements, prompting the need to adjust warranty premiums. Yet, such price increases risk being misinterpreted by customers as evidence of declining product reliability unless pricing mechanisms are transparent. To address this challenge, we introduce a data-driven framework for transparent warranty pricing that integrates claims and cost prediction to improve premium estimation. The framework employs surrogate models that approach the predictive performance of ensemble models while maintaining interpretability and transparency. Incorporating both product and customer characteristics enables premium estimation even for newly launched products without requiring extensive field data. Using a dataset of 12,000 returns from a multinational automotive supplier, we demonstrate that the framework achieves predictive accuracy comparable to an ensemble model benchmark while effectively distinguishing between high-and low-risk warranty profiles. Unlike black-box approaches, our method provides OEMs with a transparent, data-driven tool to justify warranty premiums, reducing the likelihood that customers perceive higher prices as indicators of unreliability rather than as consequences of regulatory compliance.

AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动的保修定价理论，结合索赔预测和成本预测，强调透明度和可解释性。
AI.method: 开发替代模型框架，整合产品和客户特征，使用12,000个汽车供应商退货数据集进行验证。
AI.findings: 该框架在预测准确性上与集成模型基准相当，同时能有效区分高低风险保修档案，并提供透明的定价依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合透明度和预测性能的保修定价理论框架，解决了黑盒模型在保修定价中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原始设备制造商提供了透明的数据驱动工具，能够合理调整保修保费，减少客户对价格上调的负面解读。

Cultures Of Technological Deployment In

detail.abstract: Typologies of intelligence cultures can be mapped geographically across the globe as well as temporally in time, against forming events or time periods. Deployment by intelligence agencies of disruptive or innovative technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be mapped or clustered in cultures and practices and against rigidity of applicable legislations. While attempts of inter-agency alignment of practices of technological deployments are undergoing and to some extent made known to the public, the national and regional context has an impact on how agencies deploy these technologies in both defensive and offensive purposes. Recent geopolitical events, changes in national political agendas and upheavals on the geopolitical stage put pressure on intelligence agencies and publicly underline tension points between accountability and fundamental attributions. The article aims to bring these factors together, looking at the intersection between culture of technological deployment by intelligence agencies, intensity of conflict in the region and changes in national political agendas that put pressure on the position of intelligence agencies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了情报机构在部署人工智能等颠覆性技术时，如何受到地理文化、地区冲突强度和国家政治议程变化的影响，重点关注技术部署文化、问责制与基本归因之间的张力。

AI Valuation and Semiconductor Industry Transformation (2020–2025)

AI Valuation and Semiconductor Industry Transformation (2020–2025)

An Integrated Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis of 95 Global Firms

detail.abstract: This working paper analyses the valuation determinants of 95 semiconductor and AI chip firms from 2020 to 2025 (860 firm-year observations). Using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) with firm clustering, we document robust associations between four leading indicators—business model innovation, patent value, CEO leadership, and R&D efficiency—and Tobin’s Q. A one-standard-deviation increase in Business Model Score is associated with a 1.90-unit increase in Tobin’s Q ($\beta = \mathbf{1.90}, p < 0.001$), followed by Patent Value ($\beta = 1.07, p < 0.001$) and CEO Leadership ($\beta = 0.87, p < 0.001$). These associations persist across fixed-effects panel specifications, winsorized and log-transformed Q, and subperiod splits (pre-AI vs. AI boom). A Random Forest model (out-of-sample $R^2 = \mathbf{0.79}$) corroborates the explanatory prominence of the four intangibles. The findings are consistent with a “new logic of value” in the AI semiconductor era: ecosystem positioning, software leverage, and strategic leadership are more strongly associated with market valuation than traditional financial inputs such as R&D spending intensity or manufacturing scale. To ensure transparency and replicability, we provide a public API-based validation framework (The Lens, Google Patents, FinnHub, FMP) and a runnable script that reproduces all external validations without proprietary data.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2020-2025年95家半导体和AI芯片公司的估值决定因素，发现商业模式创新、专利价值、CEO领导力和研发效率这四个无形资产指标与托宾Q值存在稳健关联，表明AI半导体时代出现了新的价值逻辑。
AI.research_question: 在AI半导体时代，哪些因素（特别是无形资产）对公司的市场估值产生显著影响？
AI.motivation: 传统财务指标在解释AI半导体公司估值时存在局限性，需要探索新的价值决定因素来理解这一新兴行业的估值逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无形资产估值理论和AI半导体行业特性，构建包含商业模式创新、专利价值、CEO领导力、研发效率等维度的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用广义估计方程（GEE）和随机森林模型，分析95家半导体和AI芯片公司2020-2025年的860个公司年度观测数据。
AI.findings: 商业模式创新对托宾Q值影响最大（β=1.90），其次是专利价值（β=1.07）和CEO领导力（β=0.87）；随机森林模型证实这四个无形资产具有最强的解释力（R²=0.79）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI半导体时代的"新价值逻辑"理论，强调生态系统定位、软件杠杆和战略领导力比传统财务投入更能解释市场估值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于公开API的验证框架和可复现脚本，为投资者、管理者和政策制定者评估AI半导体公司价值提供了实用工具。

title: Sample Complexity of Inventory Control with Setup Costs Beyond Plug-in Demand Estimation
affiliations: New York University and New York University (NYU)

detail.title: Sample Complexity of Inventory Control with Setup Costs Beyond Plug-in Demand Estimation
detail.abstract: We study the fundamental problem of how many samples are needed to learn an ϵ-optimal policy in inventory control with setup costs, where unmet demand is backlogged and unsold inventory carries over to the next period. We tackle the problem in two classical infinite-horizon metrics: the long-run average cost setting and the infinite-horizon discounted cost setting. It is well-known that for both settings, there exists an (s, S)-policy-possibly different in each setting-that is optimal when the demand distribution is known. However, the sample complexity question, where the demand distribution is unknown and only data samples are available, remains open. We provide the first (non-trivial) inventory policy learning idea that goes beyond the simple plug-in estimate. In each of the two settings, our proposed algorithm achieves superior sample complexity-and is hence more data efficient-than that achieved by either policy learning via the plug-in demand estimation or directly applying the (recently developed) optimal reinforcement learning algorithm, which is unable to exploit the specific structures inherent in inventory control problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在需求分布未知情况下，学习库存控制问题中ε最优策略所需的样本复杂度，提出了超越简单插件估计的新算法，在长期平均成本和无限期贴现成本两种设置下都实现了更优的样本复杂度。

AI.practical_contributions: 提出的算法更加数据高效，在实际库存管理中能够用更少的数据学习到高质量的策略

detail.abstract: The result of the hypothesis showed that Aggregate SME and Capitalization of SME jointly significantly influenced GDP [(R 2 = .305; F (2,20) = 3.943; p < .05)] accounting for about 30.5% of the variance observable in GDP.
