title: The Orchestra as a Laboratory: Generative Organizing for Performance and Learning
affiliations: ESCP Business School and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Orchestra as a Laboratory: Generative Organizing for Performance and Learning
detail.abstract: Orchestras and other performing arts organizations exist to deliver superior performance of artistic and cultural works. While performing arts organizations often serve as analytical templates to understand collective learning, creativity, and innovation, performance is not always concerted with learning in these and other organizations. Zooming in on a critical case of a performance arts' organization-an orchestra-cum-laboratory-our study seeks to advance understanding of generative forms of organizing for individual and organizational learning and creativity. Unlike traditional orchestras for which performance is an end and rehearsing a means, for the orchestra-cum-laboratory rehearsing is an end in itself, satisfying musicians' drives to learn and create. We are interested to advance understanding of why and how a creative collective operates as a learning-driven performance arts organization, and to what consequences. A strategy of in-betweenness, namely organizing in between an orchestra and a laboratory, is adopted to find balance between learning and performing. Yet, in-betweenness is not without its tensions. Our study demonstrates how orchestra members' growth needs lead them to organize as a laboratory, and subsequently how this implies "in-betweenness" both as a strategic choice and as a number of tensions/unintended consequences. We conclude with implications for entrepreneurial, creative, and generative organizations.

title: Five Emerging Strategies to Detect and Control Fraud: Multiple Case Studies
affiliations: , Barakatullah University Bhopal and MDI GURGAON

detail.title: Five Emerging Strategies to Detect and Control Fraud: Multiple Case Studies
detail.abstract: Fraud continues to pose a significant threat to companies, particularly in digitally-driven, high-volume environments such as the insurance sector. This article examines five emerging strategies—reactive, proactive, preventive, curative, and deterrence—used to detect and control fraud in Indian insurance companies over the last decade. A qualitative multiple-case study methodology was employed, focusing on three leading insurers. Data were analyzed using Dynamic Capability theory, emphasizing absorptive, adaptive, and innovative capacities to understand how firms anticipate, respond to, and mitigate fraud risks. Findings reveal that reactive strategies facilitate post-incident investigations and learning, proactive strategies leverage analytics and field investigations to anticipate fraud, preventive strategies strengthen internal controls and due diligence, curative strategies address systemic weaknesses from prior incidents, and deterrence strategies employ sanctions, regulatory escalation, and industry-wide collaboration. Companies effectively integrate these strategies, using dynamic capabilities to enhance resilience, reduce losses, and build stakeholder trust.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度保险公司在过去十年中采用的五种反欺诈策略（反应性、主动性、预防性、治愈性和威慑性），基于动态能力理论分析了这些策略如何帮助公司预测、应对和减轻欺诈风险。

detail.abstract:
Organizations are increasingly required to enhance their accountability to diverse internal and external stakeholders (Burrows, 1999). Knowing and understanding stakeholders’ expectations increases the ability of an organization to effectively respond to those expectations. Stakeholder relationship management is critical for corporate sustainability (Perrini & Tencati, 2006) or “capacity of a firm to continue operating over a long period of time” (p. 296). Organizations may benefit from developing collaborative interactions with their stakeholders, integrating their values and views into the formulation and implementation of organizational goals and objectives (Merrick, Parnell, Barnett & Garcia, 2005; Susniene & Vanagas, 2006).

This document contains a proposal of an Integrative Model of Stakeholders’ Needs Management (IMSM) that addresses the following components: (1) identification of organization’ stakeholders, (2) analysis of stakeholders’ needs, stakes and influence, (3) assessment and prioritization of stakeholders’ needs, (4) dialogical or consensus-building process, (5) Integration of stakeholders’ needs to organizational strategy, (6) integrated information and reporting system, and (7) continual organizational learning and growth. The conceptual framework underlying the discussion in this document was extracted from both seminal work (Argyris & Schon, 1978; Freeman, 1984; Burrows, 1999; Mitroff, 1983) and contemporary studies on stakeholders’ needs management (Friedman and Miles, 2002; Kaplan & Norton, 2001; Perrini & Tencati, 2006; Susniene & Vanagas, 2006).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个整合性利益相关者需求管理模型（IMSM），该模型包含七个关键组件，旨在帮助组织更好地识别、分析、评估和整合利益相关者需求，从而提升组织可持续性和问责制。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利益相关者理论（Freeman, 1984）、组织学习理论（Argyris & Schon, 1978）和可持续性理论，整合了当代利益相关者管理研究。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，通过文献综述和理论整合提出IMSM模型。
AI.findings: 提出了包含七个组件的整合性利益相关者需求管理模型：利益相关者识别、需求分析、评估优先排序、对话共识构建、战略整合、信息系统和持续学习。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了整合性利益相关者管理理论框架，将利益相关者需求管理系统化，为可持续性研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可操作的利益相关者管理工具，帮助组织建立有效的利益相关者关系，提升可持续性和问责能力。

detail.title:
The Impact Of Technical Skills On The Efficiency Of Administrative

detail.abstract: This study aims to investigate how technical skills affect the efficiency of administrative performance among workers in Saudi Arabia. To achieve this, a descriptive-analytical method will be used to examine the relationship between the independent variable (technical skills) and the dependent variable (administrative performance efficiency). The research sample includes workers from various sectors in Saudi Arabia. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and statistical software were used to analyze the relationship between technical skills and administrative performance efficiency. The results show that Programs of Educational Organizations (PEO) have the most significant positive impact on the Efficiency of Management Performance (EMP), followed by Programs and Systems (PS) and Electronic Configuration (EC). However, Support and Development (SD) does not have a significant effect on EMP. The study also discusses several practical implications, which are further explained in the conclusion.

title: DATA-DRIVEN SUPPLY CHAIN RESILIENCE MODELING THROUGH STOCHASTIC SIMULATION AND SUSTAINABLE RESOURCE ALLOCATION ANALYTICS
affiliations: Lamar University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DATA-DRIVEN SUPPLY CHAIN RESILIENCE MODELING THROUGH STOCHASTIC SIMULATION AND SUSTAINABLE RESOURCE ALLOCATION ANALYTICS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived as influencing the research, authorship, or publication of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients, participants, or case studies, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study investigates how data-driven capabilities and sustainable resourceallocation policies jointly influence supply chain resilience (SCRes) under disruption and uncertainty. Adopting a quantitative, cross-sectional, multiple case-study design, the research integrates survey-based measurement, archival operational data, and stochastic simulation-optimization to link organizational capabilitiesvisibility, collaboration, flexibility, supplier diversification, redundancy, risk orientation, and allocation efficiency-to key resilience outcomes, including service recovery, time-to-recovery (TTR), backorder intensity, cost variance, and emissions. Data were collected from 190 professionals across four international firms in discrete manufacturing, FMCG, healthcare logistics, and electronics sectors, each providing both perceptual and objective data spanning 12-24 months of operations. Hierarchical multiple regression models, supported by mediation and moderation analyses, revealed that collaboration, digital visibility, and allocation efficiency were the strongest predictors of resilience performance, while flexibility and diversification contributed moderate incremental effects. Allocation efficiency partially mediated the impact of visibility and collaboration on outcomes, demonstrating that information and coordination enhance resilience primarily through improved resource allocation. Moreover, capability effects intensified under uncertaintyvisibility's and collaboration's benefits were significantly amplified by demand volatility and lead-time variability. A composite Resilience Performance Index (RPI) was developed to align statistical and operational metrics, linking survey constructs to observed KPIs. Monte Carlo simulation experiments using empirically calibrated disruption parameters validated these statistical insights: sustainability-aware optimized policies improved mean service levels by 3-6 percentage points, reduced TTR by 15-27%, lowered backorder intensity by up to 24%, and cut emissions intensity by 6-11% compared to status quo. These findings confirm that resilience and sustainability can be jointly enhanced through data-driven allocation strategies. The study contributes an integrated, replicable framework that bridges measurement, inference, and decision experimentation-offering both theoretical clarity on capability mechanisms and practical guidance for managers seeking to design resilient, carbon-conscious supply chains under stochastic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数据驱动能力和可持续资源分配政策如何共同影响供应链韧性。研究发现协作、数字可视性和分配效率是韧性表现的最强预测因子，而灵活性和多样化具有中等增量效应。分配效率部分中介了可视性和协作对结果的影响。在不确定性下，能力效应增强。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了可持续优化政策可提高服务水平3-6%，缩短恢复时间15-27%，降低缺货强度达24%，减少排放强度6-11%。
AI.research_question: 数据驱动能力和可持续资源分配政策如何共同影响供应链韧性？
AI.motivation: 在中断和不确定性条件下，需要理解组织能力如何影响供应链韧性表现，以及如何通过数据驱动策略同时提升韧性和可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链韧性理论、资源基础观、能力理论、可持续供应链管理
AI.method: 定量横断面多案例研究设计，整合问卷调查、档案运营数据和随机模拟优化，收集190名专业人士数据，使用层次多元回归模型、中介和调节分析，以及蒙特卡洛模拟实验
AI.findings: 协作、数字可视性和分配效率是最强韧性预测因子；分配效率部分中介可视性和协作的影响；能力效应在不确定性下增强；可持续优化政策显著改善服务水平和环境表现
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合框架连接测量、推断和决策实验；澄清能力机制；验证韧性和可持续性可协同提升的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 开发可复制的韧性表现指数；为管理者提供设计韧性、碳意识供应链的实践指导；证明数据驱动分配策略的实际效益

title: Globalization's Startup Paradox: When Do Global Markets Really Create Jobs?

detail.title: Globalization's Startup Paradox: When Do Global Markets Really Create Jobs?
detail.abstract: Why does globalization reduce unemployment in some countries but not others? This policy synthesis addresses a puzzle: global market integration helps the UK maintain 4.5% unemployment while South Africa faces 33% joblessness despite similar openness to trade. Drawing on recent comparative research, this paper argues that the key difference lies not in the degree of openness, but in whether entrepreneurial ecosystems enable early-stage ventures to scale into stable, job-creating firms. In the United Kingdom, accessible finance, efficient regulation, and reliable infrastructure allow startups to expand and hire. In South Africa, funding shortages, regulatory hurdles, and infrastructure breakdowns trap most startups in early stages, limiting employment gains from globalization to large incumbents. Based on this analysis, the paper proposes a simple but practical, sequenced policy framework organized around four pillars: finance (co-investment funds, credit guarantees), regulation (digital one-stop shops, startup legal designation), infrastructure (reliable power, broadband), and skills/ networks (targeted training, accelerator support). Reforms in Rwanda, Morocco, Tunisia, and India demonstrate that rapid progress is feasible when policymakers focus on removing binding constraints. The core message for emerging economy policymakers: globalization creates opportunities, but jobs grow only when ecosystem conditions enable local startups to capture them.

AI.tldr: 全球化对失业率的影响取决于创业生态系统是否支持初创企业规模化发展。英国拥有完善的金融、监管和基础设施支持初创企业扩张创造就业，而南非因资金短缺、监管障碍和基础设施问题限制初创企业发展，导致高失业率。论文提出四支柱政策框架：金融、监管、基础设施、技能/网络，帮助新兴经济体通过改善创业生态系统来创造就业机会。
AI.research_question: 为什么全球化在一些国家降低失业率，而在其他国家却没有？
AI.motivation: 解释全球化背景下不同国家失业率差异的谜题：英国失业率4.5%而南非高达33%，尽管两国贸易开放度相似
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业生态系统理论，强调初创企业规模化对就业创造的关键作用
AI.method: 比较研究法，分析英国和南非的案例对比，并参考卢旺达、摩洛哥、突尼斯和印度的改革经验
AI.findings: 全球化就业效应的差异不在于开放程度，而在于创业生态系统是否支持初创企业从早期阶段发展到稳定就业创造阶段
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创业生态系统作为全球化就业效应调节机制的理论框架，强调初创企业规模化的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四支柱政策框架（金融、监管、基础设施、技能/网络）和具体改革建议，为新兴经济体创造就业提供实践指导

title: Before the Command Was Spoken: Law as the Extended Phenotype of Pre-Linguistic Norms

detail.title: Before the Command Was Spoken: Law as the Extended Phenotype of Pre-Linguistic Norms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research received no external funding and was conducted independently. No personal or financial relationships exist that could have influenced the study. All data sources are publicly available and cited in the References section.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. This research is a theoretical and systematic literature review using publicly available data from published sources. No human subjects, animal subjects, or original data collection involving participants were involved. All data are secondary analyses of peer-reviewed publications cited in the References section.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any organization, institution, or funding agency.

detail.abstract:
This paper argues that law is not a human invention ex nihilo, but the extended phenotype of pre-linguistic normative patterns that evolved to stabilize cooperation in early human groups. Drawing on Dennett's principle of "competence without comprehension," Dawkins' theory of the extended phenotype, and Richerson & Boyd's models of gene-culture coevolution, I propose that heteronomous norms predated prescriptive language and exerted selective pressure for its emergence. Using cross-linguistic evidence from deontic lexicons, archaeological markers of prehistoric social organization, primatological studies of third-party enforcement and coalition formation, and ethnographic documentation of ritual transmission, I demonstrate that proto-normsinitially encoded in embodied practice, partner selection, and collective sanctioning-created selection pressures for linguistic structures capable of abstracting, generalizing, and transmitting obligations across contexts. 
Experimental studies across great apes and New World monkeys (Pan troglodytes N=46, Cebus apella N=6) show systematic absence of normative enforcement: chimpanzees exhibit 0% third-party punishment (rejection rates 5-14% vs. 50% in humans; Riedl et al., 2012), while capuchins punish inequity (25.7%) but remain insensitive to intentionality (Leimgruber et al., 2016), demonstrating outcome-based rather than normbased responses. Archaeological analysis reveals conspicuous absence of exclusionary burial practices in Upper Paleolithic contexts (0.67%, 1/150 burials) versus systematic emergence in Neolithic/Chalcolithic periods (9-27%, 353/3,752 burials; χ²=11.89, p<0.001), suggesting egalitarian enforcement mechanisms preceded visible status marking. Far from being the origin of normativity, prescriptive language acted as a highfidelity transmission technology that allowed proto-norms to scale beyond Dunbar's number (~150 individuals) and institutionalize into recognizable legal forms. 
The written law, therefore, is not the source of obligation but its fossilized echo. This framework validates previously documented anomalies-including the 93.3% functional extinction of the Nineteenth Amendment despite formal validity and Argentina's 93-year fiscal constitutional lock-in-which remain inexplicable under textualist or institutionalist theories but are predicted by memetic competition dynamics. Testable predictions for cross-linguistic deontic density, ritual frequency correlations, and neural overlap studies are operationalized with specific falsification criteria.

AI.tldr: 法律不是人类凭空发明的，而是前语言规范模式的延伸表型，这些规范模式在早期人类群体中演化以稳定合作。规范性语言不是规范的起源，而是允许原始规范扩展到邓巴数（约150人）之外并制度化为可识别法律形式的高保真传输技术。
AI.research_question: 法律是如何从演化角度起源的？规范性语言在规范演化中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观念，认为法律是人类理性发明的产物，提出法律是前语言规范模式的延伸表型，这些模式在早期人类群体中演化以稳定合作。
AI.theoretical_framework: Dennett的"无理解能力"原则、Dawkins的延伸表型理论、Richerson & Boyd的基因-文化共同演化模型
AI.method: 跨语言证据（道义词汇）、史前社会组织考古标记、灵长类第三方执行和联盟形成研究、民族志仪式传播记录、实验研究（黑猩猩和卷尾猴）
AI.findings: 1) 类人猿缺乏规范性执行：黑猩猩第三方惩罚率为0%；2) 旧石器时代缺乏排他性埋葬实践（0.67%），新石器时代系统出现（9-27%）；3) 规范性语言是允许原始规范扩展的传输技术
AI.theory_contributions: 提出法律作为延伸表型的新理论框架，解释规范性语言在规范演化中的真正作用，为法律起源提供演化解释
AI.practical_contributions: 解释法律形式有效但功能失效的现象（如第十九修正案93.3%功能失效），预测跨语言道义密度、仪式频率相关性等可检验现象

title: The Participation of Private Stakeholders in International Tourism Governance

detail.title: The Participation of Private Stakeholders in International Tourism Governance
detail.abstract: Tourism represents a major sector of the global economy, generating around 10% of global GDP and facilitating cultural exchange, while also producing environmental degradation, cultural commodification, and unequal economic benefits. Despite its transboundary relevance, the governance of tourism has received limited attention in the law of international organizations. This paper examines the role of UN Tourism, a UN specialized agency, in coordinating global tourism regulation and integrating private stakeholders. Through its affiliate membership system, UN Tourism formally incorporates companies, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society groups, though commercial actors often dominate decision-making. Case studies of partnerships with UNESCO, ICAO, UNEP, the African Union, and the European Union reveal how private interests shape initiatives on sustainability, digital transformation, and heritage protection. The paper concludes that while UN Tourism promotes inclusivity and sustainable development, its governance structure privileges market-driven actors, risking the reproduction of global inequalities under a sustainability narrative.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了联合国旅游组织（UN Tourism）在全球旅游治理中的角色，指出尽管该组织通过附属会员制整合了私营部门利益相关者，但商业行为体在决策中占据主导地位，可能导致在可持续发展叙事下复制全球不平等。
AI.research_question: 联合国旅游组织在全球旅游治理中扮演什么角色？其治理结构如何影响可持续发展目标的实现？
AI.motivation: 旅游业占全球GDP约10%，具有重要的经济和文化意义，但也带来环境退化、文化商品化和经济收益不均等问题。尽管旅游业具有跨界相关性，但在国际组织法律框架下的治理研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际组织治理理论、公私伙伴关系理论、可持续发展治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析UN Tourism与UNESCO、ICAO、UNEP、非洲联盟和欧盟的合作关系
AI.findings: UN Tourism通过附属会员制正式整合了企业、行业协会、学术机构和民间社会团体，但商业行为体往往主导决策过程；与各国际组织的合作案例显示，私营利益在可持续发展、数字化转型和遗产保护等倡议中具有重要影响力
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际组织治理理论，特别是在公私伙伴关系背景下分析权力分配和利益代表问题；为可持续发展治理中的权力动态提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了全球旅游治理中存在的结构性不平等问题；为政策制定者提供了改善治理结构、平衡各方利益的实践建议；对国际组织改革和可持续发展议程的实施具有参考价值

It offers with concrete suggestions on how state and local officials can respond now by enforcing existing laws and creating new ones. In addition, there are action items for every single member of Congress to undertake, even if they are in the minority party.
