AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和金融机构理解市场预期形成提供新视角，有助于预测市场情绪变化

title: Digital Financial Inclusion and Financial Performance of Selected Money Deposit Banks in Nigeria
affiliations: Lead City University - Department of Management and Accounting, Lead City University and Lead City University, Ibadan. Nigeria

detail.title: Digital Financial Inclusion and Financial Performance of Selected Money Deposit Banks in Nigeria
detail.abstract: The relaunch of Digital Financial inclusion in 2012 by the central bank of Nigeria has made Nigerian banks to embrace several innovative ideas towards providing better quality services to their customers. These innovations are expected to impact on the performance of the banks as suggested by theoretical literature. This study is therefore conducted to provide some empirical explanation on the impact of Digital Financial inclusion instruments on performance of Nigerian banks. Data were collected from World Bank database, Central Bank of Nigeria Statistical Bulletin, and annual reports of deposit money banks. The data were analysed with Fixed Effect Regression Model. The Regression analysis was conducted after conducting the Breusch-Pagan Lagragian Multiplier (BP-LM) test to determine the suitability of either the fixed effect or random effect model. The findings revealed positive and significant impact of Automated Teller Machines, Bank embranchment, and point of sale terminals on bank performance at both 1% and 5% levels of significance. However, the result on the number of bank account is not significant. The study concludes that improvement in the quality of financial services will attract more customers to the bank and boost their performance. It is thus recommended that more ATMs, POS and Branches be put in place for better inclusive finance.

AI.tldr: 该研究实证分析了尼日利亚数字普惠金融工具对银行绩效的影响，发现ATM、银行分支机构和POS终端对银行绩效有显著正向影响，而银行账户数量影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 数字普惠金融工具对尼日利亚银行绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚央行2012年重新启动数字普惠金融计划，促使银行采用创新服务，理论上这些创新应影响银行绩效，但需要实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字普惠金融理论，探讨金融创新工具对银行绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用固定效应回归模型分析数据，数据来源包括世界银行数据库、尼日利亚央行统计公报和银行存款银行年报，并通过BP-LM检验确定模型适用性。
AI.findings: ATM、银行分支机构和POS终端对银行绩效在1%和5%显著性水平上有显著正向影响，而银行账户数量影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字普惠金融理论提供了实证支持，验证了特定金融创新工具对银行绩效的实际影响。

title: Corporate Social Responsibility Reporting Reforms around the World: Evidence on Firm Value and Externalities
affiliations: The University of Western Australia - Department of Accounting and Finance, Students, Australian National University - Research School of Accounting, Xiamen University - Accounting Department and Zhejiang University - School of Management

detail.title: Corporate Social Responsibility Reporting Reforms around the World: Evidence on Firm Value and Externalities
detail.abstract: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) reporting reforms are increasingly adopted worldwide, yet their implications for firm value and externalities remain unclear. Using a novel handcollected dataset of global CSR reporting reforms and a stacked difference-indifferences design, we find that treated firms experience a 9.25% decline in firm value but a 16.4% reduction in CO₂ and CO₂ equivalents emissions and a 10.27% increase in CSR ratings. Effects are stronger under reforms requiring greenhouse gas disclosures, lacking safe harbor provisions, not recommending a specific reporting framework, or not mandating external assurance. Stronger changes also emerge in jurisdictions with weaker stakeholder orientation and more developed market institutions, and among firms without CSR-contingent executive compensation and those with weaker CSR transparency and performance. At the country-level, reform jurisdictions reduce emissions by 40.75 million metric tons, yielding societal savings of $7.5 billion. Overall, CSR reporting reforms reduce firm value, but generate significant societal and environmental benefits.

AI.tldr: 企业社会责任报告改革导致公司价值下降9.25%，但显著减少碳排放16.4%并提高CSR评级10.27%。改革在缺乏安全港条款、不推荐特定报告框架或不要求外部鉴证时效果更强，同时在社会效益方面产生显著正面影响。
AI.research_question: 企业社会责任报告改革对公司价值和外部性（如碳排放）的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内CSR报告改革日益普及，但其对企业价值和环境外部性的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业社会责任理论、信息披露理论和利益相关者理论，探讨强制性CSR披露的经济和环境后果。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的全球CSR报告改革数据集，采用堆叠差分法设计进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 受改革影响的公司价值下降9.25%，但CO₂排放减少16.4%，CSR评级提高10.27%。改革效果在要求温室气体披露、缺乏安全港条款等条件下更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对强制性CSR披露经济后果的理解，揭示了企业价值与环境效益之间的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的CSR报告制度提供实证依据，帮助企业理解CSR改革的影响并调整策略。

title: Special Economic Zones: the Chinese Ladder to Get into Neoliberal Globalization
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Colombia

detail.title: Special Economic Zones: the Chinese Ladder to Get into Neoliberal Globalization
detail.abstract: This paper explored how the neoliberalism influenced the formulation, adoption, and implementation of the Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in China. In grappling with this question, a significant link was found: globalization. This process was driven by openness and liberalization, premises that neoliberalism revived in the global political sphere in the last decades of the 20th century. Then, to get into the world economy, China abandoned the protectionist ladder to take an additional one: formulate and adopt SEZs. These zones allowed China to have free trade policies without internal market liberalization. Furthermore, the implementation of SEZs as cities generated direct access to the neoliberal model of globalization.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了新自由主义如何影响中国经济特区的制定、采纳和实施，发现全球化是重要连接因素，中国通过经济特区在不进行内部市场自由化的前提下参与全球经济。
AI.research_question: 新自由主义如何影响中国经济特区的制定、采纳和实施？
AI.motivation: 理解新自由主义在全球化背景下对中国经济政策的影响，特别是经济特区作为政策工具的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义理论、全球化理论、经济特区理论
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究
AI.findings: 全球化是新自由主义影响中国经济特区的关键连接因素；经济特区使中国能在不进行内部市场自由化的前提下实施自由贸易政策；经济特区作为城市直接接入新自由主义全球化模式。

title: Regulatory responses to the financial stability implications of stablecoins
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Regulatory responses to the financial stability implications of stablecoins
detail.abstract: In essence, stablecoins are electronic money issued by a narrow balance sheet vehicle into a distributed ledger (or a "programmable platform"). Many believe that they will have significant success as new form of money. Members of the current US administration expect that US stablecoins would circulate globally and support demand for treasuries and the international role of the USD. Related to the latter, recent industry initiatives plan to rely on US stablecoins as settlement asset for cross border payments ("stablecoin sandwich"). We review the implications of large global stablecoins on the financial system and discuss financial stability risks and remedies. We compare regulatory approaches across some jurisdictions and note that different directions have been taken, although all authorities seem to agree that stablecoins must not be remunerated. We discuss additional ideas how to address the risks associated with successful stablecoins, propose some basic regulatory principles and note that prohibiting the remuneration of stablecoins is not necessarily fostering financial stability. We suggest three regulatory options fulfilling the proposed regulatory principles.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球稳定币对金融系统的影响，讨论了金融稳定风险和监管对策，比较了不同司法管辖区的监管方法，并提出了三个满足监管原则的监管选项。
AI.research_question: 大型全球稳定币对金融系统的影响是什么？如何有效监管稳定币以维护金融稳定？
AI.motivation: 稳定币作为新型电子货币形式，预计将在全球范围内广泛流通，并影响国债需求和美元国际地位，需要评估其对金融系统的潜在影响和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于电子货币理论、金融稳定理论和监管框架理论，分析稳定币作为分布式账本上的电子货币的特性及其对金融系统的影响。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和比较分析方法，回顾稳定币对金融系统的影响，比较不同司法管辖区的监管方法。
AI.findings: 不同司法管辖区对稳定币采取了不同的监管方向，但普遍认为稳定币不应获得报酬；禁止稳定币报酬不一定促进金融稳定；需要制定基本监管原则来应对风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了稳定币对金融系统影响的理论框架，分析了稳定币作为新型货币形式对金融稳定的潜在风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三个满足监管原则的监管选项，为政策制定者提供了具体的监管建议，有助于维护金融稳定和促进稳定币的健康发展。

title: Between Nothing and Everything: The Cosmic Equilibrium and Its Interdisciplinary Insights
affiliations: National Stock Exchange of India

detail.title: Between Nothing and Everything: The Cosmic Equilibrium and Its Interdisciplinary Insights
detail.abstract: This article presents the Unified Continuous Self-Balance Universe Hypothesis, a novel cosmological model that posits the universe as a dynamic, self-regulating system. Unlike classical finite-start or infinite-steady frameworks, incorporating multiscale feedback integration, this hypothesis maintains that the universe preserves equilibrium through sophisticated feedback mechanisms. Here, the Big Bang is reinterpreted as a critical phase within an ongoing self-balancing process, supported by empirical observations like the cosmic microwave background (CMB). The existence of universe is defined as a result of automatic equilibrium between "absolute nothingness"—a state absent of space, time, matter, or energy—and "unbounded infinity"—a limitless expanse of chaotic potential. Mathematically, the state of the universe, denoted by 𝐔, satisfies 𝟎 < 𝐔 < ∞, indicating it is always positive and finite. More specifically, within this framework, the time-dependent state U(t) satisfies 0a < U(t) < ∞u for all time t , where 0a represents absolute nothingness (denoted with subscript 'a' for absolute, a state devoid of space, time, matter, or energy) and ∞u represents unbounded infinity (denoted with subscript 'u' for unbounded, a limitless expanse of chaotic potential), emphasizing the universe's continuous evolution within these conceptual bounds. The universe evolves continuously between absolute nothingness (0a) and unbounded infinity (∞u), always remaining strictly within these bounds (0a < U(t) < ∞u for all t), ensuring the universe will not collapse into nothingness nor reach unbounded infinity; even in scenarios of eternal expansion leading to dilution toward emptiness, feedback mechanisms ensure no violation by regulating dynamics to prevent such dilution, converging to equilibrium Ueq. As time progresses, the universe's state converges to a unique equilibrium Ueq , expressed mathematically as limt→∞U(t) = Ueq, with 0a < Ueq < ∞u. This convergence signifies that all emergent possibilities (the bounds between absolute nothingness, 0a, and unbounded infinity, ∞u), are resolved by the automatic equilibrium, leaving only the universe itself as the final, self-contained reality. The model links to observable phenomena, including the CMB and dark energy, while extending its principles to interdisciplinary applications in fields such as ecology (e.g., ecological balance), economics (e.g., economic stability), artificial intelligence (AI), and artificial superintelligence (ASI) (e.g., optimization algorithms). Human talent optimization and exploration (e.g., feedback-driven skill development), and multiverse theories proposing cosmic equilibrium across multiple realities. Though partly speculative, this framework offers a testable and transformative perspective on cosmic evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了统一连续自平衡宇宙假说，将宇宙视为动态自调节系统，通过多尺度反馈机制维持平衡。大爆炸被重新解释为持续自平衡过程中的关键阶段，宇宙状态始终在绝对虚无（0a）和无界无限（∞u）之间演化，最终收敛到唯一平衡点Ueq。
AI.research_question: 宇宙如何通过动态自平衡机制维持其存在和演化？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统有限起始或无限稳态宇宙模型，提出更全面的自调节宇宙框架，解释宇宙的持续存在和演化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一连续自平衡宇宙假说，基于多尺度反馈整合理论，将宇宙视为在绝对虚无和无界无限之间动态平衡的系统。
AI.method: 理论建模和数学形式化，定义宇宙状态U(t)满足0a < U(t) < ∞u，并证明其收敛到平衡点Ueq。
AI.findings: 宇宙通过精密的反馈机制维持平衡，避免坍缩为虚无或达到无界无限；大爆炸是自平衡过程中的关键阶段；宇宙最终收敛到唯一平衡状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的宇宙学模型，重新解释大爆炸概念，建立了宇宙自平衡的数学框架，为理解宇宙演化提供了新视角。

title: Do Global Board Reforms Encourage Voluntary Delistings?
affiliations: Lehigh University - College of Business, , Alfaisal University and University of South Carolina - Moore School of Business

detail.title: Do Global Board Reforms Encourage Voluntary Delistings?
detail.abstract: We examine how global board reforms affect corporate decisions to voluntarily delist from public stock exchanges. Combining Azevedo et al.'s (2024) delisting model with Fauver et al.'s (2017) quasi-natural experiment setting, we analyze the impact of regulatory costs and expropriation penalties on delisting decisions. Contrary to prior evidence of positive reform outcomes, we find a significant increase in voluntary delistings. Further analyses show this increase results from an increase in the expropriation penalty. Our study suggests that global board reforms increase the expropriation penalty sufficiently that poorly managed, weakly governed firms choose to withdraw from public scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 全球董事会改革通过增加侵占惩罚，导致管理不善、治理薄弱的公司自愿退市，这与改革预期效果相反。

title: The New Dark Age: Modern Academic Publishing as the Most Autocratic Censorship Era in Scientific History
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The New Dark Age: Modern Academic Publishing as the Most Autocratic Censorship Era in Scientific History
detail.abstract: This article argues that contemporary academic publishing represents the most autocratic censorship regime in the history of science, paralleling and potentially exceeding the intellectual repression of the medieval period. While medieval despotism suppressed human freedom through political and religious authority, modern academic institutions suppress scientific truth through sophisticated gatekeeping mechanisms that systematically protect erroneous mainstream theories while excluding corrective research. We document five critical dimensions of this new dark age: (1) unprecedented proliferation of garbage and erroneous articles in mainstream journals; (2) complete absence of error-correction mechanisms despite 90-95% error rates; (3) multi-layered institutional protection systems for academic authorities and erroneous paradigms; (4) systematic suppression of correct theories through coordinated rejection across journals, preprint platforms, and even AI training datasets; and (5) elimination of historical vindication opportunities that previously allowed minority correct viewpoints to eventually triumph. The analysis reveals that modern academic censorship has achieved what medieval authorities could only dream of: creating self-perpetuating systems where errors multiply exponentially, corrections face insurmountable barriers, and even artificial intelligence inherits and amplifies institutional biases. Unlike Newton's era when correct theories could achieve posthumous recognition, contemporary minority correct viewpoints face permanent burial under mountains of mainstream garbage, creating a dark age from which escape may prove impossible without fundamental systemic revolution.

AI.tldr: 本文认为当代学术出版是科学史上最专制的审查制度，通过复杂的守门机制系统性地保护错误的主流理论并排除纠正性研究，创造了错误指数级增长、纠正面临不可逾越障碍的自延续系统。
AI.research_question: 当代学术出版如何通过审查制度系统性地压制科学真理并保护错误理论？
AI.motivation: 揭示现代学术机构如何通过复杂的守门机制创造比中世纪更严重的知识压制，导致科学真理被系统性排除。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术审查制度理论、守门机制理论、错误传播理论、制度偏见理论
AI.method: 文献分析和制度机制分析，通过五个维度考察现代学术出版系统的审查特征
AI.findings: 发现五个关键维度：主流期刊垃圾文章激增、缺乏纠错机制、多层制度保护系统、系统性压制正确理论、消除历史平反机会
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了现代学术审查制度的理论框架，揭示了其比中世纪更有效的知识压制机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术改革提供理论基础，揭示系统性问题的严重性，呼吁根本性制度变革

title: Colonial state and Muslim institutions: history of regulatory endowment) in British India
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Colonial state and Muslim institutions: history of regulatory endowment) in British India
detail.abstract:
From the perspective of English law, a typical waqf appeared to be a curious mixture of paradoxical features—combining elements of both the religious and the secular, and the public and the private. Lawyers and judges often struggled to determine whether a waqf should be classified as a religious or a secular institution, or as a public or a private trust. This question lay at the heart of debates over how such endowments should be regulated by the state.

Because vast tracts of land were dedicated as waqf, the East India Company could not overlook their significance. After the Company assumed full charge as diwan (tax collector) of Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa, it initiated a series of resumption proceedings—that is, efforts to recover lands that had been granted as rent-free holdings. These included a large number of waqf properties that the colonial authorities sought to bring under fiscal control.

AI.tldr: 本文从英国法律视角分析伊斯兰教瓦克夫制度的双重特性，探讨殖民时期东印度公司对瓦克夫财产的征用政策及其法律争议。
AI.research_question: 瓦克夫制度在英国法律体系下应如何分类？殖民政府如何规制瓦克夫财产？
AI.motivation: 瓦克夫制度兼具宗教与世俗、公共与私人的矛盾特征，导致法律分类困难，影响殖民政府的土地征用政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律分类理论、殖民法律体系、伊斯兰教财产制度
AI.method: 法律文本分析、历史档案研究、案例分析法
AI.findings: 瓦克夫在英国法律中被视为矛盾体，东印度公司通过恢复程序大量征用瓦克夫土地以加强财政控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对跨文化法律体系冲突的理解，揭示殖民法律对本土制度的重构过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代多元文化社会的法律实践提供历史借鉴，促进不同法律传统的对话与融合。

title: Independent Director-Affiliated Donations and Stock Price Crash Risk
affiliations: Xiamen University, Hunan University of Technology and Business, Xiamen University and Providence College - School of Business

detail.title: Independent Director-Affiliated Donations and Stock Price Crash Risk
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether and how independent director-affiliated corporate donations affect stock price crash risk in China. We find a significant positive relationship between affiliated donations and future crash risk. The relationship is more significant for firms with weak internal governance and limited external monitoring, when affiliated directors serve on the audit committee, and in non-state-owned enterprises. Overall, our findings suggest that the social ties built through affiliated donations undermine rather than enhance director monitoring, and that agency theory has more explanatory power than resource dependence theory for understanding the impact of affiliated donations on stock price crash risk.

AI.tldr: 独立董事关联企业捐赠与股价崩盘风险呈显著正相关关系，这种关系在公司治理薄弱、外部监督有限、关联董事任职于审计委员会以及非国有企业中更为显著。

title: W.H. Hutt's Analysis of Nazi Economics: "The Economic Strength of Dictatorships" (1939) and "Economic Lessons from the German Offensive" (1940)

detail.title: W.H. Hutt's Analysis of Nazi Economics: "The Economic Strength of Dictatorships" (1939) and "Economic Lessons from the German Offensive" (1940)
detail.abstract: This paper reproduces and contextualizes two unpublished lectures by the South African economist W.H. Hutt from 1939 and 1940 in which Hutt analyzes the economic policy of Nazi Germany. Hutt argued that the Nazis' early success in the war was attributable to their policy of eliminating anti-competitive restrictions on production by labor unions and capitalists. He believed that this provided a model for the Allies to emulate. This analysis of Nazi economic policy was far too generous to the Nazis in its depiction of Hitler as an advocate for ordinary workers and an enemy of monopoly capital. It also broke from the assessments of Hutt's fellow neoliberal economists-the German Ordoliberals and Austrian economists, such as Friedrich Hayek and Ludwig von Mises-who classified the Nazis as socialists and collectivists. Hutt's analysis of Nazi economic policy in 1939 and 1940 contributes to and complicates our understanding of neoliberal economists' recurring fascination with the possibility of a 'liberal dictator.'

AI.tldr: 本文重现并分析了南非经济学家Hutt在1939-1940年关于纳粹德国经济政策的讲座，他错误地将纳粹早期军事成功归因于消除反竞争限制，并认为盟军应效仿，这与当时其他新自由主义经济学家对纳粹的批判形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: Hutt对纳粹德国经济政策的分析如何挑战了当时新自由主义经济学家对纳粹的普遍看法？
AI.motivation: 重现Hutt未发表的讲座，探讨他对纳粹经济政策的独特解读及其在新自由主义思想史中的意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义经济学、竞争理论、国家干预与市场自由的关系
AI.method: 历史文献分析，对Hutt未发表讲座的文本解读和语境化分析
AI.findings: Hutt将纳粹早期军事成功归因于消除反竞争限制，错误地将希特勒描绘为工人利益捍卫者和垄断资本敌人，这与当时其他新自由主义经济学家将纳粹视为社会主义和集体主义的观点相悖。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新自由主义经济学家内部对'自由独裁者'可能性的不同看法，丰富了我们对新自由主义思想多样性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒当代学者警惕对专制政权经济政策的过度美化，强调需要全面评估政治体制与经济政策的关系。

title: Broken IPOs
affiliations: Miami University

detail.title: Broken IPOs
detail.abstract: This study examines the prevalence, determinants, and consequences of "broken" initial public offerings-IPOs that trade below their offer price in the secondary market. Broken IPOs are common, between 1990 and 2022, nearly one-third of U.S. IPOs trade below their offer price after one month, and nearly one-half do so after one year, with average price declines of 15.0% and 43.7%, respectively. The likelihood and timing of broken IPOs are related to firm, issue, and market characteristics, many of which reflect elevated uncertainty and information asymmetry. The implications are significant, as firms with broken IPOs suffer from limited post-IPO attention, encounter tighter external financing constraints, and face a greater risk of delisting from the stock market due to bankruptcy or liquidation than do other IPO firms.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1990-2022年间美国IPO市场中"破发"现象（即IPO后在二级市场价格跌破发行价）的普遍性、决定因素和后果。研究发现近三分之一IPO在一个月内破发，近一半在一年内破发，平均跌幅分别为15.0%和43.7%。破发可能性与公司、发行和市场特征相关，反映了不确定性和信息不对称。破发公司面临更少的市场关注、更紧的外部融资约束和更高的退市风险。
AI.research_question: IPO破发现象的普遍性、决定因素及其对公司的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: IPO破发现象在市场中普遍存在，但对其系统性研究不足，需要了解破发的规模、原因及其对公司的长期影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、市场效率理论、公司融资理论
AI.method: 实证分析1990-2022年间美国IPO数据，使用统计方法检验破发与公司特征、发行特征和市场条件的关系
AI.findings: 1/3的IPO一个月内破发，1/2一年内破发；破发与不确定性、信息不对称相关；破发公司面临更少关注、更紧融资约束和更高退市风险
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对IPO破发现象的理论理解，特别是信息不对称和市场效率在IPO定价和后续表现中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供IPO破发风险评估框架，为公司IPO定价策略提供参考，为监管机构识别高风险IPO提供依据

title: Bootstrapping under Imperfect Knowledge of Data: An Integrated Approach for Performance Assessment Using Composite Indicators
affiliations: Instituto Superior Técnico (IST), University of Lisbon, University of Catania - Department of Economics and Business and Instituto Superior Técnico (IST)

detail.title: Bootstrapping under Imperfect Knowledge of Data: An Integrated Approach for Performance Assessment Using Composite Indicators
detail.abstract: This study proposes a novel integrated methodology for performance assessment through composite indicators, capable of addressing multiple sources of imperfect knowledge of data and incorporating expert input. Performance and efficiency assessment techniques, particularly nonparametric methods such as Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), are highly sensitive to data quality. Although the proposed framework is applicable to DEA in general, for clarity and without loss of generality, this study focuses on the Benefit-of-the-Doubt (BoD) formulation. Building on the BoD approach, a DEA-based optimization method used for constructing composite indicators through entity-specific weights, we introduce for the first time a Bootstrap BoD framework. This approach brings statistical inference and bias correction into the BoD methodology, which until now lacked robustness tools. To overcome Bootstrap's known limitations, particularly its sensitivity to the original sample and its tendency to generate unrealistic resamples, we integrate it with the Hit-and-Run (H&R) procedure. H&R serves as a preprocessing step, capturing structural uncertainty by modelling and populating the feasible space for each entity. Bootstrap is then applied as a postprocessing tool, introducing stochastic perturbations to the frontier and correcting for bias. Results show that this dual-layered methodology significantly enhances the robustness and reliability of performance and efficiency assessments by combining the complementary strengths of both methods, performing better than classical BoD. This approach is capable of replacing current composite indicators methodologies as it is more complete, or at the very least capable of replicating them.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合Bootstrap和Hit-and-Run程序的新型综合指标评估方法，显著提升了数据包络分析(DEA)中Benefit-of-the-Doubt方法的稳健性和可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够处理数据不完美知识并整合专家意见的综合指标绩效评估方法？
AI.motivation: 现有绩效评估技术特别是非参数方法如DEA对数据质量高度敏感，且BoD方法缺乏稳健性工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Benefit-of-the-Doubt方法的DEA优化框架，结合Bootstrap统计推断和Hit-and-Run程序。
AI.method: 提出Bootstrap BoD框架，将Hit-and-Run作为预处理步骤捕捉结构不确定性，Bootstrap作为后处理工具引入随机扰动和偏差校正。
AI.findings: 双层次方法显著提升了绩效和效率评估的稳健性和可靠性，表现优于传统BoD方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将统计推断和偏差校正引入BoD方法，解决了其缺乏稳健性工具的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 能够替代现有综合指标方法，提供更完整或至少可复制的评估框架。

title: Can International Income Transfers Reduce the Use of Child Labor?
affiliations: Central Michigan University

detail.title: Can International Income Transfers Reduce the Use of Child Labor?

declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper shows how a policy of income transfer, such as remittance payments from a developed country, can reduce child labor, a target for the UN Sustainable Development Goals, by turning the terms of trade in favor of the transfer-receiving country. This is a novel policy measure because it utilizes an existing international economic event, known as income transfer, without imposing a significant financial burden on national governments. This reduces inequities in the global labor market without creating economic and non-economic turmoil resulting from policies involving bans or other alternatives to bans.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了收入转移政策（如来自发达国家的汇款支付）如何通过改善转移接收国的贸易条件来减少童工现象，这是联合国可持续发展目标之一。这是一种新颖的政策措施，因为它利用了现有的国际经济事件（收入转移），而不会给国家政府带来重大财政负担。这种方法在不造成因禁令或其他替代政策引发的经济和非经济动荡的情况下，减少了全球劳动力市场的不平等。
AI.research_question: 收入转移政策如何通过改变贸易条件来减少童工现象？
AI.motivation: 童工问题是联合国可持续发展目标的重要议题，需要寻找有效的政策解决方案。传统的禁令政策可能引发经济和非经济动荡，因此需要探索更温和有效的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论和收入转移理论，特别是关于贸易条件变化如何影响劳动力市场的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过分析收入转移对贸易条件的影响机制，进而推导其对童工现象的抑制作用。
AI.findings: 收入转移政策能够通过改善转移接收国的贸易条件，从而减少童工现象。这种方法比传统禁令政策更加温和有效，不会引发经济动荡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利用现有国际经济事件（收入转移）作为政策工具的新思路，丰富了童工问题解决的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府提供了一种成本较低、实施难度较小的童工问题解决方案，特别适用于发展中国家。这种方法避免了传统禁令政策可能带来的负面经济影响。

title: AI4Policy: AI-Enabled Scenario Planning for Policy-Making in the Age of AI
affiliations: Equiano Institute and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: AI4Policy: AI-Enabled Scenario Planning for Policy-Making in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: AI-enabled scenario planning (AIESP) promises to compress policy-analysis cycles from months to days, yet the same generative systems also introduce novel epistemic vulnerabilities: synthetic evidence floods, adversarial prompt injection, model-drift lobbying, and runaway feedback loops between generated narratives and data-collection priorities. We integrate recent advances in generative modelling, multi-agent wargaming and metascience retrieval into a single governance pipeline that is self-diagnostic-i.e., it continuously audits its own epistemic reliability. Our three contributions are: (1) Planning-a Bayesian scenario generator that treats LLM outputs as noisy priors and corrects for semantic data poisoning; (2) Synthesis-a metascience retrieval engine that surfaces "counter-evidence" embeddings to mitigate confirmation bias; (3) Generation-a constitutionalpolicy drafter with rollback tokens that can retract clauses when downstream audits detect inconsistency. We validate the system on a live case-UK policies retrofitting for generative foundation models-and show a reduction in epistemic error rate versus human-only panels, while flagging six intervention points that were invisible to legacy impact-assessment workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个具有自我诊断能力的AI场景规划治理管道，通过整合生成建模、多智能体兵棋推演和元科学检索技术，能够持续审计自身认知可靠性，在UK政策案例中显示出比纯人工小组更低的认知错误率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够自我诊断认知可靠性的AI场景规划治理系统，以应对生成系统带来的新型认知脆弱性？
AI.motivation: AI场景规划虽然能大幅压缩政策分析周期，但同时也引入了合成证据泛滥、对抗性提示注入、模型漂移游说等新型认知脆弱性，需要开发能够持续审计自身可靠性的治理系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯场景生成、元科学检索和宪法政策起草等理论框架，整合生成建模、多智能体兵棋推演和元科学检索技术。
AI.method: 开发包含三个核心组件的治理管道：(1)贝叶斯场景生成器，将LLM输出视为噪声先验并纠正语义数据中毒；(2)元科学检索引擎，提取"反证据"嵌入以减轻确认偏误；(3)具有回滚令牌的宪法政策起草器。
AI.findings: 在UK政策案例验证中，该系统相比纯人工小组降低了认知错误率，并识别出传统影响评估工作流无法发现的六个干预点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自我诊断治理管道的理论框架，整合了贝叶斯修正、反证据检索和回滚机制等创新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际应用的AI场景规划治理系统，能够有效应对生成AI的认知脆弱性，为政策制定提供更可靠的决策支持。

title: Bullish Minting: An Adaptive Control Framework for Token Issuance
affiliations: Kosmos Ventures and Kosmos Ventures

detail.title: Bullish Minting: An Adaptive Control Framework for Token Issuance
detail.abstract: We propose Bullish Minting, a dynamic framework for adaptive, goal-oriented token issuance. Inspired by modern monetary policy, the mechanism endogenizes the token emission rate through measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and adjusts supply according to network performance. The model formalizes the token economy as a bounded feedback-control system: the emission rate responds to KPI deviations via a weighted distance metric and decays through a timedependent sigmoid representing adoption and maturation. Targets themselves evolve according to an Additive-Increase/Multiplicative-Decrease (AIMD) rule, endogenizing the trajectory of network goals. We provide stability results under mild regularity conditions, a welfare interpretation as discounted loss minimization subject to a dynamic supply constraint, and comparative statics of policy elasticities. We outline empirical calibration and implementation considerations and propose a simulation protocol for quantitative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Bullish Minting框架，这是一个基于关键绩效指标（KPI）动态调整代币发行率的自适应机制，将代币经济建模为有界反馈控制系统，通过加权距离指标响应KPI偏差，并采用时间相关的sigmoid函数表示采用和成熟度衰减。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够根据网络性能动态调整代币发行率的自适应代币发行机制？
AI.motivation: 受现代货币政策启发，需要开发一种能够内生调整代币供应量以适应网络性能的代币发行框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有界反馈控制系统理论、现代货币政策理论、加权距离度量、时间相关sigmoid函数、AIMD（加性增加/乘性减少）规则
AI.method: 理论建模和形式化分析，包括稳定性分析、福利解释、政策弹性比较静态分析，以及模拟协议设计
AI.findings: 在温和正则条件下提供了稳定性结果，将福利解释为受动态供应约束的贴现损失最小化，并分析了政策弹性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将代币经济形式化为有界反馈控制系统的理论框架，引入了基于KPI的动态代币发行机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为代币经济设计提供了实证校准和实施考虑，提出了定量评估的模拟协议

title: Blockchain and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Bibliometric Analysis and Research Agenda
affiliations: Blockchain Research Lab, Blockchain Research Lab and Blockchain Research Lab

detail.title: Blockchain and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles: A Bibliometric Analysis and Research Agenda

declarations.funderStatement: The study was conducted as part of the research project AVIK (acronym; engl.: automated ground-air intercommunication in mobility for enhancing interaction and collaboration) which focuses on automating and enhancing the interconnectedness of different vehicles and mobility actors (e.g. UAVs and cars) in the context of data transmission, harmonization, aggregation and monetization. The project is funded by Germany’s Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (BMDV) under the conditions of the mFUND program (FKZ: 19F2227A). Consortium partners of AVIK comprise ASINCO GmbH (Consortium leader), Technische Hochschule Wildau, Werner Turck GmbH & Co. KG, and Blockchain Research Lab gGmbH.

detail.abstract: The convergence of blockchain technology and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has garnered significant attention due to its potential to enhance security, automation, and data management in UAV ecosystems. However, the ongoing growth of research in this domain necessitates a systematic analysis to delineate its intellectual structure and development trajectories. This study employs bibliometric techniques, specifically co-citation analysis and exploratory factor analysis (EFA), to identify and analyze key research streams at the intersection of blockchain and UAV technologies. Based on a dataset of 340 peer-reviewed publications retrieved from Web of Science, the analysis reveals six distinct research streams: (I) privacy and security in the Internet of Drones (IoD), (II) implications of combining emerging technologies, (III) federated learning, (IV) resource and data management in IoT, (V) optimization, security, and applications in UAV-enabled mobile edge computing (MEC) systems, and (VI) blockchain-enabled data sharing and automation in the IoD. These findings highlight blockchain's role in securing UAV communication, optimizing resource management, and enabling decentralized automation. Despite these advancements, challenges related to scalability, computational efficiency, and interoperability persist, with limited empirical validation of proposed frameworks. This study provides a structured overview of the evolving research landscape, offering insights for future investigations and interdisciplinary collaborations aimed at addressing these challenges. Building on the identified research streams, this study proposes a research agenda that highlights unresolved challenges and critical gaps-such as lightweight consensus protocols, privacypreserving federated learning, efficient resource allocation, and integration with emerging technologies-thereby advancing the secure and efficient integration of blockchain and UAV technologies across diverse applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用文献计量学方法分析区块链与无人机技术融合领域的研究现状，识别出六个主要研究方向，并提出未来研究议程以解决可扩展性、计算效率和互操作性等挑战。
AI.research_question: 区块链与无人机技术融合领域的研究结构和发展轨迹是什么？
AI.motivation: 区块链与无人机技术融合的研究快速增长，需要系统分析其知识结构和演进路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论，包括共引分析和探索性因子分析。
AI.method: 基于Web of Science数据库中340篇同行评审论文，采用共引分析和探索性因子分析。
AI.findings: 识别出六个研究流：(I)无人机互联网中的隐私与安全、(II)新兴技术融合的影响、(III)联邦学习、(IV)物联网中的资源与数据管理、(V)无人机移动边缘计算系统的优化、安全与应用、(VI)区块链支持的数据共享与自动化。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了区块链与无人机技术融合领域的知识结构框架，识别了关键研究流和发展轨迹。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了结构化概览，提出了解决可扩展性、计算效率和互操作性挑战的研究议程，促进跨学科合作。

title: The Developmental State and the Constitutional Economy
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: The Developmental State and the Constitutional Economy
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the institutional and constitutional foundations of the developmental state in Colombia, using Joseph Stiglitz's analytical framework on market failures and the role of the state in creating equitable and sustainable development. The study focuses on Title V of the 1991 Political Constitution, "On the Organization of the State," to examine whether its articles establish the necessary normative and institutional conditions to correct market failures, balance economic efficiency and social justice, and build a hard (physical) and soft (educational, cognitive, and financial) infrastructure that enables sustained and equitable growth. Preliminary results indicate that the 1991 Constitution conceives of the state as an active agent that not only regulates markets but also guides and creates them, fostering social mobility, competitiveness, and redistribution. The article concludes that the Colombian constitutional order contains the foundations of a developmental state, although its effective implementation requires a more coherent, deliberative, and distributive institutional architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文运用斯蒂格利茨的市场失灵分析框架，分析哥伦比亚1991年宪法第五编是否建立了发展型国家的制度基础，研究表明该宪法确立了国家作为市场引导者和创造者的角色，为发展型国家奠定了基础。
AI.research_question: 1991年哥伦比亚宪法第五编是否建立了纠正市场失灵、平衡经济效率与社会正义、构建硬软基础设施的制度条件，从而奠定发展型国家的基础？
AI.motivation: 探讨哥伦比亚宪法秩序是否具备发展型国家的制度基础，以及如何通过宪法框架实现公平可持续的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨关于市场失灵和国家在创造公平可持续发展中作用的理论框架。
AI.method: 文本分析法，聚焦1991年宪法第五编"国家组织"条款的规范性分析。
AI.findings: 1991年宪法将国家视为积极主体，不仅规范市场，还引导和创造市场，促进社会流动、竞争力和再分配，包含发展型国家的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将斯蒂格利茨理论应用于拉丁美洲发展型国家分析，丰富了发展型国家理论的宪法制度视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚发展型国家的制度构建提供宪法依据，指出需要更协调、协商和分配的机构架构来实现有效实施。

title: Implementation Of Social and Economic Intervention Policies to Promote Financial Inclusion and Alleviate Poverty in the Coastal Zone of Ghana
affiliations: University of Buckingham

detail.title: Implementation Of Social and Economic Intervention Policies to Promote Financial Inclusion and Alleviate Poverty in the Coastal Zone of Ghana
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the design and impact of social and economic intervention policies aimed at expanding financial inclusion and reducing poverty in Ghana's coastal zones, highlighting policy mechanisms, implementation challenges, and potential outcomes for households and small enterprises. This study thus contributes to the policy discourse by examining how targeted interventions such as microcredit support, savings mobilization, credit facilities for small and medium enterprises, and social safety nets can be designed to maximize uptake, ensure financial literacy, and promote sustainable livelihoods in coastal communities. This study thus contributes to the policy discourse by examining how targeted interventions such as microcredit support, savings mobilization, credit facilities for small and medium enterprises, and social safety nets can be designed to maximize uptake, ensure financial literacy, and promote sustainable livelihoods in coastal communities. Building on this framework, the analysis synthesizes empirical evidence from coastal Ghana to identify the mechanisms through which financial access translates into poverty reduction, resilience against climate and economic shocks, and inclusive growth in the region. By examining credit access, savings behavior, and the role of microfinance, the study underscores how expanded financial services can foster entrepreneurial activity, diversify income, and enhance household resilience to climaterelated disruptions in coastal communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估加纳沿海地区旨在扩大金融包容性和减少贫困的社会经济干预政策的设计与影响，重点关注政策机制、实施挑战以及对家庭和小企业的潜在结果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计针对性干预措施（如小额信贷支持、储蓄动员、中小企业信贷设施和社会安全网）以最大化加纳沿海社区的采纳率、确保金融素养并促进可持续生计？
AI.motivation: 评估金融包容性政策在加纳沿海地区的实际效果，探讨金融准入如何转化为减贫、抵御气候和经济冲击以及促进包容性增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、减贫理论、可持续生计框架、韧性理论
AI.method: 基于加纳沿海地区实证证据的综合分析，考察信贷准入、储蓄行为和微型金融的作用
AI.findings: 扩大金融服务能够促进创业活动、多样化收入来源，并增强沿海社区家庭对气候相关干扰的韧性
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对金融包容性政策机制的理解，阐明金融准入如何转化为减贫和韧性建设的理论路径
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供设计有效金融包容性干预措施的具体建议，帮助最大化政策效果并促进沿海社区的可持续发展

title: On Significant Misunderstandings in Macroeconomics
affiliations: Doshisha University - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: On Significant Misunderstandings in Macroeconomics
detail.abstract:
I present arguments on significant misunderstandings in macroeconomics about relationship between investment and savings. I will show that investment and savings are undertaken by the same economic agent. 
To summarize the meaning of Investment = Savings most simply, (setting aside the government and overseas factors) since savings are defined as income minus consumption, spending money on consumption increases the recipient's income without changing savings. Spending money on investment also increases the recipient's income, but since it's not consumption, the “minus consumption” component doesn't occur, so savings increase. Therefore, investment equals savings. The intermediary function of banks has nothing to do with it.
 Excluding the government and overseas sectors, total financial assets amount to zero. Therefore, savings in the equation investment = savings do not represent the accumulation of financial assets. Instead, investment represents the accumulation of fixed assets. Consequently, this savings also constitutes an increase in fixed assets. 
 Both investment and savings involve spending money to purchase goods. Defining savings as income minus consumption minus investment yields
savings = fiscal deficit plus current account surplus.
This correctly represents changes in financial assets.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了宏观经济学中对投资与储蓄关系的误解，论证了投资和储蓄由同一经济主体进行，投资等于储蓄的本质是固定资产的积累而非金融资产的积累。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济学中投资与储蓄关系的本质是什么？为什么传统理解存在误解？
AI.motivation: 纠正宏观经济学中对投资与储蓄关系的普遍误解，澄清投资=储蓄等式的真实含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国民收入核算恒等式，分析投资、储蓄、消费之间的内在联系，强调投资和储蓄行为的同一主体性。
AI.method: 理论分析和逻辑推理，通过排除政府和海外部门的简化模型来阐明核心机制。
AI.findings: 投资和储蓄由同一经济主体进行；投资=储蓄反映的是固定资产积累而非金融资产积累；正确的储蓄定义应为财政赤字加经常账户盈余。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了投资与储蓄关系的本质，纠正了传统宏观经济学中的误解，提供了更准确的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于政策制定者和经济学家更准确地理解宏观经济运行机制，避免基于错误理解的政策决策。

title: Narrative, Flows, and Concentration: Why the Contemporary AI Equity Surge Warrants Bubble Concern
affiliations: Bronx Small Business Development Center (SBDC)

detail.title: Narrative, Flows, and Concentration: Why the Contemporary AI Equity Surge Warrants Bubble Concern
detail.abstract: This paper argues that the surge in artificial intelligence (AI)-themed equities and investment vehicles exhibits classic bubble signatures, including pervasive narrative contagion, flow-driven price dynamics, elevated valuation multiples, and extreme performance concentration. Drawing on frameworks from narrative economics (Shiller, 2019) and a comparative analysis with the 2020–21 Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) boom (Klausner et al., 2020, Saul 2022), this study integrates quantitative data on valuation ratios, Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) flows, and asset concentration. Empirical evidence indicates a market susceptible to correction unless realized earnings growth aligns with heightened investor expectations. This analysis provides a structured, evidence-based assessment of the AI equity market, concluding that its structural trends justify significant bubble concern.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI主题股票和投资工具表现出典型的泡沫特征，包括广泛的叙事传染、资金流驱动的价格动态、高估值倍数和极端业绩集中。通过与2020-21年SPAC热潮的比较分析，研究发现AI股票市场存在显著的泡沫风险。
AI.research_question: AI主题股票和投资工具是否表现出典型的市场泡沫特征？
AI.motivation: 随着AI主题投资热潮的兴起，需要系统评估其是否存在市场泡沫风险，为投资者和政策制定者提供警示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事经济学（Shiller, 2019）和SPAC泡沫比较分析框架（Klausner et al., 2020, Saul 2022）
AI.method: 整合估值比率、ETF资金流和资产集中度的定量数据分析，并进行比较研究
AI.findings: AI股票市场表现出经典泡沫特征，包括叙事传染、资金流驱动价格、高估值和业绩集中，市场容易回调，除非实际盈利增长能够满足投资者预期
AI.theory_contributions: 将叙事经济学框架应用于AI投资泡沫分析，扩展了市场泡沫理论在新技术投资领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供AI投资泡沫的警示，帮助识别市场风险；为监管机构提供政策制定的实证依据

title: The Amateur's Curse of Positive Income Shocks *
affiliations: University of Mannheim - Center for Doctoral Studies in Economics and Management (CDSEM)

detail.title: The Amateur's Curse of Positive Income Shocks *
detail.abstract: How do soccer clubs react to positive income shocks? Exploiting quasi-random variation induced by penalty shootouts in Verbandspokal finals, a German amateur tournament, we find that clubs receiving a positive income shock are unable to improve their final league position in the following years. Even more surprising, these teams start to significantly underperform three years and onwards after the income shock. We observe an associated increase in insolvency proceedings, indicating financial struggles after the Verbandspokal final. We identify a causal link to longer managerial tenure, which suggests the emergence of a bias in the decision-making process regarding whether or not to appoint a new team manager. The long-run decline in club performance also carries political externalities, as the majority party in the municipal council of the club's municipality significantly underperforms in subsequent elections.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，德国业余足球俱乐部在获得意外收入冲击后，不仅未能提升联赛表现，反而在三年后开始显著表现下滑，并伴随破产风险增加。这归因于管理层任期延长导致的决策偏见，且对当地政治选举产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 足球俱乐部如何应对正向收入冲击？
AI.motivation: 探究意外收入对足球俱乐部绩效的影响机制及其外部性
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于准随机实验设计，利用德国业余杯赛点球大战产生的收入冲击作为外生变量
AI.method: 利用德国业余杯赛决赛点球大战产生的准随机收入冲击进行因果推断分析
AI.findings: 1. 收入冲击后俱乐部联赛排名未改善；2. 三年后开始显著表现下滑；3. 破产程序增加；4. 管理层任期延长导致决策偏见；5. 对当地政治选举产生负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了收入冲击对组织绩效的非线性影响机制，识别了管理层决策偏见的因果效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球俱乐部财务管理提供警示，揭示了意外收入可能带来的长期负面后果

title: Human Capital Assessment via Large Language Models alignment
affiliations: Amundi Institute, Amundi Institute, Amundi Asset Management, Amundi Institute, University of Paris-Saclay and Amundi Asset Management

detail.title: Human Capital Assessment via Large Language Models alignment
detail.abstract: This study presents a new methodological framework that combines clustering techniques with large language models (LLMs) to analyze intangible assets in various fields of research. By applying this approach to human capital, we reveal that its definition and perception vary considerably from one region to another and evolve over time, reflecting differences in socioeconomic development, institutional frameworks, and geopolitical contexts. Our financial analysis confirms that these regional variations in the perception of human capital have important implications for investment performance. Specifically, strategies that incorporate human capital development scores generate significantly different returns in emerging markets compared to developed markets, highlighting the importance of tailored portfolio approaches. Furthermore, our asset valuation results highlight the central role of human capital development in explaining emerging market dynamics, particularly during periods of geopolitical turmoil, when companies with stronger human capital demonstrate greater resilience and stability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了结合聚类技术和大型语言模型的新方法框架，用于分析各研究领域的无形资产。应用于人力资本分析发现，其定义和认知存在显著的区域差异和时间演变，反映了社会经济、制度和地缘政治背景的不同。金融分析证实这些认知差异对投资绩效有重要影响，特别是在新兴市场与发达市场中，基于人力资本发展评分的投资策略产生显著不同的回报。
AI.research_question: 人力资本的定义和认知在不同地区如何变化？这些变化对投资绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对人力资本的分析缺乏系统性的跨区域比较框架，且未能充分揭示其认知差异对投资决策的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无形资产理论、人力资本理论、区域发展差异理论、投资组合理论
AI.method: 结合聚类技术和大型语言模型的分析框架，应用于人力资本数据的跨区域比较和金融绩效分析

title: What is the Interest Rate Pass-Through under Surplus Liquidity in the Banking Sector?
affiliations: and University American College Skopje (UACS)

detail.title: What is the Interest Rate Pass-Through under Surplus Liquidity in the Banking Sector?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare that no funds, grants, or other support were received during the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the interest rate pass-through in an economy with structurally high banking sector liquidity, using North Macedonia as a case study. Persistent surplus liquidity limits commercial banks' reliance on central bank and interbank funding, potentially weakening the transmission of monetary policy. Employing a dynamic autoregressive distributed lag and error-correction (ARDL/ECM) framework augmented with a liquidity variable, we estimate the two stages of the transmission process-from the policy rate to the interbank rate, and from the interbank to lending rates. The results show that high liquidity dampens both the strength and speed of pass-through by reducing interbank rate responsiveness and moderating lending rate adjustments. These findings suggest that in banking systems with structural liquidity surpluses, conventional interest rate policy may be insufficient, underscoring the need for complementary instruments to enhance monetary transmission effectiveness.

title: Inferential Theory for Pricing Errors with Latent Factors and Firm Characteristics
affiliations: and Columbia University

detail.title: Inferential Theory for Pricing Errors with Latent Factors and Firm Characteristics

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by NSF Grant DMS-2052955.

detail.abstract: We study factor models that combine latent factors with firm characteristics and propose a new framework for modeling, estimating, and inferring pricing errors. Following Zhang (2024), our approach decomposes mispricing into two distinct components: inside alpha, explained by firm characteristics but orthogonal to factor exposures, and outside alpha, orthogonal to both factors and characteristics. Our model generalizes those developed recently such as Kelly et al. (2019) and Zhang (2024), resolving issues of orthogonality, basis dependence, and unit sensitivity. Methodologically, we develop estimators grounded in low-rank methods with explicit debiasing, providing closed-form solutions and a rigorous inferential theory that accommodates a growing number of characteristics and relaxes standard assumptions on sample dimensions. Empirically, using U.S. stock returns from 2000-2019, we document strong evidence of both inside and outside alphas, with the former showing industry-level comovements and the latter reflecting idiosyncratic shocks beyond firm fundamentals. Our framework thus unifies statistical and characteristic-based approaches to factor modeling, offering both theoretical advances and new insights into the structure of pricing errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的因子模型框架，将潜在因子与公司特征相结合，并将错误定价分解为内部alpha和外部alpha两个独立成分。该方法解决了正交性、基依赖和单位敏感性等问题，提供了基于低秩方法的估计器，并在美国股票数据中发现了两种alpha存在的强有力证据。

AI.findings: 使用2000-2019年美国股票收益数据，发现内部alpha和外部alpha均存在强有力证据：内部alpha表现出行业层面的共动，外部alpha反映了超出公司基本面的异质性冲击。

title: A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics
affiliations: School of Global Policy and Strategy, Universite du Luxembourg - Department of Economics, Columbia University and Lund University

detail.title: A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide new evidence that short-run temperature shocks affect unemployment dynamics. Linking daily weather data with three decades of Current Population Survey microdata, we show that cold, but not hot, temperatures significantly increase unemployment risk. This effect is concentrated in climate-exposed industries and driven by both increased job separations and longer unemployment durations. Separations appear to be driven by a rise in layoffs rather than quits, while the increase in unemployment duration is largely explained by a decline in employer vacancy postings. Taken together, temperature-induced joblessness dynamics are primarily demand-driven, rather than a result of changes in worker behavior.

title: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition
affiliations: Universite Libre de Bruxelles, University of Bonn and CREST Ecole Polytechnique

detail.title: Family Institutions and the Global Fertility Transition

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Much of the observed cross-country variation in fertility aligns with the predictions of classic theories of the fertility transition: countries with higher levels of human capital, higher GDP per capita, or lower mortality rates tend to exhibit lower fertility. However, when examining changes within countries over the past 60 years, larger fertility declines are only weakly associated with greater improvements in human capital, per capita GDP, or survival rates. To understand why, we focus on the role of family institutions, particularly marriage and inheritance customs. We argue that, together with the diffusion of cultural norms, they help explain variations in the timing, speed and magnitude of the fertility decline. We propose a stylized model integrating economic, health, institutional and cultural factors to study how these factors interact to shape fertility transition paths. We find that family institutions can mediate the effect of economic development by constraining fertility responses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，虽然跨国生育率差异符合经典理论预测，但国家内部60年来的生育率下降与人力资本、人均GDP或生存率改善的关联较弱。作者强调家庭制度（婚姻和继承习俗）与文化规范传播共同解释了生育率下降的时间、速度和幅度变化。

title: Immigration, Identity Choices, and Cultural Diversity
affiliations: , Universitat Autonoma de Barcelona and Centre d'Etudes Prospectives et d'Info. Internationales (CEPII)

detail.title: Immigration, Identity Choices, and Cultural Diversity

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Does immigration challenge the identities, values, and cultural diversity of receiving societies? This paper addresses this question by analyzing the impact of immigration on cultural diversity in Europe between 2004 and 2018. It combines regional cultural diversity indices derived from the European Social Survey with immigration shares from the European Labor Force Survey. The results indicate that immigration increases the salience of birthplace identity along cultural lines, fostering a shift toward nativist identities among the native population. These identity shifts, in turn, trigger a process of cultural homogenization among natives. This effect is stronger in regions receiving culturally distant immigrants. It reflects a process of convergence toward the values of highly skilled liberal natives and divergence from those of low-skilled conservative immigrants.

title: Pooling Responsibility: Incentivizing Cable Owners to Safeguard the Global Undersea Network
affiliations: The University of Texas School of Law

detail.title: Pooling Responsibility: Incentivizing Cable Owners to Safeguard the Global Undersea Network

declarations.funderStatement: This work received support from the Institute for Humane Studies under grant no. IHS019769.

publicationDetails.detailsText: [forthcoming] University of Cincinnati Law Intellectual Property and Computer Law Journal

detail.abstract:
Undersea cables form the backbone of the global communications system, yet the legal regimes governing their installation, maintenance, and protection remain fragmented, reactive, and ill-suited to the mounting risks facing this infrastructure. Existing frameworks diffuse responsibility across states, agencies, and private owners, creating a system in which even straightforward incidents trigger jurisdictional confusion, duplicative inquiries, and costly delays. The result is a structural misalignment: governments bear the burdens of resilience while the cable owners best positioned to prevent and rapidly repair breaks face minimal obligations. This Article argues that a durable legal architecture requires reversing that allocation of responsibility.

Drawing on the shortcomings of the United States’ multilevel regulatory landscape—exemplified by Team Telecom’s inconsistent and protracted licensing reviews—this Article demonstrates how the current model elevates cable-by-cable adjudication at the expense of system-wide resilience. It proposes a new regulatory paradigm that conditions landing rights on operator participation in a resilience pool: a shared fund capitalized by annual contributions calibrated to each operator’s risk profile, performance history, and adoption of best practices. Unlike traditional insurance, the pool rewards prevention, redundancy, continuous monitoring, and transparent reporting through predictable incentive structures; it also supports rapid repair, shared information systems, and long-term technological upgrades.

By shifting accountability upstream to cable owners and embedding resilience obligations in the licensing process, this approach corrects the core market failure—underinvestment in a global public good—and replaces fragmented adjudication with a coherent, systemic orientation. A pooled model ensures that outages are addressed immediately, disputes are resolved after service is restored, and private incentives finally align with the public interest in maintaining a secure, stable, and future-ready undersea network.

title: The Case of Acquihires

detail.title: The Case of Acquihires
detail.abstract: Acquihires-transactions primarily aimed at securing human capital-have become increasingly frequent, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence, and have therefore attracted growing attention from the antitrust community. While they can foster efficiency and innovation by allowing firms to better deploy scarce talent, they may also threaten competition by reinforcing monopsony power and depriving rivals of the resources needed to compete and innovate. Therefore, the paper offers a comprehensive framework for understanding acquihires. It begins by exploring the circumstances and the mechanisms through which they may produce anticompetitive effects in labor and output markets. It then assesses how existing antitrust tools can be mobilized to address these concerns and, in particular, under what conditions acquihires should be treated as concentrations within the meaning of the EU Merger Regulation. Finally, the paper discusses how competition authorities might respond to anticompetitive acquihires: whether through ex ante notification mechanisms, ex post enforcement, or innovative mobility-related remedies.

detail.abstract: This study presents the first evidence, to our knowledge, of the effects of the surge in interior immigration apprehensions in 2025 in the United States on student academic performance using detailed student-level administrative records from Florida. We find evidence that immigration enforcement reduced test scores for both U.S.-born and foreign-born Spanish-speaking students while also reducing the likelihood that these students are involved in disciplinary incidents in schools. Both of these effects are more pronounced for students in middle and high schools.

title: Energy Transition and Economic Growth in Colombia: A Dynamic CGE Model with Renewable Energies

detail.title: Energy Transition and Economic Growth in Colombia: A Dynamic CGE Model with Renewable Energies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: The analysis was conducted using publicly available secondary data from official Colombian sources (e.g., DANE, UPME, XM). No ethical approval was required as no individual-level identifiable information was used.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Climate change has gained significant relevance in recent years, encouraging many countries to implement decarbonization policies aimed at reducing carbon dioxide (CO 2) emissions. While much attention has been paid to the design of these policies, there is a growing interest in analyzing their macroeconomic implications. This study evaluates the impact of the energy transition on economic growth in Colombia using a recursive dynamic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model. The model is calibrated for the year 2022 and simulates the Colombian energy economy over a ten-year horizon. Results indicate that an ambitious and sustained policy promoting non-conventional renewable energy could increase GDP growth by up to 0.5 percentage points compared to a business-as-usual (BAU) scenario. Additionally, climate shocks such as El Niño may negatively affect economic performance; however, early investment in renewable energy technologies can partially offset these adverse effects.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用递归动态可计算一般均衡模型评估哥伦比亚能源转型对经济增长的影响。结果显示，积极推广非常规可再生能源的政策可使GDP增长率提高0.5个百分点，且早期投资可再生能源技术可部分抵消厄尔尼诺等气候冲击的负面影响。

detail.abstract: The way customs administrations handle and approach their work has been impacted by changes and unpredictability in the customs operating environment as well as the rise in commerce and travel volumes. The function of customs services has been greatly altered by the current geopolitical climate. Customs administrations have always aimed to increase compliance primarily through stepping up their enforcement efforts. Such activities are frequently motivated by a sense of urgency or the need to produce outcomes, especially in terms of raising money, but they are sometimes taken without adequate planning. However, lack of consideration of tax payers' interests and vision often lead to more sophistication of evading schemes and ultimately to reduction of customs efficiency and volume of customs taxes revenues for the state. Based on narrative review and case study tools, the article aims to consider the core essential risks in the field of customs taxes and justify the application of integrated approach. The experience of the USA, EU (in particular, Poland), Australia, UAE, and Ukraine in the field of customs tax risk vision and management was investigated, along with the overall customs landscape and challenges of today. The findings of the study allow emphasizing the crucial need to apply Integrated Risk Management strategy, based on balancing and aligning the public (state) interests and visions/interests/strategies of industries' players-foreign economic activity subjects.

title: The Fragility-Robustness Framework: Unified Metrics for Statistical Evidence Quality Across Discrete and Continuous Outcome Types
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Medicine

detail.title: The Fragility-Robustness Framework: Unified Metrics for Statistical Evidence Quality Across Discrete and Continuous Outcome Types

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest. The work is methodological and independent.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work involves no human participants, patient data, or identifiable records.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
Statistical evidence assessment requires metrics beyond p-values. This reference establishes a complete, model-free framework with two orthogonal dimensions, both scaled 0–1. **Fragility (fr)** quantifies the proportion of relevant data (or SE-scale shift) required to flip the significance classification. Primary metrics include MFQ for 2×2 binary outcomes, GFQ for multinomial r×c tables, DFQ for diagnostic benchmarks, CFQ for continuous outcomes using Welch t-geometry, and PFI for fixed-margin designs. **Robustness (nb)** quantifies geometric distance from therapeutic neutrality via the Neutrality Boundary Framework. Primary metrics include RQ (binary/multinomial), DNB (diagnostic odds ratio), MeCI (continuous means), DTI (correlation), Agreement-NBF (raw agreement), and ANOVAη² (multi-group).

All metrics rely only on observed counts or published summary statistics; no simulations, reconstructions, or covariate models are permitted. Fragility measures classification stability. Robustness is claim-dependent: high nb supports “effect exists” claims and undermines “no effect” claims.

The document provides exact formulas, toggle rules, prevalence normalization, workflows, decision rules, validation checks, and an annotated bibliography justifying the exclusion of model-dependent approaches. It finalizes integration of continuous-outcome measures (CFQ + MeCI) and the unified fr/nb notation, yielding the first evidence-quality system that applies consistently across all standard study designs with minimal assumptions.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个完整、无模型的统计证据评估框架，包含两个正交维度：脆弱性(fr)和稳健性(nb)。脆弱性衡量改变多少数据能翻转显著性分类，稳健性衡量与治疗中性边界的几何距离。该框架适用于所有标准研究设计，仅使用观察计数或已发表摘要统计量。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个完整、无模型的统计证据评估框架，能够一致地应用于所有标准研究设计？
AI.motivation: 统计证据评估需要超越p值的指标，现有方法往往依赖模型假设或模拟，缺乏统一框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中性边界框架、几何距离理论、分类稳定性理论
AI.method: 开发脆弱性和稳健性两个维度的度量指标：MFQ(2×2二元结果)、GFQ(r×c列联表)、DFQ(诊断基准)、CFQ(连续结果)、PFI(固定边际设计)等脆弱性指标；RQ(二元/多项)、DNB(诊断比值比)、MeCI(连续均值)、DTI(相关性)、Agreement-NBF(原始一致性)、ANOVAη²(多组)等稳健性指标
AI.findings: 建立了首个一致适用于所有标准研究设计的证据质量系统，仅依赖观察计数或已发表摘要统计量，无需模拟、重建或协变量模型
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的无模型统计证据评估理论框架，整合了连续结果度量(CFQ + MeCI)和统一的fr/nb符号系统
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了精确公式、切换规则、流行度标准化、工作流程、决策规则和验证检查，可直接应用于实际研究评估

title: The Fragile Promise: Job Security and Contract Design under Partial Commitment
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK-Shenzhen), University of Amsterdam and UCL

detail.title: The Fragile Promise: Job Security and Contract Design under Partial Commitment
detail.abstract: We develop a dynamic contracting framework to study how partial commitment power affects long term employment relationships. In a continuous time moral hazard model, the principal can alter the contract at random, exogenously timed "alteration opportunities," with their arrival rate measuring her (lack of) commitment power. Our results depend on the relative observability of diligence and misconduct. For guardian jobs, where misconduct is easier to observe, it is optimal to offer a static, permanent contract that pays fixed performance bonuses for observed diligence and remains immune to reductions in commitment power. For entrepreneurial jobs, where diligence is easier to observe, the optimal structure features an initial probation period, a promotion bonus upon achieving permanence, and a return to probation at each alteration opportunity. In this case, weaker commitment can, under certain conditions, improve welfare; if commitment power is already low, further reductions may yield Pareto improvements. Reduced commitment power also raises required promotion and performance bonuses, shortens probation, and accelerates the decline in promotion bonuses over time.

title: Energy Communities as Autonomous Multifacility Clubs
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Energy Communities as Autonomous Multifacility Clubs
detail.abstract: The global transition to sustainable energy systems has accelerated the rise of renewable energy communities, where individuals or entities share energy infrastructures. These communities foster local energy production, democratic governance, and social equity while promoting energy security, resilience and climate-change mitigation. This paper applies club theory (Buchanan, 1965) as an analytical framework, offering insights into voluntary participation, congestion management, exclusion mechanisms, and the determination of optimal membership size in energy communities. By framing energy infrastructures as club goods, the study demonstrates how efficiency, equity, and long-term viability can be achieved through well-designed governance structures. We assume that club members are homogeneous who possess identical preferences and resources, and that club managers compete to attract members. In such a competitive game, each club manager makes optimal choices that maximize the utility of the representative club member.We examine two settings. To derive key economic insights regarding the important role that membership size plays in the optimal configuration with multiple club facilities, we first assume that the renewable resource is not subject to exogenous climate shocks. Later, this simple setting is extended to account for the fact that renewable resources (e.g., solar energy) are intermittent. We focus on solar energy production. We introduce uncertainty and demonstrate how the club manager chooses one of two competing technologies (single source or hybrid) ex-ante and the economic arrangement that takes place ex-post. Under uncertainty, we assume that there are two possible states of nature, sunny and cloudy. The results of the analysis produce crucial insights about the complex nature of energy clubs as these entities provide multiple sharing facilities in stochastic settings.

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investment between Latin America and Spain

publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article describes the main features of foreign direct investment (FDI) into and out of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), with a special focus on flows to and from Spain. According to the latest available data for 2023, Spain is the second largest investor in the region, after the United States, and LAC FDI in Spain is also significant of late. Takeaways • FDI received and originated by LAC has increased its relative share in global FDI flows since the 1990s, but it has been heavily influenced by cyclical fluctuations in the Latin American economies and by commodity prices. • The European Union ranks first as the geographical origin of the stock of FDI in LAC, with Spain in a prominent position (15% of the total). LAC accounts for over 30% of the stock of FDI by Spain, which is concentrated in the region's two largest economies: Brazil and Mexico. By sector, services accounts for the bulk of investment. • FDI from LAC into Spain is sizeable, as it accounts for close to 8% of the stock of inbound FDI, most notably from Mexico, which represents nearly half of the region's FDI in Spain.

title: Operations Management in EV Infrastructure Projects: A Case Study of the Denker EV Truck Microgrid

detail.title: Operations Management in EV Infrastructure Projects: A Case Study of the Denker EV Truck Microgrid
detail.abstract: The transition to electric transportation is forcing the construction industry to rethink how major infrastructure projects are delivered. This paper looks back at the Prologis Denker EV Charging Depot in Los Angeles, which became the largest heavy-duty electric truck charging facility in the United States. Built in roughly five months, the 9-megawatt site now powers 96 charging stations through its own microgrid system made up of linear generators and battery storage. From my role overseeing operations for the general contractor, I share practical lessons on bringing civil and electrical work together under tight deadlines. The discussion covers coordination between trades, applying the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers’ Three-Phase Quality Control method, and maintaining safety standards around high-power equipment. I also reflect on how crews, schedules, and internal systems were adapted to handle an unfamiliar type of project. The experience points to a larger shift in our field - traditional civil contractors are being called on to deliver energy and electrification work, and success will depend on how well we blend both worlds in the years ahead.

title: Designing Renewable Energy Auctions for High Realization Probability - CfD and Payment-only Auctions
affiliations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT)

detail.title: Designing Renewable Energy Auctions for High Realization Probability - CfD and Payment-only Auctions
detail.abstract: In recent years, different instruments for renewable energy expansion have been debated. Among the support and hedging instruments, two-sided contracts for difference (CfDs) have become the default in many countries and are promoted by the European Commission. On the other hand, payment-only auctions have also become established, where the electricity sales are unregulated, but the winners must pay for the right to build energy plants. Focusing on a high realization probability and the induced welfare effects, we compare two-sided CfDs with payment-only auctions. Contrary to the conventional wisdom, the non-realization risk is higher with auctioned CfDs than with payment-only auctions and is exacerbated by risk aversion, when developers can cope with both options. CfDs are particularly useful when developers need support for implementing their projects. Against this backdrop and considering asymmetric information, i.e., developers know best the economic conditions of their projects, we propose a design in which developers decide competitively between a CfD auction and a payment-only auction and which enhances the realization probability.

title: Trade Deflections: Understanding the Mechanisms of Trade Redirection, Creation, and Diversion in Global Trade Regimes: A Chapeaux Note

detail.title: Trade Deflections: Understanding the Mechanisms of Trade Redirection, Creation, and Diversion in Global Trade Regimes: A Chapeaux Note
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the mechanisms of trade redirection within regional, sub-regional, and multilateral trade regimes, focusing on the interplay between trade creation, diversion, and deflection. Trade creation enhances welfare by shifting production to more efficient member countries, while diversion leads to inefficiencies through suboptimal sourcing from less competitive partners. Trade deflection, conceptualized as a form of arbitrage in free trade areas (FTAs) lacking harmonized external tariffs, involves rerouting goods through low-tariff members to access high-tariff markets, often circumvented by rules of origin (ROO). Utilizing gravity models and computable general equilibrium (CGE) frameworks, the analysis quantifies these effects, revealing that RTAs boost intra-trade by 34-100% but impose diversion costs of 10-25% on non-members, with deflection amplifying distortions in shallow agreements.

Empirical evidence from case studies—including the European Union's customs union model minimizing deflection via common external tariffs, NAFTA/USMCA's experiences with ROO challenges, ASEAN's struggles in apparel and electronics, and emerging examples like AfCFTA, CPTPP, and MERCOSUR—highlights net creation benefits offset by policy vulnerabilities. Deflection emerges as a critical policy issue, eroding revenues and integrity, with EU and OECD principles advocating stringent ROO and harmonization for mitigation. The paper concludes that robust design in trade agreements is essential to maximize efficiency gains and curb corrosive effects on global commerce.

title: “Leave No One Behind”: Energy Transition and Inequality
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: “Leave No One Behind”: Energy Transition and Inequality
detail.abstract: This study addresses the central question: How does the energy transition affect income and wealth inequality, considering the countries’ stages of development? The aim is to analyse the determinants of income and wealth inequality across different levels of development. A threshold model approach was employed, studying determinants across 75 countries from 2002 to 2021. The findings indicate the effects of energy transition and control variables on inequality vary by development level, suggesting the need for a non-linear approach. Below a certain threshold of economic development, the energy transition exacerbates income and wealth inequality, while it has an attenuating effect in countries above this threshold. Developed countries are encouraged to support developing countries in their transition processes and assist low-income groups in managing the costs of clean and renewable energy, ensuring the energy transition is inclusive.

keywords: The Upper reaches of the Yangtze River

detail.abstract: To address the ecological pollution problems that may be caused by Industry agglomeration (IA) in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, based on a review of relevant studies, this paper proposes a theoretical analysis framework for Industry ecological agglomeration (IEA) oriented towards the high-quality and green development of industrial space, and constructs a comprehensive evaluation index system. By using entropy method, Dagum Gini coefficient, spatial autocorrelation and other methods, the spatial distribution characteristics and sources of differences of IEA in this area were explored, and the convergence was tested by using coefficient of variation and spatial Dubin model. The research finds that the IEA in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River takes Chengdu and Guiyang as the development poles. Overall, there is path locking and spatial stickiness. The spatial correlation shows a trend of first rising and then decreasing, resulting in a gradual reduction of the agglomeration effect. The overall differences in the development of IEA and the internal differences within the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle show an M-shaped change feature, while the differences in other regions show a W-shaped change. The differences between the Chengdu-Chongqing region and other regions are the main source of the internal differences. The σ convergence trend of the upper reaches of the Yangtze River is similar to that of other regions, showing phased and periodic convergence and divergence trends. Other regions converged from 2009 to 2012 and diverged after 2012. All regions exhibit absolute β convergence and conditional β convergence characteristics, and the convergence speed of other regions is faster than that of the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle.

title: Multilateral Contracting in Stage Financing
affiliations: University of North Carolina Kenan-Flagler Business School, University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area and Duke University - Fuqua School of Business - Finance Department

detail.title: Multilateral Contracting in Stage Financing
detail.abstract: Venture capital financing typically features complex securities and staging. We develop a dynamic contracting model where an entrepreneur seeks financing from active investors (who provide costly monitoring and screening) and passive investors (who offer cheaper capital). Under multilateral moral hazard, we show that the optimal contract can be implemented through a sequential offering of securities, including common and preferred equity, options, warrants, as well as a combination of senior debt and credit lines (venture debt). Our model predicts when entrepreneurs optimally separate monitoring and screening across multiple active investors ("rounds financing") versus consolidating these functions with a single active investor ("milestone financing"). Rounds financing dominates when informed capital is scarce.

title: The Victims of Gentrification

detail.title: The Victims of Gentrification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There were no conflicts of interest for this research - just my own curiosity.
declarations.funderStatement: Cost-free research - observational and use of library and online resources only.

detail.abstract: This paper discusses the impact of gentrification on low-income and minority residents in New York City. While gentrification has created a significant amount of economic growth and higher tax revenues, it has simultaneously created greater inequality through the displacement of long-term neighborhood residents and the destruction of tightly-knit communities and cultures. Through academic and physical research, demographic information, and case studies in heavily gentrified neighborhoods like Williamsburg and the Lower East Side, this paper argues that any economic benefits of gentrification are outweighed by its harmful societal effects. The study finds that current housing policies are too weak to stop the market pressures pushing people out of their neighborhoods. The paper concludes by proposing that greater government intervention in the protection of neighborhoods and their vulnerable residents must be done to preserve the socioeconomic and cultural diversity in New York City.

title: The Impact of Zero Taxation Policies in Gilgit on Sustainable Tourism Development in the Region
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of Zero Taxation Policies in Gilgit on Sustainable Tourism Development in the Region
detail.abstract: This paper examines the potential impact of zero taxation policies on sustainable tourism development in Gilgit, situating the region within broader debates on fiscal incentives and destination competitiveness. Drawing on international case studies-including the Bahamas, UAE, Oman, Iran and Pakistan's own Gwadar Free Zone-the analysis highlights both opportunities and risks. Zero taxation can stimulate investment, infrastructure, and visitor inflows, yet may also exacerbate environmental degradation, inequality, and fiscal vulnerability. By applying global frameworks to Gilgit's fragile mountain ecology and cultural heritage, the study argues that carefully structured zero-taxation could foster sustainable tourism if coupled with strong governance safeguards.

title: How far ahead can the EIA forecast oil market developments?
affiliations: University of Warwick, Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR) and Xiamen University

detail.title: How far ahead can the EIA forecast oil market developments?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the information content of oil market forecasts produced by the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). Specifically, we evaluate the maximum forecast content horizon for EIA projections of world and U.S. total demand, supply, stock withdrawals, and oil prices. Our results show that U.S. forecasts are generally more informative than world forecasts, with the maximum content horizon reaching up to six quarters for most variables. Finally, we show that these predictive capabilities reflect the ability of the EIA to forecast evolving trends in the oil market. In addition, short-term forecasts of U.S. demand and stock withdrawals incorporate information beyond simple trend extrapolation.
