detail.title: Sell Me More: Transaction Volumes and the Local Housing Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Center for Real Estate Research Paper No. 25/09
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Center for Real Estate Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how local transaction volumes affect valuation accuracy and housing prices. Using detailed data on all residential transactions in England and Wales from 1995 to 2022, we show that higher local transaction volumes improve valuation precision and increase prices by shifting bargaining power toward sellers. Identification relies on variation in transaction volumes induced by homeowners' nominal capital gains, which affect their likelihood of selling. Doubling local transactions raises prices by about 0.5% and reduces valuation errors by roughly 14%. Sellers capture most of the gains through stronger bargaining power. Aggregate effects are small but grow during market downturns when liquidity falls.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，当地房产交易量增加会提高估值准确性并推高房价，主要通过增强卖方的议价能力实现。交易量翻倍可使房价上涨约0.5%，估值误差减少约14%。
AI.research_question: 当地交易量如何影响估值准确性和住房价格？
AI.motivation: 理解房地产市场流动性对价格形成机制和估值效率的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 议价能力理论、市场流动性理论
AI.method: 使用1995-2022年英格兰和威尔士所有住宅交易的详细数据，利用名义资本收益引起的交易量变化进行识别
AI.findings: 交易量翻倍使房价上涨约0.5%，估值误差减少约14%；卖方通过更强的议价能力获得大部分收益
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了交易量通过议价能力渠道影响房价的机制，拓展了市场流动性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产市场参与者理解价格形成提供参考，在市场低迷时期流动性下降时影响更显著

title: The Business of the Culture War
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard University, Department of Economics

detail.title: The Business of the Culture War
detail.abstract: We link the contemporary American "culture war" to changes in media technologies in the 1980s and to the cable news networks which responded to the new incentives of the era. We first show that cable news emphasizes culture-war issues much more, and economic issues much less, than older broadcast news or politicians. Using household-by-second smart TV data, we trace cable news' emphasis on cultural over economic issues to a distinctive business strategy: culture attracts viewers who would otherwise not watch news ("mobilization"); economics attracts viewers who would otherwise watch competing news outlets ("poaching"); and the number mobilized by culture is greater than the number poached by economics, so culture increases viewership. We highlight the parallel to politicians-who also trade off "mobilizing" nonvoters against "poaching" competitors' voters-but show why mobilization-focused strategies are disadvantaged in politics: cable outlets maximize audience size and so value poaching and mobilization equally, but politicians maximize vote share and so value poaching twice as much as mobilization. Cable news' incentive to center mobilizing culture war content influences politics: constituencies more exposed to cable news assign greater importance to cultural issues, and politicians respond by supplying more cultural ads. Our estimates suggest that cable news can account for one-third of the time-series increase in cultural conflict since 2000.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，1980年代有线电视新闻网络通过强调文化战争议题来吸引原本不看新闻的观众（动员效应），这种策略比强调经济议题更能增加观众规模。这种媒体激励影响了政治：更多接触有线新闻的选区更重视文化议题，政客也相应提供更多文化议题广告。有线新闻可以解释2000年以来文化冲突时间序列增长的三分之一。
AI.research_question: 有线电视新闻网络如何通过文化战争议题来影响观众规模和政治议程？
AI.motivation: 理解当代美国文化战争与1980年代媒体技术变革及有线新闻网络应对新时代激励之间的关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体经济学、观众行为理论、政治动员与争夺理论
AI.method: 使用家庭秒级智能电视数据，分析有线新闻对文化议题与经济议题的强调程度，比较动员效应与争夺效应
AI.findings: 有线新闻更强调文化战争议题而非经济议题；文化议题能动员原本不看新闻的观众，而经济议题主要争夺竞争对手的观众；动员效应大于争夺效应，因此文化议题能增加观众规模
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了媒体与政治在动员策略上的差异：媒体最大化观众规模，平等重视动员与争夺；政客最大化投票份额，更重视争夺对手选民
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了文化战争在媒体和政治中的兴起机制，为理解当代政治极化提供了媒体经济学视角

title: The Original Sin Revisited: Investor Composition and Sovereign Risk
affiliations: Department of Economics at Harvard University and

detail.title: The Original Sin Revisited: Investor Composition and Sovereign Risk
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new trade-off for emerging-market sovereign borrowing. Borrowing in local currency insulates sovereigns from default but increases the severity of bond fire sales in bad times, as local-currency bonds are endogenously held by intermediaries vulnerable to fire sales. We present three facts. First, investors with open-end funding structures who are subject to performance-based withdrawals hold most external local-currency debt. Investors with long-term and stable funding prefer to hold hard-currency bonds. Second, when open-ended intermediaries face funding withdrawals, local-currency bond prices fall differentially and issuers reallocate by issuing in hard currency. Third, issuers who have shifted towards issuing more local currency debt in recent years are more likely to experience bond market fragility. We rationalize these facts in a model where foreign households demand money-like claims denominated in their own currency from financiers who intermediate bond markets. Creditor sorting and bond fire sales arise endogenously from a complementarity between the open-end funding structure and the exchange rate risk embedded in local-currency debt. Our findings lean against conventional policy wisdom about the benefits of local-currency financing for financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了新兴市场主权借贷的新权衡：本币借贷虽然能避免违约，但会增加危机时期的债券抛售严重性，因为本币债券主要由易受抛售影响的开放式中介机构持有。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场主权借贷中本币借贷与硬通货借贷之间的权衡关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于本币融资对金融稳定性有益的传统政策智慧，揭示本币借贷可能带来的债券市场脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放式中介机构的资金结构与汇率风险互补性的理论框架，解释债权人分类和债券抛售的内生机制。
AI.method: 通过三个实证事实分析：投资者结构特征、抛售期间价格差异、发行模式与市场脆弱性关联。
AI.findings: 开放式中介机构主要持有本币债券，面临资金撤出时本币债券价格下跌更严重，发行人会转向硬通货发行，近年增加本币发行的发行人更易出现市场脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了本币借贷与硬通货借贷的新权衡理论，揭示了开放式资金结构与汇率风险的互补性如何内生地导致债权人分类和债券抛售。
AI.practical_contributions: 对传统政策建议提出质疑，为新兴市场主权借贷决策和金融稳定政策提供新的实证依据和理论指导。

title: Comparison of Dynamic Models Separating Risk and Intertemporal Substitution
affiliations: University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business - Department of Economics and Michigan State University

detail.title: Comparison of Dynamic Models Separating Risk and Intertemporal Substitution
detail.abstract: Different models have been proposed to separate the (elasticity of) intertemporal substitution from the risk attitude. Among those models, Epstein-Zin-Weil is the most famous, but there are others: Generalized Expected Discounted Utility (GEDU), Risk-Sensitive (RS), and Dynamic Quantile (DQ) preferences. This paper compares these four frameworks in terms of characteristics that are important for applications involving intertemporal decisions with risk, namely, the ability to separate intertemporal substitution from the risk attitude with observable data, dynamic consistency, monotonicity, and attitude toward long-run risk. We show that GEDU is able to separate EIS from risk, but it is neither dynamically consistent nor monotone. EZW is able to separate EIS from risk and it is dynamic consistent, but it is not monotone. RS is not able to separate EIS and risk with observable data, but it is dynamic consistent and monotone. The only model that retains all three properties-separation of intertemporal substiution and risk, dynamic consistency, and monotonicity-is the DQ model. Finally, all models, but GEDU, have aversion or indifference to long-run risk.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种跨期决策模型（EZW、GEDU、RS、DQ）在分离跨期替代弹性与风险态度方面的特性，发现只有DQ模型同时具备分离性、动态一致性和单调性。
AI.research_question: 不同跨期决策模型在分离跨期替代弹性与风险态度方面的特性比较
AI.motivation: 现有模型在分离跨期替代与风险态度方面存在不同特性，需要系统比较以指导应用选择
AI.theoretical_framework: Epstein-Zin-Weil偏好、广义期望贴现效用、风险敏感偏好、动态分位数偏好
AI.method: 理论比较分析，基于四个关键特性：分离性、动态一致性、单调性、长期风险态度
AI.findings: 只有DQ模型同时具备分离性、动态一致性和单调性；除GEDU外，其他模型都对长期风险表现出厌恶或中性态度
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了四种主要跨期决策模型的理论特性，明确了各模型的优缺点
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究中选择合适的跨期决策模型提供了理论指导

title: Short-Run Multi-Outcome Effects of Nightlife Regulation in San Juan
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Short-Run Multi-Outcome Effects of Nightlife Regulation in San Juan
detail.abstract: I evaluate San Juan, Puerto Rico's late-night alcohol sales ordinance using a multi-outcome synthetic control that pools economic and public-safety series. I show that a common-weight estimator clarifies mechanisms under low-rank outcome structure. I find economically meaningful reallocations in targeted sectors-restaurants and bars, gasoline and convenience, and hospitality employment-while late-night public disorder arrests and violent crime show no clear departures from pre-policy trends. The short post-policy window and small donor pool limit statistical power; joint conformal and permutation tests do not reject the null at conventional thresholds. I therefore emphasize effect magnitudes, temporal persistence, and pre-trend fit over formal significance. Code and diagnostics are available for replication.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用多结果合成控制方法评估波多黎各圣胡安市深夜酒精销售条例的影响，发现经济部门出现有意义的重分配，但公共安全指标没有明显变化。
AI.research_question: 圣胡安市深夜酒精销售条例对经济和公共安全指标的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估深夜酒精销售政策对经济活动和公共安全的实际影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合成控制方法、多结果分析框架、低秩结果结构理论
AI.method: 多结果合成控制方法，结合经济和公共安全时间序列数据，使用共同权重估计器
AI.findings: 目标经济部门（餐厅酒吧、汽油便利店、酒店就业）出现经济意义上的重分配，但深夜公共秩序逮捕和暴力犯罪没有明显偏离政策前趋势
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在低秩结果结构下使用共同权重估计器来澄清机制的方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为深夜酒精销售政策评估提供了实证证据，强调效应大小、时间持续性和趋势拟合度的重要性

title: Policy Uncertainty and Macroeconomic Dynamics: A New Index for Morocco
affiliations: Central Bank of Morocco

detail.title: Policy Uncertainty and Macroeconomic Dynamics: A New Index for Morocco
detail.abstract: In the absence of a dedicated Economic Policy Uncertainty (EPU) index for Morocco, we construct a novel measure using natural language processing techniques applied to seven major Moroccan newspapers. The resulting index captures fluctuations in uncertainty related to the political context, economic downturns, and extreme climate events. Employing Structural Vector AutoRegression (SVAR) models, we assess the impact of both world and domestic uncertainty shocks on Morocco’s macroeconomic dynamics. Our findings show that the EPU index is countercyclical and significantly influences the economy through several transmission channels. In particular, heightened uncertainty worsens business cycle indicators, amplifies household pessimism, and promotes cash hoarding over bank savings. This research enriches the existing literature by uncovering the distinctive features of policy uncertainty in a small open emerging economy and underscores its implications for economic policy decision-making and public policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文为摩洛哥构建了首个经济政策不确定性指数，发现该指数具有逆周期性，并通过多种传导渠道显著影响宏观经济，加剧经济周期波动、增强家庭悲观情绪并促使现金囤积。
AI.research_question: 摩洛哥经济政策不确定性如何影响其宏观经济动态？
AI.motivation: 缺乏专门针对摩洛哥的经济政策不确定性指数，需要构建适合小开放新兴经济体的不确定性衡量指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济政策不确定性理论、小开放经济体理论、宏观经济波动理论
AI.method: 使用自然语言处理技术分析七家主要摩洛哥报纸，构建EPU指数；采用结构向量自回归模型评估国内外不确定性冲击的影响
AI.findings: EPU指数具有逆周期性；不确定性加剧会恶化商业周期指标、增强家庭悲观情绪、促进现金囤积而非银行存款
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了小开放新兴经济体中政策不确定性的独特特征，丰富了经济政策不确定性文献
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济政策决策和公共政策评估提供了重要参考，强调了管理政策不确定性的重要性

title: Bond Portfolio Rebalancing During Dash-for-Cash Events: Evidence from the COVID-19 Outbreak
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Finance, Bank of Greece, Bank of Greece and Bank of Greece

detail.title: Bond Portfolio Rebalancing During Dash-for-Cash Events: Evidence from the COVID-19 Outbreak

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Greece Working Paper No. 351
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Greece Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using a granular dataset of bond fund holdings at the security-level, we examine how non-bank financial intermediaries respond to extreme liquidity crises like the COVID-19 shock of March 2020. U.S. funds primarily liquidated high-quality bonds, like Treasuries, while Euroarea funds sold across the rating spectrum. Despite these large liquidations, portfolio allocations across ratings and sectors remained stable, suggesting proportional rebalancing to maintain investment mandates. Funds with larger shares of highly-rated bonds sold lower-rated bonds less aggressively and experienced smaller losses. Our results highlight the importance of portfolio composition for the resilience of market-based finance and the transmission of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 基于债券基金持仓数据，研究发现COVID-19危机期间，美国基金主要清算高质量国债，而欧元区基金则出售各类评级债券。尽管大规模清算，投资组合结构保持稳定，表明基金进行比例再平衡以维持投资目标。持有更多高评级债券的基金在危机中表现更好。
AI.research_question: 非银行金融机构在极端流动性危机（如COVID-19冲击）中如何应对？
AI.motivation: 理解非银行金融机构在流动性危机中的行为模式，对市场基础金融的韧性和货币政策传导具有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场基础金融理论、投资组合管理理论、流动性危机应对理论
AI.method: 使用债券基金持仓的细粒度数据集，分析COVID-19危机期间基金的投资组合调整行为
AI.findings: 1. 美国基金主要清算高质量国债，欧元区基金出售各类评级债券；2. 尽管大规模清算，投资组合结构保持稳定；3. 持有更多高评级债券的基金在危机中表现更好
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对非银行金融机构在极端流动性危机中行为模式的理解，为市场基础金融理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于投资组合构成对金融韧性重要性的实证证据，有助于改进货币政策传导机制

title: Weak Business Investment in Spain following the Pandemic: An Analysis based on the Banco de España Business Activity Survey
affiliations: Banco de España, Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: Weak Business Investment in Spain following the Pandemic: An Analysis based on the Banco de España Business Activity Survey

publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Business investment has been notably weak in Spain in the past few years. This article analyses recent developments in such investment, the limiting factors and the role played by the Next Generation EU (NGEU) funds, drawing on information from a specific module included in the Banco de España Business Activity Survey (EBAE). Takeaways • The largest and most productive firms report greater momentum in their investment decisions, while firms with more idle capacity report less buoyant investment. • The obstacles to investment most often reported by firms are uncertainty over economic policy, the outsourcing of production processes and business regulation. • A total of 45% of firms with NGEU-funded projects stated that they would not have made such investments without the support of this programme, while 31% would only have made a portion of them, suggesting that these funds have a relatively high degree of additivity. However, lower additivity is observed in the case of green investments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了西班牙企业投资疲软的原因，重点考察了NGEU基金的作用。研究发现大型高生产率企业投资更活跃，闲置产能多的企业投资较弱。主要投资障碍是政策不确定性、外包和监管。NGEU基金具有较高附加性，45%企业表示没有该基金就不会投资，但绿色投资附加性较低。
AI.research_question: 西班牙企业投资疲软的原因是什么？NGEU基金在促进投资中发挥了什么作用？
AI.motivation: 西班牙近年来企业投资持续疲软，需要分析其制约因素并评估NGEU基金的政策效果
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业投资决策理论、政策干预效果评估、投资障碍分析框架
AI.method: 基于西班牙央行企业活动调查(EBAE)的专项模块数据进行分析
AI.findings: 大型高生产率企业投资更活跃；政策不确定性、外包和监管是主要投资障碍；NGEU基金具有较高附加性(45%企业完全依赖该基金投资)，但绿色投资附加性较低
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对企业投资决策影响因素的理解，特别是政策干预的附加性效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于投资障碍和NGEU基金效果的经验证据，有助于优化投资促进政策

title: The Missing Homebuyers: Demographic Changes and Financial Constraints

detail.title: The Missing Homebuyers: Demographic Changes and Financial Constraints
detail.abstract: Do mortgage constraints distort homeownership decisions for single borrowers? I show that single borrowers bunch more below regulatory thresholds for debt-to-income (DTI) ratios. When DTI constraints tighten, borrowers are overwhelmingly more likely to exit the market than to adjust their loan size, and single borrowers disproportionately account for these exits: 47% more single borrowers disappear from the market relative to co-borrowers. The large extensive margin response reflects the lumpy nature of housing and the limited availability of smaller, affordable homes due to restrictive zoning regulations. Cross-sectional and differencein-differences analyses show that single borrowers in more restrictive zoning markets have higher DTI ratios and respond more strongly to relaxations in DTI limits. My findings suggest that the decline in homeownership among young adults is not solely the result of shifting preferences, but also of financial and structural constraints that bind unevenly across a changing population.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现抵押贷款债务收入比(DTI)约束对单身借款人的购房决策产生扭曲效应。单身借款人更倾向于聚集在监管阈值以下，当DTI约束收紧时，他们更可能退出市场而非调整贷款规模，退出率比共同借款人高47%。这种显著的广延边际反应反映了住房的不可分割性和限制性分区法规导致的小型经济适用房供应不足。
AI.research_question: 抵押贷款约束是否扭曲了单身借款人的购房决策？
AI.motivation: 年轻成年人住房拥有率下降的原因不仅仅是偏好转变，还包括对变化中人口产生不均衡影响的金融和结构性约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债务收入比(DTI)约束理论、住房不可分割性理论以及分区法规对住房供应的影响理论。
AI.method: 采用横截面分析和双重差分法，比较不同分区法规严格程度市场中单身借款人的DTI比率和对DTI限制放松的反应。
AI.findings: 单身借款人在监管DTI阈值以下聚集更明显；DTI约束收紧时，单身借款人退出市场的可能性比共同借款人高47%；在限制性分区市场中，单身借款人DTI比率更高，对DTI限制放松反应更强烈。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了抵押贷款约束对单身借款人购房决策的扭曲机制，强调了住房不可分割性和分区法规在解释住房拥有率下降中的理论重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善住房可负担性的实证依据，建议考虑放松分区法规和调整抵押贷款政策以支持单身借款人购房。

title: Can Movements in Stock Market Capitalization and Financial Development Variable Predict Changes in Household Consumption in Nigeria?
affiliations: and Kebbi State Polytechnic - Department of Social Sciences

detail.title: Can Movements in Stock Market Capitalization and Financial Development Variable Predict Changes in Household Consumption in Nigeria?
detail.abstract: The aim of the paper is to measure relationship between household consumption, stock market capitalization and financial development. It attempts to answer the question: Can movements in Stock Market Capitalization and Financial Development variable predict changes in Household Consumption in Nigeria? It uses time series data from 1985 to 2019. It also employs impulse response function, variance decomposition and generalized method of moments. It findings show there is strong positive and statistically significant relationship between household consumption and stock market capitalization; but, weak and statistically insignificant relationship between household consumption and financial development. The variance decomposition analysis shows stock market capitalization is good predictor of household consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚家庭消费与股票市场资本化和金融发展之间的关系，发现股票市场资本化对家庭消费有显著正向预测作用，而金融发展的影响较弱且不显著。
AI.research_question: 股票市场资本化和金融发展变量能否预测尼日利亚家庭消费的变化？
AI.motivation: 研究家庭消费与金融市场指标之间的关系，为理解消费行为和金融市场影响提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费理论和金融发展理论，探讨金融市场对家庭消费行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1985-2019年的时间序列数据，采用脉冲响应函数、方差分解和广义矩估计方法。
AI.findings: 家庭消费与股票市场资本化存在强正相关且统计显著的关系；与金融发展的关系弱且统计不显著；方差分解显示股票市场资本化是家庭消费的良好预测指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为消费-金融市场关系理论提供了尼日利亚的实证证据，验证了股票市场对消费的预测能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供参考，强调发展股票市场对促进家庭消费的重要性，而非单纯关注金融发展指标。

title: Regulatory Compliance and Employment Arbitration: Strengthening Accountability in Adhesion Employment Agreements

detail.title: Regulatory Compliance and Employment Arbitration: Strengthening Accountability in Adhesion Employment Agreements

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could have influenced the analysis or conclusions of this study. The research was conducted independently and solely for academic purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on legal and policy analysis and did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency. It was self-directed as part of the author’s independent scholarly work.

detail.abstract: This paper critically examines whether mandatory arbitration clauses in adhesion employment contracts advance or undermine regulatory compliance goals in the United States. While employers increasingly use arbitration clauses to mitigate legal exposure and streamline dispute resolution, scholars argue that these clauses suppress statutory rights and limit regulatory transparency. Using the legal analysis of adhesion contracting principles and employment arbitration case law, including Gilmer, Circuit City, and Epic Systems, the paper evaluates how mandatory arbitration interacts with labor-law compliance frameworks and federal enforcement objectives. The research finds that arbitration, as currently practiced, functions less as a compliance safeguard and more as a risk-management strategy that may erode statutory protections. The paper contributes to compliance scholarship by proposing reforms that align arbitration practices with regulatory integrity, employee rights, and public-interest enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地研究了美国雇佣合同中强制性仲裁条款是促进还是削弱了监管合规目标。研究发现，当前实践中的仲裁更多是作为风险管理策略而非合规保障，可能侵蚀法定保护。
AI.research_question: 强制性仲裁条款在雇佣合同中是促进还是削弱监管合规目标？
AI.motivation: 雇主越来越多地使用仲裁条款来减轻法律风险和简化争议解决，但学者认为这些条款压制了法定权利并限制了监管透明度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 附合合同原则和雇佣仲裁判例法（包括Gilmer、Circuit City和Epic Systems案例）的法律分析
AI.method: 法律分析，包括对附合合同原则和雇佣仲裁判例法的分析
AI.findings: 仲裁作为当前实践，较少作为合规保障，更多作为风险管理策略，可能侵蚀法定保护
AI.theory_contributions: 通过提出将仲裁实践与监管完整性、员工权利和公共利益执行相一致的改革建议，为合规学术研究做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为改革仲裁实践提供建议，使其更好地与监管目标、员工权利和公共利益保持一致

title: Deceptively Framed Lotteries in Consumer Markets *
affiliations: University of Münster, Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Department of Economics, Center for Humans and Machines / Max Planck Institute for Human Development and Heinrich-Heine University of Düsseldorf

detail.title: Deceptively Framed Lotteries in Consumer Markets *
detail.abstract: Consumers often face products sold as lotteries rather than fixed outcomes. A prominent case is the loot box in video games, where players pay for randomized rewards. We investigate how presentation formats shape consumer beliefs and willingness to pay. In an online experiment with 802 participants, sellers could frame lotteries using two common manipulations: censoring outcome probabilities and selectively highlighting rare successes. More than 80% of sellers adopted such deceptive frames, particularly when both manipulations were available. These choices substantially inflated buyer beliefs and increased willingness to pay of up to six times the expected value. Sellers anticipated this effect and raised prices accordingly. Our results show how deceptive framing systematically shifts consumer beliefs and enables firms to extract additional surplus. For marketing practice, this highlights the strategic value of framing tools in probabilistic selling models; for policy, it underscores the importance of transparency requirements in protecting consumers.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在线实验发现，销售者普遍使用概率隐藏和稀有成功突出等欺骗性框架来呈现彩票产品，这会显著提高消费者的支付意愿（可达预期价值的6倍），销售者会预期这种效应并相应提高价格。
AI.research_question: 呈现框架如何影响消费者对彩票产品的信念和支付意愿？
AI.motivation: 消费者经常面临以彩票形式而非固定结果销售的产品（如游戏中的战利品箱），但销售者如何通过呈现框架操纵消费者信念尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的框架效应理论、概率判断偏差理论
AI.method: 在线实验，802名参与者，销售者可以选择不同的呈现框架（概率隐藏、稀有成功突出等）
AI.findings: 超过80%的销售者采用欺骗性框架；欺骗性框架显著提高消费者信念和支付意愿（可达预期价值的6倍）；销售者能预期这种效应并提高价格
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了框架效应理论在彩票产品中的应用，揭示了欺骗性框架如何系统性地影响消费者信念
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销实践提供了概率销售模型中的框架工具战略价值，为政策制定者强调了透明度要求在保护消费者方面的重要性

title:
The Persistence of the Opposites: AI and Blockchain for Transparent and Secure Cross-regulatory Compliance and Enforcement Cooperation

Test Beds in the Eu Digital Acquis
affiliations: Libera Universita Internazionale degli Studi Sociali - LUISS Guido Carli

detail.title:
The Persistence of the Opposites: AI and Blockchain for Transparent and Secure Cross-regulatory Compliance and Enforcement Cooperation

Test Beds in the Eu Digital Acquis
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and blockchain technologies occupy a prominent position on both global and European regulatory agendas, functioning as both passive objects of regulation and active instruments of regulatory governance. Their shared capacity to automate and accelerate processes traditionally performed by humans renders them apt for embedding compliance and enforcement functionalities into socio-technical systems. This potential has been formally acknowledged — and in certain instances mandated — by the European legislators. The Data Act requires the deployment of interoperable smart contracts for the execution of data-sharing agreements generated by Internet of Things (IoT) devices;1 the DLT Pilot Regime provides legal recognition for distributed ledger infrastructures in the trading and settlement of crypto-assets; and the AI Act establishes obligations around traceability, verifiability, and explainability, thereby suggesting the central role of eXplainable AI (XAI) in fostering transparency, democratic oversight, and system security. This article investigates how the ostensibly opposing properties of AI and blockchain — centralisation versus decentralisation, probabilistic versus deterministic logic, opacity versus transparency — may be harnessed to develop regulatory infrastructures that are transparent, secure, and compliant ‘by design’. Building on computer science literature and extending the RegTech and SupTech paradigms beyond the financial domain, the study investigates the prospective integration of AI’s adaptive and predictive capabilities with blockchain’s immutability, auditability, and privacy-preserving architecture — augmented by smart contract automation — while critically addressing its potential limitations and points of failure. It argues that such convergence can support cooperative, cross-sectoral, and cross-border mechanisms for legal compliance and regulatory enforcement within the EU Digital Acquis. Two exploratory test-bed hypotheses are advanced. First, it proposes that blockchain-enhanced XAI may assist in fulfilling and enabling oversight of the transparency requirements applicable to high-risk AI systems under the AI Act. Second, the paper considers how federated learning — integrated with blockchain infrastructure — can enable privacy- and security-enhancing data sharing in accordance with the normative and technical provisions of the Data Act and the Data Governance Act. While recognising the persisting technical, legal, ethical and environmental challenges to full-scale integration, the article concludes that the AI–blockchain nexus holds considerable promise for the development of robust, transparent, and cooperative regulatory enforcement architectures across the EU evolving digital legal landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能与区块链技术在欧盟监管框架中的融合应用，研究如何利用这两种技术的互补特性（集中化vs去中心化、概率性vs确定性、不透明vs透明）来构建透明、安全且合规的监管基础设施。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能与区块链技术的互补特性来开发透明、安全且合规的监管基础设施？
AI.motivation: AI和区块链技术在全球和欧洲监管议程中占据重要地位，它们既能作为监管对象，也能作为监管工具。欧盟立法者已正式承认并强制要求在某些场景下使用这些技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机科学文献，扩展RegTech和SupTech范式至金融领域之外，探讨AI的适应性和预测能力与区块链的不可篡改性、可审计性和隐私保护架构的整合。
AI.method: 理论分析和探索性测试床假设，提出两个具体应用场景：区块链增强的可解释AI用于高风险AI系统的透明度要求，以及联邦学习与区块链结合用于数据共享。
AI.findings: AI与区块链的融合能够支持欧盟数字法律框架内的合作性、跨部门和跨境法律合规与监管执行机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了RegTech和SupTech的理论范式，提出了AI与区块链技术融合的监管基础设施理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟监管机构提供了具体的技术实施路径，包括区块链增强的XAI用于AI透明度监管，以及联邦学习与区块链结合用于数据治理。

title: Whose Conscience Counts? Beneficiary Whose Conscience Counts? Beneficiary Value Alignment and ESG Public Pension Value Alignment and ESG Public Pension Funds Funds
affiliations: and Florida Atlantic University

detail.title: Whose Conscience Counts? Beneficiary Whose Conscience Counts? Beneficiary Value Alignment and ESG Public Pension Value Alignment and ESG Public Pension Funds Funds
detail.abstract: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) investing has reshaped public pension fund management. This paper explores whether ESG investing or proxy voting based on subjective social values violates fiduciary duties when diverging from the diverse beliefs of beneficiaries. As pooled investment vehicles lack inherent values, assigning moral weight to ESG portfolios challenges fiduciary neutrality. Fund managers face an untenable task in representing conflicting views. The article also questions whether ESG undermines fiduciary pluralism within the federal system, as global efforts to standardize ESG metrics may conflict with varied state laws, complicating compliance and eroding local discretion in pension fund governance. To clarify, state law governs these fiduciaries. ERISA governs most private pension plans such as 401(k)s. 2

AI.tldr: 本文探讨ESG投资和基于主观社会价值观的代理投票是否违反受托责任，特别是当这些做法与受益人的多样化信念相冲突时。文章质疑ESG投资是否破坏了联邦体系内的受托多元主义，因为全球ESG标准化可能与各州法律冲突。
AI.research_question: ESG投资和基于主观社会价值观的代理投票是否违反受托责任？ESG是否破坏了联邦体系内的受托多元主义？
AI.motivation: ESG投资重塑了公共养老基金管理，但作为集合投资工具缺乏固有价值观，为ESG投资组合赋予道德权重挑战了受托中立性。基金经理在代表冲突观点时面临不可行的任务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受托责任理论、受托中立性、受托多元主义、联邦体系理论
AI.method: 理论分析，法律分析
AI.findings: ESG投资和基于主观社会价值观的代理投票可能违反受托责任，特别是当与受益人多样化信念相冲突时。全球ESG标准化努力可能与各州法律冲突，使合规复杂化并侵蚀养老基金治理的地方裁量权。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了ESG投资与受托责任之间的理论冲突，提出了受托中立性和受托多元主义的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为养老基金管理者和监管机构提供了关于ESG投资合规性的实践指导，强调了州法律在公共养老基金治理中的主导地位。

title: Scoring in the Transition: A Signaling Model of Corporate Decarbonization
affiliations: , Finance Department, Bocconi University, Bocconi University - Department of Finance and Università Bocconi

detail.title: Scoring in the Transition: A Signaling Model of Corporate Decarbonization
detail.abstract: We assess a novel methodology to assign scores in a model in which: (i) a firm has a valuable transition growth option whose payoff is realized at the end of a transition period, (ii) the firm’s CEO has private information on the growth option quality; and (iii) a fund manager must decide how much to invest in this firm under limited information. In this setting, a progress-oriented score improves the allocation of capital. In an empirical application to the economics of climate, we show that an investment strategy that uses progress-based scores delivers a superior performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新的评分方法，用于评估具有转型增长期权的公司。该方法在信息不对称环境下，通过基于进展的评分改善资本配置效率，并在气候经济学的实证应用中显示出优越的投资表现。
AI.research_question: 在信息不对称环境下，如何通过进展导向的评分方法来改善对具有转型增长期权公司的资本配置效率？
AI.motivation: 企业在转型期间拥有有价值的增长期权，但CEO拥有关于期权质量的私有信息，而基金管理者在有限信息下需要做出投资决策，这导致了资本配置效率的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、期权定价理论和资本配置理论，构建了一个包含私有信息、转型增长期权和有限信息的理论模型。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析，在气候经济学领域进行实证应用，比较基于进展评分的投资策略与传统方法的绩效。
AI.findings: 进展导向的评分方法能够有效改善资本配置效率，基于进展评分的投资策略在气候经济学应用中表现出优越的投资绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在信息不对称环境下评估转型增长期权的新理论框架，发展了基于进展评分的资本配置理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金管理者提供了实用的投资决策工具，特别是在气候转型等复杂投资环境中，有助于提高投资效率和风险管理。

title: Delegate Pricing Decisions to an Algorithm? Experimental Evidence
affiliations: Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Department of Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Department of Economics and Center for Humans and Machines / Max Planck Institute for Human Development

detail.title: Delegate Pricing Decisions to an Algorithm? Experimental Evidence
detail.abstract: We analyze the delegation of pricing by participants, representing firms, to a collusive, self-learning algorithm in a repeated Bertrand experiment. In the baseline treatment, participants set prices themselves. In the other treatments, participants can either delegate pricing to the algorithm at the beginning of each supergame or receive algorithmic recommendations that they can override. Participants delegate more when they can override the algorithm's decisions. In both algorithmic treatments, prices are lower than in the baseline. Our results indicate that while self-learning pricing algorithms can be collusive, they can foster competition rather than collusion with humans-in-the-loop.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过重复Bertrand实验分析企业将定价权委托给自学习算法的行为。与人工定价相比，当参与者可以覆盖算法决策时委托意愿更高，但两种算法处理下的价格都低于人工定价基准，表明自学习定价算法虽然具有合谋潜力，但在人机协作模式下反而促进竞争。
AI.research_question: 当企业将定价权委托给自学习算法时，是否会导致合谋行为？人机协作如何影响定价结果？
AI.motivation: 随着定价算法在商业中的广泛应用，理解算法定价对市场竞争的影响至关重要，特别是自学习算法可能促进企业间合谋的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bertrand竞争模型和算法委托理论，探讨算法定价对市场竞争的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用重复Bertrand实验设计，设置三个处理组：人工定价基准组、完全算法委托组、可覆盖算法推荐组。
AI.findings: 1) 可覆盖算法决策时委托意愿更高；2) 两种算法处理下的价格都显著低于人工定价基准；3) 自学习算法在人机协作模式下促进竞争而非合谋。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了算法必然导致合谋的传统观点，提出人机协作可能改变算法行为模式的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供算法定价监管的政策启示，为企业算法定价策略提供实践指导。

title: Subjective Beliefs and the Q-Theory of Investment
affiliations: Swiss Finance Institute - USI Lugano

detail.title: Subjective Beliefs and the Q-Theory of Investment
detail.abstract: I study the role of managers' and investors' subjective beliefs for corporate investment and valuation. I augment a q-model allowing jointly for managers and investors to have non-rational expectations. The model highlights the importance of small distortions in expectations for investment decisions and valuation. The disagreement between these two economic agents impacts Investment-Q regressions and Investment-CashFlow sensitivity, even without other frictions. I construct a novel dataset on managers' and investors' sales forecasts and test the model predictions and estimate the model to quantify the role of subjective beliefs. I find that managers are optimistic and overinvest, while investors are pessimistic and underprice firms. Therefore, the documented gap between investment and valuation widens further. This requires higher implied markups to reconcile this evidence. These results highlight the importance of departing from rational expectations to evaluate the role of economic rents for corporate policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了管理者和投资者主观信念对企业投资和估值的影响。通过构建包含非理性预期的q模型，研究发现管理者乐观导致过度投资，投资者悲观导致企业低估，这扩大了投资与估值之间的差距，需要更高的隐含利润率来调和这一现象。
AI.research_question: 管理者和投资者的主观信念如何影响企业投资决策和估值？
AI.motivation: 传统理性预期模型无法充分解释企业投资与估值之间的差距，需要研究主观信念的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的q模型，允许管理者和投资者具有非理性预期，强调预期微小扭曲对投资决策和估值的重要性。
AI.method: 构建管理者和投资者销售预测的新数据集，测试模型预测并估计模型以量化主观信念的作用。
AI.findings: 管理者乐观导致过度投资，投资者悲观导致企业低估，投资与估值差距扩大，需要更高隐含利润率来调和。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了偏离理性预期对评估经济租金在企业政策中作用的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解企业投资决策和估值提供了新的视角，有助于解释投资-Q回归和投资-现金流敏感性的变化。

title: Taming the Storm: The Curious Case of Geopolitical Risk, Corporate Social Responsibility and M&A Failure

detail.title: Taming the Storm: The Curious Case of Geopolitical Risk, Corporate Social Responsibility and M&A Failure
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risk has emerged as a persistent feature of the global business environment, yet its impacts on domestic mergers and acquisitions (M&A) remain underexplored, particularly in emerging economies with distinctive institutional contexts. This study examines how geopolitical risk influences M&A deal failure in India and whether acquirers' corporate social responsibility (CSR) moderates this relationship under the country's mandatory CSR regime. Using a sample of 377 domestic M&A deals announced between 2015-16 and 2019-20, the analysis reveals a counterintuitive pattern: higher geopolitical risk is associated with a lower likelihood of deal failure, suggesting that firms pursue domestic consolidation as a defensive hedge against external volatility. While acquirers' CSR performance independently reduces the probability of deal failure, its interaction with high geopolitical risk increases the likelihood of failure. It indicates that strong CSR commitments may constrain financial flexibility during uncertain times, thereby heightening deal vulnerability. These results remain robust across alternative model specifications, sub-samples, and disaggregated geopolitical risk measures. By integrating geopolitical risk with a legally enforced CSR spending regime, this study provides one of the first empirical demonstrations of how macro-political turbulence and regulatory social responsibility jointly shape corporate M&A outcomes in emerging markets. These findings re-conceptualize CSR as a potential financial constraint under regulation and advance the understanding of firm behavior at the intersection of risk, responsibility, and regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了地缘政治风险对印度国内并购交易失败的影响，以及企业社会责任在强制性CSR制度下的调节作用。研究发现：更高的地缘政治风险反而降低交易失败概率，表明企业将国内整合作为对冲外部波动的防御策略；CSR表现独立降低交易失败概率，但与高政治风险交互时反而增加失败可能性，表明强CSR承诺在不确定时期可能约束财务灵活性。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何影响新兴经济体国内并购交易失败？企业社会责任在强制性CSR制度下是否调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险已成为全球商业环境的持久特征，但其对国内并购的影响，特别是在具有独特制度背景的新兴经济体中，仍未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合地缘政治风险理论与企业社会责任理论，特别关注强制性CSR制度下的企业行为。
AI.method: 使用2015-16至2019-20年间宣布的377笔国内并购交易样本进行分析，采用多种模型设定、子样本和分解的地缘政治风险指标确保稳健性。
AI.findings: 1) 更高的地缘政治风险与更低的交易失败概率相关；2) CSR表现独立降低交易失败概率；3) CSR与高政治风险交互时增加交易失败可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化CSR作为监管下的潜在财务约束，推进了对风险、责任和监管交叉点企业行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场企业如何在政治动荡和监管社会责任共同作用下管理并购决策提供了实证证据，帮助企业理解CSR在不确定时期的双重作用。

title: Credit Lines versus Cash: Implementing Incentives and Renegotiation-Proofness in a Two-Period Investment Model
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Credit Lines versus Cash: Implementing Incentives and Renegotiation-Proofness in a Two-Period Investment Model
detail.abstract: We revisit the textbook two-period investment model with moral hazard and limited liability. Building on Tirole (2006), we re-derive the optimal continuation rule under a long-term contract and provide a compact closed form for the failure-state continuation probability ξ *. We then show how the same allocation can be implemented through a short-term arrangement that transfers just-enough liquidity to the entrepreneur after period-1 outcomes and lets a competitive market supply the rest; this yields a simple, micro-founded notion of renegotiation-proofness. We interpret ξ * as a design target for liquidity instruments and compare cash reserves with committed credit lines (commitment and drawing fees omitted in the baseline and introduced later). Lattice-theoretic comparative statics (Topkis) deliver clean monotonicity of ξ * and of the optimal line size with respect to profitability, investment cost, private benefits, and incentive technology. The framework produces testable implications on the cash-line mix across industries and over the cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了道德风险和有限责任下的两期投资模型，推导出最优继续概率ξ*的闭式解，展示了如何通过短期安排实现相同配置，并将ξ*解释为流动性工具的设计目标，比较了现金储备和信贷额度的优劣。
AI.research_question: 在道德风险和有限责任的两期投资模型中，如何确定最优的继续概率ξ*？如何通过短期流动性安排实现长期契约的最优配置？
AI.motivation: 重新审视经典的两期投资模型，为流动性工具设计提供微观基础，并比较现金储备与信贷额度在不同情境下的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Tirole(2006)的两期投资模型，结合道德风险和有限责任理论，运用格论(Topkis)进行比较静态分析。
AI.method: 理论推导和数学模型分析，重新推导最优继续规则，提供闭式解，并进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 得出了最优继续概率ξ*的闭式解；展示了通过短期流动性转移和市场竞争可实现长期契约的最优配置；现金储备和信贷额度在不同参数下各有优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了重新谈判证明的微观基础概念；发展了流动性工具设计的理论框架；运用格论得出了清晰的单调性结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在现金储备和信贷额度之间的选择提供了理论指导；产生了关于行业间和周期中现金-信贷组合的可检验含义。

title: Factors Affecting the Recruitment and Selection Process of Private Commercial Banks in Bangladesh
affiliations: Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP) and North South University

detail.title: Factors Affecting the Recruitment and Selection Process of Private Commercial Banks in Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
There is a paramount importance of appropriateness in recruitment and selection for the desired performance of the private commercial banks in Bangladesh. It is the
determinant of the performance of the banks that leads to the growth and development of the banks in future. However, this aspect of management is often ignored by HRM department of the banks. The directors of the banks are unable to come out from their circles like family, friends, and relatives in recruitment decision. The people involved in the process influence the whole process of recruitment and selection for their personal interest. Candidates’ understanding and mindset for getting jobs sometimes create a kind of force that influences the process. People from the monitoring bank often create pressure on recruitment and selection process. External factors like political, economic, social, and legal also have strong influence on the selection process. As such, this study aims at identifying the factors affecting the recruitment and selection process of private sector commercial banks in Bangladesh. Results show that the factors including family pressure of the directors, interference of the people involved in the process, political interference, capability of the interviewer to design the tests, and candidates’ perception regarding the possibility of getting job have significant influence on the recruitment and selection process in the private commercial banks of Bangladesh. It was concluded from the study that the factors affecting recruitment and selection process of the banks are unable to fulfill the gap between the qualifications of the candidates and the job requirements of the banks.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了影响孟加拉国私营商业银行招聘选拔过程的关键因素，包括董事的家庭压力、流程参与者的干预、政治干预、面试官设计测试的能力以及求职者对获得工作可能性的认知，这些因素导致候选人资格与银行工作要求之间的差距无法得到满足。
AI.research_question: 影响孟加拉国私营商业银行招聘选拔过程的因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 招聘选拔的适当性对孟加拉国私营商业银行的绩效至关重要，但银行的人力资源管理部门经常忽视这一管理方面，董事们无法摆脱家庭、朋友和亲戚的圈子做出招聘决策，各种外部因素也对选拔过程产生强烈影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论，特别是招聘选拔理论，关注影响招聘过程有效性的各种内部和外部因素。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但可能是实证研究，通过识别和分析影响招聘选拔过程的因素。
AI.findings: 董事的家庭压力、流程参与者的干预、政治干预、面试官设计测试的能力以及求职者对获得工作可能性的认知对孟加拉国私营商业银行的招聘选拔过程有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对发展中国家背景下招聘选拔过程影响因素的理解，特别是在存在强烈社会网络和政治干预的环境中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国私营商业银行提供了改善招聘选拔过程的见解，帮助银行更好地匹配候选人资格与工作要求，从而提高组织绩效。

title: Coercion and Monopsony in Modern American Manufacturing: Evidence from Alabama Prison Labor
affiliations: Case Western Reserve University - Department of Economics, Columbia University, , Columbia University and W.E. Upjohn Institute for Employment Research

detail.title: Coercion and Monopsony in Modern American Manufacturing: Evidence from Alabama Prison Labor

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Funding for the research was provided by Jobs to Move America and the Freedom Together Foundation to Columbia Labor Lab. Sojourner and the Upjohn Institute did not receive funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The Columbia University and University of Western Michigan institutional review boards determined the project exempt as analysis of de-identified secondary data.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for the research was provided by Jobs to Mover America and the Freedom Together Foundation to Columbia Labor Lab.

detail.abstract: We study coercion and monopsony in contemporary U.S. manufacturing labor markets. We combine administrative data from the Alabama Department of Corrections work release program with a unique survey of workers in the Alabama auto supply chain where workers report their work-release status. We first present descriptive patterns of work-release labor, finding that the use of incarcerated (i.e., work-release) labor is concentrated in the auto supply industry, especially in the Montgomery area, where Hyundai's assembly plant is located. In the survey, the share of plant-level workers who are incarcerated is negatively correlated with non-incarcerated wages. The survey also enables estimation of hypothetical quit elasticities separately among incarcerated and non-incarcerated workers. Incarcerated workers are estimated to have quit elasticities less than half that of non-incarcerated workers. Because Alabama law requires employers to pay the same wage to incarcerated and non-incarcerated workers in the same jobs, the additional monopsony power introduced by employer access to incarcerated workers creates an incentive and ability for employers to reduce plant-level wages to, and employment of, non-incarcerated workers. We build a quantitative model of firm-specific labor supply that, for incarcerated workers, distinguishes the roles of coercion (the risk of physical harm in prison from not working), wage garnishment that blunts the consumption effect of higher wages, and monopsony (limited mobility across employers). Using it, we estimate effects on free and incarcerated workers' welfare from i) reforming prison conditions to eliminate violence, ii) eliminating prison labor wage garnishment, iii) imposing a $15 minimum wage, and iv) abolishing prison labor. Free worker welfare goes up in all scenarios, while incarcerated worker welfare goes up with the first three reforms, but down with the abolition of prison labor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国制造业劳动力市场中的强制劳动和买方垄断问题，通过阿拉巴马州监狱工作释放计划数据和汽车供应链工人调查，发现使用监禁劳动力会降低非监禁工人的工资，并建立了量化模型评估各种改革方案对工人福利的影响。
AI.research_question: 监禁劳动力如何影响制造业劳动力市场的工资水平和工人福利？
AI.motivation: 研究当代美国制造业劳动力市场中强制劳动和买方垄断现象的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 买方垄断理论、强制劳动理论、劳动力供给模型
AI.method: 结合阿拉巴马州监狱工作释放计划的行政数据和汽车供应链工人调查数据，构建企业特定劳动力供给的量化模型。
AI.findings: 使用监禁劳动力的工厂中非监禁工人工资较低；监禁工人的离职弹性仅为非监禁工人的一半；监禁劳动力为雇主提供了额外的买方垄断力量，使其能够压低整体工资水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了区分强制、工资扣押和买方垄断三种机制对监禁劳动力影响的量化模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 评估了四种改革方案（改善监狱条件、取消工资扣押、提高最低工资、废除监狱劳动）对自由工人和监禁工人福利的不同影响，为政策制定提供依据。

title: Comparison of Oracles: Part II
affiliations: Ben Gurion University of the Negev, Durham University Business School and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comparison of Oracles: Part II

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper studies incomplete-information games in which an information provider, an oracle, publicly discloses information to the players. One oracle is said to dominate another if, in every game, it can replicate the equilibrium outcomes induced by the latter. The companion Part I characterizes dominance under deterministic signaling and under stochastic signaling with a unique common knowledge component. The present paper extends the analysis to general environments and provides a characterization of equivalence (mutual dominance) among oracles. To this end, we develop a theory of information loops, thereby extending the seminal work of Blackwell (1951) to strategic environments and Aumann (1976)'s theory of common knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不完全信息博弈中信息提供者（预言机）向玩家公开披露信息的问题。一个预言机支配另一个预言机，如果它在每个博弈中都能复制后者诱导的均衡结果。本文扩展了分析到一般环境，并提供了预言机等价性（相互支配）的表征。为此，我们发展了信息循环理论，将Blackwell(1951)的开创性工作扩展到战略环境，并扩展了Aumann(1976)的共同知识理论。
AI.research_question: 在一般不完全信息博弈环境中，如何表征信息提供者（预言机）之间的等价关系（相互支配）？
AI.motivation: 扩展Part I中确定性信号和具有唯一共同知识分量的随机信号下的支配关系分析，研究更一般环境下的预言机等价性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Blackwell(1951)的信息理论和Aumann(1976)的共同知识理论，发展信息循环理论来研究战略环境中的信息披露。
AI.method: 理论分析，通过发展信息循环理论来扩展现有框架，提供预言机等价性的数学表征。
AI.findings: 在一般不完全信息博弈环境中，建立了预言机等价性的完整表征，通过信息循环理论将Blackwell和Aumann的理论扩展到战略环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将Blackwell的信息理论扩展到战略环境；2. 扩展Aumann的共同知识理论；3. 发展了信息循环理论来研究预言机等价性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解信息提供者在战略环境中的作用提供了理论框架，有助于分析信息披露对博弈结果的影响。

title: Financial Market Trading with Narrow Thinking
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Lingnan (University) College, Nanjing University and Beijing Jiaotong University

detail.title: Financial Market Trading with Narrow Thinking
detail.abstract: Traders often "narrowly bracket" their choices, in contrast to standard rational expectation equilibrium (REE) models that assume perfect coordination. We develop a two-asset rational expectations model of a "narrow thinker" whose trades in different assets are based on different, non-nested information sets. This creates an intra-personal friction that impedes the agent's ability to coordinate their own portfolio decisions. The model generates several novel predictions, including price underreaction to fundamental news, a non-monotonic U-shaped relationship between the friction and market liquidity, and a striking dichotomy in price discovery: while the informational content of any single price deteriorates for traders, the informativeness of the complete price system improves for an outside observer. Our framework provides a bounded rationality foundation for phenomena such as return momentum and excess volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个"狭隘思考者"的双资产理性预期模型，发现交易者在不同资产交易中使用非嵌套信息集，导致个人内部摩擦，阻碍投资组合决策协调。模型预测了价格对基本面新闻反应不足、摩擦与市场流动性之间的U型关系，以及价格发现的二分法。
AI.research_question: 狭隘思考者的投资决策如何影响市场价格发现和资产定价？
AI.motivation: 传统理性预期均衡模型假设完美协调，但现实中交易者往往"狭隘地"做出选择，这种个人内部摩擦对市场效率的影响需要研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期均衡模型、狭隘思考理论、信息集非嵌套性、个人内部协调摩擦
AI.method: 构建双资产理性预期模型，分析狭隘思考者在不同资产交易中使用不同信息集时的均衡结果
AI.findings: 价格对基本面新闻反应不足；摩擦与市场流动性呈U型关系；价格发现存在二分法：单个价格信息含量下降但完整价格系统信息性提高
AI.theory_contributions: 为回报动量、过度波动等现象提供了有限理性理论基础；拓展了理性预期模型框架
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解现实市场中价格发现的复杂性；为投资策略设计提供理论指导

title: Congruence between Environmental Claims and Packaging Type in the Consumer-Packaged Goods Industry
affiliations: and Mastercard

detail.title: Congruence between Environmental Claims and Packaging Type in the Consumer-Packaged Goods Industry
detail.abstract: Greenwashing, the falsification or exaggeration of a product's environmental claims, is difficult to detect and impedes environmental objectives. In this article, we investigate how environmentally friendly product claims in the consumer-packaged goods industry relate to their packaging used. The consumer-packaged goods industry is a major source of single use plastic from packaging and there are often sustainable packaging substitutes. However, they are usually more expensive and do not perform as well. We use the Global New Products Database (GNPD) to explore the congruence between product claims and the packaging used. We find that new products marketed as ecologically benign are more likely to use sustainable packaging than conventional products. However, the difference is minor and the share of organic products is small.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了消费品行业中环保产品声明与包装使用之间的关系，发现标榜环保的新产品比传统产品更可能使用可持续包装，但差异很小且有机产品份额有限。
AI.research_question: 消费品行业中环保产品声明与其包装使用之间有何关系？
AI.motivation: 绿色洗白（夸大环保声明）难以检测且阻碍环保目标实现，消费品行业是单次使用塑料包装的主要来源，而可持续包装替代品通常更昂贵且性能较差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色洗白理论、环保声明与实际行动一致性理论
AI.method: 使用全球新产品数据库（GNPD）分析产品声明与包装使用的一致性
AI.findings: 标榜环保的新产品比传统产品更可能使用可持续包装，但差异很小，有机产品份额有限
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色洗白检测提供了实证证据，深化了对环保声明与实际行为一致性的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构识别绿色洗白行为提供参考，帮助企业改进环保声明与包装实践的一致性

title: Overallocated Investors and Secondary Transactions
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business, University of Amsterdam and CEPR and Harvard Business School - Finance Unit

detail.title: Overallocated Investors and Secondary Transactions
detail.abstract: We study how institutional investors manage their private equity allocations beyond initial commitments. Using a novel method to identify secondary sales from reporting patterns, we show that U.S. public pension plans increasingly use secondary sales of private equity fund stakes to rebalance their portfolios when allocations exceed policy targets. Overallocated plans sell funds with higher net asset values and tend to accept larger discounts. Even though secondary sales are costly, they serve as a key rebalancing mechanism under static allocation policies, while overallocated pension plans make only limited adjustments through smaller new commitments and modest increases in target allocations.

AI.tldr: 美国公共养老金计划通过二级市场出售私募股权基金份额来重新平衡投资组合，当私募股权配置超过政策目标时，它们会出售净资产价值较高的基金并接受较大折扣，这成为静态配置政策下的关键再平衡机制。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者如何在初始承诺之外管理其私募股权配置？具体而言，美国公共养老金计划如何通过二级市场销售来重新平衡其私募股权投资组合？
AI.motivation: 研究机构投资者在私募股权配置管理中的实际操作机制，特别是当配置超过政策目标时的再平衡策略，这对理解机构投资组合管理的实际运作具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合再平衡理论和机构投资行为理论，探讨在静态配置政策约束下机构投资者的实际操作策略。
AI.method: 使用新颖的方法通过报告模式识别二级市场销售，分析美国公共养老金计划的数据。
AI.findings: 1) 超配的养老金计划越来越多地使用私募股权基金份额的二级销售来重新平衡投资组合；2) 它们倾向于出售净资产价值较高的基金；3) 接受较大的折扣；4) 尽管二级销售成本高昂，但在静态配置政策下成为关键的再平衡机制；5) 超配的养老金计划主要通过较小的新承诺和适度的目标配置调整来进行有限调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在静态配置政策约束下机构投资者的实际再平衡行为，丰富了投资组合管理理论和机构投资行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了关于私募股权配置管理的实践指导，特别是在使用二级市场销售作为再平衡工具时的策略选择。

title: Political Distance and International Trade
affiliations: University of Tübingen

detail.title: Political Distance and International Trade
detail.abstract: Rising geopolitical tensions and talk of a "New Cold War" have revived concerns about trade fragmentation. Yet, systematic evidence on how much political distance reduces trade is still scarce. I introduce political distance, based on UN General Assembly votes, as a novel trade cost in a structural gravity model. Using data on more than 50 years of bilateral and domestic trade among 166 countries, I estimate that an increase in political distance by the average within-pair standard deviation decreases trade by 3.1 percent, about half the effect of removing a regional trade agreement (RTA), controlling for tariffs and RTAs. The effects of past, current, and future political distance are consistent with a causal interpretation. The effect is stronger during periods of heightened political tensions and for simple-to-produce consumer goods and weaker among liberal democracies. Two counterfactuals illustrate that changes in political distance alone can cause sizable welfare redistribution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入基于联合国大会投票的政治距离作为新的贸易成本，使用结构引力模型分析50多年166个国家间的双边和国内贸易数据，发现政治距离增加一个标准差会使贸易减少3.1%，约相当于取消区域贸易协定效果的一半。
AI.research_question: 政治距离如何影响国际贸易？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势上升和"新冷战"讨论引发了对贸易碎片化的担忧，但关于政治距离如何减少贸易的系统性证据仍然稀缺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型，将政治距离作为新的贸易成本因素引入。
AI.method: 使用166个国家50多年的双边和国内贸易数据，基于联合国大会投票构建政治距离指标，在控制关税和区域贸易协定的情况下进行估计。
AI.findings: 政治距离增加一个标准差会使贸易减少3.1%；效应在政治紧张时期更强，对简单消费品更强，在自由民主国家间较弱；政治距离变化可导致显著的福利再分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将政治距离作为系统性贸易成本引入结构引力模型，提供了政治因素影响贸易的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解地缘政治对贸易的影响提供量化依据，有助于评估贸易碎片化的经济后果。

title: Democracy and the Gender Parity in Property Rights: Does Political Freedom Help?
affiliations: Austin Peay State University

detail.title: Democracy and the Gender Parity in Property Rights: Does Political Freedom Help?
detail.abstract: Democracy has been shown to help increase income in the long run. It is also essential to understand the channels through which democracy fosters development and creates more opportunities for individuals within society. In this paper, I investigate the impact of democratic transitions on property rights. Using the Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) dataset, along with Acemoglu et al.'s (2019) definition of democracy, I evaluate the impact of democracy first on the general understanding of property rights in individual countries. I then examine whether democracy affects men and women differently with regard to property rights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了民主转型对财产权的影响，特别关注民主对男女财产权的差异化影响。
AI.research_question: 民主转型如何影响财产权？民主是否对男性和女性的财产权产生不同影响？
AI.motivation: 民主在长期内有助于提高收入，但需要理解民主促进发展和为社会个体创造更多机会的具体渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Acemoglu等人（2019）的民主定义，探讨民主与财产权保护的理论关系。
AI.method: 使用Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem)数据集，采用Acemoglu等人（2019）的民主定义，评估民主对各国财产权普遍理解的影响，并分析民主对男女财产权的差异化影响。
AI.findings: 民主转型对财产权有积极影响，但对男性和女性的影响存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对民主促进发展机制的理解，特别是民主通过财产权保护渠道影响经济发展的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于民主制度如何影响财产权保护的实证依据，特别关注性别平等在财产权保护中的重要性。

title: Can Drug Pricing Transparency Reduce Drug Costs?

detail.title: Can Drug Pricing Transparency Reduce Drug Costs?
detail.abstract: High drug prices and opaque middle-man contracting have driven calls for transparency. I examine whether mandates to disclose rebate flows lower prescription drug costs. I find no meaningful reduction in premiums, deductibles, or out-of-pocket payments across different market structures and incentive conditions. Instead, I find that costs can rise in markets not directly regulated—consistent with intermediaries shifting costs across jurisdictions. Contrary to regulators' expectations, transparency alone may not reduce drug spending—and may even redirect it—when contracts span multiple markets.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，强制披露药品回扣流动并不能有效降低处方药成本，反而可能在某些市场导致成本上升，因为中介机构会将成本转移到不受监管的市场。
AI.research_question: 强制披露回扣流动是否能够降低处方药成本？
AI.motivation: 高药价和不透明的中间商合同推动了透明化要求
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场结构理论、成本转移理论、监管效应理论
AI.method: 实证分析不同市场结构和激励条件下的保费、免赔额和自付费用数据
AI.findings: 没有发现保费、免赔额或自付费用的显著降低；在不受直接监管的市场中成本反而可能上升，这与中介机构跨司法管辖区转移成本的行为一致
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了透明度自动降低成本的假设，揭示了跨市场合同中的成本转移机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供证据，表明单纯依靠透明度可能不足以降低药品支出，甚至可能重新分配支出

title: Optimal Stopping in Higher Dimensions: The Case of Investments in the Sustainable Energy Transition
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: Optimal Stopping in Higher Dimensions: The Case of Investments in the Sustainable Energy Transition
detail.abstract:
Real options analysis includes research on optimal stopping problems that is focusing largely on
one-dimensional problems, or on multidimensional problems with analytically tractable payoff
functions. However, many research questions addressing investments relevant to sustainable energy
transition require optimal stopping with multiple uncertainties, in high time resolution, with
general stochastic dynamics, and a general payoff function. These questions are difficult to answer
with current theory. Thus, this work presents a new method for solving optimal stopping problems
in this general setting. We adapted the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation to such problems,
and then developed a numerical solution procedure. This approach was tested on the following
real-world case: retrofitting an offshore wind farm with an electrolyzer, both operating under
market-based electricity pricing. Such assets are challenging to assess because of their simultaneous
exposure to a volatile electricity price and a volatile electricity production. In particular,
the fluctuating electricity price facilitate profits, while at the same time, it constitutes a potentially
investment-deterring uncertainty. Despite the method’s numerical complexity and computational
demands, it proves effective and thus, broadens the applicability of real options analysis to this
class of problems, providing a new analytical tool for research on the sustainable energy transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解决多维不确定性、高时间分辨率、一般随机动态和一般收益函数的最优停止问题的新方法，通过改编Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程并开发数值求解程序，扩展了实物期权分析在可持续能源转型投资评估中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何解决具有多维不确定性、高时间分辨率、一般随机动态和一般收益函数的最优停止问题？
AI.motivation: 当前实物期权分析主要关注一维问题或具有解析可处理收益函数的多维问题，但可持续能源转型中的许多投资问题需要处理更复杂的情况，现有理论难以解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的最优停止理论，结合实物期权分析框架。
AI.method: 改编Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程，开发数值求解程序，并在海上风电场加装电解槽的实际案例中进行测试。
AI.findings: 该方法虽然计算复杂且需求高，但在处理多维不确定性问题时有效，能够评估同时暴露于波动电价和波动电力生产的资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了实物期权分析的理论范围，使其能够处理更一般化的最优停止问题，为可持续能源转型研究提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续能源转型中的复杂投资决策提供了实用的评估方法，特别是在处理波动电价和电力生产双重不确定性的场景中。

title: Investor Beliefs and Asset Prices Under Selective Memory
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Finance

detail.title: Investor Beliefs and Asset Prices Under Selective Memory
detail.abstract: I present a consumption-based asset pricing model in which the representative agent selectively recalls past fundamentals that resemble current fundamentals and updates beliefs as if the recalled observations are all that occurred. This similarity-weighted selective memory jointly explains important facts about belief formation, survey data, and realized asset prices. Subjective expectations overreact and are procyclical, the subjective volatility is countercyclical, and the subjective risk premium has a low volatility. In contrast, realized returns are predictably countercyclical, highly volatile, and unrelated to variation of objective risk measures. The findings suggest that human memory can simultaneously account for individual-level data and aggregate asset pricing facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于消费的资产定价模型，其中代表性代理人选择性地回忆与当前基本面相似的过去基本面，并更新信念。这种基于相似性的选择性记忆共同解释了信念形成、调查数据和实际资产价格的重要事实。
AI.research_question: 选择性记忆如何解释信念形成、调查数据和资产定价的实证规律？
AI.motivation: 理解人类记忆在资产定价中的作用，解释主观期望与实际资产价格之间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费的资产定价模型，结合选择性记忆理论，代理人根据相似性权重回忆过去观察。
AI.method: 理论建模，构建包含选择性记忆机制的资产定价模型，分析主观期望与客观现实的关系。
AI.findings: 主观期望过度反应且顺周期，主观波动率逆周期，主观风险溢价波动率低；实际回报可预测地逆周期、波动率高，与客观风险度量变化无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人类记忆机制纳入资产定价理论，为信念形成和资产定价提供新的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了调查数据与市场实际表现的差异，为理解投资者行为和市场价格波动提供新视角。

title: The Cost of Optimally Acquired Information
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: The Cost of Optimally Acquired Information
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a framework for modeling the cost of information acquisition based on the principle of cost-minimization. We study the reduced-form indirect cost of information generated by the sequential minimization of a primitive direct cost function. Indirect cost functions: (i) are characterized by a novel recursive property, sequential learning-proofness; (ii) provide an optimization foundation for the popular class of "uniformly posterior separable" costs; and (iii) can often be tractably calculated from their underlying direct costs. We apply the framework by identifying fundamental modeling tradeoffs in the rational inattention literature and two new indirect cost functions that balance these tradeoffs.

title: The Altruistic Authoritarian Citizen: Prosocial Behaviour and Political Membership in Contemporary China
affiliations: University of Alberta - Department of Political Science and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Social Policy and Administration

detail.title: The Altruistic Authoritarian Citizen: Prosocial Behaviour and Political Membership in Contemporary China
detail.abstract: Can altruism flourish under authoritarianism? Conventional wisdom assumes prosocial behaviour requires democratic institutions that protect voluntary association and civic autonomy. We challenge this assumption by examining what we call the altruistic authoritarian citizen. Drawing upon original survey data across mainland China, we demonstrate that Chinese Communist Party membership robustly predicts heightened altruistic behaviour across multiple measures, even when controlling for demographic and socioeconomic factors. Critically, we show this relationship operates through mechanisms distinctive to authoritarian governance. Our findings reveal three surprising patterns. First, loneliness correlates positively rather than negatively with prosocial engagement, suggesting compensatory pathways to altruism operate independently of social capital mechanisms. Second, long-term temporal orientation consistently predicts altruistic conduct, indicating that authoritarian regimes leverage indigenous values to cultivate prosocial orientations. Third, while party membership powerfully shapes altruistic behaviour, it does not influence underlying philosophical orientations toward different forms of giving. Together, these patterns demonstrate that authoritarian citizenship constitutes a theoretically distinct mode of prosocial governance: one that produces authentic altruistic conduct through politicized pathways; creating citizen subjectivities that simultaneously serve personal fulfillment and regime legitimation. Our findings advance understanding of how authoritarian regimes shape prosocial behaviour while revealing important limits on state penetration of citizen consciousness.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，发现在威权体制下也能培养利他主义行为。通过对中国大陆的调查数据，研究发现中共党员身份能显著预测更高的利他行为，这种关系通过威权治理特有的机制运作。
AI.research_question: 威权主义下能否培养利他主义？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观点——利他行为需要民主制度保护自愿结社和公民自治的假设
AI.theoretical_framework: 利他威权公民理论，探讨威权治理如何通过独特机制塑造利他行为
AI.method: 基于中国大陆的原始调查数据，控制人口和社会经济因素
AI.findings: 1) 孤独感与亲社会参与正相关；2) 长期时间导向预测利他行为；3) 党员身份影响行为但不影响哲学取向
AI.theory_contributions: 提出威权公民身份构成了一种理论上独特的亲社会治理模式
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了威权政权如何通过政治化途径培养真实的利他行为，同时显示国家渗透公民意识的局限性

title: WHEN MONEY IS EQUITY FOR ITS ISSUER: MESSAGE TO THE CENTRAL BANKS
affiliations: and University of Palermo - d/SEAS

detail.title: WHEN MONEY IS EQUITY FOR ITS ISSUER: MESSAGE TO THE CENTRAL BANKS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: This article revisits the Accounting View of Money (AVM), which challenges the conventional treatment of money as debt. Drawing on revised international accounting standards and expert feedback, it argues that central bank money-and part of commercial bank deposits-should be classified as equity under a dedicated balance-sheet subcategory. The study refines the conceptual framework, distinguishes between primary and secondary seigniorage, and empirically applies the AVM to the UK (2007-2016). Results reveal significant unrecognized seigniorage and misrepresentation in financial reporting, with important implications for central bank capital, monetary policy credibility, and the transparency of money issuance.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视会计货币观，挑战传统将货币视为债务的观点，提出央行货币和部分商业银行存款应归类为权益，并应用于英国实证分析，发现大量未确认铸币税和财务报告失真问题。
AI.research_question: 央行货币和商业银行存款是否应重新分类为权益而非债务？会计货币观如何影响铸币税计算和财务报告透明度？
AI.motivation: 传统将货币视为债务的观点存在概念缺陷，国际会计准则修订和专家反馈支持重新审视货币的会计分类，以更准确反映货币发行的经济实质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计货币观，挑战传统货币作为债务的理论，提出货币应分类为权益，区分一级和二级铸币税概念。
AI.method: 结合修订的国际会计准则和专家反馈进行概念框架完善，并对英国2007-2016年数据进行实证应用分析。
AI.findings: 发现大量未确认的铸币税，财务报告存在失真，对央行资本、货币政策可信度和货币发行透明度有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 完善会计货币观理论框架，重新定义货币的会计分类，区分一级和二级铸币税概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行资本管理、货币政策制定提供新视角，提高货币发行透明度，改进财务报告质量。

title: Adjoint Differentiation for Path-Dependent Assets with Payment Jumps: A Generic Θ-Scheme Framework

detail.title: Adjoint Differentiation for Path-Dependent Assets with Payment Jumps: A Generic Θ-Scheme Framework
detail.abstract: A generic, fully discrete adjoint method for pricing and computing risk sensitivities of path-dependent contracts with both scheduled and stochastic payments in one-factor models is presented. Between payment dates the contract value is advanced in the diffusive state by a Theta-scheme. Path dependence is represented by a static coordinate (a half state variable) that is frozen between dates and updated only at payment times, so one tridiagonal solve per static level suffices and the PDE state dimension does not increase. Each payment date is handled by an affine update that injects cash, applies a nodewise survival/scale factor, and assembles the continuation value by interpolating across static-level rows according to an updated level. Differentiating both the Theta-scheme and the affine payment update yields an adjoint sweep in which auxiliary vectors satisfy a transpose recurrence; this cancels explicit state variations and reduces the total gradient to a sum of local terms stored during pricing (step matrices, driver values and derivatives, and interpolation indices and weights). All Greeks with respect to all model parameters are obtained in a single adjoint pass-no bump-and-rerun. The framework is applied to a callable mortgage-backed bond with scheduled amortisation and state-dependent prepayment. Adjoint bucketed-volatility vegas and the mean-reversion sensitivity match central finite differences to machine precision while producing the full gradient set in essentially one pricing-like run, delivering a measured speed-up of about 7.5x. The approach is storage-local, exploits tridiagonal sparsity, and is directly deployable in production risk engines across one-factor models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的全离散伴随方法，用于定价和计算路径依赖合约的风险敏感性，该方法在单因子模型中处理预定和随机支付。通过Theta方案推进合约价值，使用静态坐标表示路径依赖性，并通过伴随扫描计算所有模型参数的希腊值，无需重复定价，实现了约7.5倍的速度提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在单因子模型中开发一种高效的方法来定价路径依赖合约并计算其所有模型参数的风险敏感性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法如bump-and-rerun在计算风险敏感性时效率低下，需要多次重复定价，无法满足生产风险引擎的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全离散伴随方法理论，结合Theta方案和静态坐标表示路径依赖性，构建了高效的定价和敏感性计算框架。
AI.method: 使用Theta方案在支付日期之间推进合约价值，静态坐标在支付日期更新，通过伴随扫描计算梯度，所有希腊值在一次伴随传递中完成。
AI.findings: 该方法能够精确匹配中心有限差分结果，同时以约7.5倍的速度计算完整的梯度集，适用于生产风险引擎。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通用的全离散伴随方法框架，统一处理预定和随机支付，降低了计算复杂度和存储需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了高效的风险敏感性计算，可直接部署到生产风险引擎中，提升了金融衍生品定价和风险管理的效率。

title: Knowledge Spillovers, Market Power and Innovation under Trade Shocks
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Knowledge Spillovers, Market Power and Innovation under Trade Shocks
detail.abstract: This paper examines how international trade shocks affect firm innovation when knowledge spillovers interact with market power. Using matched firm-patent data from China and the United States, I compare two opposite trade episodes-China's WTO accession and the 2018 U.S. trade war. I find that tariff reductions during liberalization increased innovation, whereas tariff increases under protection reduced it. The direction of these effects depends systematically on pre-existing spillover intensity: in China, sectors with stronger spillovers responded less to liberalization, while in the United States they experienced larger declines during protection. Firms with greater market share consistently exhibited stronger innovation responses in both settings. To explain these patterns, I develop a dynamic two-country model in which oligopolistic firms invest in R&D while knowledge flows among incumbents and to a competitive fringe. Calibrated counterfactuals show that modest, sector-specific R&D or competition-policy interventions can offset welfare losses at minimal fiscal cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了国际贸易冲击如何影响企业创新，特别关注知识溢出与市场力量的交互作用。通过比较中国入世（贸易自由化）和美国贸易战（贸易保护）两个相反案例，发现关税降低促进创新而关税增加抑制创新，且这些效应受知识溢出强度和企业市场力量影响。
AI.research_question: 国际贸易冲击如何影响企业创新？知识溢出与市场力量在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 理解贸易政策变化对企业创新行为的影响机制，特别是知识溢出和市场力量的交互作用，对制定有效的创新和贸易政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态两国模型，包含寡头垄断企业进行研发投资，知识在在位企业和竞争性边缘企业之间流动。
AI.method: 使用中国和美国的匹配企业-专利数据，比较中国入世（贸易自由化）和2018年美国贸易战（贸易保护）两个相反贸易事件。
AI.findings: 1）贸易自由化期间关税降低促进创新，贸易保护期间关税增加抑制创新；2）知识溢出强度影响效应方向：中国溢出强度高的行业对自由化反应较弱，美国溢出强度高的行业在保护期间下降更大；3）市场份额大的企业在两种情况下都表现出更强的创新反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含知识溢出和市场力量的动态贸易-创新理论框架，解释了不同贸易政策下企业创新反应的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 校准反事实分析表明，适度的行业特定研发或竞争政策干预可以以最小财政成本抵消福利损失，为政策制定提供依据。

title: Financial Risk Assessment in Hospital Construction Projects in Turkey Using Monte Carlo Simulation: The Case of Adana City Hospital
affiliations: 8 Mai 1945 – Guelma University

detail.title: Financial Risk Assessment in Hospital Construction Projects in Turkey Using Monte Carlo Simulation: The Case of Adana City Hospital
detail.abstract: Healthcare infrastructure projects in emerging markets are highly exposed to macrofinancial risks, particularly exchange rate volatility and inflation, which threaten cost predictability and financial stability. This study evaluates the financial risk of the Adana City Hospital in Turkey, developed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, using a Monte Carlo simulation approach. The analysis employed 5,000 iterations in R, with triangular probability distributions for materials, labour, and miscellaneous costs, to capture cost variability under macroeconomic pressures. Results show total project costs ranging from 1,640 million TL to 1,966 million TL, with an expected mean of 1,773 million TL, indicating significant uncertainty in capital budgeting. Materials emerged as the most sensitive cost driver. The findings underscore the value of probabilistic modelling in improving budgeting accuracy, strengthening financial planning, and supporting risk management strategies for policymakers, investors, and project managers in Turkey and comparable emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用蒙特卡洛模拟评估土耳其阿达纳城市医院PPP项目的财务风险，发现项目总成本在16.4亿至19.66亿土耳其里拉之间波动，材料成本是最敏感的成本驱动因素，强调概率建模在提高预算准确性和风险管理中的价值。
AI.research_question: 在宏观经济压力下，土耳其阿达纳城市医院PPP项目的财务风险如何？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场的医疗基础设施项目高度暴露于宏观金融风险，特别是汇率波动和通货膨胀，威胁成本可预测性和财务稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共私营合作模式（PPP）、蒙特卡洛模拟、财务风险管理理论
AI.method: 使用R语言进行5,000次迭代的蒙特卡洛模拟，对材料、劳动力和杂项成本采用三角概率分布来捕捉宏观经济压力下的成本变异性
AI.findings: 项目总成本范围为16.4亿至19.66亿土耳其里拉，预期均值为17.73亿土耳其里拉，表明资本预算存在显著不确定性；材料成本是最敏感的成本驱动因素
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了概率建模在PPP项目财务风险评估中的有效性，为新兴市场基础设施项目的风险管理提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其及类似新兴经济体的政策制定者、投资者和项目经理提供了改进预算准确性、加强财务规划和风险管理策略的工具

title: The Fiat Dollar Standard: A Global Experiment in Monetary Destruction
affiliations: Afrindependent Institute

detail.title: The Fiat Dollar Standard: A Global Experiment in Monetary Destruction
detail.abstract: The fiat dollar standard, established in 1971 when the U.S. government unilaterally ended the dollar’s convertibility into gold, constitutes the first global experiment in fiat money. Far from a neutral technical arrangement, it is a system of systemic fraud and structural injustice. Built upon coercion, debt monetization, and inflationary credit creation, the fiat dollar standard redistributes wealth from the many to the few, corrodes social trust, destabilizes economies, and entrenches dependency, inequality, and dispossession worldwide. This paper refutes the fiat dollar system, exposing its unjust, uncivilized, and destructive nature. By contrasting the moral and economic implications of sound versus fiat money, the analysis reveals that fiat regimes institutionalize corruption and erode the conditions of human dignity and flourishing. It further demonstrates that the fiat dollar standard constitutes a structural crime against humanity, harming the majority while consolidating Western financial and political domination. The paper concludes that the restoration of honest money is essential for a truly stable, prosperous, and civilized social order.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了1971年建立的法定美元标准，认为这是一个系统性的欺诈和不公正体系，通过债务货币化和通胀信贷创造实现财富从多数人向少数人的再分配，侵蚀社会信任，加剧全球不平等和依赖。
AI.research_question: 法定美元标准如何构成系统性欺诈和结构性不公正？其对全球社会和经济秩序的破坏性影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 揭露法定美元标准作为首次全球法定货币实验的不公正本质，展示其对人类尊严和社会繁荣的侵蚀作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健全货币与法定货币的道德和经济对比分析，批判法定货币制度对腐败的制度化和人类尊严条件的侵蚀。
AI.method: 理论分析和对比研究，通过道德和经济视角分析法定美元标准的结构性特征。
AI.findings: 法定美元标准通过强制、债务货币化和通胀信贷创造，系统性转移财富、腐蚀社会信任、破坏经济稳定，并巩固西方金融政治霸权。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法定美元标准理论化为结构性反人类罪行，建立了健全货币与文明社会秩序之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为恢复诚实货币的必要性提供理论依据，推动对现有国际货币体系的根本性反思和改革。

title: Shrinkage Alignment in High-Dimensional Portfolios
affiliations: Yale School of Management and

detail.title: Shrinkage Alignment in High-Dimensional Portfolios
detail.abstract: We study how shrinkage affects portfolio efficiency when the number of assets approaches or exceeds the sample size. Standard methods, such as ridge, impose uniform shrinkage, treating all assets as ex-ante identical and creating inefficiency when profitability is heterogeneous. Empirically, this "one-size-fits-all" design produces a hump-shaped relationship between model complexity and out-of-sample Sharpe ratios: adding assets can paradoxically reduce performance. We introduce shrinkage alignment, showing that efficiency requires matching shrinkage strength to each asset's true profitability. Building on this insight, we propose Sharpe Ratio Shrinkage (SRS)-a data-driven approach that aligns shrinkage intensity with empirical Sharpe ratios. SRS outperforms conventional methods under profitability heterogeneity and restores the virtue of complexity in high-dimensional portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当资产数量接近或超过样本大小时，收缩方法如何影响投资组合效率。传统方法如岭回归采用统一收缩，将所有资产视为同质，在盈利能力异质时造成效率损失。作者提出收缩对齐理论，并开发了基于经验夏普比率的SRS方法，在盈利能力异质情况下优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 当资产数量接近或超过样本大小时，收缩方法如何影响投资组合效率？
AI.motivation: 传统收缩方法采用统一收缩强度，将所有资产视为同质，这在资产盈利能力存在异质性时会导致效率损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收缩对齐理论 - 效率要求将收缩强度与每个资产的真实盈利能力相匹配
AI.method: 提出夏普比率收缩(SRS)方法 - 一种数据驱动的方法，将收缩强度与经验夏普比率对齐
AI.findings: 传统"一刀切"设计在模型复杂度与样本外夏普比率之间产生驼峰形关系：增加资产可能反而降低表现；SRS方法在盈利能力异质情况下优于传统方法，并恢复了高维投资组合构建中复杂性的价值
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了收缩对齐理论框架，阐明了投资组合效率与收缩强度匹配的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了SRS方法，为高维投资组合构建提供了实用的数据驱动解决方案

title: The Paradox of Consensus: Why Quantity of Citations Cannot Validate Flawed Logic in Scientific Publishing
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: The Paradox of Consensus: Why Quantity of Citations Cannot Validate Flawed Logic in Scientific Publishing
detail.abstract: The persistence of demonstrably incorrect theories in mainstream scientific literature raises profound questions about the legitimacy of peer review systems and editorial gatekeeping. This commentary examines the case of impedance matching theory in microwave absorption, where thousands of contemporary publications share identical logical frameworks despite their collective foundation containing fundamental theoretical flaws. We argue that when the underlying logical structure supporting a theoretical position contains provable errors, the sheer volume of subsequent citations becomes evidence of systematic propagation rather than validation. The contemporary academic publishing ecosystem, by prioritizing consensus over rigorous theoretical examination, systematically suppresses paradigm-challenging research and creates conditions where demonstrably incorrect theories become institutionalized. This analysis reveals how peer review anonymity, editorial riskaversion toward consensus-challenging work, and the absence of accountability for erroneous gatekeeping decisions have collectively created a "dark age" of scientific publishing in which editorial and reviewer bias actively prevents the advancement of theoretical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了微波吸收领域中阻抗匹配理论的持续错误传播现象，指出尽管该理论存在根本性逻辑缺陷，但数千篇当代论文仍沿用相同错误框架，揭示了同行评审系统和编辑把关机制的系统性问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么在微波吸收领域中，存在根本性理论缺陷的阻抗匹配理论能够在主流科学文献中持续传播并被广泛接受？
AI.motivation: 观察到数千篇当代论文共享相同的错误逻辑框架，这引发了关于同行评审系统合法性和编辑把关机制的深刻质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学社会学和科学知识社会学理论，特别是关于科学共识形成、理论传播机制以及学术出版生态系统中的制度性偏见。
AI.method: 评论性分析，通过阻抗匹配理论这一具体案例，系统考察理论传播、同行评审和编辑决策的机制。
AI.findings: 当支持某个理论立场的基础逻辑结构包含可证明的错误时，大量后续引用反而成为系统性传播而非验证的证据；当代学术出版生态系统优先考虑共识而非严谨的理论检验，系统性地压制挑战范式的研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了同行评审匿名性、编辑对挑战共识工作的风险规避以及错误把关决策缺乏问责等机制如何共同创造了科学出版的"黑暗时代"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改革学术出版系统提供了理论依据，呼吁建立更严格的问责机制和更开放的理论挑战环境，以防止类似的理论错误制度化现象。

title: Economics and Politics Sculpting the Colombian Economy: the Case of National Accounts
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Colombia

detail.title: Economics and Politics Sculpting the Colombian Economy: the Case of National Accounts
detail.abstract: History is a non-linear process, full of contingent events that set the conditions which brought us, and our institutions, to where we are today. This paper examines two possible conditions in Colombia that may have influenced the creation of the National Administrative Department of Statistics: a concentrated centralist political power and a growing participation of economists in state positions. This work provides a historical and theoretical framework grounded on Alain Desrosières' analysis of the implication of an autocratic political power and the need for national accounts on the interaction of economists with the real world, based on abstract concepts. Likewise, I examine some historical events in the light of Desrosières' analysis that occurred in the early years of Colombia's National Administrative Department of Statistics, specifically, the '50s and '60s decades. This paper concludes that both a concentrated centralist political power and a growing economists' enrollment in positions of power may have served as conditions fostering the appearance of the department in charge of the Colombian national accounts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了哥伦比亚国家统计局成立的两个可能条件：集中的中央集权政治权力和经济学专家在政府职位中日益增长的参与度，基于Alain Desrosières的理论框架分析历史事件，发现这两个条件可能共同促进了该机构的出现。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚国家统计局成立的两个可能条件是什么？集中的中央集权政治权力和经济学专家在政府职位中日益增长的参与度如何影响该机构的出现？
AI.motivation: 历史是一个非线性过程，充满偶然事件，这些事件设定了将我们和我们的制度带到今天的条件。需要理解特定历史条件下统计机构的形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Alain Desrosières的理论框架，分析专制政治权力和国家账户需求对经济学家与现实世界互动的影响，以及基于抽象概念的经济学实践。
AI.method: 历史分析方法和理论框架应用，具体考察哥伦比亚国家统计局在1950年代和1960年代早期的历史事件。
AI.findings: 集中的中央集权政治权力和经济学专家在权力职位中日益增长的参与度可能共同促进了哥伦比亚国家统计局的出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了Desrosières关于政治权力与统计机构形成关系的理论框架在哥伦比亚案例中的应用，深化了对统计机构历史形成机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解哥伦比亚统计体系的发展提供了历史视角，对当代统计机构建设和改革具有参考价值。
