title: How did Sri Lanka overperformed the IMF program targets on tax reveue and primary surplus in post default era ?
affiliations: University of Colombo

detail.title: How did Sri Lanka overperformed the IMF program targets on tax reveue and primary surplus in post default era ?

publicationDetails.detailsText: CA Sri Lanka Tax Journal, 2025, Volume 1, Issue 1

detail.abstract:
This paper investigates Sri Lanka’s exceptional revenue overperformance under the
post-2022 IMF programme, in the context of its worst economic crisis and sovereign
default in post-independence history. While the country historically struggled to meet
IMF revenue and primary balance targets, recent fiscal gains were largely driven by
tax rate and tax base changes, particularly to VAT and income tax—rather than
administrative improvements. The 2022 crisis created a political window for
implementing unpopular, yet critical, tax reforms. Unlike in past episodes, such as
the 2019 rollback under Gotabaya Rajapaksa, these reforms persisted through the
2024 change in government. We argue that three political dynamics shaped this
continuity: (1) the dominance of pro-IMF factions in Parliament, driven by the need of
IMF to sustain economic stability, thus creating political gains; (2) the economic
fragility that discouraged the successive governments from reversing reforms, even
amid ideological contradictions; and (3) the post-default public recalibration that
valued macroeconomic stability over tax concessions. Nevertheless, while policy
adjustments helped exceed short-term revenue targets, the absence of
corresponding institutional reforms—such as tax administration
strengthening—raises concerns about long-term sustainability. Attempts to introduce
more progressive reforms, like a wealth tax, have faltered, highlighting the fragility of
these gains. The paper concludes that fiscal resilience requires not only bold policy
changes during crises but also consistent administrative reforms to sustain revenue
performance and avoid the reversals seen in Sri Lanka’s past.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了斯里兰卡在2022年后IMF计划下财政收入表现超常的现象，发现这主要源于税率和税基改革而非行政改善。经济危机创造了实施不受欢迎但关键税收改革的政治窗口，三个政治动态确保了改革的连续性。但缺乏相应的制度性改革引发了长期可持续性担忧。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡在2022年后IMF计划下财政收入表现超常的原因是什么？为何此次税收改革能够持续而不像过去那样被逆转？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡经历了独立后最严重的经济危机和主权违约，但在此背景下却实现了IMF财政收入目标的超常表现，这与该国历史上难以达成IMF目标形成鲜明对比，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治机会窗口理论、政策连续性理论、危机驱动改革理论
AI.method: 案例分析，比较历史分析，政策过程分析
AI.findings: 1）财政收入超常表现主要来自税率和税基改革；2）经济危机创造了实施关键税收改革的政治窗口；3）三个政治动态确保了改革连续性：亲IMF派系主导、经济脆弱性抑制改革逆转、公众对宏观经济稳定的重新重视
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对危机时期政策改革持续性的理解，提出了确保改革连续性的政治动态框架，丰富了发展中国家财政改革可持续性的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似挑战的发展中国家提供了政策启示：危机时期是推进关键改革的机遇，但需要配套的制度性改革来确保长期可持续性，避免改革逆转。

title: The Role of Green Financing and Technological Innovation in Enhancing Corporate Environmental Performance Among Manufacturing Companies in India
affiliations: Department of Management Studies, Islamic University of Science and Technology and Islamic University of Science and Technology

detail.title: The Role of Green Financing and Technological Innovation in Enhancing Corporate Environmental Performance Among Manufacturing Companies in India

declarations.ethicsApproval: no ethical approval required

detail.abstract: Article type: Research Article This study examines the relationship between technological innovation, green financing, and environmental performance in Indian manufacturing companies. While green finance and technological innovation are found to be good for the environment, their direct impact on the environmental performance of companies requires further investigation. Using the partial linear scale model of structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), this research assesses these effects and their interactions. The findings indicated that technological innovation significantly improves environmental performance and contributes to overall corporate success. Green financing, which includes environmental, financial, and social aspects, also has a positive impact on environmental performance. However, the economic factors do not exert a significant impact. The study presents empirical evidence of the interaction between green finance and technological innovation, offering valuable insights for policymakers and industry leaders within the Indian manufacturing sector. The findings can aid in formulating effective strategies for integrating green finance and technological innovation, thereby driving sustainable business practices and promoting environmentally responsible business models for long-term success.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度制造业企业中技术创新、绿色金融与环境绩效之间的关系。研究发现技术创新显著改善环境绩效并促进企业成功，绿色金融（环境、金融和社会维度）也对环境绩效有积极影响，但经济因素影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 技术创新、绿色金融与环境绩效之间存在怎样的关系？它们如何影响印度制造业企业的环境表现？
AI.motivation: 虽然绿色金融和技术创新被认为对环境有益，但它们对企业环境绩效的直接影响需要进一步研究验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色金融理论和技术创新理论，构建了绿色金融（环境、金融、社会、经济维度）、技术创新与环境绩效的关系框架。
AI.method: 采用结构方程建模中的偏最小二乘法（PLS-SEM）分析模型。
AI.findings: 1. 技术创新显著改善环境绩效并促进企业成功；2. 绿色金融的环境、金融和社会维度对环境绩效有积极影响；3. 经济因素对环境绩效影响不显著；4. 绿色金融与技术创新存在交互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了绿色金融与技术创新交互作用的实证证据，丰富了可持续发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业领导者制定整合绿色金融与技术创新的有效策略提供参考，推动可持续商业实践和环境责任商业模式。

title: Financialization and the Structure of Production
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Financialization and the Structure of Production
detail.abstract: In this article I present more results around the equilibrium model of capitalist spending and the structure of production developed in Mahoney (2024a, 2025). I introduce an explicit distinction between the number of stages of production, and the (temporal) length of production. These two very different aspects of roundaboutness are, almost without exception, conflated in the Austrian literature: adding more stages of production is considered equivalent to making production longer. This is not in general true and has ironically led to mischaracterizations of capitalism by Austrians. In particular, the savings rate is a misleading metric because it does not adequately distinguish between the (finite) time horizon over which all production takes place and the number of stages of production (which can be arbitrarily large). The savings rate simply reflects the (relative) number of capital transactions, which under capitalist modes of production are necessarily a large proportion of all spending. I put forth an alternative metric, akin to Böhm Bawerk’s average period of production (APP), that depends non-trivially on the number of stages, and I reexamine Hülsmann’s (2008, 2010) revisionist work on the structure of production. Financialization, far from being a defect of capitalism, is integral to the operation of the system.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了生产阶段数量与生产时间长度这两个不同的迂回生产概念，指出奥地利学派文献中普遍混淆这两者。作者提出了类似平均生产期的新指标，重新审视了Hülsmann关于生产结构的修正主义研究，并认为金融化是资本主义系统运作的组成部分而非缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何正确区分生产阶段数量与生产时间长度这两个不同的迂回生产概念？
AI.motivation: 奥地利学派文献中普遍混淆生产阶段数量与生产时间长度，导致对资本主义的误解，特别是储蓄率作为误导性指标的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Mahoney (2024a, 2025)发展的资本主义支出均衡模型和生产结构理论，借鉴Böhm Bawerk的平均生产期概念。
AI.method: 理论分析和概念区分，重新审视现有文献特别是Hülsmann (2008, 2010)的修正主义研究。
AI.findings: 生产阶段数量与生产时间长度是不同的概念，储蓄率是误导性指标，金融化是资本主义系统的必要组成部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确区分了迂回生产的两个维度，提出了新的生产结构度量指标，修正了奥地利学派对资本主义的误解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解资本主义生产结构和金融化的作用提供了新的分析框架，有助于更准确地评估经济政策效果。

title: Displaced by Climate: Navigating Land Rights, Social Justice, and Equitable Solutions for Affected Communities
affiliations: Mount Kenya University-Lecturer

detail.title: Displaced by Climate: Navigating Land Rights, Social Justice, and Equitable Solutions for Affected Communities
detail.abstract: Displaced by Climate: Navigating Land Rights, Social Justice, and Equitable Solutions for Affected Communities examines the intersection between climate-induced displacement, land tenure systems, and the pursuit of social justice in vulnerable regions. As extreme weather events and environmental degradation intensify, communities are increasingly uprooted, exposing critical legal and policy gaps in the protection of their land rights and livelihoods. This study interrogates the adequacy of existing legal frameworks governing land access, restitution, and resettlement, while highlighting the disproportionate impact on marginalized groups such as women, indigenous peoples, and pastoral communities. Through a multidisciplinary lens combining legal analysis, human rights discourse, and environmental governance, the paper advocates for equitable and rights-based approaches that ensure climate justice and sustainable solutions for displaced population.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨气候变化导致的人口流离失所与土地权利、社会正义的交叉问题，分析现有法律框架的不足，并倡导基于权利的气候公正解决方案。
AI.research_question: 现有法律框架在保护气候变化导致的流离失所人群的土地权利方面是否充分？如何实现气候公正和社会正义？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件和环境退化加剧导致社区流离失所，暴露出土地权利保护方面的法律和政策空白，特别是对边缘群体的影响更为严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合法律分析、人权话语和环境治理的多学科理论框架，重点关注土地权属制度、社会正义理论和气候公正原则。
AI.method: 采用多学科研究方法，包括法律框架分析、人权评估和环境治理政策研究。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架在保护流离失所人群土地权利方面存在显著不足，边缘群体（女性、原住民、牧民社区）受到不成比例的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了气候变化、土地权利和社会正义交叉领域的理论框架，丰富了气候公正和人权保护的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于权利的解决方案建议，促进更公平的土地获取、赔偿和重新安置政策，确保可持续的气候适应措施。

title: Advanced AI Systems Challenging the Social Contract: Reframing the debate
affiliations: University of Oslo - Department of Informatics

detail.title: Advanced AI Systems Challenging the Social Contract: Reframing the debate
detail.abstract: Recent calls for an "AGI social contract" tie socioeconomic and political risks to a speculative notion of artificial general intelligence. This framing is counterproductive. By focusing on AGI, it obscures how contemporary, advanced AI already strains core conditions of social contract legitimacy. Using a Hobbesian framework, I discuss how a number of present-day stress pathways-such as inequality and labor displacement, power concentration and democratic erosion, security dilemmas, and environmental externalities-each represent and follow known routes to instability known to social contract theory. The analysis gives rise to the development of institutional responses compatible with social contract principles: redistribution and bargaining supports, compute and capability governance, media and information safeguards, and risk-specific security regimes. Reframing the debate in these terms redirects attention from hypothetical futures to actionable governance challenges today.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了"AGI社会契约"的讨论框架，认为这种关注未来通用人工智能的做法掩盖了当前先进AI对社会契约合法性的实际威胁。作者运用霍布斯理论框架，分析了当代AI在收入不平等、权力集中、安全困境和环境外部性等方面对社会稳定的影响，并提出了符合社会契约原则的制度应对方案。
AI.research_question: 当代先进AI如何威胁社会契约的合法性条件？以及如何基于社会契约理论构建相应的制度应对方案？
AI.motivation: 当前关于"AGI社会契约"的讨论过于关注未来假设性的通用人工智能风险，而忽视了当代先进AI已经对社会契约核心条件造成的实际压力。这种框架转移了人们对当前可治理挑战的注意力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霍布斯社会契约理论框架，分析AI对社会契约合法性条件的威胁路径
AI.method: 理论分析框架，运用社会契约理论识别当代AI对社会稳定的威胁路径
AI.findings: 当代AI通过四个主要路径威胁社会契约：1）不平等和劳动力替代；2）权力集中和民主侵蚀；3）安全困境；4）环境外部性。这些路径都遵循社会契约理论已知的不稳定机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理讨论从未来假设的AGI风险重新定位到当代实际威胁，为社会契约理论在数字时代的应用提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四类制度应对方案：1）再分配和谈判支持；2）算力和能力治理；3）媒体和信息保障；4）风险特定安全机制

title: Currency Deliverability and Pro-Cyclical Capital Flows

detail.title: Currency Deliverability and Pro-Cyclical Capital Flows
detail.abstract: Why do some emerging economies remain vulnerable to procyclical capital flows despite capital-account liberalization? This paper argues that currency deliverability-the ability of a currency to circulate and serve as collateral offshore-determines whether openness stabilizes or destabilizes financial systems. When currencies are deliverable, domestic and foreign banks can engage in long-term cross-currency swaps that hedge foreign-currency borrowing, generating hedging regimes in which the cross-currency-swap basis is positive, exchange rates and interest-rate differentials move together, and crises remain contained. When currencies are non-deliverable, only short-term funding swaps are feasible, transferring currency risk mainly to domestic non-financial firms and producing funding regimes characterized by negative bases, negative exchange-rate-yield correlations, and recurrent sudden stops. Comparing Australia's deliverable dollar and Korea's non-deliverable won during 2001-2017, we find the well-known signs of their bases and opposite correlation patterns (+0.71 versus-0.72), along with contrasting behaviors during the 2008 crisis. Cross-sectional evidence across 14 currencies is consistent with these findings: deeper cross-currency-swap markets predict more stable bases during global stress. The results imply that partial liberalization without deliverability attracts short-term inflows while blocking long-term hedging. For investment-grade economies with open capital accounts, full currency deliverability is therefore a necessary-though institutionally demanding-step toward durable financial maturity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出货币可交割性（currency deliverability）是决定资本账户开放能否稳定金融体系的关键因素。可交割货币允许长期跨货币互换对冲外汇借款风险，形成对冲机制；不可交割货币只能进行短期融资互换，将汇率风险转移给国内非金融企业，导致融资机制和频繁的资本突然停止。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些新兴经济体在资本账户自由化后仍然容易受到顺周期资本流动的影响？
AI.motivation: 解释新兴经济体在资本账户开放后仍面临金融不稳定的现象，特别是资本流动的顺周期性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币可交割性理论，区分可交割货币和不可交割货币对金融稳定的不同影响机制。
AI.method: 案例比较分析（澳大利亚澳元vs韩国韩元，2001-2017年），以及14种货币的横截面数据分析。
AI.findings: 可交割货币（如澳元）显示正基差和正汇率-利率相关性（+0.71），而不可交割货币（如韩元）显示负基差和负相关性（-0.72）；跨货币互换市场深度预测全球压力期间基差的稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了货币可交割性作为解释资本流动稳定性的新理论框架，区分了对冲机制和融资机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资级经济体提供了政策建议：在资本账户开放基础上，实现完全货币可交割性是实现持久金融成熟的必要步骤。

title: Determinants of Livelihood Strategies Among Informal Food Traders in the Post-COVID-19 Pandemic Context: A South African Case Study
affiliations: University of Limpopo, University of Limpopo and University of Limpopo

detail.title: Determinants of Livelihood Strategies Among Informal Food Traders in the Post-COVID-19 Pandemic Context: A South African Case Study

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (12) , 253-276, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: This study investigated the determinants of livelihood strategies adopted by informal food traders in Polokwane Local Municipality, South Africa, to cope with the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. Primary data were collected through structured face-to-face interviews with 120 purposively sampled traders. The descriptive analysis revealed that most traders (51.7%) maintained "food trading only" as their primary livelihood strategy, while 31.7% adopted the "food trading + non-food trading" strategy, followed by 16.7% who adopted the "food trading + non-trading" (16.7%) strategy. Notably, none of the traders reported pursuing the most diversified strategy, which combines "food trading + non-food trading + non-trading." The results of the multinomial logistic (MNL) model identified several significant factors influencing the adoption of livelihood strategies. Gender, age, trading experience, shelter, government support, and supply shortages were associated with a decreased likelihood of adopting a more diversified livelihood strategy. Conversely, higher education levels, marital status, household income, a trading area, mode of transport, and possession of trading licenses were positively associated with the likelihood of adopting a more diversified livelihood strategy. Therefore, policy interventions should focus on improving access to education, infrastructure, and financial support while ensuring a more streamlined and supportive process for obtaining trading licenses. Addressing supply chain challenges and providing targeted assistance to vulnerable groups, including women and older traders, can promote resilience and economic sustainability post-COVID-19.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了南非波洛克瓦尼市非正式食品贸易商在COVID-19疫情后采取的生计策略决定因素。研究发现，大多数贸易商（51.7%）维持单一食品贸易策略，31.7%采用食品+非食品贸易组合，16.7%采用食品贸易+非贸易活动组合。多项逻辑回归模型显示，性别、年龄、贸易经验等因素与采用更分散化生计策略的可能性呈负相关，而教育水平、婚姻状况、家庭收入等因素则呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 南非波洛克瓦尼市非正式食品贸易商在COVID-19疫情后采取的生计策略的决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解非正式食品贸易商在疫情后如何调整生计策略，为政策干预提供依据，促进经济韧性和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生计策略理论、多元化生计框架、非正式经济理论
AI.method: 通过结构化面对面访谈收集120名目的性抽样贸易商的主要数据，使用描述性分析和多项逻辑回归模型
AI.findings: 大多数贸易商（51.7%）维持单一食品贸易策略；教育水平、婚姻状况、家庭收入等因素与采用更分散化生计策略呈正相关；性别、年龄、贸易经验等因素与采用更分散化生计策略呈负相关
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了非正式经济中生计策略决定因素的理论理解，特别是在疫情冲击背景下
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体建议：改善教育机会、基础设施和金融支持，简化贸易许可证获取流程，解决供应链挑战，为弱势群体提供针对性援助

title: Resilience through storage. European gas security in the 2022–2023 crisis and beyond
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics

detail.title: Resilience through storage. European gas security in the 2022–2023 crisis and beyond

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the research project under the Potencjał Program, No. 027/EEE/2025/POT.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the durability of European gas storage amid the 2022-2023 energy crisis and its subsequent effects. It looks at how storage practices changed during three phases: before the crisis, during the crisis, and after the crisis. It uses monthly data from 27 countries from 2020 to 2025. The results support three main hypotheses. First, national strategies differed greatly, creating three strong groups-"hoarders," "maintainers," and "reducers"-that lasted long after the crisis. Second, vulnerability affected how countries reacted: those that relied more on imports built up their reserves more quickly, turning structural weakness into a strength. Third, the crisis messed up the usual seasonal cycles, with injections happening earlier and withdrawals happening more sharply. By 2024, this will have led to a new equilibrium at higher baseline levels. Complementary findings indicate that elevated capacity-to-consumption ratios diminished volatility, cross-border spillovers were significant, and EU storage mandates successfully stabilized expectations. The crisis had high costs, but it also led to institutional learning, which made emergency measures a part of long-term governance. These findings show that resilience in European gas storage should not be seen as a temporary change due to war, but as part of a longterm change in energy security that other regions that rely on imports can learn from.

AI.tldr: 欧洲天然气储存在2022-2023年能源危机期间展现出持久韧性，形成了三种国家策略类型，危机改变了季节性模式并建立了新的更高基准水平，体现了能源安全体系的长期转型。
AI.research_question: 欧洲天然气储存在2022-2023年能源危机期间的持久性如何？危机如何改变了存储实践和季节性模式？
AI.motivation: 研究欧洲天然气储存在极端危机条件下的适应能力和长期变化，为依赖进口能源的地区提供经验借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源安全理论、危机应对理论、制度学习理论、跨境溢出效应理论
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年27个国家的月度数据，分析危机前、中、后三个阶段的存储实践变化
AI.findings: 1) 形成三种持久性国家策略类型；2) 脆弱性国家更快建立储备；3) 危机扰乱季节性周期；4) 2024年达到新的更高基准水平；5) 容量消费比降低波动性；6) 跨境溢出效应显著；7) 欧盟存储指令稳定预期
AI.theory_contributions: 将危机应对从临时措施发展为长期治理框架，提出能源安全韧性作为长期转型而非临时调整的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为依赖能源进口地区提供危机应对策略，证明制度学习能够将紧急措施转化为长期治理工具，指导能源安全政策制定

title: Hurdles and paternalism: the long way to overcome discrimination and sub-representation of hispanics and afro-americans in economics. An analysis for the United States between 1995-2019
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Colombia

detail.title: Hurdles and paternalism: the long way to overcome discrimination and sub-representation of hispanics and afro-americans in economics. An analysis for the United States between 1995-2019
detail.abstract: The debate on whether there is racial exclusion in economics is open. There is a strong contrast between the position of those who consider that there is still discrimination in the field and those who believe that this phenomenon has disappeared (or became insignificant) in recent decades. This document analyzes the evolution and change in the dynamics related to the representation of Afro-American and Hispanic minorities in economics within the US postsecondary educational system from 1995 to 2019. I present data from the National Center for Education Statistics (2020) and show that there is not only a low representation of Hispanic and Afro-American people in degrees awarded at post-secondary institutions but negligible employment of these groups within leading academic institutions. I evaluate some of the possible reasons for the persistence of socioeconomic barriers, like discrimination, exclusion, and self-isolation attitudes, that block academic and professional advancement in the discipline for these minorities. The analysis is important for economists outside the US due to two factors: the "Americanization" of economics and the influence of the US top centers over the curriculum of other institutions around the world.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1995-2019年间美国高等教育系统中非裔和西班牙裔少数族裔在经济学领域的代表性演变，发现这些群体在学位授予和顶尖学术机构就业方面存在严重不足，并探讨了歧视、排斥等社会经济障碍的持续原因。
AI.research_question: 美国高等教育系统中非裔和西班牙裔少数族裔在经济学领域的代表性如何演变？导致这些群体在学术和职业发展中持续面临障碍的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 关于经济学领域是否存在种族排斥的争议持续存在，需要实证数据来澄清这一现象的程度和原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于种族歧视理论、社会排斥理论和职业发展障碍理论。
AI.method: 使用美国国家教育统计中心（2020）的数据进行纵向分析，涵盖1995-2019年期间。
AI.findings: 非裔和西班牙裔群体在经济学学位授予和顶尖学术机构就业方面代表性极低，社会经济障碍（如歧视、排斥、自我隔离态度）持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济学领域的种族代表性研究提供了实证证据，深化了对系统性障碍的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国经济学教育体系的代表性不平等问题，对全球经济学教育具有警示意义，因为美国经济学模式对全球课程设置具有重要影响。

title: Poland and Selected EU Countries (2015-2024): Evolution and Determinants of the Household Electricity Price Gap
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics

detail.title: Poland and Selected EU Countries (2015-2024): Evolution and Determinants of the Household Electricity Price Gap
detail.abstract: This study documents and explains the evolution of the Poland-EU selected household electricity price gap across selected Member States (with EU selected aggregate used as a benchmark) over 2015-2024 using Eurostat semi-annual prices (band DC, EUR/kWh, taxes included) and credible cost, structure and policy covariates. Descriptively, the gap widened during the 2022 shock, peaked in H2-2022, and narrowed by H2-2024. Fixed-effects models (country and period) are estimated, integrating supply-side structure (generation-mix shares), cost proxies (wholesale/TTF and ETS with lags), taxes/levies and binary policy flags for Poland's shields and VAT changes in 2022-2024. Robustness covers net prices and PPS, alternative cost metrics and lag structures, and an event-study design. Findings support a policy mix that preserves pass-through discipline while cushioning exceptional shocks, and call for transparent tax/levy reporting to benchmark convergence within the EU. A balanced seven-unit panel (Poland, EU selected, and its five constituents) is analysed at semi-annual frequency (H1/H2) over 2016-S1 to 2024-S2, yielding N = 126 observations post-lags.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2015-2024年波兰与欧盟选定成员国之间的家庭电价差距演变，发现该差距在2022年能源危机期间扩大，在2022年下半年达到峰值，到2024年下半年收窄。研究使用固定效应模型识别了影响电价差距的关键因素，包括供应结构、成本代理变量、税收/征费和政策干预。
AI.research_question: 波兰与欧盟选定成员国之间的家庭电价差距如何演变？哪些因素解释了这种差距的变化？
AI.motivation: 理解欧盟内部电价差距的动态变化，特别是在能源危机和政策干预背景下，为欧盟能源市场一体化和政策协调提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源经济学和价格传导理论，分析供应结构、成本因素、税收政策和监管干预对电价差距的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用固定效应模型（国家和时间固定效应），分析平衡的七单元面板数据（波兰、欧盟选定及其五个成员国），涵盖2016年上半年至2024年下半年，共126个观测值。
AI.findings: 电价差距在2022年能源危机期间扩大，2022年下半年达到峰值，随后到2024年下半年收窄。政策干预（如波兰的防护盾和增值税变化）对缓解冲击有显著作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对能源危机期间价格传导机制和政策干预效果的理解，为欧盟能源市场一体化理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了管理能源价格冲击的策略建议，强调在保持价格传导纪律的同时缓冲异常冲击，并呼吁提高税收/征费透明度以促进欧盟内部趋同。

title: EVALUATION OF THE RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE OF THE TAX APPEAL TRIBUNAL IN NIGERIA
affiliations: VC Aniako & Partners, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: EVALUATION OF THE RULES OF PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE OF THE TAX APPEAL TRIBUNAL IN NIGERIA
detail.abstract: An analysis of the Tax Appeal Tribunal's jurisdiction in Nigeria underscores ongoing efforts to expedite the resolution of tax disputes. This initiative aims to alleviate the delays commonly encountered in traditional courts, which are often hindered by procedural technicalities, frequent adjournments, congested dockets, and a rigid approach to justice. As tax disputes pertain to revenue collection, prompt and effective resolution is vital for both tax authorities and taxpayers. Nonetheless, the intricate and often inaccessible rules governing the Tribunal may undermine fair outcomes, particularly when inconsistent application across cases or regions engenders uncertainty. Taxpayers and their representatives often lack sufficient knowledge of Tribunal procedures, leading to improper filings or missed appeals. There are also concerns about the independence and impartiality of tribunal members, especially in cases involving government agencies, which can erode public confidence. These challenges highlight the need to review and enhance the tribunal's rules of practice and procedure. This article examined the rules established by the Tax Appeal Tribunal (Procedure) Rules, 2021, which underpin the dispute-resolution framework under the 2025 tax reforms. It evaluated their efficacy in ensuring the equitable and expeditious resolution of tax disputes, analyzed stakeholders' difficulties in complying with these rules, and proposed recommendations to refine the tribunal's practice and procedural regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚税务上诉法庭的管辖权，评估了2021年税务上诉法庭程序规则在确保税务争议公平快速解决方面的有效性，并提出了改进建议。
AI.research_question: 2021年税务上诉法庭程序规则在确保税务争议公平快速解决方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 传统法院处理税务争议存在程序繁琐、频繁休庭、案件积压等问题，而税务上诉法庭旨在加快争议解决，但其复杂的规则可能影响公平结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税务争议解决理论、程序公正理论、司法效率理论
AI.method: 对2021年税务上诉法庭程序规则进行文本分析，评估其有效性并分析利益相关者遵守规则的困难
AI.findings: 税务上诉法庭规则存在复杂性、可及性不足、适用不一致等问题，纳税人缺乏程序知识导致不当申请或错过上诉，法庭成员的独立性和公正性也受到质疑
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税务争议解决机制程序规则有效性的理论理解，提出了程序规则设计对司法公正和效率的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进税务上诉法庭的实践和程序规则提供了具体建议，有助于提高税务争议解决的效率和公平性

title: Computer modelling the management of innovation: Corporate performance, innovations and the managers' dilemma
affiliations: Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration and Kingston University

detail.title: Computer modelling the management of innovation: Corporate performance, innovations and the managers' dilemma

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: Managing innovation for corporate benefit is a highly complex topic. Flat matrix organizations are more innovative compared to hierarchical firms because of the higher rate of leveraging innovations into performance. However innovations can fail or may be unsuitable for organizations, harming the organization. To this model we add the simplest form of hierarchy, one manager who makes decisions about implementing innovations by flipping a coin, thus halving the loss compared to the flat organization. Modelling shows that, unless special conditions apply, a hierarchy is the only possible form for growing organizations.  However if special conditions do apply, a stable flat "oasis" can be reached at size >200 employees; the special condition is that the level of competence of the employees resembles that of the managers.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过建模分析发现，在大多数情况下，层级结构是组织成长的唯一可行形式，但特殊条件下（员工能力与管理者相当）可以在200人以上规模形成稳定的扁平矩阵组织。
AI.research_question: 在创新管理中，层级结构和扁平矩阵组织哪种形式更有利于组织发展？
AI.motivation: 管理创新对企业利益至关重要，但创新可能失败或不适合组织，从而损害组织。需要研究不同组织结构对创新管理的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织理论、创新管理理论、决策理论
AI.method: 数学建模方法，通过比较扁平矩阵组织和简单层级结构（一个管理者通过抛硬币决策）的创新管理效果
AI.findings: 扁平矩阵组织创新性更高但损失更大；简单层级结构（一个管理者）可将损失减半；除非特殊条件，层级结构是组织成长的唯一形式；特殊条件下（员工能力与管理者相当）可在200人以上规模形成稳定扁平组织
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了组织创新管理的理论模型，揭示了员工能力与管理者能力匹配对组织结构稳定性的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在不同发展阶段选择组织结构提供指导，特别强调了员工能力发展对维持扁平组织的重要性

title: Corruption Perceptions, The Pendleton Act, and Sovereign Borrowing Costs
affiliations: and

detail.title: Corruption Perceptions, The Pendleton Act, and Sovereign Borrowing Costs
detail.abstract: A large body of literature has evaluated the relationship between bureaucratic selection processes and corruption. Much of this work suggest that systems of patronage tend to promote bureaucratic corruption and nepotism, generally to the detriment of the provision of publicly provided goods. However, much less work has been done to consider how market actors perceive such selection processes and especially reforms that jurisdictions implement to minimize any corruption stemming from bureaucratic selection. This study rectifies this by evaluating how the Pendleton Civil Service Reform Act (a piece of US federal legislation that curbed the system of patronage and attempted to promote bureaucratic efficiency) impacted federal borrowing costs. To the extent that patronage resulted in increased corruption, nepotism, and bureaucratic inefficiency this should be reflected in relatively higher bond yields. If the Pendleton Act was successful in curbing this behavior, then this should be rewarded by market actors in the form of lower yields. Using interrupted time series analysis with and without control, we find that passage of the Pendleton Act did, in fact, result in lower borrowing costs for the federal government of between 63 and 84 basis points depending on specification. Implications are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究彭德尔顿公务员改革法案对美国联邦政府借贷成本的影响，发现该改革降低了63-84个基点的借贷成本，表明市场对减少官僚腐败的改革持积极态度。
AI.research_question: 彭德尔顿公务员改革法案如何影响美国联邦政府的借贷成本？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注官僚选拔过程与腐败的关系，但缺乏对市场参与者如何看待此类选拔过程及改革的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于官僚腐败与市场反应理论，假设减少腐败的官僚改革会被市场奖励，表现为更低的借贷成本。
AI.method: 采用中断时间序列分析（有控制组和无控制组）来评估改革前后的借贷成本变化。
AI.findings: 彭德尔顿法案的实施使联邦政府借贷成本降低了63-84个基点，具体取决于模型设定。
AI.theory_contributions: 为官僚改革与市场反应之间的关系提供了实证证据，扩展了官僚腐败理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于官僚改革经济收益的量化证据，支持反腐败改革的经济价值。

title: From Political Economy to Economics: How Statistics, Graphs, and the State Forged Twentieth Century Economics
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Colombia

detail.title: From Political Economy to Economics: How Statistics, Graphs, and the State Forged Twentieth Century Economics
detail.abstract: The purpose of this essay is to present not only the entrance but also the effect Statistics had upon the consolidation of Economics and its further influence in state intervention. The traditional method of Political Economy in the late nineteenth century disregarded Statistics as a valid approach to acquire economic knowledge. This paradigm was changed, amongst others, by the American Wesley C. Mitchell and the Englishman William Stanley Jevons, who used graphs and statistics as part of the "economic toolset" for research for causal relationships. Furthermore, Statistics only entered state intervention and planning after mayor crises (the World Wars and the Great Depression) forced states to play an active role in the economy. This essay will focus on the experience of the United States and the United Kingdom on these matters.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了统计学如何进入经济学领域并影响国家干预，重点分析美国与英国经验，指出统计学在19世纪末被传统政治经济学忽视，后经Mitchell和Jevons等人引入，并在世界大战和大萧条等危机后成为国家干预的重要工具。
AI.research_question: 统计学如何进入经济学领域并影响国家干预政策的形成？
AI.motivation: 传统政治经济学在19世纪末忽视统计学作为获取经济知识的有效方法，需要探讨统计学如何改变这一范式并影响国家干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、计量经济学、国家干预理论
AI.method: 历史分析法和案例研究法，聚焦美国和英国的经验
AI.findings: 统计学最初被传统政治经济学忽视，后经Mitchell和Jevons等学者引入经济学研究；统计学进入国家干预领域是在世界大战和大萧条等重大危机迫使国家在经济中扮演积极角色之后。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了统计学从被忽视到成为经济学核心工具的转变过程，阐明了危机在推动统计学应用于国家干预中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现代经济政策制定中统计工具的应用提供了历史视角，对当前经济危机应对政策具有借鉴意义。

title: From Competition to Collaboration: Integrating 2025's Leading LLMs -ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and DeepSeek -Through a Sequential Multi-Model Workflow Framework (S-MMWF)
affiliations: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) - School of Management Studies and Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT)

detail.title: From Competition to Collaboration: Integrating 2025's Leading LLMs -ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and DeepSeek -Through a Sequential Multi-Model Workflow Framework (S-MMWF)
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence development in 2025 reflects a strategic pivot from competitive singularity toward integrated collaborative architectures. This study introduces the Sequential Multi-Model Workflow Framework (S-MMWF), coordinating six leading AI systems-ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and DeepSeek-according to their specialized functional strengths. Based on contemporary performance benchmarking, the framework assigns sequential roles: ChatGPT-5 for conceptual structuring and ideation, Claude 4.5 for analytical expansion, reasoning and citation, Gemini 2.5 for multimodal visualization, Perplexity AI for factual verification, Grok-4 for real-time contextual analysis, and DeepSeek V3.1 for computational validation. This approach transitions from isolated model evaluation toward orchestrated interoperability. Results demonstrate that taskspecific multi-model integration outperforms single-system deployment in complex workflows. Future directions include automated coordination platforms, energy-efficient protocols, and comprehensive ethical frameworks for integrated AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了顺序多模型工作流框架(S-MMWF)，通过协调ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity、Grok和DeepSeek六个AI系统的专业功能优势，实现从竞争性单点向集成协作架构的战略转变。结果表明，在复杂工作流中，任务特定的多模型集成优于单系统部署。
AI.research_question: 如何通过协调多个AI系统的专业功能优势来提升复杂工作流的性能？
AI.motivation: 从孤立的模型评估转向协调互操作性，解决单一AI系统在复杂任务中的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成协作架构理论、AI系统功能专业化理论、工作流协调理论
AI.method: 基于当代性能基准测试，为六个领先AI系统分配顺序角色：ChatGPT-5用于概念构建和构思，Claude 4.5用于分析扩展、推理和引用，Gemini 2.5用于多模态可视化，Perplexity AI用于事实验证，Grok-4用于实时情境分析，DeepSeek V3.1用于计算验证。
AI.findings: 任务特定的多模型集成在复杂工作流中优于单系统部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从竞争性单点向集成协作架构的战略转变理论，发展了AI系统协调互操作性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了顺序多模型工作流框架(S-MMWF)，为复杂AI任务提供了实用的集成解决方案，并为自动化协调平台、能效协议和综合伦理框架提供了基础。

title: Disability-Inclusive Communications and Knowledge Management: A Pressing Need in Pacific Island Countries

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethical approval or informed consent as it involved no human subjects, in accordance with institutional guidelines. Special recognition is extended to Disabled Persons Organizations throughout the region whose tireless work makes inclusion possible.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding: The author(s) received no financial support or specific grant from any funding agencies, whether public, commercial, or not-for-profit, for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Pacific Island Countries (PICs) face unique challenges in implementing disability-inclusive communications and knowledge management systems due to geographical dispersion, limited resources, and cultural contexts. This paper examines the current state of disability inclusion across 14 Pacific nations, analyzing gaps in communication accessibility and knowledge management frameworks. Drawing on the Innovation to Inclusion (i2i) Programme, the Sustainable Education Support for Deaf Children initiative, and UNCRPD implementation efforts, this research proposes a comprehensive framework for enhancing disability-inclusive practices. The findings reveal that approximately 10-15% of Pacific populations (an estimated 1.2-1.8 million people) live with disabilities, yet face systematic exclusion from information access, education, and governance processes. This paper provides evidencebased recommendations for policy makers, development practitioners, and service providers to build more inclusive communication ecosystems that align with Sustainable Development Goals and regional commitments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了太平洋岛国在实施包容性残障通信和知识管理系统方面的现状与挑战，提出了一个增强残障包容实践的综合性框架。
AI.research_question: 太平洋岛国如何有效实施包容性残障通信和知识管理系统？
AI.motivation: 太平洋岛国由于地理分散、资源有限和文化背景等因素，在实施包容性残障通信和知识管理系统方面面临独特挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新包容计划、聋哑儿童可持续教育支持倡议和联合国残疾人权利公约实施工作的实践框架。
AI.method: 分析14个太平洋国家的现状，评估通信可及性和知识管理框架的差距。
AI.findings: 约10-15%的太平洋人口（约120-180万人）患有残疾，但面临信息获取、教育和治理过程的系统性排斥。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个增强残障包容实践的综合性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、发展实践者和服务提供者提供基于证据的建议，以建立更包容的通信生态系统，符合可持续发展目标和区域承诺。

title: The Network Effects of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism with a Quantitative Trade Model
affiliations: , IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca and Scuola IMT Alti Studi Lucca

detail.title: The Network Effects of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism with a Quantitative Trade Model
detail.abstract: We investigate the economic and environmental impacts of the European Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) using a multi-country, multi-sector general equilibrium model with input-output linkages adapted from Caliendo, Parro, and Tsyvinski, 2022. We quantify the general equilibrium responses of trade flows, expenditures, and emissions. To our knowledge, we are the first to endogenize both carbon prices and the CBAM price. We find that, when CBAM is at full force, it could contribute to reducing carbon emissions by 5.19%, a rate that could have been higher (-8.84%) without the moderating role of global production networks. As a consequence of CBAM, we observe substitution effects towards non-targeted carbon-intensive inputs located upstream in the supply network. Notably, CBAM marginally increases EU Gross National Expenditure (GNE) due to changes in the terms of trade, and it shifts sourcing towards domestic and environmentally cleaner inputs. In contrast, extra-EU countries experience only a slight decline in GNE (-0.02%) and emissions (-0.11%). Finally, we propose counterfactual exercises that show the relative importance of technological progress on economic integration in global supply networks. Nonetheless, we argue that supply-chain-wise policies are useful for capturing the full carbon footprint in production.

AI.tldr: 本文使用多国多部门一般均衡模型研究欧盟碳边境调节机制的经济和环境影响，发现CBAM可减少5.19%碳排放，但全球生产网络削弱了其效果。机制导致向上游非目标碳密集型投入品的替代效应，并轻微提升欧盟国民总支出。
AI.research_question: 欧盟碳边境调节机制对经济和环境的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 量化CBAM在一般均衡框架下的全面影响，首次内生化碳价格和CBAM价格，填补研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Caliendo、Parro和Tsyvinski(2022)的多国多部门一般均衡模型，包含投入产出联系。
AI.method: 使用多国多部门一般均衡模型进行量化分析，内生化碳价格和CBAM价格。
AI.findings: CBAM在全面实施时可减少5.19%碳排放；全球生产网络削弱减排效果；产生向上游非目标碳密集型投入品的替代效应；轻微提升欧盟GNE；对欧盟外国家影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在一般均衡框架内内生化碳价格和CBAM价格；揭示全球生产网络对碳政策效果的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供CBAM影响的量化评估；建议供应链层面的政策能更有效捕捉生产碳足迹；展示技术进步的相对重要性。

title: A General Panorama of the Import Substitution Industrialisation (ISI) Model for Colombia – A Comparative Case Study with Singaporea
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Colombia

detail.title: A General Panorama of the Import Substitution Industrialisation (ISI) Model for Colombia – A Comparative Case Study with Singaporea
detail.abstract: The document compares the Import Substitution Industrialisation (ISI) model for Colombia with the success of Singapore, to determine if there were failures in the implantation of the model in Colombia and if so, to identify them. It should be noted that an analysis of this type may present problems since the conditions of both territories differ considerably. To correct that problem the possible deficiencies found for the South American country are evaluated under the possibilities granted by its context and not by the conditions that could have been established in Singapore. The analysis of this work is limited only to the following three perspectives: historical, governmental and cultural, inasmuch as these dimensions, in the author's opinion, yield interesting results of the ISI phase of the Colombian economy and provide sufficient information for the reader to become familiar with the import substitution process in Colombia, its strengths, weaknesses and economic consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了哥伦比亚的进口替代工业化(ISI)模式与新加坡的成功经验，旨在识别哥伦比亚在实施该模式中的失败之处。研究从历史、政府和文化三个维度分析哥伦比亚ISI阶段的经济表现。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚在实施进口替代工业化模式中是否存在失败？如果存在，具体是什么失败？
AI.motivation: 通过比较哥伦比亚与新加坡的ISI实施情况，识别哥伦比亚模式的问题，但考虑到两国条件差异，分析基于哥伦比亚自身背景而非新加坡条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进口替代工业化理论，比较发展经济学
AI.method: 从历史、政府和文化三个维度进行定性比较分析
AI.findings: 通过三个维度的分析揭示了哥伦比亚ISI阶段的经济表现、优势、弱点和经济后果
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于特定国家背景的ISI模式实施分析框架，强调历史、政府和文化因素在发展模式中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚及其他发展中国家提供了ISI模式实施的教训和改进建议

title: Optimal Taxation under Imperfect Trust
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Optimal Taxation under Imperfect Trust
detail.abstract: We study optimal taxation when citizens are not fully confident that the government will transform tax revenue into useful public goods. In an otherwise standard Ramsey framework, a representative agent values a public good financed by distortionary taxes, but believes that the government is honest only with some given probability and may otherwise divert all revenue. This simple departure from the canonical model delivers two central results. First, there is a sharp trust threshold: if perceived government honesty is too low, any positive tax rate lowers expected welfare and the optimal policy is a zero-tax corner, even though the public good is valued. Second, once trust exceeds this threshold, the usual sufficient-statistics logic of optimal taxation re-emerges, but with a trust-adjusted marginal value of public funds that scales down the benefits of raising revenue. In a simple parametric example we obtain closed-form expressions that map trust into the optimal tax rate and the size of the public sector. The framework provides a compact way to incorporate government credibility into tax design and suggests that in low-trust environments credibility-enhancing reforms should precede attempts to expand the tax base.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在公民不完全信任政府能将税收转化为有用公共产品时的最优税收政策。研究发现存在一个信任阈值：当政府可信度过低时，最优政策是零税收；超过阈值后，传统最优税收逻辑重新适用但需调整公共资金边际价值。
AI.research_question: 当公民不完全信任政府能将税收转化为有用公共产品时，最优税收政策是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统最优税收模型假设政府会诚实使用税收收入，但现实中公民往往对政府可信度存疑，这会影响税收政策的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于标准的Ramsey税收框架，引入政府可信度概率，代表政府可能挪用税收收入的风险。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，在标准Ramsey框架中加入政府可信度参数，通过数学推导得出最优税收条件。
AI.findings: 1. 存在信任阈值：当政府可信度过低时，任何正税率都会降低预期福利，最优政策为零税收；2. 超过信任阈值后，传统最优税收逻辑适用但需调整公共资金边际价值；3. 在参数化示例中获得闭式解，将信任映射到最优税率和公共部门规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将政府可信度正式纳入最优税收理论框架；2. 识别出信任阈值的关键作用；3. 提出信任调整的公共资金边际价值概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为低信任环境下的税收政策设计提供指导；2. 建议在低信任环境中，应先进行可信度提升改革，再尝试扩大税基；3. 提供将政府可信度纳入税收设计的紧凑框架。

title: The tax elasticity of capital gains Evidence from millions of housing sales
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: The tax elasticity of capital gains Evidence from millions of housing sales
detail.abstract: I exploit a duration-dependent housing capital gains tax (CGT) schedule in France to reconcile conflicting evidence on the CGT elasticity. A bunching design reveals large intertemporal tax arbitrage responses, but also substantial inattention frictions and a strong bias of non-professional owners for reaching full-exemption status. After a significant tax hike in 2012, affected transactions responded sharply, erasing a third of mechanical revenue effects, partly through avoidance instruments designed to entirely escape CGT on large embedded gains (such as anticipated disposition, gifts, and incorporation). Aversion to paying any tax plays a quantitatively important role in tax responsiveness and portfolio allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用法国住房资本利得税的期限依赖性设计，通过聚束分析方法揭示了纳税人存在大规模跨期税收套利行为，但也面临显著的注意力摩擦，非专业业主强烈偏好获得完全免税资格。2012年税收大幅增加后，受影响交易反应剧烈，抵消了三分之一机械性税收收入效应，部分通过预期处置、赠与和公司化等避税工具完全规避大额内含收益的资本利得税。避税倾向在税收响应和投资组合配置中发挥重要作用。
AI.research_question: 如何解释住房资本利得税弹性的矛盾证据？纳税人对资本利得税的反应机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有关于资本利得税弹性的证据存在矛盾，需要更深入理解纳税人的行为反应机制，特别是跨期套利、注意力摩擦和避税倾向的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为公共经济学、税收套利理论、注意力经济学、避税行为理论
AI.method: 聚束设计（bunching design），利用法国住房资本利得税的期限依赖性特征，分析2012年税收政策变化前后的交易行为
AI.findings: 发现大规模跨期税收套利反应，但存在显著注意力摩擦；非专业业主强烈偏好完全免税资格；税收增加后交易反应剧烈，抵消三分之一机械性收入效应；避税工具（预期处置、赠与、公司化）被广泛使用；避税倾向在税收响应中发挥重要作用
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本利得税弹性矛盾证据提供解释框架，揭示注意力摩擦和避税倾向在税收响应中的关键作用，丰富行为公共经济学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供税收设计建议，识别有效的避税渠道，帮助优化税收政策以减少收入损失

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Qualitative Research Methods: Between Hype and Risks?
affiliations: University of Fribourg, University of Fribourg and

detail.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Qualitative Research Methods: Between Hype and Risks?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in part by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF), grant no. 10002211.

contentType.other: Peer-reviewed position paper not included in formal conference proceedings

detail.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly promoted and used in qualitative research, it also raises profound methodological issues. This position paper critically interrogates the role of generative AI (genAI) in the context of qualitative coding methodologies. Despite widespread hype and claims of efficiency, we propose that genAI is not methodologically valid within qualitative inquiries, and its use risks undermining the robustness and trustworthiness of qualitative research. The lack of meaningful documentation, commercial opacity, and the inherent tendencies of genAI systems to produce incorrect outputs all contribute to weakening methodological rigor. Overall, the balance between risk and benefits does not support the use of genAI in qualitative research, and our position paper cautions researchers to put sound methodology before technological novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视生成式AI在质性研究编码中的方法论有效性，认为其缺乏方法论有效性，会损害研究的严谨性和可信度，建议研究者优先考虑健全的方法论而非技术新颖性。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI在质性研究编码中的方法论有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在质性研究中的推广使用，引发了深刻的方法论问题，需要批判性审视生成式AI在质性编码中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于质性研究方法论、可信度理论和AI伦理框架
AI.method: 立场论文，通过批判性分析生成式AI在质性编码中的方法论问题
AI.findings: 生成式AI缺乏方法论有效性，其使用会削弱质性研究的严谨性和可信度，风险收益比不支持在质性研究中使用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了生成式AI在质性研究方法论中的有效性批判框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为质性研究者提供了关于使用生成式AI的风险警示和实用建议

title: Alternative Justice, Unintended Harms: How Fast-Track Non-Prosecution Criminal Justice Affects Domestic Violence
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Alternative Justice, Unintended Harms: How Fast-Track Non-Prosecution Criminal Justice Affects Domestic Violence
detail.abstract: This paper examines the unintended effects of fast-track, non-prosecution criminal procedures on domestic violence against women. Brazil provides an ideal setting for this analysis, as Law 9.099/95 established the Juizados Especiais Criminais (JECrim), which mandated that all misdemeanor crimes, defined by sentencing thresholds in the Penal Code, be resolved through conciliation hearings rather than formal trials. This nationwide reform aimed to improve judicial efficiency by redirecting minor offenses outside the traditional court system. Although gender-neutral by design, the law applied to many domestic violence cases, particularly minor assaults. We exploit variation in pre-reform misdemeanor assault rates across judicial districts to estimate the impact of the policy on female homicide rates at home. Our difference-indifferences estimates indicate that, over the decade following implementation, a district with average baseline exposure experienced an increase of about 0.16 female homicides at home per 100,000 women, corresponding to roughly a 15% rise relative to the pre-reform mean. The results are robust across specifications and highlight how efficiency-oriented legal reforms can produce adverse spillovers when gender dynamics are not explicitly accounted for.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了巴西快速刑事程序改革对家庭暴力中女性受害者的意外负面影响，发现旨在提高司法效率的改革反而导致女性家庭凶杀率上升约15%。
AI.research_question: 快速刑事程序改革如何影响家庭暴力中的女性受害者？
AI.motivation: 巴西1995年通过的第9.099号法律建立了特别刑事法庭，要求所有轻罪通过调解而非正式审判解决，这一改革虽然设计上是性别中立的，但适用于许多家庭暴力案件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法效率改革与性别暴力关系的理论框架，关注政策意外后果和性别动态。
AI.method: 利用司法区改革前轻罪袭击率的差异，采用双重差分法估计政策对女性家庭凶杀率的影响。
AI.findings: 改革实施后十年内，平均基线暴露的司法区每10万女性中家庭凶杀率增加约0.16起，相对于改革前均值上升约15%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了效率导向的法律改革在未明确考虑性别动态时可能产生负面溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示，在司法改革中需要特别关注性别暴力问题，避免效率优先导致的安全隐患。

title: Optimal Portfolio and Numeraire
affiliations: Hong Kong US invest

detail.title: Optimal Portfolio and Numeraire
detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified framework for the Kelly optimal portfolio strategy under a stochastic Consumer Price Index (CPI) numeraire. We extend the classical nominal Kelly criterion to a multi-asset setting where investors maximize the compound growth rate of real wealth. Our key theoretical contribution is a closed-form solution that cleanly decomposes the optimal portfolio into a mean-variance tangency portfolio and a distinct inflation hedging component. This decomposition, novel in its application to maximizing compound growth with a CPI numeraire, explicitly characterizes the hedging motive first identified by Merton. Empirically, we implement this framework using US data (1971-2025) for portfolios of equities, bonds, and gold. While the theoretical hedging demand is empirically confirmed, its historical impact on portfolio allocations is economically small (< 1%), as low inflation volatility mutes the adjustment. The more striking finding is the high optimal leverage (∼7-8×) suggested by historical risk premia, which starkly contrasts with conventional practice. This establishes the Kelly strategy as a theoretical benchmark rather than a directly implementable plan, due to extreme drawdowns and substantial parameter uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个在随机消费者价格指数（CPI）计价单位下的Kelly最优投资组合统一框架，将经典名义Kelly准则扩展到多资产环境，投资者最大化实际财富的复合增长率。关键理论贡献是闭式解，将最优组合分解为均值-方差切点组合和独立的通胀对冲成分。实证显示对冲需求存在但影响很小（<1%），而历史风险溢价建议的高杠杆（7-8倍）使Kelly策略成为理论基准而非可直接实施的计划。
AI.research_question: 在随机CPI计价单位下，如何构建Kelly最优投资组合策略？
AI.motivation: 将经典Kelly准则扩展到实际财富最大化框架，解决通胀环境下的投资组合优化问题
AI.theoretical_framework: Kelly准则、Merton的对冲动机理论、均值-方差分析
AI.method: 理论推导闭式解，使用美国1971-2025年股票、债券和黄金数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1）理论对冲需求得到实证确认但影响很小（<1%）；2）历史风险溢价建议高杠杆（7-8倍）；3）Kelly策略因极端回撤和参数不确定性而更适合作为理论基准
AI.theory_contributions: 1）开发了随机CPI计价单位下的Kelly最优组合统一框架；2）提供了闭式解，明确分解为切点组合和通胀对冲成分；3）形式化表征了Merton的对冲动机
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示了Kelly策略的高杠杆特性；2）表明Kelly策略更适合作为理论基准而非实际操作计划；3）为通胀环境下的投资组合构建提供理论指导

title: Artificial Intelligence in Microfinance and Financial Inclusion: Applications, Issues, and Future Directions

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Microfinance and Financial Inclusion: Applications, Issues, and Future Directions

declarations.ethicsApproval: Only public information used.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging as a transformative force in microfinance and financial inclusion, addressing long-standing barriers such as credit invisibility, high operational costs, and limited access to formal financial services. This paper systematically examines AI applications across key financial domains (payments, savings, lending, insurance, investments) highlighting how machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI are enabling innovative solutions tailored to the needs of marginalized populations. Drawing on contemporary research and case studies from the Global South, the analysis demonstrates AI's potential to democratize financial services through alternative credit scoring, automated underwriting, and adaptive tools. However, the deployment of AI also presents significant challenges, including algorithmic bias, proxy discrimination, privacy violations, and the risk of exacerbating digital divides. The paper underscores the need for robust governance frameworks, ethical oversight, and inclusive policies to mitigate these risks and ensure that AI-driven financial inclusion serves the most vulnerable without creating new forms of exclusion. Future directions include advancing fairness-aware AI, improving transparency, and fostering cross-sector collaboration to align technological innovation with social justice and human dignity.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了AI在微金融和普惠金融中的变革作用，探讨了AI在支付、储蓄、贷款、保险和投资等领域的应用，同时指出了算法偏见、隐私风险等挑战，并提出了治理框架和未来发展方向。
AI.research_question: AI如何促进普惠金融发展，同时面临哪些挑战以及如何解决这些挑战？
AI.motivation: AI正在成为微金融和普惠金融的变革力量，能够解决信用不可见性、高运营成本和金融服务获取受限等长期障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习、自然语言处理和生成式AI的技术框架，结合普惠金融理论和社会正义理论。
AI.method: 系统文献综述和案例研究分析，重点关注全球南方国家的实践经验。
AI.findings: AI能够通过替代信用评分、自动化承保和适应性工具来民主化金融服务，但同时也带来算法偏见、代理歧视、隐私侵犯和数字鸿沟加剧等风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI驱动的普惠金融理论框架，强调技术与社会正义的整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构提供了AI治理框架、伦理监督机制和包容性政策建议，以降低风险并确保AI服务于最弱势群体。

title: Public Acceptance of International Redistribution in High-Income Countries
affiliations: CNRS

detail.title: Public Acceptance of International Redistribution in High-Income Countries
detail.abstract:
Using an original survey of 12,000 respondents representative of eleven high-income countries (the United States, Japan, Russia, Saudi Arabia, and seven European countries), I examine public support for global redistribution and climate policies, as well as its sensitivity to key policy features such as the size of transfers and country coverage. Although global inequality is not a salient concern, it is perceived as a significant injustice. There is majority acceptance in every country for nearly all global policies tested, including those that would redistribute 5 percent of global income or entail personal costs for respondents. An information treatment shows that support for global policies causally increases among respondents who perceive them as likely; an effect opposite to warm glow. Support for international policies decreases only slightly as country coverage shrinks. Overall, the results reinforce previous findings and suggest that a broad coalition of countries could feasibly advance sustainable development.

[If the paper is not available for download on SSRN, you can still find it here: https://github.com/bixiou/robustness_global_redistr/raw/main/papers/support_global_redistr.pdf  ]

AI.tldr: 基于11个高收入国家的调查显示，公众普遍支持全球再分配和气候政策，即使这些政策会带来个人成本。政策可行性感知会显著提升支持度，而政策覆盖范围缩小仅轻微降低支持度。
AI.research_question: 公众对全球再分配和气候政策的支持程度如何？政策特征（如转移规模、国家覆盖范围）如何影响这种支持？
AI.motivation: 全球不平等虽然不突出但被视为显著不公正，需要了解公众对全球政策的接受度以推进可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策支持理论、全球正义理论、行为经济学中的可行性感知效应
AI.method: 对11个高收入国家12,000名受访者进行的原始调查，包含信息处理实验测试政策可行性感知的影响
AI.findings: 所有国家的大多数人都支持几乎所有测试的全球政策，包括那些会重新分配全球收入5%或带来个人成本的政策。政策可行性感知会因果性地增加支持度，而政策覆盖范围缩小仅轻微降低支持度。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"温暖效应"理论，发现政策可行性感知对支持度有正向因果影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为推进可持续发展提供了实证基础，表明广泛的国际联盟在政策制定上是可行的

title: Trends in Social Protection Spending and its Effects: Evidence from the Harmonized Social Protection Expenditure Database (HASPED)
affiliations: , Eberhard-Karls University Tübingen and German Institute of Development and Sustainability (IDOS)

detail.title: Trends in Social Protection Spending and its Effects: Evidence from the Harmonized Social Protection Expenditure Database (HASPED)
detail.abstract: Social protection is a key instrument to tackle poverty and promote human development. In order to understand and compare countries' commitment to social protection and to conduct empirical analyses to examine the effects as well as the determinants of social protection, it is necessary to focus on public spending in this sector. Most scholars and international organizations rely on a single source of data on social protection expenditures or on multiple sources without any attempt to harmonize the data. In the first case, empirical analyses necessarily make use of data containing a relatively small number of countries and/or years; in the second case, scholars can exploit a larger sample size but one that is composed of data with limited comparability. Against this background, the paper has two objectives. First, it presents the Harmonized Social Protection Expenditure Database (HASPED), a comprehensive, harmonized dataset of social protection expenditure, measured as a percentage of GDP, obtained by combining and harmonizing data from multiple sources. We prioritize data reliability and ensure as much consistency across sources (and government levels) as possible through a systematic process. To do so, we examine the various definitions of social protection adopted by the different organizations providing the data and employ different statistical methodologies to ensure consistent alignment of the data across the different sources. As a result, we were able to generate the largest social protection expenditure database so far (consisting of 4,337 country-year points) while at the same time ensuring high comparability across countries, years, and data sources. The database includes 157 countries in the period 1980-2023. Second, we used the HASPED to analyze country-level trends in social protection spending and to examine the crosscountry relationship between social protection expenditures and different socioeconomic indicators. We find that since 2000, the large majority of countries (76.4%) have increased the share of GDP used for social protection, with the lowest improvements detected in South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. The exploratory correlation and regression analyses then reveal that a higher share of GDP destined for social protection is associated with higher economic and human development as well as lower (income and multidimensional) poverty, though the effects are not always statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HASPED数据库——一个通过整合和协调多个数据源构建的全面、统一的社会保护支出数据库，包含1980-2023年间157个国家的4,337个观测点。研究发现自2000年以来，大多数国家增加了社会保护支出占GDP的比重，且更高的社会保护支出与经济、人类发展正相关，与贫困负相关。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个全面、可比较的社会保护支出数据库？社会保护支出与经济社会发展指标之间存在什么关系？
AI.motivation: 现有社会保护支出数据存在样本量小或可比性差的问题，限制了实证研究的开展和政策比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保护作为减贫和促进人类发展的关键工具，其支出水平反映国家承诺程度。
AI.method: 通过系统化流程整合和协调多个数据源，采用不同统计方法确保数据一致性，构建HASPED数据库，并进行相关性和回归分析。
AI.findings: 76.4%的国家自2000年以来增加了社会保护支出占比；南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲改善最小；社会保护支出与经济社会发展正相关，与贫困负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了迄今为止最大的社会保护支出数据库，建立了数据协调的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供可比较的跨国数据支持，有助于评估社会保护政策效果和制定针对性干预措施。

title: IF MACHIAVELLI HAD KNOWN DARWIN: EVOLUTIONARY FOUNDATIONS OF MODERN GOVERNANCE

detail.title: IF MACHIAVELLI HAD KNOWN DARWIN: EVOLUTIONARY FOUNDATIONS OF MODERN GOVERNANCE

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced this research. This work was conducted independently without institutional affiliation, corporate sponsorship, or external funding that might create competing interests. The computational tools developed (IusMorfos, Constitutional Lock-in Index, JurisRank) are made publicly available through GitHub repositories for academic use without commercial restrictions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involves analysis of publicly available legal documents, constitutional texts, judicial decisions, and published government statistics. No human subjects, interviews, surveys, or confidential data were used. All empirical analysis relies on secondary sources in the public domain.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. All work was conducted independently by the author without external financial support.

detail.abstract:
Political theory cannot explain why manifestly dysfunctional institutions persist across generations despite repeated reform attempts. When Niccolò Machiavelli wrote Il Principe in 1513, he revolutionized political thought by describing power as it IS rather than as it SHOULD BE. 
But writing 346 years before Darwin published On the Origin of Species, he analyzed princes rather than institutions, personal cunning rather than evolutionary fitness. 
This paper intends to complete Machiavelli's project by integrating Darwin's natural selection, Dawkins's extended phenotypes, and Dennett's memetics into a unified framework for governance. 
The core principle is stark: institutions optimize for memetic replication, not social welfare. 
This fitness-welfare divergence explains why "bad" institutions systematically outcompete "good" alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个整合达尔文自然选择、道金斯扩展表型和丹尼特模因学的统一治理框架，解释为何功能失调的制度能持续存在——制度优化的是模因复制而非社会福利。
AI.research_question: 为什么明显功能失调的制度能够跨代持续存在，尽管有多次改革尝试？
AI.motivation: 政治理论无法解释功能失调制度的持久性，需要将达尔文进化论引入制度分析，完成马基雅维利的项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 达尔文自然选择理论、道金斯扩展表型概念、丹尼特模因学，整合为统一的治理分析框架。
AI.method: 理论整合与概念框架构建，将进化生物学理论应用于制度分析。
AI.findings: 制度优化的是模因复制而非社会福利，这种适应度-福利分歧解释了"坏"制度系统性地胜过"好"替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 完成了马基雅维利的项目，将权力分析从个人层面扩展到制度层面，提供了制度持久性的进化解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度改革提供了新的分析视角，帮助理解为何某些改革会失败，以及如何设计更具适应性的制度。

title: Mapping the Italian Third Sector: Insights from Web-augmented Administrative Data

detail.title: Mapping the Italian Third Sector: Insights from Web-augmented Administrative Data

declarations.funderStatement: We kindly acknowledge the University of Milano-Bicocca for financial support within the framework of the Bicocca Starting Grant 2023, ATESP2024-0007 "Big Data Platform per il Terzo Settore"

detail.abstract: Reliable data on the Italian Third Sector remain limited despite its socioeconomic importance. This paper presents a methodology for assembling a comprehensive dataset on the sector by systematically exploiting administrative data from the Single National Register of the Third Sector (RUNTS). The proposed pipeline automates the acquisition and cleaning of data on more than 134,000 organisations through a tailored web-scraping procedure. To address common shortcomings of administrative data, such as incompleteness and self-reporting bias, a novel web-augmentation strategy is implemented, combining information extracted from organisational websites with a Generative AI-based classification system. This approach allows the identification of beneficiaries, territorial scope, and economic activities, and enables comparison between web-derived and self-declared information for the latter case. Using data for the second quarter of 2025, the paper provides an up-to-date picture of the Italian Third Sector and offers a new informational base for socioeconomic research and co-programming of local policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用意大利第三部门单一国家登记册（RUNTS）行政数据构建全面数据集的方法论，通过自动化网络爬取和生成式AI分类系统，解决了行政数据不完整和自报告偏差的问题，为意大利第三部门研究提供了新的信息基础。

title: Multinational enterprises and greenhouse gas emissions: The dual reality of climate governance mechanisms
affiliations: Gustavson School Of Business and University of Western Ontario - Asian Management Institute

detail.title: Multinational enterprises and greenhouse gas emissions: The dual reality of climate governance mechanisms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Neither author has any conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Lansdowne Chair in Finance, University of Victoria

detail.abstract: Multinational enterprises (MNEs) have a collective carbon footprint that would rank fifth among nations, positioning them at the center of the debate on climate change mitigation. Framed through theories of temporality, stakeholder pressure, and signaling, this study examines whether and how MNEs have reduced greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions over time. Using longitudinal data over 15 years (2009-2023), we track absolute reductions in scope 1 (direct) and scope 2 (indirect) emissions across the world's top non-financial MNEs headquartered in 30 countries. We find that 69% of firms reduced scope 1 emissions, with an even higher proportion reducing scope 2 emissions and emission intensities. Reductions accelerated after the 2015 Paris Agreement, though fewer than 45% achieved reductions consistent with international climate targets. Our results highlight the central role of sustained climate governance mechanisms including board oversight, climate strategy, emission targets, monetary incentives, and verification in driving emission reductions. These mechanisms are effective only among firms already on a path to reduce GHG emissions. In firms that increased emissions, governance mechanisms appeared largely symbolic, underscoring the risk of greenwashing in corporate climate governance.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察跨国企业在2009-2023年间温室气体排放的绝对减少情况，发现69%的企业减少了范围1排放，更多企业减少了范围2排放和排放强度。巴黎协定后减排加速，但不到45%的企业减排符合国际气候目标。气候治理机制对已减排企业有效，对增加排放企业则多为象征性措施。
AI.research_question: 跨国企业是否以及如何随时间减少温室气体排放？
AI.motivation: 跨国企业的集体碳足迹在全球排名第五，在气候变化减缓讨论中处于核心地位
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间性理论、利益相关者压力理论、信号理论
AI.method: 使用2009-2023年15年纵向数据，追踪全球30个国家总部的前非金融跨国企业的范围1（直接）和范围2（间接）排放绝对减少情况
AI.findings: 69%企业减少范围1排放，更多企业减少范围2排放和排放强度；巴黎协定后减排加速；不到45%企业减排符合国际气候目标；气候治理机制对已减排企业有效，对增加排放企业多为象征性
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对跨国企业气候治理机制有效性的理解，揭示了治理机制在不同减排路径企业中的差异化作用
