title: Evaluating The Financial Performance of MGNREGS in Uttarakhand: An Analytical Study of Budget Allocation, Expenditure Patterns, and Fund Utilization Efficiency
affiliations: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) and Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)

detail.title: Evaluating The Financial Performance of MGNREGS in Uttarakhand: An Analytical Study of Budget Allocation, Expenditure Patterns, and Fund Utilization Efficiency
detail.abstract: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) is a comprehensive and effective programme introduced by the Government of India in 2006 to reduce poverty and unemployment in rural India. It has two objectives: one is to provide 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to every rural household whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work, and the second is to ensure a minimum of 33% employment for women under the programme. This study aims to analyse the inclusiveness of the programme and the employment opportunities it provides to marginalised communities, such as Scheduled Castes (SCs), Scheduled Tribes (STs), and women, in Uttarakhand, India. The study takes the secondary data from official websites of MGNREGA covering 2020-21 to 2024-25 on three broad parameters, such as (1) Financial Progress, (2) Physical Progress, and (3) Inclusiveness of the programme. The study takes data from 2020-21 to 2024-25, and found that MGNREGS experienced significant growth, characterised by increased budget allocations and effective fund utilisation, indicative of strong implementation. The timely processing of payments has consistently been outstanding, strengthening the confidence of the workforce. The overall increase in employment days per household and infrastructure projects indicates a beneficial effect of the scheme on rural livelihoods. Nonetheless, reductions in average wages and variations in project completion highlight difficulties in wage advancement and task execution. The consistent majority participation of women highlights the programme's significance in promoting gender inclusion. Meanwhile, the stable involvement of Scheduled Castes and the fluctuating participation of Scheduled Tribes indicate the influence of social and regional dynamics. Changes in spending habits related to agriculture and resource management, however, indicate a transformation in priorities. To ensure continued effectiveness, it is essential to concentrate on enhancing wage rates, completing projects on schedule, and distributing resources fairly.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度MGNREGS计划在Uttarakhand地区的包容性表现，发现该计划在预算分配、资金利用和女性参与方面表现良好，但在工资水平、项目完成度和部落社区参与方面存在挑战。
AI.research_question: MGNREGS计划在Uttarakhand地区为边缘化社区（如种姓制度下的弱势群体、部落和女性）提供的包容性和就业机会如何？
AI.motivation: MGNREGS是印度政府2006年推出的重要减贫和就业保障计划，旨在为农村家庭提供100天有保障的工资就业，并确保女性获得至少33%的就业机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于包容性发展理论和社会公平框架，关注边缘化群体的就业参与和资源分配公平性。
AI.method: 使用2020-21至2024-25年期间的官方MGNREGA网站二手数据，分析三个主要参数：财务进展、实体进展和计划包容性。
AI.findings: MGNREGS经历了显著增长，预算分配增加，资金利用有效，支付及时性良好。女性参与持续占主导地位，但平均工资下降，项目完成度波动，部落参与不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 为包容性就业政策理论提供了实证支持，揭示了社会结构和区域动态对边缘群体参与的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善工资水平、确保项目按时完成和公平分配资源的具体建议，以提升计划的持续有效性。

title: Do Lower Mortgage Rates Benefit First-Time Homebuyers?
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: Do Lower Mortgage Rates Benefit First-Time Homebuyers?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the mortgage channel of monetary policy transmission to home purchasing behaviors of first-time home buyers and incumbent homeowners. Between 2009 and 2019, the first-time home buyer share of home purchases fell from 35% to 22%, a period in which mortgage rates fell from nearly 7% to 3.5%. First, I construct a new mortgage rate-specific monetary policy shock to use as an IV for mortgage rate changes which predicts future mortgage rates better than existing monetary policy shocks. Next, I provide empirical evidence for three new findings: 1) transacted house prices respond to monetary policy-induced mortgage rate changes within a matter of weeks, indicating a rapid housing demand response to mortgage rates; 2) a negative 25 basis point mortgage rate shock lowers the first-time buyer share of home purchases by 77 b.p. in the first three months after the shock; 3) these results are more pronounced in areas with higher shares of high LTV-constrained borrowers which tend to be areas with more severe housing crises. Finally, I construct a lifecycle model with a housing ladder, heterogeneous agents, and a system of housing-related taxes calibrated to my empirical findings. I find that a one-time unanticipated negative one p.p. transitory shock to mortgage rates causes potential first-time home buyers to face 0.05% consumption-equivalent welfare losses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了货币政策通过抵押贷款渠道对首次购房者和现有房主购房行为的影响。研究发现，抵押贷款利率下降会降低首次购房者比例，并导致潜在首次购房者面临福利损失。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过抵押贷款渠道影响首次购房者和现有房主的购房行为？
AI.motivation: 2009-2019年间，首次购房者比例从35%下降到22%，而抵押贷款利率从7%降至3.5%，这种矛盾现象需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期模型，包含住房阶梯、异质性主体和住房相关税收系统
AI.method: 构建新的抵押贷款利率特定货币政策冲击作为工具变量，结合实证分析和校准的生命周期模型
AI.findings: 1) 房价在数周内对抵押贷款利率变化做出反应；2) 25个基点的抵押贷款利率冲击在三个月内使首次购房者比例下降77个基点；3) 在高LTV约束借款人比例较高的地区效果更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的抵押贷款利率特定货币政策冲击测量方法，建立了包含住房阶梯的生命周期模型
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了货币政策对住房市场分配效应的影响，为政策制定者提供了关于住房市场不平等问题的洞见

title: Forecasting House Prices

detail.title: Forecasting House Prices
detail.abstract: This article identifies the factors that drove house prices in 13 advanced countries over the past 35 years. It does so based on Breiman's (2001) random forest model. Shapley values indicate that annual house price growth across countries is explained first and foremost by price momentum, initial valuations (proxied by price to rent ratios) and household credit growth. Partial effects of explanatory variables are also elicited and suggest important non-linearities, for instance as to what concerns the effects of CPI inflation on house price growth. The out-ofsample forecast test reveals that the random forest model delivers 44% lower house price variation RMSEs and 45% lower MAEs when compared to an OLS model that uses the same set of 10 predetermined explanatory variables. Notably, the same model works well for all countries, as the random forest attributes minimal values to country fixed effects.

AI.tldr: 本文使用随机森林模型分析13个发达经济体35年来的房价驱动因素，发现价格动量、初始估值和家庭信贷增长是主要解释变量，模型预测精度比OLS模型显著提高44-45%。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素驱动了13个发达经济体过去35年的房价变化？
AI.motivation: 理解房价驱动因素对政策制定和风险管理至关重要，传统线性模型可能无法捕捉复杂的非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Breiman(2001)的随机森林机器学习模型，结合Shapley值进行变量重要性分析。
AI.method: 使用随机森林模型分析13个国家35年的面板数据，包含10个预定解释变量，并与OLS模型进行对比。
AI.findings: 房价增长主要由价格动量、初始估值(价格租金比)和家庭信贷增长解释；发现CPI通胀对房价增长存在重要非线性效应；随机森林模型预测精度显著优于OLS模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了机器学习方法在房价预测中的优越性，揭示了房价驱动因素的非线性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的房价预测工具，有助于房地产市场监管和金融稳定风险评估。

title: Housing Market Definitions Matter for Hedonic Valuation: Evidence from Cross Validation and the 2011 Tohoku Earthquake
affiliations: Kobe University - Graduate School of Economics, Graduate School of Economics, Kyoto University and Seijo University

detail.title: Housing Market Definitions Matter for Hedonic Valuation: Evidence from Cross Validation and the 2011 Tohoku Earthquake
detail.abstract: The hedonic method is widely applied because of its ability to recover intuitive price effects of nonmarket goods from readily available data. These valuations become inaccurate when housing markets are too broadly defined, however. We address this issue by developing a novel statisticallearning method to better delineate housing markets across space, time, and attributes and by examining how this decision impacts valuation. Our methodology not only provides insight into the quantity of markets but along which boundaries to define them. We find within our application, where the implicit price for seismic risk is causally identified using the Tohoku Earthquake as a natural experiment, that housing transactions are best categorized into three submarkets defined across commuting time to central Tokyo. More importantly, this specification is statistically preferred and yields aggregate valuations that are 23.7% ($485 million) less relative to a singlemarket approach.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种新的统计学习方法，通过更好地划分住房市场空间、时间和属性边界来提高享乐定价法的准确性。研究发现，将东京住房交易按通勤时间划分为三个子市场是最优方案，这种划分使地震风险的总估值比单一市场方法降低了23.7%（4.85亿美元）。
AI.research_question: 如何通过更好的住房市场划分来提高享乐定价法的估值准确性？
AI.motivation: 享乐定价法在住房市场定义过宽时会产生不准确的估值，需要开发新方法来精确划分市场边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 享乐定价理论、统计学习理论、市场细分理论
AI.method: 开发新的统计学习方法，利用东北地震作为自然实验，因果识别地震风险的隐含价格，分析不同市场划分对估值的影响。
AI.findings: 东京住房交易最适合按通勤时间划分为三个子市场，这种划分在统计上更优，且使地震风险的总估值比单一市场方法降低23.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于统计学习的住房市场划分方法，为享乐定价法提供了更精确的市场边界界定理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和房地产从业者提供了更准确的住房估值方法，特别是在风险评估和灾害损失评估方面具有重要应用价值。

title: The Lending Technology of Direct Lenders in Private Credit
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business, Office of Financial Research, US Department of the Treasury and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: The Lending Technology of Direct Lenders in Private Credit
detail.abstract: We compare the lending technology of direct lenders, banks, and finance companies using a unique data set on secured borrowing by the universe of U.S.-based private middle market firms. The borrowers of direct lenders are distinct relative to those of traditional lenders; they are younger, more likely to be in intangible capital industries, and more likely to be located in the biggest cities in the United States. These differences reflect the focus of direct lenders on private equity-owned firms; direct lenders have negligible impact in industries and cities with low private equity presence. The lending technology of direct lenders is distinct from banks: they have almost no branch network, they are geographically distant from borrowers, they write collateral claims more focused on the continuation value of firms after a default, and they have a higher degree of specialization in certain industries. Direct lenders and private equity sponsors match on industry specialization more strongly than geographic proximity. The findings suggest that direct lenders are not a general substitute for traditional lenders in middle market business lending, but they are instead specialized lenders focused on a particular segment of the U.S. economy with a distinct lending technology.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了直接贷款机构、银行和金融公司的贷款技术，发现直接贷款机构主要服务于私募股权拥有的企业，其贷款技术专注于特定行业和违约后的企业持续价值，而非传统贷款机构的替代品。
AI.research_question: 直接贷款机构与传统贷款机构（银行和金融公司）在贷款技术上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解直接贷款机构在美国中型市场企业贷款中的独特作用和专业化特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贷款技术理论、专业化贷款理论、私募股权与贷款机构匹配理论
AI.method: 使用美国所有私营中型企业担保贷款数据的实证分析
AI.findings: 直接贷款机构的借款人更年轻、更多从事无形资产行业、更多位于大城市；贷款技术无分支机构、地理距离远、专注于违约后企业持续价值的抵押品、行业专业化程度高；与私募股权赞助商的匹配更多基于行业专业化而非地理邻近
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对直接贷款机构专业化贷款技术的理解，提出了行业专业化匹配的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为中型企业选择贷款机构提供参考，帮助贷款机构优化业务策略

reference: The Journal of Financial Data Science, volume 3, issue 2, 2021[10.3905/jfds.2021.1.061]
title: Neural Networks, the Treasury Yield Curve, and Recession Forecasting
affiliations: and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Neural Networks, the Treasury Yield Curve, and Recession Forecasting

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Journal of Financial Data Science, volume 3, issue 2, 2021[10.3905/jfds.2021.1.061]

detail.abstract: It is difficult to make the case that neural network classifiers greatly outperform traditional econometric methods such as probit regression when forecasting US recessions if performance is measured on the basis of forecast accuracy alone. That said, neural network classifiers identify important features of the joint distribution of recession over term spreads and other macro-financial time series that probit regression and other traditional methods cannot. The authors propose a three-step econometric process for conducting statistical inference on machine learning classifiers, with the goal of better explaining recession forecasts and enabling model outputs to be linked back to the instruments of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 神经网络分类器在预测美国经济衰退时，仅基于预测准确性的表现并不明显优于传统计量方法（如probit回归），但能识别传统方法无法捕捉的联合分布特征。作者提出了一个三步计量过程来对机器学习分类器进行统计推断，以更好地解释衰退预测并将模型输出与货币政策工具联系起来。
AI.research_question: 神经网络分类器在预测美国经济衰退时是否显著优于传统计量方法？如何对机器学习分类器进行统计推断以解释其预测结果？
AI.motivation: 虽然神经网络在预测准确性方面可能不显著优于传统方法，但它们能识别传统方法无法捕捉的联合分布特征，这有助于更好地理解经济衰退预测并与货币政策工具建立联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于神经网络分类器和传统计量经济学方法（如probit回归）的比较框架，结合机器学习统计推断理论。
AI.method: 提出一个三步计量过程，包括特征重要性分析、统计推断和模型解释，用于对机器学习分类器进行统计推断。
AI.findings: 神经网络分类器在预测准确性方面并不明显优于传统计量方法，但能识别term spreads与其他宏观金融时间序列联合分布的重要特征，这是传统方法无法做到的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对机器学习分类器进行统计推断的新计量方法，填补了传统计量经济学与机器学习方法之间的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更好的经济衰退预测解释框架，使模型输出能够与货币政策工具直接关联，提高了预测结果的实际应用价值。

title: The Drivers of Digital Transformation in Banking: From AI and Cloud Adoption to Customer-Centric Platforms
affiliations: Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

detail.title: The Drivers of Digital Transformation in Banking: From AI and Cloud Adoption to Customer-Centric Platforms
detail.abstract:
The European banking sector is undergoing profound structural transformation, driven by the simultaneous interaction of multiple macro-structural forces. Advancing digitalisation – particularly through Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing, and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) – together with a tightening regulatory framework (e.g., PSD2/PSD3, FiDA, DORA), intensifying competition from BigTech and FinTech players, combined with fundamentally changing customer behaviour are presenting banks with profound challenges.

This paper analyses how these digital drivers affect business models, IT infrastructures, regulatory compliance, and the strategic positioning of banks. It shows that the simultaneous management of these transformations requires integrated management approaches to overcome challenges such as outdated legacy IT systems, increasing data security risks, and the potential loss of the customer interface.

Specifically, it focuses on the strategic use of AI and Big Data for hyper-personalisation, referencing psychometric approaches such as the OCEAN model; the role of Cloud Computing in migrating from legacy systems and the associated regulatory requirements (MaRisk, Sec. 25b KWG); and the rise of the Platform Economy, 'Embedded Finance', and the necessity of a customer-centric (CRM) approach. The study concludes that banks must develop a high degree of organisational and technological agility to sustain competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了数字化转型对欧洲银行业的影响，指出银行需要整合管理方法来应对多重挑战，包括AI、云计算等技术的战略应用，以及向平台经济和嵌入式金融的转型。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型如何影响银行业的商业模式、IT基础设施、监管合规和战略定位？
AI.motivation: 欧洲银行业正经历深刻的结构性变革，受到数字化、监管收紧、竞争加剧和客户行为变化等多重因素的驱动，银行面临重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: OCEAN心理测量模型、平台经济理论、客户关系管理(CRM)理论
AI.method: 分析性研究，探讨数字化转型对银行业的影响机制
AI.findings: 银行需要同时管理多重转型，应对遗留IT系统、数据安全风险和客户界面丧失等挑战；AI和大数据可用于超个性化服务；云计算有助于系统迁移；平台经济和嵌入式金融正在兴起。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了银行业数字化转型的综合分析框架，整合了技术、监管和客户行为等多维度因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行提供了应对数字化转型的实用策略，包括发展组织和技术敏捷性、采用客户中心方法、合规管理云计算迁移等。

title: A Theory of Attention Weighted Utility
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) and National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Economics

detail.title: A Theory of Attention Weighted Utility
detail.abstract: The human brain is miserly in minimizing energy expenditure constantly and unconsciously, giving rise to an unstable and context-sensitive attentional process. We propose a theory of attention weighted utility (AWU) where the dynamically changing utility of a lottery emerges from attention-induced decision weights that are potentially volatile. When topdown attention is stable, AWU exhibits transitivity in binary choice along with standard Allais behavior using a continuous decision weight function. When attention is unstable, AWU can be intransitive and exhibit expected-utility conforming behavior in the correlated common-consequence problem if and only if its bivariate attention function is symmetric, coinciding formally with Regret Theory and Salience Theory. In addition, valuing lotteries individually under unstable attention yields a form of complexity aversion with the more complex lottery being evaluated using a less value-enhancing attention function. Incorporating the influence of stimulus-driven salience, AWU yields context sensitive choice, when distinct attention functions are applied to similar lotteries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了注意力加权效用理论（AWU），认为彩票的动态变化效用源于注意力诱导的决策权重，这些权重可能具有波动性。该理论解释了注意力稳定和不稳定状态下的不同决策行为模式，包括传递性、Allais悖论、预期效用一致性行为、复杂性厌恶和情境敏感选择。
AI.research_question: 注意力如何影响个体在不确定性决策中的效用评估和选择行为？
AI.motivation: 人脑为了最小化能量消耗，会形成不稳定且情境敏感的注意力过程，这影响了决策权重和效用评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力加权效用理论（AWU），整合了注意力诱导的决策权重、自上而下和自下而上的注意力机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，通过构建注意力加权效用函数，分析不同注意力状态下的决策行为特征。
AI.findings: 1）稳定注意力下AWU呈现传递性和标准Allais行为；2）不稳定注意力下可能产生非传递性，且在相关共同后果问题中仅当双变量注意力函数对称时呈现预期效用一致性行为；3）不稳定注意力导致复杂性厌恶；4）刺激驱动显著性产生情境敏感选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了统一的注意力加权效用理论框架；2）形式化地连接了后悔理论和显著性理论；3）解释了注意力波动对决策行为的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实决策中的非理性行为提供了理论解释，有助于设计更有效的决策辅助工具和干预措施。

title: Derived Daily Features from S&P 500 Index (SPX) Options DRAFT

detail.title: Derived Daily Features from S&P 500 Index (SPX) Options DRAFT

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a dataset of daily features derived from S&P 500 Index (SPX) options. The features include interpretable quantities such as normalized straddle prices, skewness, and volume ratios. The dataset is intended to provide researchers and practitioners with derived indicators of market activity, volatility, and skewness in SPX options. It is distributed in a format suitable for use in Python, R, Excel, and other data analysis tools.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了基于标普500指数期权构建的日度特征数据集，包含可解释的指标如标准化跨式期权价格、偏度和成交量比率，旨在为研究者和从业者提供市场活动、波动率和偏度的衍生指标。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个包含可解释特征的标普500指数期权日度数据集？
AI.motivation: 为研究者和从业者提供标准化的衍生指标，便于分析市场活动、波动率和偏度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期权定价理论和市场微观结构理论，构建可解释的特征指标。
AI.method: 从标普500指数期权数据中提取和计算日度特征，包括标准化跨式期权价格、偏度和成交量比率等。
AI.findings: 成功构建了一个包含多种可解释特征的日度数据集，适用于多种数据分析工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了标准化的期权特征数据集，支持期权市场相关研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和从业者提供了易于使用的数据集，便于市场分析和策略开发。

title: Financial Reporting and Detection of Labor Union Misconduct
affiliations: University of Iowa

detail.title: Financial Reporting and Detection of Labor Union Misconduct
detail.abstract: Labor unions are central to promoting worker protection and fairness, yet misconduct can undermine their ability to advocate. Despite over 60 years of regulations requiring unions to file financial reports, debate persists about those rules' effectiveness. Proponents argue that transparency exposes wrongdoing, while critics question whether reporting constrains misconduct. Accounting research shows that financial information can uncover fraud in public firms, but its generalizability to unions is unclear. Using a handcollected dataset, I examine the role of financial reporting in detecting and disciplining union misconduct. Results show that reporting information can reveal misconduct and that detection and discipline increase for unions subject to enhanced reporting requirements following a 2004 regulatory change. Further analysis indicates that union stakeholders, including members, employers, media, and anti-union organizations, use this information to help reveal misconduct. Overall, the findings suggest that financial reporting plays a significant role in promoting accountability within labor unions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了财务报告在发现和约束工会不当行为中的作用。研究发现，财务报告信息能够揭示工会不当行为，且在2004年监管改革后，受强化报告要求约束的工会的不当行为发现率和约束率均有所提高。工会利益相关者（包括成员、雇主、媒体和反工会组织）会利用这些信息来帮助揭露不当行为。
AI.research_question: 财务报告在发现和约束工会不当行为中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 工会是促进工人保护和公平的核心组织，但不当行为可能削弱其倡导能力。尽管已有60多年的法规要求工会提交财务报告，但关于这些规则有效性的争论仍在继续。支持者认为透明度能揭露不当行为，而批评者质疑报告是否能约束不当行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于会计研究中财务信息能够揭露上市公司欺诈的理论框架，探讨其在工会背景下的适用性。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的数据集，分析财务报告在发现和约束工会不当行为中的作用。特别关注2004年监管变化后强化报告要求的影响。
AI.findings: 财务报告信息能够揭示工会不当行为；在2004年监管改革后，受强化报告要求约束的工会的不当行为发现率和约束率均有所提高；工会利益相关者（成员、雇主、媒体和反工会组织）会利用这些信息来帮助揭露不当行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将会计研究中关于财务信息揭露欺诈的理论扩展到工会组织领域，验证了财务报告在非营利组织治理中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管政策提供实证支持，表明强化财务报告要求确实能够提高工会的问责制；为工会利益相关者提供了利用财务信息监督工会行为的实践指导。

title: Financing Urban Ecosystem Resilience: A Sentinel-2-Based Parametric Insurance Prototype for Coastal Cities

detail.title: Financing Urban Ecosystem Resilience: A Sentinel-2-Based Parametric Insurance Prototype for Coastal Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of Interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No subjects involved
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: Urban green zones-including mangroves, wetlands, parks, and grasslands-play a vital role in buffering cities against climate-related hazards such as floods, droughts, and heatwaves. Yet, these ecological assets remain largely excluded from formal climate risk financing frameworks. This study introduces a novel parametric insurance prototype that links satellite-derived vegetation health indicators to rapid financing for ecosystem restoration. Using Sentinel-2 imagery from 2018 to 2023, monthly Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) values were extracted across delineated green zones in four highly exposed coastal cities: Mumbai, Jakarta, Manila, and Nairobi. Dynamic seasonal NDVI baselines were constructed, and trigger thresholds were defined as a 30% decline from rolling three-month norms. Simulated payouts were generated for each trigger event, and basis risk was evaluated by comparing NDVI-based triggers with historical flood disaster records from EM-DAT. Results show that 15-38% of NDVI trigger events coincide with recorded floods, with stronger temporal alignment in mangrove and wetland areas where large NDVI anomalies appear within one to two months of major events. Sensitivity analysis indicates that mangroves and wetlands consistently exhibit higher trigger frequencies and payout volumes, highlighting their dual role as risk buffers and restoration priorities. While Sentinel-2 provides scalable and consistent monitoring across cities, the framework can be enhanced through rapid drone or field validation to improve trigger accuracy and stakeholder confidence. Overall, the study demonstrates the feasibility of remote-sensing-based insurance mechanisms for urban nature and outlines a pathway to integrate ecological performance into disaster recovery finance, climate adaptation, and CSR-funded restoration programs in data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于卫星植被健康指标的参数化保险原型，将城市绿地的生态表现与气候风险融资相结合，为生态系统恢复提供快速资金支持。
AI.research_question: 如何将城市绿地的生态表现纳入气候风险融资框架，通过卫星遥感数据建立参数化保险机制？
AI.motivation: 城市绿地在缓冲气候灾害方面发挥重要作用，但现有气候风险融资框架中这些生态资产被排除在外，需要创新机制将其纳入风险管理体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于参数化保险理论，结合生态恢复融资和遥感监测技术，构建将生态表现与金融工具连接的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用Sentinel-2卫星影像（2018-2023年），提取孟买、雅加达、马尼拉和内罗毕四个沿海城市绿地的月度NDVI值，建立动态季节性基线，定义触发阈值（30%偏离三个月滚动均值），模拟赔付并评估基差风险。
AI.findings: 15-38%的NDVI触发事件与历史洪水记录重合，红树林和湿地区域的NDVI异常在重大事件后1-2个月内出现，表现出更高的触发频率和赔付量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将生态表现纳入风险融资的理论框架，拓展了参数化保险在生态风险管理中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据稀缺地区提供了可扩展的生态保险机制，可整合到灾害恢复融资、气候适应和企业社会责任资助的恢复项目中。

title: Forecasting Macro with Finance
affiliations: University of Cambridge, Faculty of Economics and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Forecasting Macro with Finance
detail.abstract: While financial markets are known to contain information about future economic developments, the channels through which asset prices enhance macroeconomic forecastability remain insufficiently understood. We develop a structured set of like-for-like experiments to isolate which data and model properties drive forecasting power. Using U.S. data on inflation, industrial production, unemployment and equity returns, we test eight hypotheses along two dimensions: the contribution of financial data given different estimation methods and model classes, and the role of model choice given different financial inputs. Data aspects include cross-sectional granularity, intra-period frequency, and real-time, revisionless availability; model aspects include sparsity, direct versus indirect specification, nonlinearity, and state dependence on volatile periods. We find that financial data can deliver consistent and economically meaningful gains, but only under suitable modeling choices: Random Forest most reliably extracts useful signals, whereas an unregularised VAR often fails to do so; by contrast, expanding the financial information set along granularity, frequency, or real-time dimensions yields little systematic benefit. Gains strengthen somewhat under elevated policy uncertainty, especially for inflation, but are otherwise fragile. The analysis clarifies how data and model choices interact and provides practical guidance for forecasters on when and how to use financial inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化实验发现，金融数据只有在合适的建模方法下才能提升宏观经济预测能力，其中随机森林模型表现最佳，而扩展金融数据的粒度、频率或实时性维度带来的系统性收益有限。
AI.research_question: 金融数据通过哪些渠道增强宏观经济预测能力？数据和模型选择如何影响预测效果？
AI.motivation: 虽然金融市场包含未来经济发展的信息，但资产价格提升宏观经济可预测性的具体渠道仍不够清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于预测理论和金融经济学，探讨数据属性（横截面粒度、期内频率、实时性）与模型属性（稀疏性、直接/间接设定、非线性、状态依赖性）的交互作用。
AI.method: 使用美国通胀、工业生产、失业率和股票收益率数据，设计结构化对照实验，测试8个假设，比较不同估计方法和模型类别下金融数据的贡献。
AI.findings: 金融数据能在合适的建模选择下带来一致且有经济意义的好处，随机森林模型最可靠地提取有用信号，而无约束VAR模型往往失败；扩展金融信息集在粒度、频率或实时性维度上收益有限；政策不确定性高时收益略有增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了数据和模型选择如何相互作用影响预测效果，深化了对金融数据预测渠道的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测者提供了关于何时以及如何使用金融输入的实际指导，帮助优化宏观经济预测实践。

title: Corruption and Sustainable Development Goal 17: Partnership for the Goals
affiliations: James Cook University - College of Business, Law and Governance,, Social Sciences University of Ankara and Le Moyne College

detail.title: Corruption and Sustainable Development Goal 17: Partnership for the Goals
detail.abstract: This chapter examines how corruption undermines Sustainable Development Goal 17 (SDG 17). Developing countries continue to face large investment gaps, rising debt burdens, technological lags, and limited institutional capacity to achieve the SDGs. SDG 17 emphasizes the need to strengthen global partnerships to mobilize domestic and external financial resources, promote trade, foster technology transfer, and build institutional capacity. This chapter explores how corruption poses a major challenge to achieving these targets by weakening institutions, increasing transaction costs and uncertainty, reducing external financial flows, and misallocating resources. It also reduces the effectiveness of foreign aid and hinders technological innovation and adoption. In addition, the chapter discusses the potential of various anti-corruption measures such as Freedom of Information laws, Information and Communication Technology tools, and global partnerships to help reduce corruption and support the broader goals of sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨腐败如何破坏可持续发展目标17（SDG 17），分析腐败通过削弱制度、增加交易成本、减少外部资金流动和资源错配等方式阻碍全球伙伴关系建设，并讨论反腐败措施如信息自由法、ICT工具和全球伙伴关系的潜力。
AI.research_question: 腐败如何破坏可持续发展目标17（SDG 17）的实现？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家在实现可持续发展目标时面临巨大的投资缺口、不断上升的债务负担、技术滞后和有限的制度能力，而腐败可能对这些挑战产生负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学和治理理论，探讨腐败对发展合作和资源分配的负面影响。
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述，探讨腐败与SDG 17各目标之间的关联机制。
AI.findings: 腐败通过削弱制度、增加交易成本和不确定性、减少外部资金流动、资源错配、降低外援效果以及阻碍技术创新和采用等方式，严重破坏SDG 17的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对腐败在发展合作中负面作用的理解，建立了腐败与可持续发展目标实现之间的理论联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了信息自由法、信息通信技术工具和全球伙伴关系等具体反腐败措施，为政策制定者提供了支持可持续发展目标实现的实际建议。

title: Will Intra-African Trade Reach a New Level? Opportunities, challenges, and pathways forward for the African Continental Free Trade Agreement and its effects on food security
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and German Institute of Development and Sustainability (IDOS)

detail.title: Will Intra-African Trade Reach a New Level? Opportunities, challenges, and pathways forward for the African Continental Free Trade Agreement and its effects on food security

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to declare

detail.abstract: This paper examines the current progress made with the African Continental Free Trade Agreement (AfCFTA), its implementation challenges, and its implications for food security. While 48 African countries have ratified the agreement, full trading under AfCFTA preferences remains limited, with only 10 countries actively participating in the Guided Trade Initiative as of February 2025. The paper analyzes three critical implementation barriers: the verification and gazetting of tariff concessions, ongoing negotiations regarding Rules of Origin—particularly for complex sectors like textiles, clothing, and automobiles—and the persistently low level of intra-African trade (currently 15% of merchandise trade and 20% of food trade). The paper emphasizes that, while tariff reductions alone provide minimal benefit due to already low intra-regional tariffs, reducing nontariff trade barriers is essential for realizing AfCFTA's economic potential. This study concludes that achieving meaningful progress requires large-scale investments in intra-African transport infrastructure, substantial reductions in trade bureaucracy, harmonization of food safety standards, and flexible regulatory frameworks for low-value consignments to address current trade disruptions and enable full implementation across all member states.​

AI.tldr: 本文分析了非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的实施进展、挑战及其对粮食安全的影响。尽管48个国家已批准该协议，但实际贸易参与有限。研究识别了三大实施障碍：关税减让验证、原产地规则谈判以及低水平的区内贸易。研究强调降低非关税贸易壁垒比关税减让更重要，建议投资交通基础设施、简化贸易程序、统一食品安全标准以实现AfCFTA的潜力。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）的实施进展如何？面临哪些主要挑战？以及这些因素如何影响非洲的粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 尽管非洲大陆自由贸易区已获48个国家批准，但实际贸易参与度很低，仅有10个国家积极参与指导贸易倡议。这种实施差距对非洲的经济发展和粮食安全构成了重要挑战，需要深入分析实施障碍并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域经济一体化理论、贸易便利化理论和粮食安全理论，分析自由贸易区实施对贸易流动和粮食可获得性的影响。
AI.method: 通过分析AfCFTA的实施现状数据、贸易统计和政策文件，识别关键实施障碍并评估其对粮食安全的影响。
AI.findings: AfCFTA实施面临三大主要障碍：1）关税减让的验证和公布程序复杂；2）原产地规则谈判进展缓慢，特别是在纺织、服装和汽车等复杂行业；3）非洲区内贸易水平低（商品贸易占15%，粮食贸易占20%）。由于区内关税已较低，关税减让的收益有限，降低非关税贸易壁垒更为关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家区域贸易协定实施挑战的理解，特别是非关税壁垒在贸易一体化中的关键作用，为区域经济一体化理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的实施建议：大规模投资区内交通基础设施、大幅减少贸易官僚程序、统一食品安全标准、建立低价值货物灵活监管框架，以促进AfCFTA的全面实施和改善非洲粮食安全。

title: Redevelopment and Gentrification in General Equilibrium
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Redevelopment and Gentrification in General Equilibrium
detail.abstract: Redevelopment is a major source of housing supply in dense cities, but it is spatially concentrated and often associated with gentrification and displacement. This paper studies the equilibrium consequences of redevelopment and of policies that restrict it. We first empirically evaluate a teardown tax implemented in two Chicago neighborhoods using a spatial difference-indifferences design and find that it substantially reduced demolitions and modestly curbed displacement. We then develop a dynamic general equilibrium model with forward-looking landlords who choose when to redevelop and heterogeneous households who choose across neighborhoods and vertically differentiated housing units. Redevelopment affects income sorting across neighborhoods and generates filtering dynamics over time. Model counterfactuals show that a spatially targeted teardown tax preserves old, affordable housing in treated areas but shifts redevelopment to untreated areas, raising rents there. The policy benefits lowincome households but harms middle-and high-income households, with the largest losses for the middle. Land values fall in treated areas and rise elsewhere. We conclude with a discussion of the policy implications of our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究芝加哥两个社区实施的拆除税对再开发的影响，发现该政策显著减少拆除活动并适度抑制了人口置换。通过建立动态一般均衡模型分析，发现定向拆除税能保护处理区的旧有可负担住房，但会将再开发转移到未处理区，导致当地租金上涨。政策对低收入家庭有利，但对中高收入家庭不利，其中中等收入家庭损失最大。
AI.research_question: 再开发及其限制政策的均衡后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 再开发是密集城市住房供应的主要来源，但具有空间集中性，常与绅士化和人口置换相关。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型，包含前瞻性房东的再开发决策和异质性家庭在社区间及垂直差异化住房单元的选择。
AI.method: 首先使用空间双重差分设计实证评估芝加哥两个社区的拆除税政策，然后建立理论模型进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 拆除税显著减少拆除活动，适度抑制人口置换；定向拆除税保护处理区可负担住房但转移再开发至未处理区，导致当地租金上涨；政策对低收入家庭有利但对中高收入家庭不利。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含再开发决策和收入分选的动态一般均衡模型，揭示了再开发对社区收入分选和住房过滤动态的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了拆除税政策的空间效应分析，揭示了政策对不同收入群体的差异化影响，有助于设计更精准的住房政策。

title: Highly Disaggregated Disclosure and Cost of Capital: Evidence from the Hospital Price Transparency Requirements
affiliations: Temple University - Department of Accounting, Temple University - Department of Accounting and Temple University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Highly Disaggregated Disclosure and Cost of Capital: Evidence from the Hospital Price Transparency Requirements
detail.abstract: In November 2019, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) issued the Hospital Price Transparency Requirements (HPTR), which for the first time, required hospitals to publicly disclose the actual prices charged to different payers for all individual medical procedures. While this mandate increased the public availability of granular revenue-related data, critics argue it could also raise hospitals' proprietary costs. We find that, after the promulgation of HPTR, yield spreads on hospital municipal bonds declined and bid-ask spreads narrowed relative to comparable municipal bonds not subject to the regulation. The reduction in bond spreads is greatest among hospitals operating in states with more opaque accounting practices, consistent with reductions in information asymmetry driving the effect, and for hospitals operating in more competitive markets, where voluntary price disclosure was previously less likely. The effect is also stronger for hospitals in states with less competitive health-insurance markets, where access to peer price data strengthens hospitals' negotiating leverage with insurers. Our findings suggest that the informational benefits of highly disaggregated price disclosure outweigh purported proprietary costs on average.

AI.tldr: 医院价格透明度规定降低了医院市政债券的收益率利差和买卖价差，表明高度细分的价格披露的信息收益超过了专有成本
AI.research_question: 医院价格透明度规定对医院市政债券市场的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: CMS首次要求医院公开披露各项医疗程序的实际价格，这增加了收入相关数据的公开性，但批评者认为可能增加医院的专有成本
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、专有成本理论
AI.method: 比较受监管医院市政债券与不受监管可比市政债券的收益率利差和买卖价差变化
AI.findings: HPTR实施后，医院市政债券收益率利差下降，买卖价差收窄；在会计实践更不透明的州、竞争更激烈的市场以及健康保险市场竞争较弱的州，这种效应更强
AI.theory_contributions: 为高度细分价格披露的信息收益与专有成本权衡提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 支持价格透明度政策的有效性，为监管机构提供决策依据

title: Ownership Structure and Short Selling Around the World
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Banking and Finance and University of Melbourne, Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Ownership Structure and Short Selling Around the World
detail.abstract: We study how ownership structure affects short selling in 40 stock markets around the world. We show that ownership by non-institutional blockholders reduces the supply of lendable shares available to short sellers, whereas ownership by foreign institutions increases it, and more strongly than domestic institutions. We establish causality by exploiting additions to the MSCI index as plausibly exogenous shocks to ownership structure. Our findings indicate that the effect of ownership structure on lending supply originates from the owners' connections (or the lack thereof) to equity lending market intermediaries and has consequences for short-selling activities globally.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球40个股票市场中所有权结构对卖空活动的影响，发现非机构大股东持股会减少可借出股票的供应，而外国机构持股则会增加供应，且影响强于国内机构。通过MSCI指数纳入作为外生冲击验证了因果关系。
AI.research_question: 所有权结构如何影响全球股票市场的卖空活动？
AI.motivation: 理解不同所有权结构对股票借贷市场的影响机制，特别是大股东类型对可借出股票供应的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于所有权结构与股票借贷市场连接的理论框架，关注不同类型股东与借贷市场中介绍的关系差异。
AI.method: 利用全球40个股票市场数据，采用MSCI指数纳入作为外生冲击来建立因果关系。
AI.findings: 非机构大股东持股减少可借出股票供应，外国机构持股增加供应且影响强于国内机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了所有权结构通过股东与借贷市场中介绍的关系影响股票借贷供应的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球投资者理解卖空约束提供了新视角，对投资策略和风险管理具有实践意义。

title: Redistributing Decision-Making Power and Influence in the AI Ecosystem: A Call for Inclusive Participation of Users and User Organizations
affiliations: InfoSecurity Infrastructure, Inc.

detail.title: Redistributing Decision-Making Power and Influence in the AI Ecosystem: A Call for Inclusive Participation of Users and User Organizations

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: The power to make decisions about the governance and risk management of AI, is now unfairly and dangerously concentrated among certain types of organizations. This concentration of power is inequitable and is already leading to socially undesirable consequences. It is high time for both user organizations and individual users to have more say in their futures. They must be included at decision-making tables if a two-tier system (involving the controllers and the controlled) is to be avoided. This article discusses some details about how that objective might be achieved.

AI.tldr: 本文认为AI治理和风险管理的决策权目前不公平地集中在少数组织手中，这种权力集中已导致不良社会后果，需要让用户组织和个体用户在决策中拥有更多话语权以避免两级分化。
AI.research_question: 如何让用户组织和个体用户在AI治理和风险管理决策中获得更多话语权，避免权力过度集中？
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理和风险管理的决策权过度集中在少数组织手中，这种权力不平等已经产生了不良社会后果，需要改变这种状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于权力分配理论和社会公平理论，探讨AI治理中的权力集中问题。
AI.method: 概念性分析，讨论实现用户参与AI决策的具体途径和方法。
AI.findings: 权力过度集中在AI治理中已造成社会问题，需要通过制度设计让用户参与决策来避免两级分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI治理中权力分配的理论框架，强调用户参与决策的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为如何让用户组织和个体用户参与AI决策提供了具体实现路径的建议。

title: Football matches and policing: Evidence from London
affiliations: University of Reading, Newcastle University, University of Reading and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Football matches and policing: Evidence from London
detail.abstract: While the relationship between football matches and crime has been well documented, little is known about whether such events also escalate violent interactions between police officers and civilians. This study addresses that gap by analysing use of force data from the Metropolitan Police Service in London to assess the impact of football matches on police behaviour. We find that on match days, the number of use of force incidents increases by an average of 0.772 in the boroughs where games are held. This effect is geographically concentrated around football stadium and is primarily driven by matches involving popular clubs, or those with violent fan bases. We find no evidence of spatial or temporal displacement of incidents. We also find some suggestive evidence that incidents may be more frequent in the case of unexpected losses. We make the case that despite the long-standing association between football and crime, the effects are considerably smaller compared to other popular mass events.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析伦敦警察厅的使用武力数据，发现足球比赛日会增加警察与平民之间的暴力互动，特别是在比赛举办区平均增加0.772起武力使用事件，且效果集中在足球场周边，主要受热门俱乐部或暴力球迷群体的比赛驱动。
AI.research_question: 足球比赛是否加剧了警察与平民之间的暴力互动？
AI.motivation: 虽然足球比赛与犯罪的关系已有充分记录，但关于此类事件是否也会加剧警察与平民之间暴力互动的研究尚属空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于足球比赛作为大规模聚集事件可能引发冲突的理论框架，探讨其对警察执法行为的影响。
AI.method: 分析伦敦警察厅的使用武力数据，评估足球比赛对警察行为的影响。
AI.findings: 比赛日武力使用事件在举办区平均增加0.772起；效果地理集中在足球场周边；主要由热门俱乐部或暴力球迷群体的比赛驱动；无时空位移证据；意外失利时事件可能更频繁。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了足球比赛对警察-平民暴力互动影响的研究空白，提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为警察部门在足球比赛日的警力部署提供参考，尽管影响相对其他大型活动较小，但仍需针对性管理。

title: Intelligent and Secure Communication Systems: Signal Processing, AI, and Cloud-Enabled Architectures for Next-Generation Networks
affiliations: Cosendai Adventist University, Cosendai Adventist University, Cosendai Adventist University and Cosendai Adventist University

detail.title: Intelligent and Secure Communication Systems: Signal Processing, AI, and Cloud-Enabled Architectures for Next-Generation Networks
detail.abstract: The exponential growth in connected devices and data-intensive applications necessitates fundamental transformation in communication systems through convergence of advanced signal processing, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing. This review examines architectural evolution and technological innovations shaping intelligent and secure communication systems for next-generation networks, analyzing developments from 2020 to 2025 with projections through 2035. Analysis of AIdriven signal processing techniques demonstrates 8-12 dB SNR improvements in channel estimation and 35 percent capacity gains in beamforming through deep learning approaches. Neural network-based detectors achieve 75 percent complexity reduction while maintaining superior performance compared to traditional methods. Cloud-enabled architectures show 40-50 percent CAPEX reduction and 85-90 percent resource utilization through intelligent orchestration, from centralized Cloud-RAN to Open RAN implementations. Security analysis addresses AI-enhanced mechanisms achieving 92-98 percent threat detection accuracy and emerging vulnerabilities in AI-enabled networks. Quantumsafe communication strategies and integration timelines reveal challenges in maintaining security-performance trade-offs. The paper synthesizes standardization efforts across 3GPP, IEEE, and open-source initiatives, mapping regulatory landscapes across major markets. Analysis of 6G enabling technologies projects terahertz communications delivering 1 Tbps peak rates, reconfigurable intelligent surfaces with 100K elements, and AI-native air interfaces achieving complete intelligent optimization by 2030. Semantic communications potentially offer substantial efficiency gains, while federated learning enables privacy-preserving network intelligence. Cross-layer optimization strategies demonstrate 40-45 percent improvements in resource utilization and quality of experience metrics. This work provides researchers, engineers, and policymakers with a framework for advancing intelligent, secure, and sustainable next-generation communication systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2020-2025年智能安全通信系统的发展，分析了AI驱动的信号处理、云架构、安全机制和6G技术，为下一代通信系统提供发展框架。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AI、云计算和先进信号处理的融合，构建智能安全的下一代通信系统？
AI.motivation: 连接设备和数据密集型应用的指数增长需要通信系统进行根本性转型，整合先进信号处理、人工智能和云计算技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI驱动的信号处理理论、云计算架构理论、网络安全理论和6G通信理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析2020-2025年的技术发展，并预测至2035年的趋势。
AI.findings: AI信号处理提升SNR 8-12dB，容量增益35%；神经网络检测器复杂度降低75%；云架构CAPEX降低40-50%，资源利用率85-90%；AI安全机制威胁检测准确率92-98%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了智能安全通信系统的理论框架，整合了AI、云计算和安全机制的多维度理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、工程师和政策制定者提供了推进智能、安全、可持续下一代通信系统的实用框架和具体技术路径。

title: Competition and Collaboration in the AI Race: Country-Level Causal Evidence for Risk Management and Policy
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - Edinburgh Business School, University of Edinburgh Business School, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Kent, Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics, Georgia Institute of Technology - College of Engineering and University of Virginia - Systems and Information Engineering

detail.title: Competition and Collaboration in the AI Race: Country-Level Causal Evidence for Risk Management and Policy
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly intertwined with national economies, yet country-level causal pathways remain difficult to identify. Using annual U.S. and China data from 1980 to 2020, we triangulate Pattern Causality, Granger causality, VECM-based cointegration, and lead-lag correlation to map directional links between AI R&D and core macro aggregates with weighted networks and heatmaps. Three findings are robust. First, nonlinear AI-macro dependence is 1 moderate and mostly positive, which is useful for monitoring rather than as a stand-alone trigger. Second, publications and patents display broad short-run predictive links, supporting their use as early-warning signals. Third, cointegration places AI as the long-run follower, so policy should target macro fundamentals to unlock AI payoffs. Adding U.S.-China collaboration variables increases AI embeddedness more in China than in the U.S. Collaboration is a measurable policy lever, and decoupling risks foregone spillovers. The U.S. pathway is patent-driven and selective. China's pathway is denser and collaboration-led, implying tailored risk-management priorities. Triangulation across methods reduces single-test overreach and supports risk-aware policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多种因果分析方法发现AI与宏观经济存在适度正相关，AI出版物和专利可作为短期预警信号，AI在长期是宏观经济的跟随者，中美合作对中国的AI嵌入度影响更大。
AI.research_question: AI研发与核心宏观经济指标之间的因果路径是什么？
AI.motivation: AI日益融入国民经济，但国家层面的因果路径仍难以识别
AI.theoretical_framework: 模式因果性、格兰杰因果性、基于VECM的协整分析、领先-滞后相关性
AI.method: 使用1980-2020年美中年度数据，通过加权网络和热图分析AI研发与宏观总量的方向性联系
AI.findings: 1. AI-宏观依赖关系适度且多为正相关；2. 出版物和专利具有广泛的短期预测联系；3. 协整分析显示AI是长期跟随者
AI.theory_contributions: 通过多种方法三角验证减少单一测试的过度推断，支持风险感知的政策设计
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供指导：应关注宏观基本面以释放AI收益，合作是可衡量的政策杠杆，脱钩会错失溢出效应

title: Who Authors the Internet? Analyzing Gender Diversity in ChatGPT-3 Training Data
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh and University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: Who Authors the Internet? Analyzing Gender Diversity in ChatGPT-3 Training Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
We conducted an analysis of the publicly-disclosed ChatGPT-3 training corpus, which comprises datasets including Common Crawl, WebText2, and filtered portions of public domain books and Wikipedia. With available data, we infer the percentage of primary authors across these sources in order to quanify degree of gender diversity influencing the LLM’s worldview.

We find an underrepresentation of content authored by women, demonstrating that the 'voice' of the foundational internet knowledge base is overwhelmingly male-dominated. Moreover, a major takeaway is that the opacity of proprietary training datasets severely limits researchers' ability to fully estimate and assess gender representation, underscoring the need for greater transparency to assess these systems and their potential biases.

AI.tldr: 分析了ChatGPT-3训练语料库的性别多样性，发现女性作者内容代表性不足，训练数据不透明限制了研究者评估性别代表性的能力。
AI.research_question: ChatGPT-3训练语料库中不同性别作者的内容代表性如何？
AI.motivation: 评估大型语言模型训练数据的性别多样性，了解其对模型世界观的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别代表性理论、算法偏见理论、数据透明度理论
AI.method: 分析公开的ChatGPT-3训练语料库（包括Common Crawl、WebText2、公共领域书籍和维基百科），推断不同性别作者的比例
AI.findings: 女性作者内容代表性不足，互联网知识基础的声音主要由男性主导；专有训练数据的不透明性严重限制了研究者评估性别代表性的能力
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了大型语言模型训练数据中的性别偏见问题，强调了数据透明度对算法公平性的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁提高训练数据的透明度，为评估和减轻AI系统的潜在偏见提供基础

title: Credit Risk and Systemic Spillovers from an Unexpected Bank Rescue: Evidence from India
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Credit Risk and Systemic Spillovers from an Unexpected Bank Rescue: Evidence from India
detail.abstract: I exploit an unexpected rescue of a private sector bank to examine spillover effects on other banks. The unprecedented protection of shareholder claims in the failed bank increases bailout expectations among other private sector banks, triggering two opposing channels of systemic risk. Affected banks engage in individual risk-shifting by increasing credit risk, lending more to risky borrowers, and restructuring loans. Yet, they also increase loan specialization due to weaker incentives to correlate assets with peers. On net, their contribution to systemic risk rises by about 23%, highlighting how bailouts can reshape risk-taking and amplify fragility across the banking system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用一家私营银行意外获救的事件，研究对其他银行的溢出效应。研究发现，对失败银行股东权益的保护提高了其他私营银行的救助预期，通过两个相反渠道影响系统性风险：一方面银行增加个体风险承担（提高信贷风险、向高风险借款人放贷），另一方面通过贷款专业化减少与同行的资产相关性。净效应是系统性风险贡献上升约23%。
AI.research_question: 银行救助如何通过影响其他银行的救助预期来改变其风险承担行为，进而影响系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 理解银行救助政策对金融系统稳定性的意外后果，特别是救助预期如何重塑银行的风险承担激励
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于道德风险理论和系统性风险理论，分析救助预期对银行风险承担行为的双重影响机制
AI.method: 利用一家私营银行意外获救的自然实验，采用实证分析方法检验对其他银行风险承担行为和系统性风险贡献的影响
AI.findings: 救助预期触发两个相反渠道：个体风险转移（增加信贷风险）和贷款专业化（减少资产相关性），但净效应是系统性风险贡献上升23%
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了救助政策通过救助预期渠道对系统性风险的复杂影响机制，拓展了道德风险理论在银行系统性风险中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计更有效的银行救助政策提供重要启示，强调需要权衡个体银行稳定与系统性风险的关系

title: Neural Fractional Stochastic Differential Equations
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London and University of Edinburgh

detail.title: Neural Fractional Stochastic Differential Equations
detail.abstract: Fractional-order differential equations (FDEs) excel at modelling systems with long-range memory, but many such systems also exhibit stochastic behaviour. While existing neural differential equation models can capture either memory effects (Neural FDEs) or stochastic dynamics (Neural SDEs), a framework that efficiently combines both is lacking. We introduce the Neural Fractional Stochastic Differential Equation (Neural FSDE), a model that learns continuous-time dynamics with both memory and randomness from data. To enable scalable training, we derive an adjoint sensitivity method for Neural FSDEs. We demonstrate its practical utility on an option pricing task, where our Neural FSDE not only achieves superior accuracy compared to strong baselines like rough volatility models and standard Neural SDEs, but also offers an order-of-magnitude speedup in calibration time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了神经分数随机微分方程（Neural FSDE）模型，能够同时捕捉系统记忆效应和随机行为，在期权定价任务中表现出更高的准确性和更快的校准速度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时有效捕捉系统记忆效应和随机行为的连续时间动态模型？
AI.motivation: 现有的神经微分方程模型只能单独处理记忆效应（神经FDEs）或随机动态（神经SDEs），缺乏一个能够高效结合两者的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数阶微分方程（FDEs）理论、随机微分方程（SDEs）理论、神经微分方程框架。
AI.method: 提出了神经分数随机微分方程（Neural FSDE）模型，并推导了其伴随灵敏度方法以实现可扩展训练。
AI.findings: 在期权定价任务中，Neural FSDE不仅比粗糙波动率模型和标准神经SDEs等强基线获得更高的准确性，而且在校准时间上实现了数量级的加速。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了能够同时建模记忆效应和随机行为的神经分数随机微分方程框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为具有长期记忆和随机行为的系统提供了实用的建模工具，在金融期权定价等应用中具有显著优势。

title: The Dual-Class Stock Revolution
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law and Tel Aviv University - Buchmann Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Dual-Class Stock Revolution
detail.abstract: One of the most striking developments in American capital markets over the past three decades is the surge of dual-class stock structures in initial public offerings (IPOs). From just a few percent, dual-class stock companies have now reached about a third of all IPOs. While the virtues and vices of dual-class structures are hotly debated, the underlying reasons for their recent spike have surprisingly received little attention. This Article offers a novel explanation for the rise of dual-class IPOs, focusing on two intertwined developments: the decline of traditional anti-takeover provisions and the rise of shareholder activism as the primary threat to management. We argue that these two developments fueled the rise of dual-class share structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了双类股IPO激增的新解释，认为传统反收购条款的衰落和股东积极主义作为管理层主要威胁的兴起共同推动了双类股结构的崛起。
AI.research_question: 美国资本市场中双类股IPO结构激增的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 过去三十年间，双类股IPO从仅占几个百分点增长到约三分之一，但其激增原因却鲜有研究关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、反收购机制理论、股东积极主义理论
AI.method: 理论分析和实证观察
AI.findings: 传统反收购条款的衰落和股东积极主义的兴起共同推动了双类股结构的崛起。
AI.theory_contributions: 为双类股结构激增提供了新的理论解释框架，连接了反收购机制演变与股东积极主义的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解现代公司治理结构的演变，为政策制定者和投资者提供决策参考。

title: The Intermediary Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Vienna University of Economics and Business and Goethe University Frankfurt - Graduate School of Economics, Finance and Management (GSEFM)

detail.title: The Intermediary Channel of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how monetary policy shocks propagate to asset prices via their impact on financial intermediaries. Based on high-frequency U.S. financial sector equity returns around FOMC announcements, we first document a striking reversal in the effects of monetary policy on intermediaries: while tightening surprises depressed financial sector stocks relative to the market prior to the Great Financial Crisis, they raised intermediary stock prices during the monetary policy normalization from 2013 to 2019, particularly for firms with lower net interest margins, higher risk and greater deposit dependence. We then document that intermediary announcement returns have strong predictive power for asset price changes around FOMC announcements-in particular for financial conditions and risk perceptions-and convey information beyond what is captured by common policy surprise measures and the reaction of the broad stock market. Our results illustrate that announcement returns of the U.S. financial sector constitute a concise, forwardlooking measure of policy-induced shifts in financial sector health and highlight the role of intermediaries in shaping the risk-taking channel of monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现货币政策冲击通过影响金融中介机构传导至资产价格的机制。基于FOMC公告期间美国金融部门高频股票回报数据，发现货币政策对中介机构的影响在金融危机前后出现显著逆转：紧缩政策在危机前抑制金融股表现，但在2013-2019年政策正常化期间反而提升了中介机构股价，特别是对净息差较低、风险较高和存款依赖度较高的公司。中介机构公告回报对FOMC公告期间的资产价格变化具有强预测能力。
AI.research_question: 货币政策冲击如何通过金融中介机构传导至资产价格？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策通过金融中介渠道影响资产价格的机制，特别是在金融危机前后这一传导机制的变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、金融中介理论、风险承担渠道
AI.method: 基于FOMC公告期间美国金融部门高频股票回报数据的实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 货币政策对金融中介的影响在金融危机前后出现显著逆转；2) 中介机构公告回报对资产价格变化具有强预测能力；3) 中介机构在货币政策风险承担渠道中发挥重要作用
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了货币政策通过金融中介传导的新机制，深化了对风险承担渠道的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了衡量政策诱导金融部门健康状况的前瞻性指标，为政策制定者和投资者提供决策参考

title: "Going the Distance:" Images in Corporate ESG Reports
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Finance, Investment and Banking, Idaho State University, New York University (NYU) - Department of Accounting, Rutgers University, Newark, School of Business-Newark, Department of Finance & Economics and

detail.title: "Going the Distance:" Images in Corporate ESG Reports
detail.abstract: We show that the information content in ESG report images is associated with ratings. We construct novel visual informative metrics including Content Reinforcement-how much image content reinforces text, Closeness-image proximity to text, and Potency-reinforced word frequency. All metrics are consistently associated with 6,318 Refinitiv report ratings (2005-2022) irrespective of image-reinforced text distance or sentence importance. Results hold under Principal Component Analysis. In a quasi-experimental setting, analysis of TruValue ratings, which do not rely on human evaluation (unlike Refinitiv), reveals no association with images, suggesting a causative link between images and human information processing.

AI.tldr: ESG报告中的图像信息含量与评级相关。研究发现图像内容与文本的强化程度、图像与文本的接近度以及强化词频等视觉指标与Refinitiv评级显著相关，但在不依赖人工评估的TruValue评级中无此关联，表明图像通过影响人类信息处理来影响评级。
AI.research_question: ESG报告中的图像信息是否与ESG评级相关？
AI.motivation: 探讨ESG报告中图像内容对评级的影响，特别是图像如何通过人类信息处理机制影响评级决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类信息处理理论和视觉传达理论，研究图像在ESG报告中的信息传递作用。

title: ASSESSING TRADE COMPETITIVENESS IN KAZAKHSTAN'S VEGETABLE EXPORTS: EVIDENCE FROM RCA, RTA, RSCA AND TBI INDICES
affiliations: and Sumgait State University

detail.title: ASSESSING TRADE COMPETITIVENESS IN KAZAKHSTAN'S VEGETABLE EXPORTS: EVIDENCE FROM RCA, RTA, RSCA AND TBI INDICES
detail.abstract: This study analyses Kazakhstan's trade competitiveness in the vegetable sector by applying the Revealed Comparative Advantage (RCA), Revealed Symmetric Comparative Advantage (RSCA), Relative Trade Advantage (RTA), and Trade Balance Index (TBI). The analysis spans 2017 to 2024 and utilizes international trade data from the International Trade Center (ITC) and national statistical sources. Additionally, 2024 export market data are incorporated to evaluate the geographical concentration and value distribution of key products across major destinations. The results reveal a highly asymmetric export structure, with strong comparative and trade advantages concentrated in a few leguminous products, particularly HS-071340 (Dried, shelled lentils, whether or not skinned or split) and HS-071310 (Dried, shelled peas "Pisum sativum", whether or not skinned or split), while most fresh vegetables remain import-dependent and weakly competitive. Leguminous crops consistently recorded positive RCA, RSCA, and RTA values, along with strong TBI surpluses, confirming Kazakhstan's specialization and comparative strength in this segment. In contrast, products such as potatoes, tomatoes, and carrots exhibited persistently negative values across all the indices. Export statistics further indicate a high level of market concentration, with Türkiye, Uzbekistan, Afghanistan, and Russia accounting for the majority of the export value in 2024. These findings highlight the dual nature of Kazakhstan's vegetable trade: a competitive, exportoriented segment alongside a structurally constrained, import-reliant segment. Strengthening technological capacity, investing in cold chain infrastructure, and diversifying export destinations are essential for enhancing long-term competitiveness and resilience in the sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用RCA、RSCA、RTA和TBI指数分析哈萨克斯坦蔬菜部门的贸易竞争力，发现其出口结构高度不对称，豆类产品具有强竞争力而新鲜蔬菜依赖进口，建议加强技术能力和冷链基础设施。

AI.method: 使用2017-2024年国际贸易数据，应用RCA、RSCA、RTA和TBI指数进行定量分析，结合2024年出口市场数据评估地理集中度。

title: Exclusive Contracts in the Video Streaming Market

detail.title: Exclusive Contracts in the Video Streaming Market
detail.abstract: I study who gains and who loses from exclusive contracts in the video streaming market, where studios grant streaming services exclusive rights to distribute their content. Streaming services can use these contracts to differentiate their content offerings and soften competition, while studios may leverage them to negotiate higher license fees from streaming services. I develop and estimate a structural model that incorporates bargaining between streaming services and studios, streaming services setting subscription prices, and consumer demand for subscriptions and titles. I find that streaming services that lack in-house content (like Hulu) gain from exclusive contracts, while those with extensive in-house content (like Netflix) see minimal or even negative effects. For studios, exclusive contracts benefit small studios with weak bargaining power but harm large ones with strong bargaining power. While exclusive contracts harm consumers due to reduced title distribution and higher subscription prices, they may benefit consumers in the long run by stimulating content production and streaming service entry.

title: Factor Stability Under Universe Expansion: Evidence from Indian Equities, 2005-2025
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd

detail.title: Factor Stability Under Universe Expansion: Evidence from Indian Equities, 2005-2025
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether expanding the Indian equity universe impacts Fama-French, momentum, and low-risk factors. Analysing data from October 2005 to September 2025, we study the effect of increasing the firm universe from 5,447 to 6,104 on six factors using nonparametric tests and multivariate regressions to check for structural breaks in factor premia. Results show factor returns remain consistent post-expansion, with mean differences under one basis point monthly and adjusted R-squared close to 1. This indicates the robustness of the percentile-based size methodology and stability of factor estimates in Indian equities. The study adds to literature on factor robustness in emerging markets, confirming universe expansion does not affect well-specified factor model reliability in portfolio construction and research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度股票市场扩容对Fama-French、动量、低风险因子的影响。通过对2005-2025年数据的分析，发现股票数量从5,447只增加到6,104只后，因子收益保持稳定，月均差异小于1个基点，调整R方接近1，表明因子模型在印度市场具有稳健性。
AI.research_question: 印度股票市场扩容是否会影响Fama-French、动量和低风险因子的表现？
AI.motivation: 随着印度股票市场不断发展和扩容，需要验证因子模型在市场结构变化时的稳健性，为投资组合构建和研究提供可靠依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Fama-French三因子模型、动量因子和低风险因子理论框架，研究市场扩容对这些因子稳定性的影响。

AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场因子稳健性研究提供实证证据，验证了基于百分位规模方法的稳健性。

title: The Economics of a Burger: Testing the Balassa-Samuelson Effect Using the Big Mac Index (2024-2025 Data)

detail.title: The Economics of a Burger: Testing the Balassa-Samuelson Effect Using the Big Mac Index (2024-2025 Data)
detail.abstract: This paper empirically investigates the Balassa-Samuelson effect using The Economist's Big Mac Index for 2024-2025. By relating burger prices to GDP per capita, we test the hypothesis that richer countries exhibit higher price levels due to productivity-driven wage spillovers into non-tradable sectors. Results confirm a strong positive association (elasticity ≈ 0.4), validating the intuitive link between income and cost of living.

title: COMMENTARY: REVISITING EARNINGS MANAGEMENT WITH A FOCUS ON THE IMPACT OF SOX AND AUDITING
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Paul Merage School of Business

detail.title: COMMENTARY: REVISITING EARNINGS MANAGEMENT WITH A FOCUS ON THE IMPACT OF SOX AND AUDITING

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I attest that I have no financial conflicts or any other conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: In this commentary, I revisit the issue of earnings management (EM) more than 35 years after Schipper’s (1989) influential commentary on the subject. Revisiting is timely as important legislative, regulatory, and other events have occurred since 1989, including accounting fraud scandals, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and increased regulation of auditing, and the EM literature’s evolution and recognition that managers can use real activities to manage earnings as well as, or in place of, accounting-based EM techniques. I discuss some key findings of EM research, examples of professional literature pronouncements and their EM effects, and focus on the likely impact of SOX and auditing on EM. Recent research evidence supports the continuation of early results showing a decline in accounting-based EM post-SOX; the weakening of the substitution between accounting-based and real EM post-SOX; and external auditors constraining EM in settings of heightened pressure on clients to manage earnings.

title: All Betas Are Not the Same
affiliations: and

detail.title: All Betas Are Not the Same
detail.abstract: This study revisits the beta anomaly by decomposing beta into two components: industry-related and stock-specific. Both components reduce portfolio volatility when used to lower beta exposure; however, only the stock-specific (residual) component is associated with a meaningful return premium. In contrast, the industry component, while effective for risk reduction, offers little or no compensation in terms of excess return. This distinction refines our understanding of beta as a risk factor and offers practical implications for asset pricing and portfolio construction. The results highlight the value of disentangling systematic risk into its underlying sources in order to more effectively interpret and exploit the low beta anomaly.

title: When Supply Becomes a Demand Signal: Evidence from UK Gilt Issuance

detail.title: When Supply Becomes a Demand Signal: Evidence from UK Gilt Issuance
detail.abstract: For decades, research on sovereign-debt issuance has centred on whether uniform or discriminatory-price auctions best minimise government borrowing costs. This paper argues that the debate may have overlooked subtle design features that can meaningfully affect outcomes. I study the United Kingdom's Post-Auction Option Facility (PAOF)-introduced in 2009-which allows the Debt Management Office, after observing the bid book, to decide whether to activate the facility and sell an additional tranche to winners at the average accepted price. Using the universe of gilt auctions from 1998 to 2017, I find three main results. First, primary dealers bid more aggressively after the PAOF's introduction. Second, the mechanism reduced total fiscal cost by roughly £1.2 billion. Third, the DMO's activation decision-announced with results-moves secondary prices in opposite directions: activation raises prices (lowers yields), while non-activation depresses them, consistent with the model's signaling channel. Together, these findings show that even small, responsive-issuance mechanisms can enhance information revelation and materially lower sovereign borrowing costs without altering the core auction design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了英国2009年引入的拍卖后选择机制（PAOF），发现这种机制能显著降低政府借贷成本约12亿英镑，通过增强信息揭示和信号传递渠道改善拍卖结果。
